nodes.label: AI-Revenue Disclosure Rewrite
nodes.short_label: AI-Revenue Disclosure
nodes.description: The 2026 rewrite of how AI revenue is reported to capital markets: SEC AI-revenue concept release and Corporation Finance staff guidance, audited monthly-revenue and WAU disclosure cadence from foundation labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), Big-3 hyperscaler AI-services 10-Q footnote breakouts (Microsoft Azure AI Services run-rate, Alphabet AI Services segment), AMD AI-accelerator revenue 10-Q segment footnote, AI-accelerator IPO and S-1 disclosure cohort (Cerebras, Tenstorrent, per-counterparty risk-factor tables, hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity disclosure), per-token-margin reporting.

label.en: AI-Revenue Disclosure Rewrite
label.ja: AI売上開示リライト
label.es: Reescritura de divulgación de ingresos de IA
label.fil: AI-Revenue Disclosure Rewrite

short_label.en: AI-Revenue Disclosure
short_label.ja: AI売上開示
short_label.es: Divulgación ingresos IA
short_label.fil: AI-Revenue Disclosure

description.en: The 2026 rewrite of how AI revenue is reported to capital markets: SEC AI-revenue concept release and Corporation Finance staff guidance, audited monthly-revenue and WAU disclosure cadence from foundation labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), Big-3 hyperscaler AI-services 10-Q footnote breakouts (Microsoft Azure AI Services run-rate, Alphabet AI Services segment), AMD AI-accelerator revenue 10-Q segment footnote, AI-accelerator IPO and S-1 disclosure cohort (Cerebras, Tenstorrent, per-counterparty risk-factor tables, hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity disclosure), per-token-margin reporting.
description.ja: AI売上が資本市場にどう報告されるかの2026年リライト: SECのAI売上コンセプトリリースとCorporation Financeスタッフガイダンス、ファウンデーションラボ (OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI) による監査済み月次売上・WAU開示の定期化、Big-3ハイパースケーラのAIサービス10-Q脚注開示 (Microsoft Azure AIサービス・ランレート、Alphabet AIサービス・セグメント)、AMDのAIアクセラレータ売上10-Qセグメント脚注、AIアクセラレータIPO・S-1開示コホート (Cerebras、Tenstorrent、相手先別リスクファクター表、ハイパースケーラ・アンカーのワラント持分開示)、トークン単位マージン報告。
description.es: La reescritura de 2026 sobre cómo se reportan los ingresos de IA a los mercados de capitales: concept release de ingresos de IA de la SEC y guía del personal de Corporation Finance, cadencia de divulgación de ingresos mensuales auditados y WAU de los laboratorios fundacionales (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), desgloses en notas 10-Q de servicios de IA de los Big-3 hyperscalers (run-rate de Azure AI Services de Microsoft, segmento AI Services de Alphabet), nota de segmento 10-Q de ingresos por aceleradores AI de AMD, cohorte de divulgación de IPO y S-1 de aceleradores AI (Cerebras, Tenstorrent, tablas de factores de riesgo por contraparte, divulgación de warrant-equity de anclas hyperscaler), reporte de margen por token.
description.fil: Ang 2026 rewrite kung paano iniuulat ang kita ng AI sa capital markets: SEC AI-revenue concept release at staff guidance ng Corporation Finance, cadence ng audited monthly-revenue at WAU disclosure mula sa mga foundation lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), mga 10-Q footnote breakout ng AI-services ng Big-3 hyperscaler (run-rate ng Microsoft Azure AI Services, segment ng Alphabet AI Services), 10-Q segment footnote ng AI-accelerator revenue ng AMD, cohort ng IPO at S-1 disclosure ng AI-accelerator (Cerebras, Tenstorrent, per-counterparty risk-factor tables, warrant-equity disclosure ng hyperscaler-anchor), pag-uulat ng per-token margin.

nodes.description: **"Physical AI 8-hour production runs" become an enterprise procurement requirement in H2 2026.** Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha's **8 hours / 90% success / 60 totes/hour** at Erlangen — on the production line, not a demo — is a clear graduation point from "humanoid = PoC." By Q4 2026, big-manufacturer RFPs (VW / Bosch / Mercedes / Foxconn / TSMC / Toyota) will fold "24h continuous operation," "1-week MTBF," "90%+ autonomous completion rate," and "MES / PLC integration" into de facto cuts. The competitive axis for Physical AI shifts entirely from "good-looking demo videos" to "ease of insertion into existing OT environments." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **"Physical AI 8-hour production runs" become an enterprise procurement requirement in H2 2026.** Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha's **8 hours / 90% success / 60 totes/hour** at Erlangen — on the production line, not a demo — is a clear graduation point from "humanoid = PoC." By Q4 2026, big-manufacturer RFPs (VW / Bosch / Mercedes / Foxconn / TSMC / Toyota) will fold "24h continuous operation," "1-week MTBF," "90%+ autonomous completion rate," and "MES / PLC integration" into de facto cuts. The competitive axis for Physical AI shifts entirely from "good-looking demo videos" to "ease of insertion into existing OT environments." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「Physical AIの8時間連続生産稼働」が2026年下半期に企業調達要件となる。** Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 AlphaがErlangenで記録した**8時間 / 90%成功率 / 60トート/時間** ― デモではなく生産ラインでの実績 ― は、「ヒューマノイド = PoC」からの明確な卒業点である。Q4 2026までに、大手製造業のRFP(VW / Bosch / Mercedes / Foxconn / TSMC / Toyota)は「24時間連続稼働」「1週間MTBF」「90%以上の自律完了率」「MES / PLC統合」を事実上の足切り条件として組み込む。Physical AIの競争軸は「見栄えの良いデモ動画」から「既存OT環境への組み込みやすさ」へと完全に移行する。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Las "corridas de producción de 8 horas de Physical AI" se convierten en un requisito de compras empresariales en H2 2026.** Las **8 horas / 90% de éxito / 60 totes/hora** de Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha en Erlangen — en la línea de producción, no una demo — son un punto de graduación claro de "humanoide = PoC". Para el Q4 2026, las RFPs de grandes fabricantes (VW / Bosch / Mercedes / Foxconn / TSMC / Toyota) integrarán "operación continua de 24h", "MTBF de 1 semana", "tasa de finalización autónoma del 90%+", e "integración MES / PLC" como cortes de facto. El eje competitivo de Physical AI cambia completamente de "videos de demo bonitos" a "facilidad de inserción en entornos OT existentes". In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "Physical AI 8-hour production runs" ay magiging enterprise procurement requirement sa H2 2026.** Ang **8 hours / 90% success / 60 totes/hour** ng Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha sa Erlangen — sa production line, hindi demo — ay malinaw na graduation point mula sa "humanoid = PoC." Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, isasama ng big-manufacturer RFPs (VW / Bosch / Mercedes / Foxconn / TSMC / Toyota) ang "24h continuous operation," "1-week MTBF," "90%+ autonomous completion rate," at "MES / PLC integration" bilang de facto cuts. Ang competitive axis para sa Physical AI ay ganap na lumilipat mula sa "good-looking demo videos" papunta sa "ease of insertion into existing OT environments." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

By Q4 2026, big-manufacturer RFPs are expected to fold 24h continuous operation, 1-week MTBF, 90% autonomy, and MES / PLC integration into procurement cuts.

summary_short_locales.en: Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha's 8-hour Erlangen run at 60 totes/hour and 90% success on a live production line graduates humanoids from PoC. By Q4 2026, big-manufacturer RFPs are expected to fold 24h continuous operation, 1-week MTBF, 90% autonomy, and MES / PLC integration into procurement cuts.
summary_short_locales.ja: Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 AlphaがErlangenの実生産ラインで1時間あたり60トート、90%成功率の8時間稼働を達成し、ヒューマノイドはPoCから卒業した。Q4 2026までに、大手製造業のRFPは24時間連続稼働、1週間MTBF、90%自律性、MES / PLC統合を調達足切りに組み込むと予想される。
summary_short_locales.es: La corrida de 8 horas en Erlangen de Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha a 60 totes/hora y 90% de éxito en una línea de producción en vivo gradúa a los humanoides del PoC. Para el Q4 2026, se espera que las RFPs de grandes fabricantes integren operación continua de 24h, MTBF de 1 semana, autonomía del 90%, e integración MES / PLC en los cortes de compras.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang 8-oras na Erlangen run ng Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha sa 60 totes/hour at 90% success sa live production line ay nagpapagraduate sa mga humanoid mula sa PoC. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang big-manufacturer RFPs ay inaasahang magsasama ng 24h continuous operation, 1-week MTBF, 90% autonomy, at MES / PLC integration sa procurement cuts.

bridges.text: Figure AI's Wednesday May 27 disclosure — BotQ scaling Figure 03 from one robot per day to one robot per hour over 120 days, 350+ shipments across 10+ variants, 9,000+ actuators, 80% first-pass yields — supplies the second OEM-anchored throughput-plus-yield data point alongside Apptronik's Apollo Gen 2 Tuscaloosa cohort, exactly the publishable comparable metrics RFP-grade procurement language requires to cite.

text_locales.en: Figure AI's Wednesday May 27 disclosure — BotQ scaling Figure 03 from one robot per day to one robot per hour over 120 days, 350+ shipments across 10+ variants, 9,000+ actuators, 80% first-pass yields — supplies the second OEM-anchored throughput-plus-yield data point alongside Apptronik's Apollo Gen 2 Tuscaloosa cohort, exactly the publishable comparable metrics RFP-grade procurement language requires to cite.
text_locales.ja: Figure AIの水曜日5月27日の開示——BotQが120日間でFigure 03を1日1台から1時間1台へとスケール、出荷350台超、製品バリエーション10種超、アクチュエータ9,000基超、初回合格率80%——は、Apptronik Apollo Gen 2のTuscaloosa陣営と並ぶ、第2のOEMを軸とした処理能力・歩留まりのデータ点を供給する。これは、RFPグレードの調達文言が引用する必要のある公表可能な比較対象指標そのものである。
text_locales.es: La divulgación de Figure AI del miércoles 27 de mayo —BotQ escalando Figure 03 de un robot por día a un robot por hora en 120 días, más de 350 envíos en 10+ variantes, más de 9.000 actuadores y 80% de rendimiento de primer paso— aporta el segundo dato anclado en OEM de rendimiento y yield junto a la cohorte de Apollo Gen 2 de Apptronik en Tuscaloosa, exactamente las métricas comparables publicables que el lenguaje de adquisiciones de grado RFP exige para citar.
text_locales.fil: Ang pagsisiwalat ng Figure AI noong Miyerkules Mayo 27—pinalakas ng BotQ ang Figure 03 mula isang robot kada araw patungo isang robot kada oras sa loob ng 120 araw, 350+ shipments sa 10+ variants, 9,000+ actuators, 80% first-pass yields—ay nagbibigay ng pangalawang OEM-anchored throughput-plus-yield na data point katabi ng Apptronik Apollo Gen 2 Tuscaloosa cohort, eksaktong publikableng comparable metrics na kailangang ireperensya ng RFP-grade procurement language.

bridges.text: The Wednesday ten-unit cohort cleared a 120-hour zero-MTBF continuous-operation pre-flight at the Tuscaloosa fixture before the day-shift release into the production trial on body-shop material-handoff and door-line subassembly. The 120-hour hold is a substantially longer interval than the 8-hour single-shift benchmark, and the Mercedes-Benz final-assembly OT environment is the canonical procurement fact-pattern the structural force rests on.

text_locales.en: The Wednesday ten-unit cohort cleared a 120-hour zero-MTBF continuous-operation pre-flight at the Tuscaloosa fixture before the day-shift release into the production trial on body-shop material-handoff and door-line subassembly. The 120-hour hold is a substantially longer interval than the 8-hour single-shift benchmark, and the Mercedes-Benz final-assembly OT environment is the canonical procurement fact-pattern the structural force rests on.
text_locales.ja: 水曜日の10ユニット集団は、日勤シフトでのボディショップ材料受け渡しとドアライン・サブアセンブリでの生産トライアルへのリリースの前に、Tuscaloosaの治具で120時間ゼロMTBF連続運転プレフライトを通過した。120時間保持は、8時間の単一シフト・ベンチマークよりも大幅に長い間隔であり、Mercedes-Benz最終組立OT環境は、構造的な力が立脚する標準的な調達事実パターンである。
text_locales.es: La cohorte de diez unidades del miércoles superó un preflight de operación continua de 120 horas con cero MTBF en la instalación de Tuscaloosa antes de la liberación del turno de día a la prueba de producción en manejo de materiales del taller de carrocería y subensamblaje de la línea de puertas. La retención de 120 horas es un intervalo sustancialmente más largo que el benchmark de turno único de 8 horas, y el entorno OT de ensamblaje final de Mercedes-Benz es el patrón de hechos canónico de adquisición sobre el que descansa la fuerza estructural.
text_locales.fil: Nilinis ng Miyerkules ten-unit cohort ang isang 120-hour zero-MTBF continuous-operation pre-flight sa Tuscaloosa fixture bago ang day-shift release patungo sa production trial sa body-shop material-handoff at door-line subassembly. Ang 120-hour hold ay isang sapat na mas mahabang interval kaysa sa 8-hour single-shift benchmark, at ang Mercedes-Benz final-assembly OT environment ay siyang canonical procurement fact-pattern kung saan nakaupo ang structural force.

text_locales.es: Las 1.250+ horas y 90.000+ partes de Figure 02 más las unidades de producción comprometidas de Atlas con Hyundai + Google DeepMind sostienen el framing de OEM-adopted-records sobre el cual descansa la predicción. El lanzamiento de construcción de data center de SoftBank Roze AI extiende el vector de despliegue comercial de physical-AI más allá de logística hacia el propio buildout de capex IA. Señal moderada.
text_locales.fil: Ang 1,250+ hours at 90,000+ parts ng Figure 02 plus ang nakatuong Hyundai + Google DeepMind production units ng Atlas ay sumusuporta sa OEM-adopted-records framing na pinaninindigan ng prediction. Ang data-center-construction launch ng SoftBank Roze AI ay nag-eextend ng physical-AI commercial deployment vector lampas sa logistics papasok sa AI-capex buildout mismo. Moderate signal.

bridges.text: The carry-forward production-pilot data from Figure 02 (1,250+ hours, 90,000+ parts) and Atlas's committed Hyundai + Google DeepMind production units sustains the OEM-adopted-records framing the prediction rests on. Nothing fresh today, so the signal is consistent rather than reinforcing.

text_locales.en: The carry-forward production-pilot data from Figure 02 (1,250+ hours, 90,000+ parts) and Atlas's committed Hyundai + Google DeepMind production units sustains the OEM-adopted-records framing the prediction rests on. Nothing fresh today, so the signal is consistent rather than reinforcing.
text_locales.ja: Figure 02の引き継がれた生産パイロットデータ(1,250時間以上、90,000部品以上)とAtlasのコミット済みHyundai + Google DeepMind生産ユニットは、予測が依拠するOEM採用記録の枠組みを維持する。本日新たなものはないため、シグナルは強化ではなく一貫している。
text_locales.es: Los datos de pilot de producción que se mantienen de Figure 02 (1.250+ horas, 90.000+ piezas) y las unidades de producción comprometidas de Atlas con Hyundai + Google DeepMind sostienen el encuadre de récords-adoptados-por-OEM sobre el que descansa la predicción. Nada fresco hoy, así que la señal es consistente más que reforzante.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **"Physical AI 8-hour production runs" become an enterprise procurement requirement in H2 2026.** Siemens-Humanoid HMND 01 Alpha's **8 hours / 90% success / 60 totes/hour** at Erlangen — on the production line, not a demo — is a clear graduation point from "humanoid = PoC." By Q4 2026, big-manufacturer RFPs (VW / Bosch / Mercedes / Foxconn / TSMC / Toyota) will fold "24h continuous operation," "1-week MTBF," "90%+ autonomous completion rate," and "MES / PLC integration" into de facto cuts. The competitive axis for Physical AI shifts entirely from "good-looking demo videos" to "ease of insertion into existing OT environments." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.description: **Capital markets reset their valuation of "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" inside Q2 2026.** ServiceNow's **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** on Apr 23, IBM's same-day decline, and the chained falls of Salesforce / Workday / Oracle reveal a shift in how capital markets weigh "AI cost-savings benefit" vs "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Inside Q2 2026, expect Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports to make the "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis explicit, and market-cap math to move from "seats × ARPU" to "share of API calls touched by agents." Lagging analyst consensus updates mean another 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) likely see 15%+ drops in the next two quarters. description.en: **Capital markets reset their valuation of "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" inside Q2 2026.** ServiceNow's **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** on Apr 23, IBM's same-day decline, and the chained falls of Salesforce / Workday / Oracle reveal a shift in how capital markets weigh "AI cost-savings benefit" vs "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Inside Q2 2026, expect Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports to make the "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis explicit, and market-cap math to move from "seats × ARPU" to "share of API calls touched by agents." Lagging analyst consensus updates mean another 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) likely see 15%+ drops in the next two quarters. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **資本市場はQ2 2026中に「AIエージェントに置換される企業向けSaaS」のバリュエーションをリセットする。** 4月23日のServiceNowの**-18%(史上最悪の単日下落)**、IBMの同日下落、Salesforce / Workday / Oracleの連鎖的な下落は、資本市場が「AIによるコスト削減効果」と「AIによるレガシー・ワークフローSaaSの置換」をどう天秤にかけるかが転換したことを示している。Q2 2026中に、Gartner / Forresterのマジック・クアドラント / ウェーブ・レポートが「Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS」軸を明示し、時価総額の計算式は「シート数 × ARPU」から「エージェントが触れるAPIコールのシェア」へと移行すると予想される。アナリスト・コンセンサスの更新が遅れるため、今後2四半期でさらに3-5社(Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheetなど)が15%以上の下落を見せる可能性が高い。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los mercados de capitales restablecen su valoración del "SaaS empresarial desplazado por agentes de IA" dentro del Q2 2026.** El **-18% (peor caída en un solo día de la historia)** de ServiceNow el 23 de abril, el declive de IBM el mismo día, y las caídas encadenadas de Salesforce / Workday / Oracle revelan un cambio en cómo los mercados de capitales sopesan el "beneficio de ahorro de costos por IA" frente al "desplazamiento por IA del SaaS de workflow legacy". Dentro del Q2 2026, se espera que los reportes Magic Quadrant / Wave de Gartner / Forrester hagan explícito el eje "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS", y que la matemática de capitalización de mercado pase de "asientos × ARPU" a "cuota de llamadas a API tocadas por agentes". Las actualizaciones rezagadas del consenso de analistas significan que probablemente otros 3-5 nombres (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) verán caídas del 15%+ en los próximos dos trimestres. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Iri-reset ng capital markets ang valuation nila ng "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" sa loob ng Q2 2026.** Ang **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** ng ServiceNow noong Apr 23, ang same-day decline ng IBM, at ang chained falls ng Salesforce / Workday / Oracle ay naghahayag ng pagbabago kung paano tinitimbang ng capital markets ang "AI cost-savings benefit" laban sa "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Sa loob ng Q2 2026, asahan ang Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports na gawing explicit ang "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis, at ang market-cap math na lumipat mula sa "seats × ARPU" papunta sa "share of API calls touched by agents." Ang lagging analyst consensus updates ay nangangahulugan na isa pang 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) ay malamang na makikita ng 15%+ drops sa susunod na dalawang quarter. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

detail.description: **Capital markets reset their valuation of "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" inside Q2 2026.** ServiceNow's **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** on Apr 23, IBM's same-day decline, and the chained falls of Salesforce / Workday / Oracle reveal a shift in how capital markets weigh "AI cost-savings benefit" vs "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Inside Q2 2026, expect Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports to make the "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis explicit, and market-cap math to move from "seats × ARPU" to "share of API calls touched by agents." Lagging analyst consensus updates mean another 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) likely see 15%+ drops in the next two quarters. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **資本市場はQ2 2026中に「AIエージェントに置換される企業向けSaaS」のバリュエーションをリセットする。** 4月23日のServiceNowの**-18%(史上最悪の単日下落)**、IBMの同日下落、Salesforce / Workday / Oracleの連鎖的な下落は、資本市場が「AIによるコスト削減効果」と「AIによるレガシー・ワークフローSaaSの置換」をどう天秤にかけるかが転換したことを示している。Q2 2026中に、Gartner / Forresterのマジック・クアドラント / ウェーブ・レポートが「Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS」軸を明示し、時価総額の計算式は「シート数 × ARPU」から「エージェントが触れるAPIコールのシェア」へと移行すると予想される。アナリスト・コンセンサスの更新が遅れるため、今後2四半期でさらに3-5社(Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheetなど)が15%以上の下落を見せる可能性が高い。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Los mercados de capitales restablecen su valoración del "SaaS empresarial desplazado por agentes de IA" dentro del Q2 2026.** El **-18% (peor caída en un solo día de la historia)** de ServiceNow el 23 de abril, el declive de IBM el mismo día, y las caídas encadenadas de Salesforce / Workday / Oracle revelan un cambio en cómo los mercados de capitales sopesan el "beneficio de ahorro de costos por IA" frente al "desplazamiento por IA del SaaS de workflow legacy". Dentro del Q2 2026, se espera que los reportes Magic Quadrant / Wave de Gartner / Forrester hagan explícito el eje "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS", y que la matemática de capitalización de mercado pase de "asientos × ARPU" a "cuota de llamadas a API tocadas por agentes". Las actualizaciones rezagadas del consenso de analistas significan que probablemente otros 3-5 nombres (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) verán caídas del 15%+ en los próximos dos trimestres. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Iri-reset ng capital markets ang valuation nila ng "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" sa loob ng Q2 2026.** Ang **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** ng ServiceNow noong Apr 23, ang same-day decline ng IBM, at ang chained falls ng Salesforce / Workday / Oracle ay naghahayag ng pagbabago kung paano tinitimbang ng capital markets ang "AI cost-savings benefit" laban sa "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Sa loob ng Q2 2026, asahan ang Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports na gawing explicit ang "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis, at ang market-cap math na lumipat mula sa "seats × ARPU" papunta sa "share of API calls touched by agents." Ang lagging analyst consensus updates ay nangangahulugan na isa pang 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) ay malamang na makikita ng 15%+ drops sa susunod na dalawang quarter. nodes.title: Big-3 hyperscalers gate AI capex on per-token-margin floor by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. description.en: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **Mag 7 の Q1 決算 (4/29-30) が AI capex の ROI ナラティブを再設定する — Q3 2026 までに、トークンマージンの閾値で AI capex を公に階層化する最初のハイパースケーラが登場する。** Alphabet ($175B-$185B)、Amazon (約 $200B)、Meta ($115B-$135B)、そして Microsoft (Azure 出遅れによる再評価リスク) を合算した 2026 capex ガイダンスは合計 ~$650B-$700B に達し、ウォール街の「AI ROI リアリティチェック」と対峙する。4/29-30 の決算は、**トークン単位売上のエグジットベロシティ**仮説を裏付けるか、それともマルチプル圧縮を引き起こすかのいずれかとなる。Q3 2026 までに、Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社は **Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限で増分 GPU capex を公にゲーティング** — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」が登場し、2024-2025 の「使え、さもなくば死ね」ドクトリンに終止符を打つ。フロンティアラボのアンカーディール (Google $40B / Anthropic、Amazon $25B / Anthropic、OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) が可視的な圧力解放弁になる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los resultados del Q1 de Mag 7 (29-30 de abril) reinician la narrativa del ROI del capex en IA — el Q3 2026 ve al primer hyperscaler que tiera públicamente el capex de IA por una valla de margen por token.** Con la guía combinada de capex 2026 de Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B) y Microsoft (riesgo de rerating por rezago de Azure) totalizando ~$650B-$700B contra el "AI ROI reality check" de Wall Street, las publicaciones del 29-30 de abril o validan la tesis de **velocidad-de-salida de ingresos por token** o disparan una compresión de múltiplos. Para el Q3 2026, al menos uno de los Big-3 hyperscalers públicamente **gatea el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — el primer umbral explícito de "ROI de infra de IA" de una nube pública, terminando la doctrina de "gastar o morir" de 2024-2025. Los acuerdos ancla con laboratorios frontier (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) se convierten en la válvula visible de alivio de presión. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) ay magre-reset ng AI-capex ROI narrative — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, makikita ang unang hyperscaler na pampublikong magti-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.** Sa pinagsamang 2026 capex guidance mula sa Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), at Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) na umaabot sa ~$650B-$700B laban sa "AI ROI reality check" ng Wall Street, ang Apr 29-30 prints ay magpapatunay sa **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis o magti-trigger ng multiple compression. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscalers ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa pamamagitan ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud, na nagtatapos sa 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Ang frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) ay magiging visible pressure relief valve. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.es: El avance de la impresión del 5 de mayo de AMD ajusta la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: el colapso de MI308 China más la división de analistas (recorte de Cathie Wood, Buy de DA Davidson, Hold de RBC) muestra que la presión del lado comprador para divulgación explícita de ROI de capex de IA ahora opera por proveedor, exactamente la precondición para que un hyperscaler escalone públicamente el capex de IA por puerta de margen por token.
text_locales.fil: Ang AMD May 5 print preview ay nagpapatigas sa structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang MI308 China collapse plus ang analyst split (Cathie Wood trim, DA Davidson Buy, RBC Hold) ay nagpapakita na ang buyside pressure para sa explicit AI-capex ROI disclosure ay aktibo na ngayon sa per-vendor basis, eksaktong precondition para sa isang hyperscaler na pampublikong mag-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.

text_locales.es: La guía Q3 de Apple sin línea de servicios de IA, el tape de capex 2026 de $700B y la divulgación de run-rate de $37B de Microsoft son exactamente las señales de presión del lado comprador que la predicción necesitaba para moverse de narrativa a forma de divulgación. El cohorte ahora compite públicamente sobre transparencia de margen por token en lugar de esconderse detrás de ingresos agregados de nube.
text_locales.fil: Ang Q3 guide ng Apple na walang AI-services line, ang $700B 2026 capex tape, at ang $37B run-rate disclosure ng Microsoft ang eksaktong buyside-pressure signals na kinailangan ng prediction upang lumipat mula narrative tungo sa disclosure-shape. text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de Apple y la guía limpia +14-17% reconstruyeron la cinta de capex-IA-por-fe exactamente cuando la predicción esperaba que el lado comprador exigiera una puerta de margen-por-token; la impresión AMD del 5 mayo y la IPO de Cerebras son los siguientes puntos de presión que deberían producir esa divulgación.
text_locales.fil: Ang $100B buyback ng Apple at malinis na +14-17% guide ay muling nagbuo sa AI-capex-on-faith tape eksakto nang hilingin ng buyside ang per-token-margin gate na inaasahan ng prediction; ang May 5 print ng AMD at ang Cerebras IPO ay ang susunod na pressure points na dapat magpoduce ng disclosure na iyon.

text_locales.en: Apple's clean Q2 beat plus the $700B 2026 AI-capex tracking number and Apple's $100B buyback land the cohort-side of the Mag 7 super-week reset, but no hyperscaler has yet stated a per-token-margin gate. Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate disclosure remains the closest precedent, one structural step short of the explicit gate the prediction calls for.
text_locales.ja: AppleのクリーンなQ2 ビートに加え、7,000億ドルの2026年AI設備投資追跡数値とAppleの1,000億ドル自社株買いは、Mag 7スーパーウィークリセットのコホート側を着地させるが、ハイパースケーラーはまだトークンあたりマージンゲートを述べていない。Microsoftの370億ドルAIランレート開示が依然として最も近い前例であり、予測が要求する明示的なゲートよりも構造的に1ステップ短い。
text_locales.es: El beat limpio Q2 de Apple más el número de tracking de capex-IA-2026 de $700B y la recompra de $100B de Apple aterrizan el lado-cohorte del reset de la super-semana Mag 7, pero ningún hyperscaler ha enunciado aún un gate por token-margin. La disclosure del run-rate IA de $37B de Microsoft sigue siendo el precedente más cercano, un paso estructural por debajo del gate explícito que la predicción exige.
text_locales.fil: Ang malinis na Q2 beat ng Apple plus ang $700B 2026 AI-capex tracking number at ang $100B buyback ng Apple ay naghatid ng cohort-side ng Mag 7 super-week reset, ngunit walang hyperscaler na nag-state pa ng per-token-margin gate. Ang $37B AI run-rate disclosure ng Microsoft ay nananatiling pinakamalapit na precedent, isang structural step na kulang sa explicit na gate na hinihingi ng prediction.

text_locales.es: El evento de prints Mag 7 aterrizó exactamente en la ventana de pronóstico de la predicción con Microsoft publicando la primera disclosure por-AI-business como sola línea de run-rate de $37B. Eso queda un paso estructural corto frente a un gate explícito de margen-por-token, pero es el precedente más cercano que ha sentado cualquier hyperscaler. El reset de -7% AH de META por shortfall de capex refuerza la pata de presión de disclosure.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mag 7 print event ay lumapag eksakto sa forecast window ng prediction kasama ng Microsoft na nag-post ng unang per-AI-business single-line $37B run-rate disclosure. Iyon ay isang structural step kulang sa explicit per-token-margin gate ngunit ang pinakamalapit na precedent na itinakda ng anumang hyperscaler. Ang -7% AH capex-shortfall reset ng META ay nagpapatibay sa disclosure-pressure leg.

text_locales.en: The Apr 29-30 Mag-7 print collision with Powell's final FOMC presser arrives exactly as the prediction projected, on top of Apr 28's WSJ-driven OpenAI-revenue-miss tape crack. The landing window the prediction names - prints + FOMC compressing the AI-capex ROI debate into a single 24-hour tape - is materializing as scripted; what's left to verify is whether at least one Big-3 hyperscaler tiers capex on a per-token-margin floor by Q3 2026.
text_locales.ja: 4月29-30日のMag-7プリント衝突がPowellの最終FOMC記者会見と重なり、4月28日のWSJ駆動OpenAI収益ミス・テープ・クラックの上に、まさに予測が投影した通りに到着している。予測が指摘する着地ウィンドウ - プリント + FOMCがAI-capex ROI議論を単一の24時間テープに圧縮 - はスクリプト通りに物質化している。残された検証は、少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラーが2026年Q3までにトークン単位マージン・フロアでcapexを階層化するかどうかだ。
text_locales.es: La colision de resultados Mag-7 del 29-30 de abril con la conferencia final FOMC de Powell llega exactamente como la prediccion proyecto, encima de la cinta del fallo-de-ingresos-de-OpenAI impulsada por WSJ del 28 de abril. La ventana de aterrizaje que la prediccion nombra - resultados + FOMC comprimiendo el debate del ROI del capex de IA en una sola cinta de 24-horas - se esta materializando como guion; lo que queda por verificar es si al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 tierara capex sobre un piso de margen-por-token para el Q3 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 29-30 Mag-7 print collision kasama ang final FOMC presser ni Powell ay dumarating nang eksakto sa ipino-project ng hula, sa ibabaw ng Apr 28 WSJ-driven OpenAI-revenue-miss tape crack. Ang landing window na pinapangalanan ng hula - prints + FOMC na nag-co-compress ng AI-capex ROI debate sa iisang 24-hour tape - ay nag-mamaterialize gaya ng inilarawan; ang natitira sa pag-verify ay kung kahit isang Big-3 hyperscaler ay mag-tier ng capex sa per-token-margin floor pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

text_locales.fil: Ang FOMC at Mag 7 prints na kumukolisyon sa parehong 48h tape na may ~$700B capex sa lamesa ay ang landing-window na itinakda ng prediction; ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay nagbibigay ng relief-valve framing at ang per-token-margin disclosure setup na inaasahan ng thesis.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **Mag 7 の Q1 決算 (4/29-30) が AI capex の ROI ナラティブを再設定する — Q3 2026 までに、トークンマージンの閾値で AI capex を公に階層化する最初のハイパースケーラが登場する。** Alphabet ($175B-$185B)、Amazon (約 $200B)、Meta ($115B-$135B)、そして Microsoft (Azure 出遅れによる再評価リスク) を合算した 2026 capex ガイダンスは合計 ~$650B-$700B に達し、ウォール街の「AI ROI リアリティチェック」と対峙する。4/29-30 の決算は、**トークン単位売上のエグジットベロシティ**仮説を裏付けるか、それともマルチプル圧縮を引き起こすかのいずれかとなる。Q3 2026 までに、Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社は **Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限で増分 GPU capex を公にゲーティング** — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」が登場し、2024-2025 の「使え、さもなくば死ね」ドクトリンに終止符を打つ。フロンティアラボのアンカーディール (Google $40B / Anthropic、Amazon $25B / Anthropic、OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) が可視的な圧力解放弁になる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Los resultados del Q1 de Mag 7 (29-30 de abril) reinician la narrativa del ROI del capex en IA — el Q3 2026 ve al primer hyperscaler que tiera públicamente el capex de IA por una valla de margen por token.** Con la guía combinada de capex 2026 de Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B) y Microsoft (riesgo de rerating por rezago de Azure) totalizando ~$650B-$700B contra el "AI ROI reality check" de Wall Street, las publicaciones del 29-30 de abril o validan la tesis de **velocidad-de-salida de ingresos por token** o disparan una compresión de múltiplos. Para el Q3 2026, al menos uno de los Big-3 hyperscalers públicamente **gatea el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — el primer umbral explícito de "ROI de infra de IA" de una nube pública, terminando la doctrina de "gastar o morir" de 2024-2025. Los acuerdos ancla con laboratorios frontier (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) se convierten en la válvula visible de alivio de presión. prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) ay magre-reset ng AI-capex ROI narrative — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, makikita ang unang hyperscaler na pampublikong magti-tier ng AI capex sa pamamagitan ng token-margin gate.** Sa pinagsamang 2026 capex guidance mula sa Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), at Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) na umaabot sa ~$650B-$700B laban sa "AI ROI reality check" ng Wall Street, ang Apr 29-30 prints ay magpapatunay sa **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis o magti-trigger ng multiple compression. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscalers ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa pamamagitan ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud, na nagtatapos sa 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Ang frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) ay magiging visible pressure relief valve. nodes.description: **The "AGI-clause unwind" sets a template — by Q4 2026 at least one other foundation-lab × hyperscaler contract is publicly amended to drop a discretionary "capability-trigger" clause, replaced by fixed-end revenue-share + non-exclusive cloud distribution.** Apr 27's Microsoft/OpenAI rewrite is no longer just about Azure exclusivity — it converts a binary, board-discretionary IP-revocation risk into a **calendar-bound revenue cap (2030)** and **multi-cloud distribution as the new default**. Google × Anthropic's $40B / 5GW deal, Amazon × Anthropic's $5B + $25B / $100B AWS commit, OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft, and the upcoming Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B mid-May) all sit on similar capability-trigger language. **By Q4 2026 we see at least one of those contracts publicly restructured to mirror Apr 27's pattern** — fixed-date revenue cap, non-exclusive license, multi-cloud distribution clause. The "AGI" word becomes a financial-instrument primitive, not a metaphysical one. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.es: **El "desmontaje de la cláusula AGI" sienta una plantilla — para Q4 2026 al menos otro contrato foundation-lab × hyperscaler se modifica públicamente para eliminar una cláusula discrecional de "capability-trigger", reemplazada por revenue-share de fecha-fin fija + distribución cloud no exclusiva.** La reescritura del 27 de abril Microsoft/OpenAI ya no se trata solo de la exclusividad de Azure — convierte un riesgo binario y discrecional del consejo de revocación de IP en un **límite de ingresos vinculado al calendario (2030)** y **distribución multi-cloud como nuevo estándar**. El acuerdo de Google × Anthropic de $40B / 5GW, el compromiso AWS de Amazon × Anthropic de $5B + $25B / $100B, OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft, y la próxima IPO de Cerebras ($22B-$25B a mediados de mayo) todos se basan en lenguaje similar de capability-trigger. **Para Q4 2026 vemos al menos uno de esos contratos reestructurado públicamente para reflejar el patrón del 27 de abril** — límite de ingresos con fecha fija, licencia no exclusiva, cláusula de distribución multi-cloud. summary.ja: **「AGI 条項アンワインド」がテンプレート化する — Q4 2026 までに、少なくとももう 1 件のフロンティアラボ × ハイパースケーラ契約が、裁量的な「能力トリガ」条項を撤廃し、固定期日の収益シェア + 非排他的なクラウド配信に置き換える形で公に修正される。** 4/27 の Microsoft / OpenAI 書き換えはもはや Azure 排他性の話だけではない — 二者択一かつ取締役会裁量による IP 失効リスクを、**カレンダーで縛られた収益キャップ (2030)** と **新たなデフォルトとしてのマルチクラウド配信** に変換している。Google × Anthropic の $40B / 5GW ディール、Amazon × Anthropic の $5B + $25B / $100B AWS コミット、OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft、そして 5 月中旬予定の Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B) はいずれも類似の能力トリガ文言を抱えている。**Q4 2026 までに、これらの契約のうち少なくとも 1 件が 4/27 のパターンを反映する形で公に再構成される** — 固定期日の収益キャップ、非排他的ライセンス、マルチクラウド配信条項。「AGI」という語は形而上的なものではなく、金融商品のプリミティブとなる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
summary.es: **El "desmontaje de la cláusula AGI" sienta una plantilla — para Q4 2026 al menos otro contrato foundation-lab × hyperscaler se modifica públicamente para eliminar una cláusula discrecional de "capability-trigger", reemplazada por revenue-share de fecha-fin fija + distribución cloud no exclusiva.** La reescritura del 27 de abril Microsoft/OpenAI ya no se trata solo de la exclusividad de Azure — convierte un riesgo binario y discrecional del consejo de revocación de IP en un **límite de ingresos vinculado al calendario (2030)** y **distribución multi-cloud como nuevo estándar**. El acuerdo de Google × Anthropic de $40B / 5GW, el compromiso AWS de Amazon × Anthropic de $5B + $25B / $100B, OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft, y la próxima IPO de Cerebras ($22B-$25B a mediados de mayo) todos se basan en lenguaje similar de capability-trigger. **Para Q4 2026 vemos al menos uno de esos contratos reestructurado públicamente para reflejar el patrón del 27 de abril** — límite de ingresos con fecha fija, licencia no exclusiva, cláusula de distribución multi-cloud. La palabra "AGI" se convierte en una primitiva de instrumento financiero, no metafísica. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
summary.fil: **Ang "AGI-clause unwind" ay naglalatag ng template — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, kahit isa pang foundation-lab x hyperscaler contract ay pampublikong susuguin upang alisin ang discretionary "capability-trigger" clause, na papalitan ng fixed-end revenue-share + non-exclusive cloud distribution.** Ang Apr 27 Microsoft/OpenAI rewrite ay hindi na lamang tungkol sa Azure exclusivity — ito ay nagko-convert ng binary, board-discretionary IP-revocation risk patungo sa **calendar-bound revenue cap (2030)** at **multi-cloud distribution bilang bagong default**. Ang Google x Anthropic na $40B / 5GW deal, ang Amazon x Anthropic na $5B + $25B / $100B AWS commit, ang OpenAI x Cerebras + Microsoft, at ang paparating na Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B mid-May) ay lahat nakaupo sa katulad na capability-trigger language. **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, makikita natin ang kahit isa sa mga kontratang iyon na pampublikong nirestructure upang sumalamin sa pattern ng Apr 27** — fixed-date revenue cap, non-exclusive license, multi-cloud distribution clause. description.en: **Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 force the first **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure from a hyperscaler by Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal anchor the new doctrine.** Combined Mag 7 capex of ~$700B for 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending to ~$170B FY27) lands into a tape that has already shifted from "rewarding capex on faith" to "demanding tangible profit." **Apr 27 contract restructurings explicitly route AI-lab compute through hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton with Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs at scale). By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — first explicit "AI-infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud. NVDA $5T-class market cap and AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory hold; the spend curve doesn't break, but its disclosure language does. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **Mag 7 決算 + 4/28-29 FOMC が、Q3 2026 までにハイパースケーラからの初の **トークン単位マージンでゲーティングされた capex** 開示を強要する — 4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft 協定 + Anthropic / AWS Trainium のシリコンレベル ディールが新ドクトリンを定礎する。** 2026 年の Mag 7 合算 capex 約 $700B (Alphabet $175B-$185B、Amazon 約 $200B、Meta $115B-$135B、Microsoft 約 $146B FY26 から FY27 で約 $170B へトレンド) は、すでに「信仰に基づき capex を報いる」から「具体的な利益を要求する」へとシフトしたテープに着地する。**4/27 の契約再構築は AI ラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ自社シリコン経由に明示的にルーティング** している (Anthropic との AWS Trainium / Graviton、スケールでの Meta-Graviton CPU)。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が **増分 GPU capex を Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限でゲーティング** する — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」となる。NVDA $5T クラスの時価総額と AMD / Cerebras IPO 軌道は維持される。支出曲線は折れないが、その開示言語は折れる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Las publicaciones de Mag 7 + FOMC del 28-29 de abril fuerzan la primera divulgación de **capex con margen-por-token gateado** desde un hyperscaler para Q3 2026 — el pacto OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril + el acuerdo Anthropic/AWS Trainium a nivel de silicio anclan la nueva doctrina.** El capex combinado de Mag 7 de ~$700B para 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 tendiendo a ~$170B FY27) aterriza en una cinta que ya ha pasado de "recompensar el capex con fe" a "exigir ganancia tangible." **Las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril enrutan explícitamente la computación de los AI-labs a través del silicio propiedad del hyperscaler** (AWS Trainium/Graviton con Anthropic; CPUs Meta-Graviton a escala). Para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler **gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — primer "umbral de ROI de AI-infra" explícito de un cloud público. La capitalización de mercado de NVDA tipo $5T y la trayectoria de IPO AMD/Cerebras se mantienen; la curva de gasto no se rompe, pero su lenguaje de divulgación sí. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 ay magpipilit sa unang **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure mula sa hyperscaler pagsapit ng Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal ang nag-aanchor sa bagong doctrine.** Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 capex na ~$700B para sa 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending sa ~$170B FY27) ay tumatama sa tape na lumipat na mula sa "rewarding capex on faith" patungo sa "demanding tangible profit." **Ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay tahasang nagru-route ng AI-lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton kasama ang Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs sa scale). Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI-infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud. Ang NVDA $5T-class market cap at AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory ay nananatili; hindi mababasag ang spend curve, ngunit ang disclosure language nito ay babasagin. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.ja: AAPLの$100B自社株買いが$700B capexテープに積層され、MSFTの$37B run-rate単一ライン開示と合わせて、トークン当たりマージンゲーティングテーゼが活発に保たれる。Powellが2028年まで理事会に残る決定とAMD 5月5日決算、5月8日の4月雇用統計が、ハイパースケーラーへのより厳格なトークン当たり開示への圧力をかけるマクロボラティリティの足を加える。
text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de AAPL apilada sobre el tape de capex de $700B y la divulgación de línea única de run-rate de $37B de MSFT mantienen activa la tesis de gating de margen por token. Powell-se-queda-en-la-Junta hasta 2028 más la impresión de AMD del 5 de mayo y la impresión de empleos de abril del 8 de mayo añaden la pierna de volatilidad macro que presiona a los hyperscalers hacia una divulgación más dura por token.
text_locales.fil: Ang $100B buyback ng AAPL na nakapatong sa $700B capex tape at sa $37B run-rate single-line disclosure ng MSFT ay pinapanatiling aktibo ang per-token-margin gating thesis. Ang Powell-stays-on-Board hanggang 2028 plus ang AMD May 5 print at ang May 8 Apr jobs print ay nagdaragdag ng macro-volatility leg na nagpipilit sa hyperscalers tungo sa mas matigas na per-token disclosure.

text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de Apple más la cinta récord del 1 mayo reconstruyeron el condicionamiento de capex-IA-por-fe que la predicción espera que se rompa en una puerta de margen-por-token, con la disidencia FOMC del 29 abr suministrando la capa de presión de riesgo institucional.

La disclosure de capex condicionada por per-token-margin en sí misma todavía está upstream — el run-rate de $37B de Microsoft es el precedente más cercano.
text_locales.fil: Ang pag-close ng Apple sa Mag 7 super-week nang walang separate AI-services line plus ang $700B 2026 capex print ay eksaktong tumutugma sa buyside-pressure setup na pinanindigan ng prediction. El disenso 8-4 del FOMC + Powell-se-queda-en-la-Junta refuerzan la prima de riesgo institucional bajo todo el tape de capex-IA. Señal de refuerzo fuerte.

Ang 8-4 FOMC dissent + Powell-stays-on-Board ay nagpapatibay sa institutional-risk premium sa ilalim ng buong AI-capex tape. Matibay na nagpapatibay na signal.

text_locales.ja: Mag-7プリントは本日引け後に到着し、FOMC午後2:30 ET記者会見がPowellの任期を締めくくる。これはまさに予測が指摘した4月28-29日の着地ウィンドウであり、4月28日のチップ売却が信頼に基づくAI-capexテープを割った上に乗っている。予測が投影する開示言語のシフトは今やライブの圧力下にある。トークン単位マージン・フロア自体は決算コメントにまだ現れていない。
text_locales.es: Los resultados Mag-7 llegan despues del cierre hoy y la conferencia FOMC de las 2:30 PM ET cierra el termino de Powell, exactamente la ventana de aterrizaje del 28-29 de abril que la prediccion nombro, encima del selloff de chips del 28 de abril quebrando la cinta de capex-de-IA-por-fe. El cambio de lenguaje de divulgacion que la prediccion proyecta ahora esta bajo presion en vivo; el piso de margen-por-token mismo todavia no ha aparecido en el comentario de resultados.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mag-7 prints ay dumarating pagkatapos ng close ngayon at ang FOMC 2:30 PM ET presser ay nagsasara sa termino ni Powell, eksakto sa Apr 28-29 landing window na pinapangalanan ng hula, sa ibabaw ng Apr 28 chip selloff na bumabasag sa AI-capex-on-faith tape. Ang disclosure-language shift na ipino-project ng hula ay ngayon nasa ilalim ng live pressure; ang per-token-margin floor mismo ay hindi pa lumitaw sa earnings commentary.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 force the first **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure from a hyperscaler by Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal anchor the new doctrine.** Combined Mag 7 capex of ~$700B for 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending to ~$170B FY27) lands into a tape that has already shifted from "rewarding capex on faith" to "demanding tangible profit." **Apr 27 contract restructurings explicitly route AI-lab compute through hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton with Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs at scale). By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — first explicit "AI-infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud. NVDA $5T-class market cap and AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory hold; the spend curve doesn't break, but its disclosure language does. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **Mag 7 決算 + 4/28-29 FOMC が、Q3 2026 までにハイパースケーラからの初の **トークン単位マージンでゲーティングされた capex** 開示を強要する — 4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft 協定 + Anthropic / AWS Trainium のシリコンレベル ディールが新ドクトリンを定礎する。** 2026 年の Mag 7 合算 capex 約 $700B (Alphabet $175B-$185B、Amazon 約 $200B、Meta $115B-$135B、Microsoft 約 $146B FY26 から FY27 で約 $170B へトレンド) は、すでに「信仰に基づき capex を報いる」から「具体的な利益を要求する」へとシフトしたテープに着地する。**4/27 の契約再構築は AI ラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ自社シリコン経由に明示的にルーティング** している (Anthropic との AWS Trainium / Graviton、スケールでの Meta-Graviton CPU)。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が **増分 GPU capex を Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限でゲーティング** する — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」となる。NVDA $5T クラスの時価総額と AMD / Cerebras IPO 軌道は維持される。支出曲線は折れないが、その開示言語は折れる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Las publicaciones de Mag 7 + FOMC del 28-29 de abril fuerzan la primera divulgación de **capex con margen-por-token gateado** desde un hyperscaler para Q3 2026 — el pacto OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril + el acuerdo Anthropic/AWS Trainium a nivel de silicio anclan la nueva doctrina.** El capex combinado de Mag 7 de ~$700B para 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 tendiendo a ~$170B FY27) aterriza en una cinta que ya ha pasado de "recompensar el capex con fe" a "exigir ganancia tangible." **Las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril enrutan explícitamente la computación de los AI-labs a través del silicio propiedad del hyperscaler** (AWS Trainium/Graviton con Anthropic; CPUs Meta-Graviton a escala). Para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler **gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — primer "umbral de ROI de AI-infra" explícito de un cloud público. La capitalización de mercado de NVDA tipo $5T y la trayectoria de IPO AMD/Cerebras se mantienen; la curva de gasto no se rompe, pero su lenguaje de divulgación sí. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 ay magpipilit sa unang **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure mula sa hyperscaler pagsapit ng Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal ang nag-aanchor sa bagong doctrine.** Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 capex na ~$700B para sa 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending sa ~$170B FY27) ay tumatama sa tape na lumipat na mula sa "rewarding capex on faith" patungo sa "demanding tangible profit." **Ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay tahasang nagru-route ng AI-lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton kasama ang Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs sa scale). Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI-infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud. Ang NVDA $5T-class market cap at AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory ay nananatili; hindi mababasag ang spend curve, ngunit ang disclosure language nito ay babasagin. nodes.title: KV-cache-compression dtype ships as inference-stack deployment knob by Q4 2026
nodes.description: **By Q4 2026 KV-cache-compression dtype is exposed as a first-class deployment knob in every major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM all ship a `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (or equivalent) flag with TurboQuant + at least one alternative (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Apr 27-29 makes this a near-certainty: **TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 already in-tree** with a fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** at Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demoing multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** circulating before Google's official Python release lands in Q2 2026. The economic forcing function is the same Mag-7 capex tape the Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report just cracked: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that can move from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x. By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs. description.ja: **2026年Q4までに、KVキャッシュ圧縮dtypeが主要な全推論スタックでファーストクラスのデプロイメント・ノブとして公開される — vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLMのすべてが、TurboQuantと少なくとも1つの代替手段(KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention)を備えた`--kv-cache-dtype turboquant`(または同等)フラグを出荷する。** 4月27日〜29日の動向で、これはほぼ確実となった: **TurboQuantがICLR 2026 + Google Researchブログに掲載**、**SGLang PR #21419はすでにツリー内**で、フューズドカーネル書き換え(#23134)がbf16スループットの93〜105%に到達、**NVIDIA kvpress**はDecoding-Press成熟度に達し、**PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** がマルチエージェント共有プール量子化をデモ、**コミュニティのMLX + Triton + vLLMポート**が2026年Q2のGoogle公式Pythonリリース前から流通している。経済的な強制関数は、4月28日OpenAIミスのWSJレポートが直撃したのと同じMag-7 capexテープだ: メモリ帯域幅律速のロングコンテキストワークロードがFP16から3.5ビットに移行できれば、トークンあたりの実効コストを約5〜6倍削減できる。2026年Q4までに、ハイパースケーラーはBedrock/Azure/Vertexのトークン単価をオプトイン圧縮キャッシュ階層でゲートし、昨日のレポートが示した増分GPU capexのハードウェア上限テーゼは、GPU削減ではなくこのレバーを通じて締まっていく。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el Q4 2026 el dtype de compresion de KV-cache se expone como una palanca de despliegue de primera clase en cada stack de inferencia importante — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM todos envian un flag `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o equivalente) con TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** El 27-29 de abril lo convierte en una casi-certeza: **TurboQuant aterriza en ICLR 2026 + blog de Google Research**, **SGLang PR #21419 ya en el arbol** con una reescritura de kernel fusionado (#23134) alcanzando 93-105% del throughput de bf16, **NVIDIA kvpress** en madurez Decoding-Press, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demostrando cuantizacion de pool compartido multi-agente, y **ports de la comunidad MLX + Triton + vLLM** circulando antes de que aterrice el lanzamiento oficial Python de Google en el Q2 2026. La funcion forzante economica es la misma cinta de capex Mag-7 que el reporte WSJ del fallo de OpenAI del 28 de abril acaba de quebrar: cada workload de contexto largo limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pueda moverse de FP16 a 3.5-bit reduce el costo efectivo por token ~5-6x. Para el Q4 2026 los hyperscalers gatean el precio por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex sobre tiers opt-in de cache-comprimido, y la tesis del cap-de-hardware-sobre-capex-incremental-de-GPU del reporte de ayer se aprieta via esta palanca en lugar de via menos GPUs. description.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang KV-cache-compression dtype ay ilalabas bilang first-class deployment knob sa bawat major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM lahat ay maglalabas ng `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o katumbas) flag na may TurboQuant + kahit isang alternatibo (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Ang Apr 27-29 ay ginagawa itong halos kasiguraduhan: **TurboQuant ay lumapag sa ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 ay nasa-tree na** kasama ang fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) na umaabot ng 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** sa Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** na nag-demo ng multi-agent shared-pool quantization, at **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** na umiikot bago ang opisyal na Python release ng Google sa Q2 2026. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag-7 capex tape na binasag ng Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na maaaring lumipat mula FP16 papunta sa 3.5-bit ay nababawasan ang epektibong per-token cost ng ~5-6x. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang mga hyperscaler ay mag-gate ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing sa opt-in compressed-cache tiers, at ang hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis mula sa report kahapon ay tumitindi sa pamamagitan ng lever na ito sa halip na sa pamamagitan ng mas kakaunting GPUs. detail.description: **By Q4 2026 KV-cache-compression dtype is exposed as a first-class deployment knob in every major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM all ship a `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (or equivalent) flag with TurboQuant + at least one alternative (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Apr 27-29 makes this a near-certainty: **TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 already in-tree** with a fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** at Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demoing multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** circulating before Google's official Python release lands in Q2 2026. The economic forcing function is the same Mag-7 capex tape the Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report just cracked: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that can move from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x. By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年Q4までに、KVキャッシュ圧縮dtypeが主要な全推論スタックでファーストクラスのデプロイメント・ノブとして公開される — vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLMのすべてが、TurboQuantと少なくとも1つの代替手段(KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention)を備えた`--kv-cache-dtype turboquant`(または同等)フラグを出荷する。** 4月27日〜29日の動向で、これはほぼ確実となった: **TurboQuantがICLR 2026 + Google Researchブログに掲載**、**SGLang PR #21419はすでにツリー内**で、フューズドカーネル書き換え(#23134)がbf16スループットの93〜105%に到達、**NVIDIA kvpress**はDecoding-Press成熟度に達し、**PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** がマルチエージェント共有プール量子化をデモ、**コミュニティのMLX + Triton + vLLMポート**が2026年Q2のGoogle公式Pythonリリース前から流通している。経済的な強制関数は、4月28日OpenAIミスのWSJレポートが直撃したのと同じMag-7 capexテープだ: メモリ帯域幅律速のロングコンテキストワークロードがFP16から3.5ビットに移行できれば、トークンあたりの実効コストを約5〜6倍削減できる。2026年Q4までに、ハイパースケーラーはBedrock/Azure/Vertexのトークン単価をオプトイン圧縮キャッシュ階層でゲートし、昨日のレポートが示した増分GPU capexのハードウェア上限テーゼは、GPU削減ではなくこのレバーを通じて締まっていく。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el Q4 2026 el dtype de compresion de KV-cache se expone como una palanca de despliegue de primera clase en cada stack de inferencia importante — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM todos envian un flag `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o equivalente) con TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** El 27-29 de abril lo convierte en una casi-certeza: **TurboQuant aterriza en ICLR 2026 + blog de Google Research**, **SGLang PR #21419 ya en el arbol** con una reescritura de kernel fusionado (#23134) alcanzando 93-105% del throughput de bf16, **NVIDIA kvpress** en madurez Decoding-Press, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demostrando cuantizacion de pool compartido multi-agente, y **ports de la comunidad MLX + Triton + vLLM** circulando antes de que aterrice el lanzamiento oficial Python de Google en el Q2 2026. La funcion forzante economica es la misma cinta de capex Mag-7 que el reporte WSJ del fallo de OpenAI del 28 de abril acaba de quebrar: cada workload de contexto largo limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pueda moverse de FP16 a 3.5-bit reduce el costo efectivo por token ~5-6x. Para el Q4 2026 los hyperscalers gatean el precio por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex sobre tiers opt-in de cache-comprimido, y la tesis del cap-de-hardware-sobre-capex-incremental-de-GPU del reporte de ayer se aprieta via esta palanca en lugar de via menos GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang KV-cache-compression dtype ay ilalabas bilang first-class deployment knob sa bawat major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM lahat ay maglalabas ng `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o katumbas) flag na may TurboQuant + kahit isang alternatibo (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Ang Apr 27-29 ay ginagawa itong halos kasiguraduhan: **TurboQuant ay lumapag sa ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 ay nasa-tree na** kasama ang fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) na umaabot ng 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** sa Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** na nag-demo ng multi-agent shared-pool quantization, at **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** na umiikot bago ang opisyal na Python release ng Google sa Q2 2026. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag-7 capex tape na binasag ng Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na maaaring lumipat mula FP16 papunta sa 3.5-bit ay nababawasan ang epektibong per-token cost ng ~5-6x. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang mga hyperscaler ay mag-gate ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing sa opt-in compressed-cache tiers, at ang hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis mula sa report kahapon ay tumitindi sa pamamagitan ng lever na ito sa halip na sa pamamagitan ng mas kakaunting GPUs. nodes.description: **The OpenAI Apr 28 WSJ report initiates a 2026 "AI-revenue disclosure rewrite" — by Q3 2026 at least one foundation lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, or xAI) ships an audited monthly-revenue + WAU disclosure cadence, and at least one Mag-7 hyperscaler publishes Bedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertex per-token-margin disclosure separated from raw cloud revenue.** WSJ Apr 28 was decisive: a single off-target-leak dropped Oracle 4%, AMD 3%, Broadcom 4%, SoftBank 10% in one session, on top of the **Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft AGI-clause unwind** (which already removed the discretionary "AGI declaration" IP-revocation risk). Combined with the Mag-7 print collision today + ~$700B aggregated 2026 capex + the Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), Wall Street is now **explicitly demanding tangible AI-economics disclosure, not narrative**. By Q3 2026 the SEC + analyst pressure produces (a) at least one foundation lab moving to a public monthly revenue / WAU dashboard cadence, and (b) at least one Big-3 cloud separating per-token AI-platform margin in the 10-Q footnotes. The "AGI" word goes from metaphysical to financial-instrument; "DAU/WAU" goes from product KPI to MD&A. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

detail.description: **The OpenAI Apr 28 WSJ report initiates a 2026 "AI-revenue disclosure rewrite" — by Q3 2026 at least one foundation lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, or xAI) ships an audited monthly-revenue + WAU disclosure cadence, and at least one Mag-7 hyperscaler publishes Bedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertex per-token-margin disclosure separated from raw cloud revenue.** WSJ Apr 28 was decisive: a single off-target-leak dropped Oracle 4%, AMD 3%, Broadcom 4%, SoftBank 10% in one session, on top of the **Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft AGI-clause unwind** (which already removed the discretionary "AGI declaration" IP-revocation risk). Combined with the Mag-7 print collision today + ~$700B aggregated 2026 capex + the Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), Wall Street is now **explicitly demanding tangible AI-economics disclosure, not narrative**. By Q3 2026 the SEC + analyst pressure produces (a) at least one foundation lab moving to a public monthly revenue / WAU dashboard cadence, and (b) at least one Big-3 cloud separating per-token AI-platform margin in the 10-Q footnotes. The "AGI" word goes from metaphysical to financial-instrument; "DAU/WAU" goes from product KPI to MD&A. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.title: Local-LLM stacks expose unified compressed-KV-cache flag by H2 2026
nodes.description: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.

Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.
description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、すべての主要なローカルLLMエコシステム(vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM、Foundry Local)が統一された圧縮KVキャッシュデプロイメントノブ — TurboQuant + 少なくとも1つの代替案 — を公開し、Foundry Local(Microsoft、4月9日GA)はWindows ML / WinML実行プロバイダに紐付いたネイティブTurboQuant統合をWindowsデフォルト最適化として出荷する。** 4月27-29日のエビデンス:SGLang PR #21419がインツリー化、SGLang #23134のfused-Triton-decodeカーネル書き換えがbf16スループットの93–105%に到達、vLLM v0.19.0(4月2日)はtorch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / 非同期スケジューラがデフォルト + Model Runner V2、PolyKV(arxiv 2604.24971、4月27日)はマルチエージェント推論向けの共有非対称KVプール、NVIDIA kvpressはDecoding-Press成熟度、llama.cpp #20969のTurboQuant議論スレッドがアクティブ、Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論が20-30%高速化。Foundry Localは欠けていたエンタープライズWindowsエントリポイントである — Microsoftはこれをハードウェア対応のWinML実行プロバイダで任意のアプリにローカルAIをバンドルする約20MBのネイティブライブラリとして出荷しており、2026年Q2の明らかな次の一歩はFoundry CatalogでTurboQuantフラグを公開することである。経済的な強制要因はMag 7 capexテープと同じである:FP16から3.5ビットに移行するメモリ帯域幅律速の長文脈ワークロードはすべてトークンあたりの実効コストを約5-6倍削減し、Foundry Localはその切替をエンドデベロッパーに対して不可視にする。
description.es: **Para H2 2026 cada ecosistema mayor de LLM local (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) expone un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido — TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa — y Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA 9 abr) lanza integración nativa de TurboQuant atada a los execution providers de Windows ML / WinML como optimización por defecto en Windows.** Evidencia del 27-29 abr: el PR #21419 de SGLang está in-tree; la rescritura de fused-Triton-decode kernel de SGLang #23134 alcanza 93–105% del throughput bf16; vLLM v0.19.0 (2 abr) trae torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler por defecto + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, 27 abr) es un pool compartido asimétrico de KV para inferencia multi-agente; NVIDIA kvpress alcanza madurez en Decoding-Press; el hilo #20969 de discusión de TurboQuant en llama.cpp está activo; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inferencia 20-30% más rápida. Foundry Local es el punto de entrada empresarial-Windows que faltaba — Microsoft lo envía como una librería nativa de ~20MB que empaqueta IA local en cualquier app con execution providers de WinML adaptados al hardware, y el siguiente paso obvio para Q2 2026 es exponer un flag de TurboQuant en el Foundry Catalog. La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang bawat pangunahing local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) ay maglalantad ng unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + hindi bababa sa isang alternatibo — at ang Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ay magpapadala ng native TurboQuant integration na nakatali sa Windows ML / WinML execution providers bilang Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 ebidensiya: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite na umabot sa 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool para sa multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress sa Decoding-Press maturity; aktibo ang llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% mas mabilis. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

summary.es: **Para H2 2026 cada ecosistema mayor de LLM local (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) expone un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido — TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa — y Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA 9 abr) lanza integración nativa de TurboQuant atada a los execution providers de Windows ML / WinML como optimización por defecto en Windows.** Evidencia del 27-29 abr: el PR #21419 de SGLang está in-tree; la rescritura de fused-Triton-decode kernel de SGLang #23134 alcanza 93–105% del throughput bf16; vLLM v0.19.0 (2 abr) trae torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler por defecto + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, 27 abr) es un pool compartido asimétrico de KV para inferencia multi-agente; NVIDIA kvpress alcanza madurez en Decoding-Press; el hilo #20969 de discusión de TurboQuant en llama.cpp está activo; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inferencia 20-30% más rápida. Foundry Local es el punto de entrada empresarial-Windows que faltaba — Microsoft lo envía como una librería nativa de ~20MB que empaqueta IA local en cualquier app con execution providers de WinML adaptados al hardware, y el siguiente paso obvio para Q2 2026 es exponer un flag de TurboQuant en el Foundry Catalog. La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. summary.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang bawat pangunahing local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) ay maglalantad ng unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + hindi bababa sa isang alternatibo — at ang Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ay magpapadala ng native TurboQuant integration na nakatali sa Windows ML / WinML execution providers bilang Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 ebidensiya: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite na umabot sa 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool para sa multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress sa Decoding-Press maturity; aktibo ang llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% mas mabilis. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.

nodes.description: **The Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss report + Apr 29 Mag 7 print collision triggers a 2026 SEC + analyst push for AI-revenue disclosure rewrite — by Q3 2026 at least one foundation lab (OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) ships an audited monthly-revenue or WAU disclosure cadence, and at least one Big-3 hyperscaler separates Bedrock / Azure-OpenAI / Vertex per-token margin in 10-Q footnotes from raw cloud revenue.** Apr 28 selloff (S&P -0.49%, Nasdaq -0.9%, Oracle -4%, AMD -3%, Broadcom -4%, SoftBank -10%) was the first material crack in the AI-capex-on-faith tape; Apr 29 prints were a mixed reset (MSFT/GOOGL beat hard, META -7% AH); Apr 30 AAPL prints close the Mag 7 cycle. Microsoft already cited a $37B AI run rate (+123%) explicitly — that is the disclosure precedent. With the Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), the SEC + buyside pressure for explicit per-token margin + WAU disclosure converges around Q2-Q3 2026 earnings cycles. Powell's choice to stay on Board as a check on Trump-admin Fed investigation also raises the political-risk premium on the entire AI-capex tape; demanding harder numbers is the lever public markets have.
