In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **AIエージェントのセキュリティ標準が「サードパーティベンダー境界」と「URL命名エントロピー」に拡大する。** Mythosの不正アクセスインシデント(契約者 + 命名規則の推測 + サードパーティのデータ漏洩)は、Vercel-Context.aiのサプライチェーンパターンを再現しており、今度はフロンティアモデルのアクセス制御レイヤーで起きた。2026年Q3までに、「フロンティアモデルのプレビュー / 早期アクセスのサードパーティベンダー環境」は、SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forumの共通セキュリティベースラインのクリアが必要となり、エンドポイントURL / サブドメインはランダム化された推測困難な命名へ移行する。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los estándares de seguridad de agentes de IA se extienden a la "frontera de proveedores externos" y la "entropía de nomenclatura de URL."** El incidente de acceso no autorizado de Mythos (contratista + adivinanza de convención de nomenclatura + datos filtrados de terceros) repite el patrón de cadena de suministro de Vercel-Context.ai, esta vez en una capa de control de acceso de modelo de frontera. Para el Q3 2026, los "entornos de proveedores externos para preview / acceso temprano de modelos de frontera" deberán superar una línea base de seguridad común de SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum, y las URLs / subdominios de endpoints pasarán a una nomenclatura aleatorizada y difícil de adivinar. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang AI agent security standards ay umaabot na sa "third-party-vendor boundary" at "URL-naming entropy."** Ang Mythos unauthorized-access incident (contractor + naming-convention guess + third-party leaked data) ay umuulit sa Vercel-Context.ai supply-chain pattern, sa pagkakataong ito sa frontier-model access-control layer. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang "frontier model preview / early access third-party vendor environments" ay kakailanganing pumasa sa common security baseline ng SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum, at ang mga endpoint URL / subdomain ay lilipat sa randomized, mahirap-hulaang naming. text_locales.en: On the frontier-model preview SOC 2 + FedRAMP + FMF baseline prediction (April 23, revived), Anthropic's containment post documents the engineering posture (gVisor + seccomp, Seatbelt/Bubblewrap, full guest VMs) third-party preview vendors must now match or justify diverging from. text_locales.ja: フロンティアモデル・プレビューSOC 2 + FedRAMP + FMF基準予想(4月23日、再活性化)に対し、Anthropicの封じ込め投稿は、第三者プレビュー・ベンダーがいまや一致させるか、乖離の理由を正当化しなければならないエンジニアリング姿勢(gVisor + seccomp、Seatbelt/Bubblewrap、完全なゲストVM)を文書化する。成熟したハイパーバイザーがカスタム・セキュリティ・ラッパーを上回るという主張は、次回のプレビュー・アクセス審査周期での文書化された対比を硬化させる。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción del baseline de preview de modelo frontera SOC 2 + FedRAMP + FMF (23 de abril, revivida), la publicación de contención de Anthropic documenta la postura de ingeniería (gVisor + seccomp, Seatbelt/Bubblewrap, VMs guest completas) que los proveedores externos de preview deben ahora igualar o justificar por qué divergen. El argumento de que los hipervisores maduros superan a los wrappers de seguridad personalizados endurece el contraste documentado en el próximo ciclo de revisión de acceso a preview.
text_locales.fil: Sa hula ng frontier-model preview SOC 2 + FedRAMP + FMF baseline (Abril 23, revived), dinodokumento ng containment post ng Anthropic ang engineering posture (gVisor + seccomp, Seatbelt/Bubblewrap, full guest VMs) na kailangang itumbas o bigyan ng katwiran ng mga third-party preview vendors. Pinapatigas ng argumento na higit na mahusay ang matatandang hypervisors kaysa sa custom security wrappers ang dokumentadong kaibahan sa susunod na preview-access review cycle.

text_locales.en: Cisco's May 4 ~$400M Astrix acquisition explicitly governs API keys, service accounts, OAuth tokens, and machine-to-machine credentials AI agents now use at scale, with planned integration into Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo. Combined with FIS + Anthropic embedding engineers inside FIS infrastructure with full audit trail, today's evidence re-activates the dormant third-party-vendor security baseline thesis.
text_locales.ja: Ciscoの5月4日 約 $400M でのAstrix買収は、AIエージェントが現在大規模に使用するAPIキー、サービスアカウント、OAuthトークン、機械間認証情報を明示的にガバナンスし、Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duoへの統合が計画されている。FIS + Anthropicがエージェント決定の完全な監査証跡とともにエンジニアをFISインフラに埋め込むことと組み合わさり、本日の証拠はドーマントな第三者ベンダー・セキュリティ・ベースライン・テーゼを再活性化する。
text_locales.es: La adquisición Astrix de Cisco del 4 de mayo por ~$400M gobierna explícitamente claves API, cuentas de servicio, tokens OAuth y credenciales máquina-a-máquina que los agentes de IA ahora usan a escala, con integración planificada en Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo. Combinado con FIS + Anthropic integrando ingenieros dentro de la infraestructura FIS con rastro de auditoría completo, la evidencia de hoy reactiva la tesis de línea base de seguridad de proveedor-tercero dormante.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 ~$400M Astrix acquisition ng Cisco ay tahasang namamahala sa API keys, service accounts, OAuth tokens, at machine-to-machine credentials na ginagamit na ngayon ng AI agents sa scale, na may planned integration sa Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo. Pinagsama sa FIS + Anthropic na nag-eembed ng engineers sa loob ng FIS infrastructure na may full audit trail, ang ebidensiya ngayon ay muling nag-aaktibo sa dormant third-party-vendor security baseline thesis.

text_locales.en: Oracle's SuiteCloud Agent Skills is the first non-foundation-lab vendor to publish skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the default security frame. text_locales.es: SuiteCloud Agent Skills de Oracle es el primer vendor no-foundation-lab en publicar skills-as-a-product con distribución firmada como marco de seguridad por defecto. Esa es la misma forma que proyectaba la tesis de frontera-de-vendor-third-party de la predicción, aplicada una capa más arriba en el marketplace de skills en lugar de en la superficie de preview-URL. Útil pero parcial.
text_locales.fil: Ang SuiteCloud Agent Skills ng Oracle ay ang unang non-foundation-lab vendor na naglalathala ng skills-as-a-product na may signed-distribution bilang default na security frame. Iyan ang parehong hugis na inaasahan ng third-party-vendor-boundary thesis ng prediction, na inilapat isang layer pataas sa skills marketplace sa halip na sa preview-URL surface. Kapaki-pakinabang ngunit bahagya lamang.

nodes.title: Open-weight 1M-context era arrives as the new floor by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **The "1M context as default" open-weight era arrives in full by Q3 2026.** DeepSeek V4's "1M context designed in, not bolted on," Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension, Claude Opus 4.7's 1M context (Bedrock), and GPT-5.5's long-context strengthening all point the same direction. By Q3 2026, "native 1M context" becomes the floor for open weights, and existing 32K-128K models drop to legacy. RAG pipelines flip from "search → context-insert" to "dump everything in + dynamic prune," and vector DB vendors are pushed to redefine themselves as "long-context cache optimization layers." description.en: **The "1M context as default" open-weight era arrives in full by Q3 2026.** DeepSeek V4's "1M context designed in, not bolted on," Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension, Claude Opus 4.7's 1M context (Bedrock), and GPT-5.5's long-context strengthening all point the same direction. By Q3 2026, "native 1M context" becomes the floor for open weights, and existing 32K-128K models drop to legacy. RAG pipelines flip from "search → context-insert" to "dump everything in + dynamic prune," and vector DB vendors are pushed to redefine themselves as "long-context cache optimization layers." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「1Mコンテキストがデフォルト」のオープンウェイト時代がQ3 2026までに本格到来する。** DeepSeek V4の「1Mコンテキストは後付けではなく設計段階から組み込み」、Qwen3.6-27Bの262K → 1M拡張、Claude Opus 4.7の1Mコンテキスト(Bedrock)、GPT-5.5の長コンテキスト強化は、すべて同じ方向を指している。Q3 2026までに、「ネイティブ1Mコンテキスト」がオープンウェイトの最低水準となり、既存の32K-128Kモデルはレガシーに転落する。RAGパイプラインは「検索 → コンテキスト挿入」から「全部投入 + 動的プルーニング」へと反転し、ベクトルDBベンダーは「長コンテキスト・キャッシュ最適化レイヤー」への再定義を迫られる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La era de "contexto de 1M por defecto" en pesos abiertos llega de lleno para el Q3 2026.** El "contexto de 1M diseñado de origen, no añadido a la fuerza" de DeepSeek V4, la extensión de 262K → 1M de Qwen3.6-27B, el contexto de 1M de Claude Opus 4.7 (Bedrock) y el refuerzo de contexto largo de GPT-5.5 apuntan todos en la misma dirección. Para el Q3 2026, el "contexto de 1M nativo" se convierte en el piso para los pesos abiertos, y los modelos existentes de 32K-128K caen al nivel legacy. Los pipelines RAG cambian de "búsqueda → inserción de contexto" a "volcar todo + poda dinámica", y los proveedores de bases de datos vectoriales son empujados a redefinirse como "capas de optimización de caché de contexto largo". In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "1M context bilang default" open-weight era ay buong dadating sa Q3 2026.** Ang "1M context designed in, not bolted on" ng DeepSeek V4, ang 262K to 1M extension ng Qwen3.6-27B, ang 1M context ng Claude Opus 4.7 (Bedrock), at ang long-context strengthening ng GPT-5.5 ay lahat tumuturo sa parehong direksyon. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang "native 1M context" ay nagiging floor para sa open weights, at ang umiiral na 32K-128K models ay babagsak sa legacy. Ang RAG pipelines ay lumilipat mula sa "search → context-insert" papunta sa "dump everything in + dynamic prune," at ang mga vendor ng vector DB ay napipilitang i-redefine ang sarili bilang "long-context cache optimization layers." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4が1MコンテキストのHybrid-Attentionを担い、Anthropicが1Mコンテキストベータを廃止してSonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6で1Mを標準価格化することは、オープンウェイト1Mデフォルトのテーゼを直接強化する。PolyKVの共有マルチエージェント推論における97.7%のKVキャッシュ削減は、まさに予測が投影する長コンテキストキャッシュ置換アーキテクチャである。両側で強い強化シグナル。
text_locales.es: DeepSeek V4 acarreando Hybrid-Attention de 1M-context más Anthropic retirando su beta de 1M-context para hacer que 1M sea pricing estándar en Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 refuerza directamente la tesis de open-weight 1M-as-default. El recorte del 97.7% del KV-cache de PolyKV en inferencia multi-agente compartida es exactamente la arquitectura de reemplazo de long-context-cache que la predicción proyecta. Señal de refuerzo fuerte en ambos legs.
text_locales.fil: Ang DeepSeek V4 na nagdadala ng 1M-context Hybrid-Attention plus ang Anthropic na nag-retire ng 1M-context beta nito para gawing 1M standard pricing sa Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 ay direktang nagpapatibay sa open-weight 1M-as-default thesis. Ang 97.7% KV-cache cut ng PolyKV sa shared multi-agent inference ay eksaktong long-context-cache replacement architecture na ipina-project ng prediction. Strong reinforcing signal sa magkabilang leg.

bridges.text: The Spring AI vector-DB query-plane CVE is direct evidence that vendors are repositioning vector stores into the inference-server-class attack surface — the architectural shift the prediction anticipated. PolyKV's shared asymmetric KV-pool plus DeepSeek V4's native 1M context fill in the long-context-cache replacement architecture. Strong signal across multiple legs of the thesis.

text_locales.en: The Spring AI vector-DB query-plane CVE is direct evidence that vendors are repositioning vector stores into the inference-server-class attack surface — the architectural shift the prediction anticipated. PolyKV's shared asymmetric KV-pool plus DeepSeek V4's native 1M context fill in the long-context-cache replacement architecture. Strong signal across multiple legs of the thesis.
text_locales.ja: Spring AIベクトルDBクエリプレーンCVEは、ベンダーがベクトルストアを推論サーバクラスの攻撃面に再配置していることの直接的な証拠である — 予測が予期したアーキテクチャ的シフトである。PolyKVの共有非対称KVプールに加え、DeepSeek V4のネイティブ1Mコンテキストが長文脈キャッシュ置換アーキテクチャを埋める。テーゼの複数の脚にわたる強いシグナル。
text_locales.es: El CVE de Spring AI en el plano de query del vector-DB es evidencia directa de que los vendors están reposicionando los vector stores hacia la superficie de ataque clase inference-server — el cambio arquitectónico que anticipaba la predicción. El pool asimétrico compartido de KV de PolyKV más el contexto nativo 1M de DeepSeek V4 completan la arquitectura de reemplazo del cache de contexto largo. Señal fuerte a través de múltiples patas de la tesis.
text_locales.fil: Ang Spring AI vector-DB query-plane CVE ay direktang ebidensiya na nire-reposisyon ng vendors ang vector stores tungo sa inference-server-class attack surface — ang architectural shift na inaasahan ng prediction. Ang shared asymmetric KV-pool ng PolyKV kasama ang native 1M context ng DeepSeek V4 ay pumupuno sa long-context-cache replacement architecture. Matibay na signal sa maraming legs ng thesis.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4 ships 1M context as a designed-in property, Corpus2Skill demonstrates that hierarchical-skill-tree navigation beats dense retrieval and agentic RAG on WixQA without an embedding index at serve time, and PolyKV proposes a shared multi-agent KV-cache pool. Together they materialize the consequence the prediction projects: pipelines flip from search-then-insert to dump-and-prune, and vector DBs are pushed toward long-context cache layers.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4 ships 1M context as a designed-in property, Corpus2Skill demonstrates that hierarchical-skill-tree navigation beats dense retrieval and agentic RAG on WixQA without an embedding index at serve time, and PolyKV proposes a shared multi-agent KV-cache pool. Together they materialize the consequence the prediction projects: pipelines flip from search-then-insert to dump-and-prune, and vector DBs are pushed toward long-context cache layers.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4が1Mコンテキストを設計上の特性として出荷し、Corpus2Skillが階層的スキル・ツリー・ナビゲーションがサーブ時に埋め込みインデックスなしでWixQA上で密検索とagentic RAGを上回ることを実証し、PolyKVが共有マルチエージェントKVキャッシュ・プールを提案する。これらが組み合わさり、予測が投影する結果を物質化する: パイプラインがsearch-then-insertからdump-and-pruneに反転し、ベクトルDBはロングコンテキスト・キャッシュ層に押し進められる。
text_locales.es: DeepSeek V4 envia contexto 1M como propiedad disenada-por-dentro, Corpus2Skill demuestra que la navegacion de skill-tree jerarquico supera a dense retrieval y agentic RAG en WixQA sin un indice de embedding en serve time, y PolyKV propone un pool de KV-cache compartido multi-agente. Juntos materializan la consecuencia que la prediccion proyecta: los pipelines voltean de search-then-insert a dump-and-prune, y los vector DBs son empujados hacia capas de cache long-context.
text_locales.fil: Ang DeepSeek V4 ay naglalabas ng 1M context bilang designed-in property, ang Corpus2Skill ay nagpapakita na ang hierarchical-skill-tree navigation ay tinatalo ang dense retrieval at agentic RAG sa WixQA nang walang embedding index sa serve time, at ang PolyKV ay nagmumungkahi ng shared multi-agent KV-cache pool. Magkakasama silang nag-mamaterialize ng konsekwensyang ipino-project ng hula: ang pipelines ay lumilipat mula search-then-insert papunta sa dump-and-prune, at ang vector DBs ay itinutulak patungo sa long-context cache layers.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4's designed-in 1M context compute economics plus Opus 4.7's 1M ceiling on Bedrock reinforce the underlying premise that native 1M is now the floor rather than a bolt-on extension across both open and proprietary surfaces.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4's designed-in 1M context compute economics plus Opus 4.7's 1M ceiling on Bedrock reinforce the underlying premise that native 1M is now the floor rather than a bolt-on extension across both open and proprietary surfaces.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4 のはじめから組み込まれた 1M コンテキスト計算経済学と Bedrock 上の Opus 4.7 の 1M 上限は、ネイティブ 1M がオープン側と独自側の両表面でアドオン拡張ではなく床になっているという根底前提を補強する。
text_locales.es: La economía de cómputo de contexto 1M diseñada de DeepSeek V4 más el techo 1M de Opus 4.7 en Bedrock refuerzan la premisa subyacente de que 1M nativo es ahora el piso en lugar de una extensión bolt-on a través de superficies tanto abiertas como propietarias.
text_locales.fil: Ang designed-in 1M context compute economics ng DeepSeek V4 plus ang 1M ceiling ng Opus 4.7 sa Bedrock ay pinatatatag ang underlying premise na ang native 1M ay floor ngayon sa halip na bolt-on extension sa parehong open at proprietary surfaces.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4's designed-in 1M context plus Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension reinforce the underlying premise that native 1M is now the open-weight floor, not a bolt-on.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4's designed-in 1M context plus Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension reinforce the underlying premise that native 1M is now the open-weight floor, not a bolt-on.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4 の設計時点での 1M コンテキストと Qwen3.6-27B の 262K → 1M 拡張は、ネイティブな 1M が今やオープンウェイトのフロアであり、後付けではないという根底前提を補強している。
text_locales.es: El 1M context diseñado en DeepSeek V4 más la extensión 262K → 1M de Qwen3.6-27B refuerzan la premisa subyacente de que el 1M nativo es ahora el piso de pesos abiertos, no un agregado.
text_locales.fil: Ang designed-in 1M context ng DeepSeek V4 kasama ang 262K -> 1M extension ng Qwen3.6-27B ay nagpapatibay sa underlying premise na ang native 1M ay ngayon ang open-weight floor, hindi bolt-on.

bridges.text: gHacks' confirmation of DeepSeek V4's Hybrid Attention cutting memory 9.5x-13.7x at 1M-token context with Huawei Ascend tuning and ~7x lower cost than Opus 4.7 plus Hugging Face's Qwen3.6-27B card with 262K context extensible to 1M deliver two concurrent native-1M open-weight confirmations inside the window.

text_locales.en: gHacks' confirmation of DeepSeek V4's Hybrid Attention cutting memory 9.5x-13.7x at 1M-token context with Huawei Ascend tuning and ~7x lower cost than Opus 4.7 plus Hugging Face's Qwen3.6-27B card with 262K context extensible to 1M deliver two concurrent native-1M open-weight confirmations inside the window.
text_locales.ja: gHacksによるDeepSeek V4のハイブリッド・アテンション(1Mトークン・コンテキストでメモリを9.5x-13.7x削減、ファーウェイ・アセンドのチューニング、Opus 4.7より~7x低コスト)の確認に加え、Hugging FaceのQwen3.6-27Bカード(262Kコンテキスト、1Mまで拡張可能)が、ウィンドウ内に2件の同時ネイティブ1Mオープンウェイト確認を提供する。
text_locales.es: La confirmación de gHacks de Hybrid Attention de DeepSeek V4 recortando memoria 9.5x-13.7x a contexto de 1M tokens con ajuste para Huawei Ascend y ~7x menor costo que Opus 4.7 más la tarjeta Qwen3.6-27B de Hugging Face con contexto 262K extensible a 1M entregan dos confirmaciones concurrentes de open-weight nativo-1M dentro de la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang gHacks' confirmation ng DeepSeek V4's Hybrid Attention na nagba-bawas ng memory ng 9.5x-13.7x sa 1M-token context na may Huawei Ascend tuning at ~7x mas mababang gastos kaysa Opus 4.7 plus ang Hugging Face's Qwen3.6-27B card na may 262K context na maaaring i-extend sa 1M ay naghahatid ng dalawang concurrent native-1M open-weight confirmations sa loob ng window.

bridges.text: TechXplore's Hybrid Attention writeup pinning long-context inference cost at 27% of V3.2 with KV cache at 10%, Cryptonomist's open-source 1M-token race framing, and OFox's release guide confirming 1.6T MoE / 1M context / Apache 2.0 / immediate API availability give three concurrent confirmations of native 1M context in open weights.

text_locales.en: TechXplore's Hybrid Attention writeup pinning long-context inference cost at 27% of V3.2 with KV cache at 10%, Cryptonomist's open-source 1M-token race framing, and OFox's release guide confirming 1.6T MoE / 1M context / Apache 2.0 / immediate API availability give three concurrent confirmations of native 1M context in open weights.
text_locales.ja: TechXploreのハイブリッド・アテンション分析が長コンテキスト推論コストをV3.2の27%、KVキャッシュを10%にピンポイント、Cryptonomistのオープンソース1Mトークンレースの枠組み、OFoxのリリース・ガイドが1.6T MoE / 1Mコンテキスト / Apache 2.0 / 即時API利用可能を確認することが、オープンウェイトでのネイティブ1Mコンテキストの3つの同時並行的確認を提供する。
text_locales.es: El writeup de Hybrid Attention de TechXplore fijando el costo de inferencia de contexto largo al 27% de V3.2 con caché KV al 10%, el encuadre de Cryptonomist de la carrera open-source de 1M tokens, y la guía de lanzamiento de OFox confirmando 1.6T MoE / contexto 1M / Apache 2.0 / disponibilidad inmediata de API dan tres confirmaciones concurrentes de contexto 1M nativo en pesos abiertos.
text_locales.fil: Ang Hybrid Attention writeup ng TechXplore na nagpipipi sa long-context inference cost sa 27% ng V3.2 kasama ang KV cache sa 10%, ang open-source 1M-token race framing ng Cryptonomist, at ang release guide ng OFox na nagkukumpirma ng 1.6T MoE / 1M context / Apache 2.0 / agarang API availability ay nagbibigay ng tatlong sabay-sabay na kumpirmasyon ng native 1M context sa open weights.

detail.description: **The "1M context as default" open-weight era arrives in full by Q3 2026.** DeepSeek V4's "1M context designed in, not bolted on," Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension, Claude Opus 4.7's 1M context (Bedrock), and GPT-5.5's long-context strengthening all point the same direction. By Q3 2026, "native 1M context" becomes the floor for open weights, and existing 32K-128K models drop to legacy. RAG pipelines flip from "search → context-insert" to "dump everything in + dynamic prune," and vector DB vendors are pushed to redefine themselves as "long-context cache optimization layers." By Q3 2026, "native 1M context" becomes the floor for open weights, and existing 32K-128K models drop to legacy. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **「1Mコンテキストがデフォルト」のオープンウェイト時代がQ3 2026までに本格到来する。** DeepSeek V4の「1Mコンテキストは後付けではなく設計段階から組み込み」、Qwen3.6-27Bの262K → 1M拡張、Claude Opus 4.7の1Mコンテキスト(Bedrock)、GPT-5.5の長コンテキスト強化は、すべて同じ方向を指している。Q3 2026までに、「ネイティブ1Mコンテキスト」がオープンウェイトの最低水準となり、既存の32K-128Kモデルはレガシーに転落する。RAGパイプラインは「検索 → コンテキスト挿入」から「全部投入 + 動的プルーニング」へと反転し、ベクトルDBベンダーは「長コンテキスト・キャッシュ最適化レイヤー」への再定義を迫られる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **La era de "contexto de 1M por defecto" en pesos abiertos llega de lleno para el Q3 2026.** El "contexto de 1M diseñado de origen, no añadido a la fuerza" de DeepSeek V4, la extensión de 262K → 1M de Qwen3.6-27B, el contexto de 1M de Claude Opus 4.7 (Bedrock) y el refuerzo de contexto largo de GPT-5.5 apuntan todos en la misma dirección. Para el Q3 2026, el "contexto de 1M nativo" se convierte en el piso para los pesos abiertos, y los modelos existentes de 32K-128K caen al nivel legacy. Los pipelines RAG cambian de "búsqueda → inserción de contexto" a "volcar todo + poda dinámica", y los proveedores de bases de datos vectoriales son empujados a redefinirse como "capas de optimización de caché de contexto largo". In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang "1M context bilang default" open-weight era ay buong dadating sa Q3 2026.** Ang "1M context designed in, not bolted on" ng DeepSeek V4, ang 262K to 1M extension ng Qwen3.6-27B, ang 1M context ng Claude Opus 4.7 (Bedrock), at ang long-context strengthening ng GPT-5.5 ay lahat tumuturo sa parehong direksyon. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang "native 1M context" ay nagiging floor para sa open weights, at ang umiiral na 32K-128K models ay babagsak sa legacy. Ang RAG pipelines ay lumilipat mula sa "search → context-insert" papunta sa "dump everything in + dynamic prune," at ang mga vendor ng vector DB ay napipilitang i-redefine ang sarili bilang "long-context cache optimization layers." nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.

description.en: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.
description.ja: 2026年Q3までにエージェント型AIのCVEクラスが独立した第一級のCNA発行サブコーパスとなり、CSAIのMITRE認定CNAの下でエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが50件以上公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic skills、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Face skills)が公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みの必須ゲートを実装する。4月29日のCSAI MITRE-CNA認定は制度的な火種であり、4月28日のATT&CK v19は技術名(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント展開)を命名し、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDKは7つのサンドボックスプロバイダー(Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel)全体でデフォルトのプリミティブとしてネイティブサンドボックス実行を出荷し、4月28日のNovita Sandbox+4月28日のAWS Bedrock Managed Agents+4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry hosted agentsはベンダー側の対応を形成し、4月26日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208(単一のSQLi行がOpenAI+Anthropic+Bedrockキーを漏洩)+4月28日のSpring AI CVE-2026-40967+繰り越しのSGLang CVE-2026-5760はモデルツールレイヤー注入の影響半径を実証している。強制関数は企業のリスク移転である ― 明示的なAIエージェント任務を持つCNAが存在すれば、開示ケイデンスはランダムパブリッシャーから調整発行者主導へと圧縮され、スキルマーケットプレイスはエンタープライズ顧客を失わずに署名なしデフォルトを維持できなくなる。CSAIの最初のフルクォーター(2026年Q3)が閾値を超える最も可能性の高い着地点である。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 la clase de CVE de IA-agéntica se convierte en su propio sub-corpus de primera clase emitido por una CNA, con ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicadas bajo la CNA autorizada por MITRE de CSAI, y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills (skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face) lanza un gate obligatorio de firma + atestación de provenance antes de publicar. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.
description.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang agentic-AI CVE class ay magiging sariling first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, na may ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na inilathala sa ilalim ng MITRE-authorized CNA ng CSAI, at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ay maglulunsad ng mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate bago mag-publish. Ang Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ang institutional spark; ang Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ay nagpangalan sa mga technique (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ay naglulunsad ng native sandbox execution bilang default primitive sa 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents ang bumubuo ng vendor-side counterpart; ang Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row na naglalabas ng OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nagpapakita ng model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise risk transfer — kapag may CNA na may explicit AI-agent mandate, mag-co-compress ang disclosure cadence mula random-publisher patungo sa coordinated-issuer-driven, at hindi makakaiwas ang skill marketplaces na manatiling unsigned-by-default nang hindi nawawalan ng enterprise customers. Ang first-pull-quarter ng CSAI (Q3 2026) ay ang pinaka-malamang na landing zone para malagpasan ang threshold.

detail.summary_short: CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE CNA authorization plus ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques and parallel sandbox-as-primitive launches at OpenAI, AWS, and Microsoft point to ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs publishing under the CSAI CNA and at least one major skill marketplace mandating signed + provenance-attested gates before publish by Q3 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE CNA authorization plus ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques and parallel sandbox-as-primitive launches at OpenAI, AWS, and Microsoft point to ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs publishing under the CSAI CNA and at least one major skill marketplace mandating signed + provenance-attested gates before publish by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: CSAIの4月29日のMITRE CNA認定に加え、ATT&CK v19が命名したエージェント型技法、OpenAI、AWS、Microsoftの並行するサンドボックス・アズ・プリミティブ・ローンチは、2026年Q3までにCSAI CNAの下で50件以上のエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイスが公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みゲートを必須化することを示している。
summary_short_locales.es: La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr más las técnicas agénticas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 y los lanzamientos paralelos de sandbox-como-primitiva en OpenAI, AWS y Microsoft apuntan a ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicándose bajo la CNA de CSAI y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills exigiendo gates firmados + atestados con provenance antes de publicar para Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Apr 29 MITRE CNA authorization ng CSAI plus ang named agentic techniques ng ATT&CK v19 at ang parallel sandbox-as-primitive launches sa OpenAI, AWS, at Microsoft ay tumuturo sa ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na maipa-publish sa ilalim ng CSAI CNA at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace na mag-mandate ng signed + provenance-attested gates bago mag-publish pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: NHS England's blocklist names five distinct agentic-runtime CVEs (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) tied to the CISA May 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, and Trail of Bits publishes a sixth (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) the same week — the empirical base for a distinguishable agentic-AI CVE class hardens, but advisory coordination still flows through CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS rather than a CSAI CNA.

text_locales.en: NHS England's blocklist names five distinct agentic-runtime CVEs (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) tied to the CISA May 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, and Trail of Bits publishes a sixth (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) the same week — the empirical base for a distinguishable agentic-AI CVE class hardens, but advisory coordination still flows through CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS rather than a CSAI CNA.
text_locales.ja: NHS Englandのブロックリストは5つの異なるエージェンティック・ランタイムCVE(Ni8mare、LangGraph、LiteLLM、CrewAI、Haystack)をCISA 5月21日KEVミラーリング期限に紐付けて命名し、Trail of Bitsは同じ週で6つ目(SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1)を公表 — 区別可能なエージェンティックAI CVEクラスのための経験的ベースが硬化するが、アドバイザリー連携はCSAI CNAではなくCISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHSを通じて依然流れる。
text_locales.es: La blocklist de NHS England nombra cinco CVEs de runtime agéntico distintos (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) atados a la fecha límite KEV-mirroring del 21 de mayo de CISA, y Trail of Bits publica un sexto (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) la misma semana — la base empírica para una clase distinguible de CVE IA agéntica se endurece, pero la coordinación de avisos todavía fluye a través de CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS en lugar de un CSAI CNA.
text_locales.fil: Pinapangalanan ng blocklist ng NHS England ang limang distinct agentic-runtime CVEs (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) na nakatali sa CISA Mayo 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, at naglathala ang Trail of Bits ng pang-anim (SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 CVSS 8.1) sa parehong linggo — tumitigas ang empirical base para sa distinguishable agentic-AI CVE class, ngunit dumadaloy pa rin ang advisory coordination sa pamamagitan ng CISA / GitLab / OWASP / NHS sa halip na CSAI CNA.

bridges.text: CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 deserialization RCE in the agent-task-checkpoint loader and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 unauthenticated path-traversal in the deepset-cloud agent-tool registry land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM, both added to the OWASP GenAI Exploit feed within hours. Aikido and Sysdig flag at least seven additional unmaintained agent-checkpoint loaders with structurally similar exposure, supplying the multi-vendor weekly cadence the CSAI sub-corpus requires.

Aikido and Sysdig flag at least seven additional unmaintained agent-checkpoint loaders with structurally similar exposure, supplying the multi-vendor weekly cadence the CSAI sub-corpus requires.
text_locales.ja: agent-task-checkpointローダーにおけるCrewAI CVE-2026-44352デシリアライゼーションRCE、およびdeepset-cloud agent-toolレジストリにおけるHaystack CVE-2026-44391の認証なしpath-traversalは、LangGraphとLiteLLMの24時間後に着地し、両方とも数時間以内にOWASP GenAI Exploitフィードに追加される。AikidoとSysdigは、構造的に類似した暴露パターンを持つ未保守agent-checkpointローダーが少なくともさらに7件存在することをフラグし、CSAIサブコーパスが要求するマルチベンダー週次cadenceを供給する。

Aikido y Sysdig senalan al menos siete agent-checkpoint loaders no mantenidos adicionales con exposicion estructuralmente similar, suministrando la cadencia semanal multi-vendor que requiere el sub-corpus CSAI.
text_locales.fil: Ang CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 deserialization RCE sa agent-task-checkpoint loader at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 unauthenticated path-traversal sa deepset-cloud agent-tool registry ay lumalapag 24 oras matapos ang LangGraph plus LiteLLM, parehong idinagdag sa OWASP GenAI Exploit feed sa loob ng ilang oras. Tinatandaan ng Aikido at Sysdig ang hindi bababa sa pitong karagdagang unmaintained agent-checkpoint loaders na may structurally similar exposure, nagbibigay ng multi-vendor weekly cadence na kinakailangan ng CSAI sub-corpus.

bridges.text: n8n entering KEV plus LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass within hours of disclosure plus MCP-server exposure compounding at +34%/4 weeks tighten the structural force the agentic-AI CVE-as-sub-corpus prediction (May 1) names: the AI-tooling CVE category is now operationally distinguishable by advisory shape and exploitation-latency profile across multi-vendor weekly cadence.

text_locales.en: n8n entering KEV plus LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass within hours of disclosure plus MCP-server exposure compounding at +34%/4 weeks tighten the structural force the agentic-AI CVE-as-sub-corpus prediction (May 1) names: the AI-tooling CVE category is now operationally distinguishable by advisory shape and exploitation-latency profile across multi-vendor weekly cadence.
text_locales.ja: n8nのKEV入りに加え、LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM認証バイパスが開示後数時間で発生、MCPサーバー露出が4週間で+34%増加し、エージェント型AI CVEサブコーパス予測(5月1日)が指す構造的力を強化する。AIツーリングCVEカテゴリーは、勧告形態とエクスプロイト潜時プロファイルにより、マルチベンダー週次ケイデンス全体で運用上区別可能となった。
text_locales.es: n8n entrando al KEV más SSRF de LangGraph + bypass de autenticación de LiteLLM en horas tras la divulgación más exposición de servidores MCP componiéndose a +34%/4 semanas tensan la fuerza estructural que la predicción de CVE-como-subcorpus de IA agéntica (1 de mayo) nombra: la categoría CVE de herramientas de IA es ahora operativamente distinguible por la forma del aviso y el perfil de latencia de explotación a través de cadencia semanal multi-proveedor.
text_locales.fil: Ang pagpasok ng n8n sa KEV kasama ang LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass sa loob ng oras pagkatapos ng disclosure kasama ang MCP-server exposure na nagco-compound sa +34%/4 weeks ay naghihigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng agentic-AI CVE-as-sub-corpus prediction (Mayo 1): ang AI-tooling CVE category ay operational distinguishable na ngayon sa pamamagitan ng advisory shape at exploitation-latency profile sa multi-vendor weekly cadence.

bridges.text: The Ni8mare CVSS-10 RCE plus the Flowise prompt-injection RCE plus the LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency, all multi-vendor advisory-coordinated within one week, deliver exactly the precondition the agentic-AI CVE-as-sub-corpus prediction (May 1) names: the AI-tooling CVE category is now operationally distinguishable from generic web-app CVEs by advisory shape and exploitation-latency profile.

text_locales.en: The Ni8mare CVSS-10 RCE plus the Flowise prompt-injection RCE plus the LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency, all multi-vendor advisory-coordinated within one week, deliver exactly the precondition the agentic-AI CVE-as-sub-corpus prediction (May 1) names: the AI-tooling CVE category is now operationally distinguishable from generic web-app CVEs by advisory shape and exploitation-latency profile.
text_locales.ja: Ni8mare CVSS-10 RCEに加え、FlowiseのプロンプトインジェクションRCE、LMDeployの12時間31分の悪用レイテンシ、これらすべてが1週間以内に複数ベンダーでアドバイザリ協調されており、エージェンティックAI CVEのサブコーパス予測(5月1日)が指摘する前提条件をまさに満たす: AIツーリングCVEカテゴリは現在、アドバイザリの形状と悪用レイテンシのプロファイルにより、汎用Webアプリ CVEから運用上区別可能になっている。
text_locales.es: El RCE Ni8mare CVSS-10 más el RCE prompt-injection de Flowise más la latencia de 12h-31m de LMDeploy, todos coordinados con avisos multi-vendor en una semana, entregan exactamente la condición previa que nombra la predicción de CVE de IA agéntica como sub-corpus (1 de mayo): la categoría CVE de tooling-IA es ahora operacionalmente distinguible de los CVEs genéricos de aplicaciones web por la forma del aviso y el perfil de latencia de explotación.
text_locales.fil: Ang Ni8mare CVSS-10 RCE plus ang Flowise prompt-injection RCE plus ang LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency, lahat ay multi-vendor advisory-coordinated sa loob ng isang linggo, ay nagdedeliver ng eksaktong precondition na pinapangalanan ng agentic-AI CVE-as-sub-corpus prediction (Mayo 1): operationally distinguishable na ang AI-tooling CVE category mula sa generic web-app CVEs sa pamamagitan ng advisory shape at exploitation-latency profile.

text_locales.fil: Ang 15-day SGLang CVE-2026-5760 carry plus ang Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain plus ang Stellar Cyber operative survey treatment ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition: ang agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVE class ay may volume at named-technique scaffolding na kailangan bago i-compress ng CSAI Foundation's CNA cadence ang disclosure.

bridges.text: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority plus ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques plus the still-unpatched SGLang CVE plus LiteLLM key-leak SQLi compose the disclosure issuance and exemplar pipeline the prediction's >=50-CVE landing depends on. Glasswing's gated-distribution shape is the marketplace-side analog.

text_locales.en: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority plus ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques plus the still-unpatched SGLang CVE plus LiteLLM key-leak SQLi compose the disclosure issuance and exemplar pipeline the prediction's >=50-CVE landing depends on. Glasswing's gated-distribution shape is the marketplace-side analog.
text_locales.ja: CSAIのMITRE-CNA権限とATT&CK v19の命名済みエージェント手法、未だ未パッチのSGLang CVE、LiteLLM鍵漏洩SQLiが、予測の>=50-CVEランディングが依存する開示発出と模範パイプラインを構成する。Glasswingのゲート付き配布形は、マーケットプレイス側のアナログだ。
text_locales.es: La autoridad MITRE-CNA de CSAI más las técnicas agénticas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 más el SGLang CVE aún sin parchar más LiteLLM key-leak SQLi componen la tubería de emisión de divulgación y ejemplares de la que depende el aterrizaje de >=50 CVEs de la predicción. La forma de distribución gated de Glasswing es el análogo del lado de marketplace.
text_locales.fil: Ang MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI plus ang named agentic techniques ng ATT&CK v19 plus ang nananatiling unpatched na SGLang CVE plus LiteLLM key-leak SQLi ay bumubuo ng disclosure issuance at exemplar pipeline na inaasahan ng >=50-CVE landing ng prediction. Ang gated-distribution shape ng Glasswing ang marketplace-side analog.

bridges.text: The CSAI MITRE-CNA lane plus the steady drip of agent-tooling CVEs (SGLang unpatched, IBM Langflow, UTT HiPER, LiteLLM) keep the issuance pipeline fed exactly the way the prediction needs to reach the ≥50-CVE threshold.

text_locales.en: The CSAI MITRE-CNA lane plus the steady drip of agent-tooling CVEs (SGLang unpatched, IBM Langflow, UTT HiPER, LiteLLM) keep the issuance pipeline fed exactly the way the prediction needs to reach the ≥50-CVE threshold.
text_locales.ja: CSAI MITRE-CNAレーンと、エージェントツーリングCVEの安定したドリップ(SGLang未パッチ、IBM Langflow、UTT HiPER、LiteLLM)が、予測が≥50 CVE閾値に到達するために必要な発行パイプラインを正に供給し続けている。
text_locales.es: El carril MITRE-CNA de CSAI más el goteo constante de CVEs de tooling de agentes (SGLang sin parchear, IBM Langflow, UTT HiPER, LiteLLM) mantienen la tubería de emisión alimentada exactamente como la predicción necesita para alcanzar el umbral de ≥50 CVEs.
text_locales.fil: Ang CSAI MITRE-CNA lane kasama ang patuloy na pagdaloy ng agent-tooling CVEs (SGLang unpatched, IBM Langflow, UTT HiPER, LiteLLM) ay nagpapanatili ng pinakain ang issuance pipeline eksakto sa paraang kailangan ng prediction upang abutin ang ≥50-CVE threshold.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q3までにエージェント型AIのCVEクラスが独立した第一級のCNA発行サブコーパスとなり、CSAIのMITRE認定CNAの下でエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが50件以上公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic skills、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Face skills)が公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みの必須ゲートを実装する。4月29日のCSAI MITRE-CNA認定は制度的な火種であり、4月28日のATT&CK v19は技術名(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント展開)を命名し、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDKは7つのサンドボックスプロバイダー(Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel)全体でデフォルトのプリミティブとしてネイティブサンドボックス実行を出荷し、4月28日のNovita Sandbox+4月28日のAWS Bedrock Managed Agents+4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry hosted agentsはベンダー側の対応を形成し、4月26日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208(単一のSQLi行がOpenAI+Anthropic+Bedrockキーを漏洩)+4月28日のSpring AI CVE-2026-40967+繰り越しのSGLang CVE-2026-5760はモデルツールレイヤー注入の影響半径を実証している。強制関数は企業のリスク移転である ― 明示的なAIエージェント任務を持つCNAが存在すれば、開示ケイデンスはランダムパブリッシャーから調整発行者主導へと圧縮され、スキルマーケットプレイスはエンタープライズ顧客を失わずに署名なしデフォルトを維持できなくなる。CSAIの最初のフルクォーター(2026年Q3)が閾値を超える最も可能性の高い着地点である。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 la clase de CVE de IA-agéntica se convierte en su propio sub-corpus de primera clase emitido por una CNA, con ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicadas bajo la CNA autorizada por MITRE de CSAI, y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills (skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face) lanza un gate obligatorio de firma + atestación de provenance antes de publicar. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang agentic-AI CVE class ay magiging sariling first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, na may ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na inilathala sa ilalim ng MITRE-authorized CNA ng CSAI, at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ay maglulunsad ng mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate bago mag-publish. Ang Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ang institutional spark; ang Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ay nagpangalan sa mga technique (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ay naglulunsad ng native sandbox execution bilang default primitive sa 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents ang bumubuo ng vendor-side counterpart; ang Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row na naglalabas ng OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nagpapakita ng model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise risk transfer — kapag may CNA na may explicit AI-agent mandate, mag-co-compress ang disclosure cadence mula random-publisher patungo sa coordinated-issuer-driven, at hindi makakaiwas ang skill marketplaces na manatiling unsigned-by-default nang hindi nawawalan ng enterprise customers. Ang first-pull-quarter ng CSAI (Q3 2026) ay ang pinaka-malamang na landing zone para malagpasan ang threshold.

description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、5月1日のCopy Fail(CVE-2026-31431)BOD-22-01の14日期限 + 4月30日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208の26時間悪用ウィンドウ + 5月1日まで未パッチのSGLang CVE-2026-5760という3点セットが、「LLMツーリング層CVEのサプライチェーン武器化」を支配的な攻撃パターンにする — 少なくとも1つの大手IRファームが、LLMゲートウェイ/エージェントハーネス/推論ランタイムのCVEとLinuxカーネルLPE(Copy Failまたはその後継)を組み合わせて、マルチテナント推論基盤上でフルチェーンrootを取得した実際の侵入の公開ポストモーテムを発表する;少なくとも1つのCSAI-CNA発行のアドバイザリーが、ATT&CK v19のDefense Impairment内で、LLMツーリング+カーネル連鎖を名前付きテクニックとして明示的に切り出す。** 4月28日のATT&CK v19はすでにエージェント関連テクニック(コンテキストポイズニング、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェントデプロイ)を命名している;5月1日のCopy Failの波が、攻撃者にクラウドサービスプロバイダーへの実環境利用が確認された(Microsoft Security Blog開示による)汎用Linux LPEを与えた;LiteLLMのSQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keysの先例が、横展開ベクトルを与える。CSAIの4月29日CNA認可は開示発行側であり、IRファームのQ3インシデントレポートにとって最も抵抗の少ない経路は、まさにこの形で組み立てられた1件のクラウドマルチテナント侵入である。In plain language: ハッカーはAIツーリングのバグとLinuxカーネルのバグを連鎖させて、共有AIサーバーを乗っ取れる。In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el H2 2026, el plazo de 14 días BOD-22-01 del Copy Fail del 1 mayo (CVE-2026-31431) + la ventana de explotación de 26 horas del LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 30 abr + el trío SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sin parchear hasta el 1 mayo convierte la "weaponización de la cadena de suministro de CVEs de la capa de tooling-LLM" en el patrón dominante de los atacantes — al menos una firma importante de respuesta a incidentes publicará un post-mortem público de una intrusión real que combine un CVE de gateway-LLM / agent-harness / inference-runtime con un LPE del kernel Linux (Copy Fail o su sucesor) para obtener root de cadena completa en inferencia multi-inquilino, y al menos un aviso emitido por CSAI-CNA destacará explícitamente la cadena tooling-LLM + kernel como técnica nombrada dentro del Defense Impairment de ATT&CK v19.** ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr ya nombra las técnicas agénticas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agente malicioso); la ola Copy Fail del 1 mayo da a los atacantes un LPE Linux universal con uso confirmado en el mundo real contra proveedores de servicios cloud (según divulgación del Microsoft Security Blog); el precedente de SQLi-fuga-de-claves-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock de LiteLLM les da el vector de movimiento lateral. La autorización CNA del 29 abr de CSAI es el lado de emisión de divulgaciones; la ruta de menor resistencia para un informe de incidentes Q3 de una firma IR es una intrusión cloud multi-inquilino unida exactamente de esta forma. En lenguaje claro: Los hackers pueden encadenar un bug de tooling de IA con un bug del kernel Linux para tomar el control de servidores de IA compartidos. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
description.fil: **Sa H2 2026 ang trio ng May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + ang unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay magpapakahulugan sa "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" bilang dominanteng attacker pattern — hindi bababa sa isang major IR firm ang maglalathala ng pampublikong post-mortem ng totoong intrusion na pinagsasama ang LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE sa Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail o ang successor nito) para sa full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, at hindi bababa sa isang CSAI-CNA-issued advisory ang explicitly mag-cha-carve out sa LLM-tooling + kernel chain bilang named technique sa loob ng Defense Impairment ng ATT&CK v19.** Pinangalanan na ng Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ang agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang May 1 Copy Fail wave ay nagbibigay sa attackers ng universal-Linux LPE na may confirmed in-the-wild use laban sa cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); ang LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent ang nagbibigay sa kanila ng lateral-movement vector. Ang Apr 29 CSAI CNA authorization ay ang disclosure-issuance side; ang pinakamadaling daan para sa Q3 incident report ng IR firm ay isang cloud-multi-tenant intrusion na pinagsama-sama nang ganito.

bridges.text: The June 6 Flowise CVE-2026-40933 is a textbook LLM-tooling weaponization: a CVSS 9.9 OS command injection in the MCP stdio adapter executing with host privileges, with a published PoC and mapping to the NSA MCP information sheet. A second CVSS-9-plus framework RCE in successive weeks makes the LLM-tooling-as-attack-surface premise concrete, though no kernel-LPE chaining appears.

text_locales.en: The June 6 Flowise CVE-2026-40933 is a textbook LLM-tooling weaponization: a CVSS 9.9 OS command injection in the MCP stdio adapter executing with host privileges, with a published PoC and mapping to the NSA MCP information sheet. A second CVSS-9-plus framework RCE in successive weeks makes the LLM-tooling-as-attack-surface premise concrete, though no kernel-LPE chaining appears.
text_locales.ja: 6月6日のFlowise CVE-2026-40933は、LLMツール武器化の典型である。MCP stdioアダプタにおけるCVSS 9.9のOSコマンドインジェクションがホスト権限で実行され、PoCが公開され、NSAのMCP情報シートに対応づけられている。数週間のうちに2件目となるCVSS9超のフレームワークRCEは、LLMツールを攻撃対象領域とする前提を具体化する。ただしカーネルのローカル権限昇格の連鎖は現れていない。
text_locales.es: La CVE-2026-40933 de Flowise del 6 de junio es una militarización de manual de herramientas LLM: una inyección de comandos del sistema operativo de CVSS 9,9 en el adaptador stdio de MCP que se ejecuta con privilegios del host, con una PoC publicada y mapeo a la hoja informativa de la NSA sobre MCP. Un segundo RCE en un marco con CVSS de 9 o más en semanas consecutivas hace concreta la premisa de herramientas LLM como superficie de ataque, aunque no aparezca ningún encadenamiento con LPE del kernel.
text_locales.fil: Ang June 6 Flowise CVE-2026-40933 ay isang tipikal na LLM-tooling weaponization: isang CVSS 9.9 OS command injection sa MCP stdio adapter na nag-e-execute gamit ang host privileges, na may inilathalang PoC at pagkakaugnay sa NSA MCP information sheet. Isang pangalawang CVSS-9-plus framework RCE sa magkakasunod na linggo ang nagpapakonkreto sa LLM-tooling-as-attack-surface na premise, kahit walang lumilitaw na kernel-LPE chaining.

text_locales.en: Today's cluster names the very LiteLLM CVE this thesis listed in its signal set, now actively exploited and paired with Langroid's CVSS-9.8 SQLChatAgent flaw. Both run the same prompt-injected text-to-SQL path escalating to database-host RCE, confirming LLM-tooling exploitation is hardening into a live, repeatable attack pattern exactly as anticipated.
text_locales.ja: 本日の群は、この予想がシグナル集合に挙げていた当の LiteLLM CVE を名指しする。いまや実際に悪用され、Langroid の CVSS 9.8 の SQLChatAgent の欠陥と対になっている。両者は同じプロンプト注入による「テキストから SQL」の経路をたどり、データベースホストの RCE へ昇格する。これは LLM ツール群の悪用が、予想どおり、生きた再現可能な攻撃パターンへ固まりつつあることを裏づける。
text_locales.es: El grupo de hoy nombra la misma CVE de LiteLLM que esta tesis listó en su conjunto de señales, ahora activamente explotada y emparejada con el fallo del SQLChatAgent de Langroid de CVSS 9.8. Ambos recorren la misma vía de texto a SQL inyectado por prompt que escala hasta una RCE en el host de la base de datos, y confirman que la explotación de herramientas de LLM se está consolidando como un patrón de ataque vivo y repetible, justo como se anticipó.
text_locales.fil: Binabanggit ng cluster ngayon ang mismong LiteLLM CVE na inilista ng thesis na ito sa signal set nito, aktibo nang pinagsasamantalahan at nakapares na sa CVSS-9.8 na SQLChatAgent na depekto ng Langroid. Pareho silang tumatakbo sa iisang prompt-injected na landas ng text-to-SQL na nag-e-escalate sa RCE sa database host, na nagpapatunay na tumitigas ang LLM-tooling exploitation tungo sa isang buhay at maaaring ulit-ulitin na attack pattern gaya ng inaasahan.

That is the inference-runtime and gateway surface the pattern names, one shared-dependency flaw amplifying across the whole serving stack.

text_locales.en: BadHost is a single-character host-header flaw in Starlette, the routing core under FastAPI at roughly 325 million weekly downloads, defeating path-based authentication and chaining to auth bypass, request forgery, and sometimes remote code execution across vLLM, LiteLLM, and MCP servers. That is the inference-runtime and gateway surface the pattern names, one shared-dependency flaw amplifying across the whole serving stack.
text_locales.ja: BadHost は、週におよそ 3 億 2,500 万回ダウンロードされる FastAPI の土台にあるルーティング中核 Starlette の 1 文字のホストヘッダーの欠陥で、パスに基づく認証を破り、vLLM・LiteLLM・MCP サーバーをまたいで認証回避・リクエストフォージェリ、時にはリモートコード実行へとつながる。これはこのパターンが指す推論ランタイムとゲートウェイの面そのものであり、単一の共有された依存先の欠陥がサービング基盤全体に増幅される。
text_locales.es: BadHost es un fallo de cabecera Host de un solo carácter en Starlette, el núcleo de enrutamiento bajo FastAPI con unas 325 millones de descargas semanales, que anula la autenticación basada en rutas y encadena a bypass de autenticación, falsificación de solicitudes y a veces ejecución remota de código en vLLM, LiteLLM y servidores MCP. Ese es el runtime de inferencia y el gateway que el patrón nombra, un único fallo de dependencia compartida que se amplifica por toda la pila de servicio.
text_locales.fil: Ang BadHost ay isang single-character na host-header na depekto sa Starlette, ang routing core sa ilalim ng FastAPI sa humigit-kumulang 325 milyong download kada linggo, na tumatalo sa path-based na authentication at umuugnay sa auth bypass, request forgery, at kung minsan ay remote code execution sa buong vLLM, LiteLLM, at mga MCP server. Iyon ang inference-runtime at gateway na saklaw na binabanggit ng pattern, isang shared-dependency na depekto na lumalaki sa buong serving stack.

bridges.text: Monday's CVE-wave evidence consolidates the LLM-tooling supply-chain weaponization theme this dormant longshot anticipated: the CISA federal-civilian directive holds cleanly into its fourth operating day under compliance-monitoring, n8n Ni8mare exposed instances tighten to roughly 798 (first sub-800 reading of the cycle), MCP credential-extraction holds a 5-minute median for a fourteenth day, and Defender quarantine holds at 54 percent — but no post-mortem chains LLM-tooling CVE with a Linux-kernel LPE.

text_locales.es: La evidencia de la oleada de CVE del lunes consolida el tema de armamento de la cadena de suministro de la capa de herramientas de LLM que esta apuesta latente anticipaba: la directiva del ámbito civil federal de CISA se mantiene limpiamente en su cuarto día operativo bajo monitoreo de cumplimiento, las instancias expuestas de n8n Ni8mare se estrechan a aproximadamente 798 (la primera lectura por debajo de 800 del ciclo), la extracción de credenciales de MCP mantiene una mediana de 5 minutos por decimocuarto día, y la cuarentena de Defender se mantiene en el 54 por ciento —pero ningún post-mortem encadena un CVE de herramientas de LLM con una escalada de privilegios local del núcleo de Linux.

text_locales.ja: 水曜日のCVE波の証拠は、この休眠中の大穴が見通していたLLMツーリングのサプライチェーン武器化テーマを前進させる。CISA連邦民間運用指令は、11件のCVEのエージェント・ローダー分類体系と5月22日の遵守が1日前にある状態で2日目の完全な運用日を走り、n8nの露出インスタンス数は約1,180へと緩和し、MCPサーバーの認証情報抜き取り試行までの中央値は9日連続で5分を保ち、Defender for Cloudの隔離率は新規MCPサーバーの50パーセントへと上昇した。しかし、LLMツーリングのCVEとLinuxカーネルのローカル特権昇格を連鎖させるIR企業の事後検証はない。
text_locales.es: La evidencia de la oleada de CVE del miércoles avanza el tema de la armamentización de la cadena de suministro de herramientas de LLM que este rezagado latente anticipaba: la directiva operativa del ámbito civil federal de CISA cursa su segundo día operativo completo con la taxonomía de once CVE del cargador de agentes y el cumplimiento del 22 de mayo a T menos uno, el recuento de instancias expuestas de n8n desciende a aproximadamente 1.180, la extracción de credenciales del servidor MCP mantiene una mediana de 5 minutos por noveno día consecutivo, y la cuarentena de Defender for Cloud avanza al 50 por ciento en los servidores MCP de nueva incorporación. Pero ningún post-mortem de una firma de respuesta a incidentes encadena un CVE de herramientas de LLM con una escalada de privilegios locales del núcleo de Linux.

text_locales.ja: 月曜は、この予測が予期した LLM ツーリングのサプライチェーン兵器化のテーマを前進させる。CISA 連邦民政機関運用指令が11件の CVE の Trail of Bits エージェントローダー分類体系を備えて公表され、n8n CVE スキャンが期限の3営業日前で稼働し、MCP サーバーの認証情報抽出が5分の中央値を維持した。だが LLM ツーリングの CVE と Linux カーネルのローカル権限昇格を連鎖させた事後分析はなかった。
text_locales.es: El lunes avanza el tema de armamentización de la cadena de suministro de herramientas de LLM que esta predicción anticipaba: la directiva operativa del ámbito civil federal de CISA se publicó llevando la taxonomía de cargadores de agentes de once CVE de Trail of Bits, el escaneo del CVE-2026-21858 de n8n corrió a T menos tres respecto al plazo, y la extracción de credenciales de servidores MCP mantuvo una mediana de 5 minutos, pero ningún post-mortem encadenó un CVE de herramientas de LLM con una escalada local de privilegios del núcleo de Linux.
text_locales.fil: Isinusulong ng Lunes ang LLM-tooling supply-chain weaponization theme na inasahan ng prediction na ito: inilathala ang CISA federal-civilian operational directive na nagdadala ng eleven-CVE Trail of Bits agent-loader taxonomy, tumakbo ang n8n CVE scan sa T-minus-three sa deadline, at hawak ng MCP-server credential-extraction ang isang 5-minutong median — ngunit walang post-mortem na nag-chain ng isang LLM-tooling CVE sa isang Linux-kernel local-privilege-escalation.

The specific full-chain attack thesis is not directly evidenced.

text_locales.ja: 構成要素のサーフェスは生きている——n8nのCVE是正のテーパーは5月21日の期限に向けて続き、MCPサーバーの認証情報抜き取りのウィンドウは6日連続で5分に維持されている——が、週末にはLLMツールのCVEをLinuxカーネルの権限昇格と連鎖させるIR企業の事後分析は浮上していない。その特定のフルチェーン攻撃のテーゼは直接的には証拠付けられていない。
text_locales.es: Las superficies componentes siguen vivas —la disminución de la remediación del CVE de n8n continúa hacia el plazo del 21 de mayo y la ventana de extracción de credenciales de servidor MCP se mantiene en cinco minutos por sexto día— pero el fin de semana no aflora ningún análisis post mortem de una firma de respuesta a incidentes que encadene un CVE de herramientas LLM con una escalada de privilegios del kernel de Linux. La tesis específica del ataque de cadena completa no está directamente evidenciada.
text_locales.fil: Nananatiling buhay ang mga component surface — patuloy ang n8n CVE remediation taper patungo sa May 21 deadline at hawak ang MCP-server credential-extraction window sa limang minuto sa ikaanim na araw — ngunit walang IR-firm post-mortem na nagkakadena ng isang LLM-tooling CVE sa isang Linux-kernel privilege escalation na lumitaw sa katapusan ng linggo. Hindi direktang napatunayan ang tiyak na full-chain attack thesis.

bridges.text: The n8n RCE landing arbitrary commands on the underlying host plus Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency confirm exactly the precondition the LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (May 2) names: LLM-tooling vulnerabilities now reliably reach host OS execution within hours of disclosure. The kernel-CVE half of the chain has not yet been demonstrated.

text_locales.en: The n8n RCE landing arbitrary commands on the underlying host plus Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency confirm exactly the precondition the LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (May 2) names: LLM-tooling vulnerabilities now reliably reach host OS execution within hours of disclosure. The kernel-CVE half of the chain has not yet been demonstrated.
text_locales.ja: 基盤ホストへ任意コマンドを着地させるn8n RCEに加え、FlowiseのプロンプトインジェクションRCE、LMDeployの12時間31分の悪用レイテンシは、LLMツーリング・Linuxカーネル・チェーン予測(5月2日)が指摘する前提条件を確認する: LLMツーリング脆弱性は現在、開示から数時間以内に確実にホストOS実行に到達する。チェーンのカーネルCVE側はまだ実証されていない。
text_locales.es: La RCE de n8n aterrizando comandos arbitrarios en el host subyacente más la RCE impulsada por prompt-injection de Flowise más la latencia de 12h-31m de LMDeploy confirman exactamente la condición previa que nombra la predicción de cadena CVE LLM-tooling + Linux-kernel (2 may): las vulnerabilidades de tooling LLM ahora alcanzan de forma fiable ejecución en SO host en horas tras la divulgación. La mitad kernel-CVE de la cadena aún no se ha demostrado.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n RCE na naglalanding ng arbitrary commands sa underlying host plus ang Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus ang LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency ay nagkukumpirma sa eksaktong precondition na pinapangalanan ng LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (Mayo 2): ang LLM-tooling vulnerabilities ay reliably na nakaka-reach ng host OS execution sa loob ng oras pagkatapos ng disclosure. Hindi pa na-demonstrate ang kernel-CVE half ng chain.

bridges.text: The Stellar Cyber survey treating SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain as the operative late-2026 threat class extends the LLM-tooling-layer leg of the predicted chain; the kernel leg stays quiet today.

text_locales.en: The Stellar Cyber survey treating SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain as the operative late-2026 threat class extends the LLM-tooling-layer leg of the predicted chain; the kernel leg stays quiet today.
text_locales.ja: Stellar Cyber調査がSGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agentサイレント流出チェーンを運用上の2026年後半脅威クラスとして扱うことが、予測されたチェーンのLLMツール層レッグを延長する; カーネル・レッグは本日も静かなままである。
text_locales.es: La encuesta de Stellar Cyber tratando SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + cadena de exfiltración silenciosa Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent como la clase de amenaza operativa de finales de 2026 extiende la pierna de capa de herramientas LLM de la cadena predicha; la pierna de kernel permanece silenciosa hoy.
text_locales.fil: Ang Stellar Cyber survey na nagtatrato sa SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain bilang operative late-2026 threat class ay nagpapahaba sa LLM-tooling-layer leg ng predicted chain; ang kernel leg ay nananatiling tahimik ngayon.

bridges.text: Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers stacked on the still-unpatched SGLang and LiteLLM key-leak SQLi gives attackers a complete LLM-tooling-plus-kernel template. The chain the prediction names is now visible across the May 1-3 advisory window.

text_locales.en: Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers stacked on the still-unpatched SGLang and LiteLLM key-leak SQLi gives attackers a complete LLM-tooling-plus-kernel template. The chain the prediction names is now visible across the May 1-3 advisory window.
text_locales.ja: Copy Failのユニバーサル-Linux LPEがクラウドサービスプロバイダに対する野生での使用が確認され、未だ未パッチのSGLangとLiteLLM鍵漏洩SQLiと積層して、攻撃者に完全なLLMツーリングプラスカーネルテンプレートを与える。予測が命名するチェーンは今や5月1-3日のアドバイザリーウィンドウを通じて可視化されている。
text_locales.es: El LPE Linux universal de Copy Fail con uso confirmado in-the-wild contra proveedores de servicio de nube apilado sobre el SGLang aún sin parchar y LiteLLM key-leak SQLi da a los atacantes una plantilla LLM-tooling-más-kernel completa. La cadena que la predicción nombra ahora es visible a través de la ventana de avisos del 1-3 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Ang universal-Linux LPE ng Copy Fail na may kumpirmadong in-the-wild use laban sa cloud service providers na nakapatong sa nananatiling unpatched na SGLang at LiteLLM key-leak SQLi ay nagbibigay sa attackers ng kumpletong LLM-tooling-plus-kernel template. Ang chain na pinapangalanan ng prediction ay nakikita na ngayon sa kabuuan ng May 1-3 advisory window.

detail.description: **By H2 2026 the May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + the Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + the unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 trio makes "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" the dominant attacker pattern — at least one major IR firm publishes a public post-mortem of a real intrusion that pairs an LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE with a Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail or its successor) for full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, and at least one CSAI-CNA-issued advisory explicitly carves out the LLM-tooling + kernel chain as a named technique within ATT&CK v19's Defense Impairment.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 already names the agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); the May 1 Copy Fail wave gives attackers a universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); the LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent gives them the lateral-movement vector. CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization is the disclosure-issuance side; the path of least resistance for an IR firm Q3 incident report is one cloud-multi-tenant intrusion stitched together this exact way. In plain language: Hackers can chain an AI-tooling bug with a Linux-kernel bug to take over shared AI servers. In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el H2 2026, el plazo de 14 días BOD-22-01 del Copy Fail del 1 mayo (CVE-2026-31431) + la ventana de explotación de 26 horas del LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 30 abr + el trío SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sin parchear hasta el 1 mayo convierte la "weaponización de la cadena de suministro de CVEs de la capa de tooling-LLM" en el patrón dominante de los atacantes — al menos una firma importante de respuesta a incidentes publicará un post-mortem público de una intrusión real que combine un CVE de gateway-LLM / agent-harness / inference-runtime con un LPE del kernel Linux (Copy Fail o su sucesor) para obtener root de cadena completa en inferencia multi-inquilino, y al menos un aviso emitido por CSAI-CNA destacará explícitamente la cadena tooling-LLM + kernel como técnica nombrada dentro del Defense Impairment de ATT&CK v19.** ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr ya nombra las técnicas agénticas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agente malicioso); la ola Copy Fail del 1 mayo da a los atacantes un LPE Linux universal con uso confirmado en el mundo real contra proveedores de servicios cloud (según divulgación del Microsoft Security Blog); el precedente de SQLi-fuga-de-claves-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock de LiteLLM les da el vector de movimiento lateral. La autorización CNA del 29 abr de CSAI es el lado de emisión de divulgaciones; la ruta de menor resistencia para un informe de incidentes Q3 de una firma IR es una intrusión cloud multi-inquilino unida exactamente de esta forma. En lenguaje claro: Los hackers pueden encadenar un bug de tooling de IA con un bug del kernel Linux para tomar el control de servidores de IA compartidos. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Sa H2 2026 ang trio ng May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + ang unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay magpapakahulugan sa "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" bilang dominanteng attacker pattern — hindi bababa sa isang major IR firm ang maglalathala ng pampublikong post-mortem ng totoong intrusion na pinagsasama ang LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE sa Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail o ang successor nito) para sa full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, at hindi bababa sa isang CSAI-CNA-issued advisory ang explicitly mag-cha-carve out sa LLM-tooling + kernel chain bilang named technique sa loob ng Defense Impairment ng ATT&CK v19.** Pinangalanan na ng Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ang agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang May 1 Copy Fail wave ay nagbibigay sa attackers ng universal-Linux LPE na may confirmed in-the-wild use laban sa cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); ang LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent ang nagbibigay sa kanila ng lateral-movement vector. Ang Apr 29 CSAI CNA authorization ay ang disclosure-issuance side; ang pinakamadaling daan para sa Q3 incident report ng IR firm ay isang cloud-multi-tenant intrusion na pinagsama-sama nang ganito.

nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 dual filing — Nvidia's 8-K disclosing that Vera Rubin sampling has reached production-volume customer commitments for nine of the top ten hyperscaler and neocloud accounts with H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue backlog-covered through Q3 2027 at the current Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, plus AMD's CFO 8-K supplement to the May 5 print confirming a 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI's standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus a previously-undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment for Asia-Pacific deployment — combined with the same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement plus disclosed OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, the post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple anchored under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, and the SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle pressing the Mag-7 cohort on capital-allocation attribution and customer-concentration footnotes, force AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, plus the SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort behind them) to adopt a structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence as the standard disclosure shape, separate from earnings releases. The forcing function is that once two duopoly issuers ship dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks with named-customer commitment GW figures, sell-side coverage and SEC Corp Fin staff treat the format as the operative template for forward-visibility disclosure — silence between earnings becomes the anomaly rather than the norm. The most likely shape is a recurring mid-quarter 8-K naming production cadence, customer-by-customer GW or rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits where material, and forward-revenue-coverage windows. Bear case is SEC Corp Fin issuing Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance that pushes the cadence back into earnings-call-only territory; absent that, by Q4 2026 the Q3 print cycle lands with at least two prior pre-announcement 8-Ks per accelerator issuer.
