title_locales.en: Cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP registry converges into draft RFC by Q3 2026
title_locales.ja: クラウド横断のエージェントID + MCPレジストリが2026年Q3までにRFCドラフトに収束する
title_locales.es: Identidad de agentes multi-nube + registro MCP converge en borrador de RFC para Q3 2026
title_locales.fil: Magsasanib ang cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP registry sa draft RFC pagsapit ng Q3 2026

detail.summary_short: Microsoft Agent 365 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Vertex, the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0, and CSAI MITRE-CNA pressure converge on a published interop layer. By Q3 2026 an IETF / OpenID / CSAI draft RFC for cross-cloud agent identity + MCP inventory + tool-invocation logs is expected to ship.

summary_short_locales.en: Microsoft Agent 365 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Vertex, the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0, and CSAI MITRE-CNA pressure converge on a published interop layer. By Q3 2026 an IETF / OpenID / CSAI draft RFC for cross-cloud agent identity + MCP inventory + tool-invocation logs is expected to ship.
summary_short_locales.ja: Microsoft Agent 365 GAのAWS Bedrock + Google Vertexとのレジストリ同期、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0、CSAI MITRE-CNA圧力が、公開された相互運用層へと収斂する。2026年Q3までに、クラウド横断のエージェントID + MCPインベントリ + ツール呼び出しログのためのIETF / OpenID / CSAIドラフトRFCの出荷が見込まれる。
summary_short_locales.es: La GA de Microsoft Agent 365 con Registry Sync hacia AWS Bedrock + Google Vertex, el OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 del 30 de abril, y la presión de CSAI MITRE-CNA convergen en una capa de interoperabilidad publicada. Para Q3 2026 se espera un borrador de RFC de IETF / OpenID / CSAI sobre identidad de agentes multi-nube + inventario MCP + registros de invocación de herramientas.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Microsoft Agent 365 GA Registry Sync sa AWS Bedrock + Google Vertex, ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Foundry Agent Framework 1.0, at ang CSAI MITRE-CNA pressure ay nagsasama-sama tungo sa isang inilathalang interop layer. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, inaasahang ilalabas ang isang IETF / OpenID / CSAI draft RFC para sa cross-cloud agent identity + MCP inventory + tool-invocation logs.

bridges.text: The three-hyperscaler parallel landing converges further Sunday: Bedrock's OpenAI agent registry interop moves to public preview for FedRAMP-Moderate; Vertex adds parallel public-preview interop with the Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry; Foundry adds South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB attestation fields; arxiv 2605.06012 supplies the compositional safety scaffolding the converged RFC would cite, with Microsoft joining the MIT/ETH/Anthropic authorship loop.

text_locales.en: The three-hyperscaler parallel landing converges further Sunday: Bedrock's OpenAI agent registry interop moves to public preview for FedRAMP-Moderate; Vertex adds parallel public-preview interop with the Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry; Foundry adds South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB attestation fields; arxiv 2605.06012 supplies the compositional safety scaffolding the converged RFC would cite, with Microsoft joining the MIT/ETH/Anthropic authorship loop.
text_locales.ja: 3ハイパースケーラー並行着地は日曜にさらに収束する: BedrockのOpenAIエージェント・レジストリ相互運用はFedRAMP-Moderate向けパブリック・プレビューへ移行;VertexはClaude Code 3.0サンドボックス化スキル・レジストリとの並行パブリック・プレビュー相互運用を追加;Foundryは韓国PIPCとニュージーランドGCSBアテステーション・フィールドを追加;arxiv 2605.06012は収束RFCが引用する合成安全性足場を供給し、MicrosoftがMIT / ETH / Anthropic著者ループに合流する。
text_locales.es: El aterrizaje paralelo de tres-hyperscaler converge más el domingo: la interop de registro de agente OpenAI de Bedrock pasa a preview público para FedRAMP-Moderate; Vertex añade interop paralelo de preview público con el registro de skills sandboxeado Claude Code 3.0; Foundry añade campos de atestación South Korea PIPC y New Zealand GCSB; arxiv 2605.06012 suministra el andamiaje de seguridad composicional que el RFC convergido citaría, con Microsoft uniéndose al loop de autoría MIT/ETH/Anthropic.
text_locales.fil: Mas nag-co-converge ang three-hyperscaler parallel landing noong Linggo: lumilipat ang OpenAI agent registry interop ng Bedrock sa public preview para sa FedRAMP-Moderate; nagdaragdag ang Vertex ng parallel public-preview interop sa Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry; nagdaragdag ang Foundry ng South Korea PIPC at New Zealand GCSB attestation fields; nagbibigay ang arxiv 2605.06012 ng compositional safety scaffolding na sisipiin ng converged RFC, kasama ang Microsoft na sumasama sa MIT/ETH/Anthropic authorship loop.

bridges.text: Mistral Workflows landing in EU Tier-1 production with control-plane / data-plane separation plus the Cisco-Astrix NHI carry plus the n8n / Flowise CVE wave tighten the structural force the cross-cloud RFC prediction (May 3) names: the MCP-registry + agent-identity standards gap is operationally visible across both vendor-stack architectures and CVE-class attack patterns.

text_locales.en: Mistral Workflows landing in EU Tier-1 production with control-plane / data-plane separation plus the Cisco-Astrix NHI carry plus the n8n / Flowise CVE wave tighten the structural force the cross-cloud RFC prediction (May 3) names: the MCP-registry + agent-identity standards gap is operationally visible across both vendor-stack architectures and CVE-class attack patterns.
text_locales.ja: Mistral Workflowsがコントロールプレーンとデータプレーンの分離とともにEU Tier-1本番に着地、Cisco-Astrix NHIキャリ、n8n / Flowise CVEウェーブが、クロスクラウドRFC予測(5月3日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する: MCPレジストリ + エージェント・アイデンティティの標準ギャップは、ベンダー・スタック・アーキテクチャとCVEクラス攻撃パターンの両方にわたって運用上可視化されている。
text_locales.es: Mistral Workflows aterrizando en producción Tier-1 UE con separación plano-control / plano-datos más la traída Cisco-Astrix NHI más la ola de CVEs n8n / Flowise tensan la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción cross-cloud RFC (3 may): la brecha de estándares registro-MCP + agent-identity es operacionalmente visible tanto en arquitecturas vendor-stack como en patrones de ataque clase-CVE.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mistral Workflows na naka-land sa EU Tier-1 production na may control-plane / data-plane separation plus ang Cisco-Astrix NHI carry plus ang n8n / Flowise CVE wave ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng cross-cloud RFC prediction (Mayo 3): ang MCP-registry + agent-identity standards gap ay operationally visible sa parehong vendor-stack architectures at CVE-class attack patterns.

bridges.text: Cisco's May 4 Astrix acquisition making non-human-identity discovery + governance an M&A primitive, plus the CSA first-pillar framing, plus ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (roughly half with no authorization controls) keep the precondition warm: federal CISO offices and banking regulators now need a published-standard reference above the vendor-specific architecture diagrams.

text_locales.en: Cisco's May 4 Astrix acquisition making non-human-identity discovery + governance an M&A primitive, plus the CSA first-pillar framing, plus ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (roughly half with no authorization controls) keep the precondition warm: federal CISO offices and banking regulators now need a published-standard reference above the vendor-specific architecture diagrams.
text_locales.ja: Ciscoの5月4日 Astrix買収が非人間アイデンティティのディスカバリ + ガバナンスをM&Aプリミティブにすること、CSAの第一の柱フレーミング、約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバー(およそ半数は認可制御なし)が前提条件を温存している: 連邦CISOオフィスと銀行規制当局は現在、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図の上の公表された標準リファレンスを必要とする。
text_locales.es: La adquisición Astrix de Cisco del 4 de mayo haciendo del descubrimiento + gobernanza de identidad no humana una primitiva M&A, más el framing de primer pilar de CSA, más ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (aproximadamente la mitad sin controles de autorización) mantienen caliente la precondición: las oficinas CISO federales y los reguladores bancarios ahora necesitan una referencia de estándar publicado por encima de los diagramas de arquitectura específicos de proveedores.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 Astrix acquisition ng Cisco na ginagawa ang non-human-identity discovery + governance bilang M&A primitive, plus ang first-pillar framing ng CSA, plus ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (humigit-kumulang kalahati ay walang authorization controls) ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition: ang federal CISO offices at banking regulators ngayon ay nangangailangan ng published-standard reference sa ibabaw ng vendor-specific architecture diagrams.

bridges.text: The RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity reinforces the structural force the prediction names: the platform-side schema-lock pressure on AWS + Google is now operative, but no working group publishes a public draft RFC in the window.

text_locales.en: The RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity reinforces the structural force the prediction names: the platform-side schema-lock pressure on AWS + Google is now operative, but no working group publishes a public draft RFC in the window.
text_locales.ja: RSACウィークのMicrosoft + Cisco + CSAのエージェントをファーストクラス・アイデンティティとして扱うことへの収斂は、予測が指摘する構造的な強制力を強化する: AWS + Googleに対するプラットフォーム側のスキーマロック・プレッシャーは現在運用されているが、ワーキンググループはウィンドウ内で公開草案RFCを公表しない。
text_locales.es: La convergencia de Microsoft + Cisco + CSA durante la semana RSAC sobre agente-como-identidad-de-primera-clase refuerza la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: la presión de bloqueo de esquema del lado plataforma sobre AWS + Google ahora es operativa, pero ningún grupo de trabajo publica un borrador RFC público en la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence sa agent-as-first-class-identity ay nagpapatibay sa structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang platform-side schema-lock pressure sa AWS + Google ay aktibo na ngayon, ngunit walang working group na naglalathala ng public draft RFC sa window.

detail.description: **By Q3 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK ~97M monthly downloads + the parallel Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack converges into a published draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) that formalizes the cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema as a standard interop layer.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: once Microsoft ships the registry-sync primitive at $15/user/mo with M365 admin-surface integration, AWS + Google must either expose parallel surfaces or be absorbed into the Microsoft schema; CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) provide the threat-side standardization pressure; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA already standardize the build/runtime layer so the missing piece is the interop-protocol layer the registry-sync proves works; expect Microsoft + AWS + Google to triangulate on a public draft RFC because vendor-specific schemas would lose the M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. In plain language: Microsoft just made AI agent IDs work across Microsoft, Amazon, and Google clouds — soon a public spec will lock that in. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.en: **By Q3 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK ~97M monthly downloads + the parallel Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack converges into a published draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) that formalizes the cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema as a standard interop layer.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: once Microsoft ships the registry-sync primitive at $15/user/mo with M365 admin-surface integration, AWS + Google must either expose parallel surfaces or be absorbed into the Microsoft schema; CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) provide the threat-side standardization pressure; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA already standardize the build/runtime layer so the missing piece is the interop-protocol layer the registry-sync proves works; expect Microsoft + AWS + Google to triangulate on a public draft RFC because vendor-specific schemas would lose the M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年Q3までに、Microsoft Agent 365の5月1日GAでのAWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platformとのレジストリ同期、Anthropic MCP SDKの月間~97Mダウンロード、並行する4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCoreスタックが、クラウド横断のエージェントID + MCPサーバーインベントリ + ツール呼び出しログスキーマを標準的な相互運用層として形式化する公開ドラフトRFC(IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation作業部会)へと収斂する。** 強制力はエンタープライズ調達である。Microsoftが$15/user/moでM365管理画面統合を伴うレジストリ同期プリミティブを出荷すれば、AWS + Googleは並行する画面を露出するか、Microsoftスキーマに吸収されるかを迫られる。CSAIの4月29日のMITRE-CNA権限 + ATT&CK v19の命名済み手法(MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント配備)が脅威側の標準化圧力を提供する。4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GAは既にビルド/ランタイム層を標準化しているため、欠けているのはレジストリ同期が機能することを証明している相互運用プロトコル層だけだ。Microsoft + AWS + Googleが公開ドラフトRFCで三角測量することが期待される。なぜならベンダー固有のスキーマではM365 + Bedrock + Vertexのインストールベース錨点優位を失うからだ。平易な言葉で言えば: MicrosoftがAIエージェントIDをMicrosoft、Amazon、Googleクラウド間で動作させた — まもなく公開仕様がそれを固定化する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para Q3 2026, la GA del 1 de mayo de Microsoft Agent 365 con Registry Sync hacia AWS Bedrock + la Plataforma de Agentes Empresariales Gemini de Google Cloud Vertex + el SDK MCP de Anthropic con ~97M de descargas mensuales + la convergencia paralela del 30 de abril del OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore se traduce en un borrador de RFC publicado (grupo de trabajo de IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation) que formaliza el esquema de identidad de agentes multi-nube + inventario de servidores MCP + registro de invocaciones de herramientas como una capa estándar de interoperabilidad.** La función forzante es la contratación empresarial: una vez que Microsoft entrega la primitiva de registry-sync a $15/usuario/mes con integración en la superficie de administración de M365, AWS + Google deben exponer superficies paralelas o ser absorbidos en el esquema de Microsoft; la autoridad MITRE-CNA del 29 de abril de CSAI + las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 (compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue malicioso de agente) aportan la presión estandarizadora del lado de las amenazas; el OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA del 30 de abril ya estandarizan la capa de build/runtime, así que la pieza faltante es la capa de protocolo de interoperabilidad que el registry-sync demuestra que funciona; se espera que Microsoft + AWS + Google triangulen sobre un borrador público de RFC porque los esquemas vendor-específicos perderían la ventaja del ancla de base instalada de M365 + Bedrock + Vertex. En lenguaje sencillo: Microsoft acaba de hacer que los IDs de agentes de IA funcionen entre las nubes de Microsoft, Amazon y Google — pronto una especificación pública lo afianzará.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync sa AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK na may ~97M monthly downloads + ang parallel na Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack ay magsasama-sama sa isang inilathalang draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) na nagbibigay ng pormal na anyo sa cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema bilang standard interop layer.** Ang forcing function ay enterprise procurement: kapag inilabas na ng Microsoft ang registry-sync primitive sa $15/user/mo na may M365 admin-surface integration, kailangang ilabas ng AWS + Google ang katumbas na surfaces o masisipsip sila sa Microsoft schema; ang Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) ang nagbibigay ng threat-side standardization pressure; ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA ay nagsa-standardize na sa build/runtime layer kaya ang nawawalang piraso ay ang interop-protocol layer na pinatunayan ng registry-sync na gumagana; inaasahang magta-triangulate ang Microsoft + AWS + Google sa isang pampublikong draft RFC dahil ang vendor-specific schemas ay mawawalan ng M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. Sa madaling salita: pinagana lang ng Microsoft ang AI agent IDs sa kabuuan ng Microsoft, Amazon, at Google clouds — malapit nang lumabas ang isang public spec na maglo-lock niyan.

nodes.description: By Q1 2027 the May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) selecting Workflows for tax-return anomaly-detection routing across the central tax-administration estate with the Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model explicitly named as procurement deciders over LangGraph self-hosted plus the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, paid Workflows tenancy lifting to 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) with daily-execution count crossing 4.4M, and the parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note showing per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperates with the OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — combined with the May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort that lifted tenancy past 290, the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter now extended to South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB inside the May 9 weekend extension, and the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist naming LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 as disallowed pre-patch versions — force the next wave of EU central-government and allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs to name a Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation between tenant data and orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model with named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperable with the OpenAI Codex CLI export format) as a baseline procurement-eligibility requirement rather than a discretionary scoring criterion. The forcing function is that once a flagship central-tax-administration estate cites the architecture by name as the decider against the two leading US alternatives, EU member-state procurement frameworks and Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories have a defensible reference template they can require without authoring bespoke language. The most likely shape is a four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + at least one Singapore/Japan signatory + at least one Five Eyes ally) treating sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop as the paired clauses; sovereign-cloud and FedRAMP-Moderate tenants adopt first because the AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter is already the operative threshold. Bear case is that AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus the Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ships a hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent first; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the Workflows-shaped tenancy clause across the cohort.

description.en: By Q1 2027 the May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) selecting Workflows for tax-return anomaly-detection routing across the central tax-administration estate with the Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model explicitly named as procurement deciders over LangGraph self-hosted plus the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, paid Workflows tenancy lifting to 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) with daily-execution count crossing 4.4M, and the parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note showing per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperates with the OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — combined with the May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort that lifted tenancy past 290, the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter now extended to South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB inside the May 9 weekend extension, and the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist naming LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 as disallowed pre-patch versions — force the next wave of EU central-government and allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs to name a Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation between tenant data and orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model with named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperable with the OpenAI Codex CLI export format) as a baseline procurement-eligibility requirement rather than a discretionary scoring criterion. The forcing function is that once a flagship central-tax-administration estate cites the architecture by name as the decider against the two leading US alternatives, EU member-state procurement frameworks and Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories have a defensible reference template they can require without authoring bespoke language. The most likely shape is a four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + at least one Singapore/Japan signatory + at least one Five Eyes ally) treating sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop as the paired clauses; sovereign-cloud and FedRAMP-Moderate tenants adopt first because the AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter is already the operative threshold. Bear case is that AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus the Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ships a hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent first; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the Workflows-shaped tenancy clause across the cohort.
description.ja: Q1 2027までに、5月9日のMistral AI Workflows 9日目ソブリン・クラウド着地 — フランスのDirection Générale des Finances Publiques(DGFiP)が中央税務行政資産全体での税還付異常検知ルーティングにWorkflowsを選定し、Workflowsのコントロール・プレーン分離アーキテクチャとソブリン・クラウド実行ワーカー・モデルを、LangGraphセルフホストおよびAnthropic Claude Code 3.0レジストリに対する調達決定要因として明示的に指名;有償Workflowsテナンシーが296エンタープライズ顧客(金曜の290社から)に上昇し、日次実行カウントが4.4Mを超え、並行するWorkflows-Codestral統合ノートが、ステップごとのトークン予算記録がOpenAI Codex CLIの/agent Plan-Applyモード・エクスポート形式と相互運用可能であることを示す — に、5月8日のBNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital本番稼働コホート(テナンシーを290超に押し上げた)、5月9日の週末拡張内でSingapore IMDA / Japan AISIサイバー評価レシプロシティ境界が韓国PIPC + ニュージーランドGCSBへ拡張されたこと、NHS Englandエージェンティック AIワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEブロックリストがLangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391を非許可プリパッチ・バージョンとして指名したことが組み合わさり、次のEU中央政府および同盟国管轄AIオーケストレータRFPに、Workflowsの形をしたソブリン・クラウド・テナンシー条項(テナント・データとオーケストレータ・ランタイムの間のコントロール・プレーン分離、名指し管轄実行境界を備えるソブリン・クラウド実行ワーカー・モデル、OpenAI Codex CLIエクスポート形式と相互運用可能なステップごとのトークン予算記録)を、裁量的スコアリング基準ではなくベースラインの調達適格性要件として指名することを強制する。強制機能は、フラッグシップ中央税務行政資産がアーキテクチャを名指しで2つの主要米国代替に対する決定要因として引用するや否や、EU加盟国の調達フレームワークおよびインド太平洋レシプロシティ・シグナトリは、ビスポーク言語を起草せずに要求できる擁護可能な参照テンプレートを持つことである。最も可能性の高い形状は4管轄区域コホート(France DGFiP同等 + Germany BSI同等 + 少なくとも1つのSingapore/Japanシグナトリ + 少なくとも1つのFive Eyes同盟国)で、ソブリン・クラウド・コントロール・プレーン分離 + 実行ワーカー管轄 + トークン予算相互運用をペアの条項として扱う;ソブリン・クラウドおよびFedRAMP-Moderateテナントが最初に採用するのは、AISI管理サイバー評価レシプロシティ境界が既に運用閾値となっているためである。ベア・ケースはAWS Bedrock Agent RegistryのFedRAMP-Moderate継承およびGoogle Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Centerのレシプロシティ・アテステーション・フィールド追加が、ハイパースケーラー管理のソブリン・クラウド同等品を先に出荷する;それ以外の場合、Q1 2027はコホート全体にWorkflowsの形をしたテナンシー条項を着地させる。
description.es: Para Q1 2027 el aterrizaje sovereign-cloud del día-nueve de Mistral AI Workflows del 9 de mayo — la Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) de Francia seleccionando Workflows para enrutamiento de detección de anomalías de declaraciones fiscales a través de la propiedad central de administración tributaria con la arquitectura de separación del plano-de-control de Workflows más el modelo de execution-worker sovereign-cloud explícitamente nombrados como factores decisivos de adquisición sobre LangGraph autoalojado más el registro de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0, la tenancia paga de Workflows elevándose a 296 clientes empresariales (vs 290 el viernes) con el conteo de ejecuciones diarias cruzando 4.4M, y la nota paralela de integración Workflows-Codestral mostrando que la contabilidad de presupuesto-de-tokens por paso interopera con el formato de exportación del modo Plan-Apply del /agent del Codex CLI de OpenAI — combinado con la cohorte de go-live del 8 de mayo de BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital que elevó la tenancia más allá de 290, el perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI ahora extendido a South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB dentro de la extensión de fin de semana del 9 de mayo, y la lista de bloqueo de CVE de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI de NHS England nombrando LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 como versiones pre-parche no permitidas — fuerzan a la próxima ola de RFPs de orquestador AI de gobierno central de la UE y de jurisdicciones aliadas a nombrar una cláusula de tenancy sovereign-cloud forma-Workflows (separación del plano-de-control entre datos del tenant y runtime del orquestador, modelo de execution-worker sovereign-cloud con frontera-de-ejecución de jurisdicción-nombrada, contabilidad de presupuesto-de-tokens por paso interoperable con el formato de exportación del Codex CLI de OpenAI) como un requisito de elegibilidad-de-adquisición de línea-base en lugar de un criterio de scoring discrecional. La función forzante es que una vez que una propiedad insignia de central-tax-administration cita la arquitectura por nombre como el factor decisivo contra las dos principales alternativas estadounidenses, los marcos de adquisición de estados-miembro EU y los signatarios de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífico tienen una plantilla de referencia defensible que pueden requerir sin redactar lenguaje a medida. La forma más probable es una cohorte de cuatro jurisdicciones (Francia DGFiP-equivalente + Germany BSI-equivalente + al menos un signatario Singapur/Japón + al menos un aliado Five Eyes) tratando la separación del plano-de-control sovereign-cloud más la jurisdicción del execution-worker más la interop de presupuesto-de-tokens como las cláusulas emparejadas; los tenants sovereign-cloud y FedRAMP-Moderate adoptan primero porque el perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber administrado por AISI ya es el umbral operativo. El caso bajista es que la herencia FedRAMP-Moderate del AWS Bedrock Agent Registry más el campo add de atestación-de-reciprocidad del Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center envíen un equivalente sovereign-cloud gestionado por hyperscaler primero; en ausencia de eso, Q1 2027 aterriza la cláusula de tenancy forma-Workflows a través de la cohorte.
description.fil: Sa Q1 2027 ang May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — ang pagpili ng France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) sa Workflows para sa tax-return anomaly-detection routing sa buong central tax-administration estate na may Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na hayagang pinangalanan bilang procurement deciders laban sa LangGraph self-hosted plus ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, ang paid Workflows tenancy na umaakyat sa 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) na may daily-execution count na tumatawid sa 4.4M, at ang parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note na nagpapakita na ang per-step token-budget bookkeeping ay nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — kasama ng May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort na nag-angat ng tenancy lampas sa 290, ang Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter na ngayon ay pinalawak sa South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB sa loob ng May 9 weekend extension, at ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist na nagngangalan sa LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 bilang disallowed pre-patch versions — ay pumipilit sa susunod na alon ng EU central-government at allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs na pangalanan ang Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation sa pagitan ng tenant data at orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na may named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping na nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI export format) bilang baseline procurement-eligibility requirement imbis na discretionary scoring criterion. Ang forcing function ay na sa sandaling isang flagship central-tax-administration estate ang bumanggit sa architecture by name bilang decider laban sa dalawang nangungunang US alternatives, ang EU member-state procurement frameworks at Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories ay mayroong defensible reference template na pwede nilang i-require nang hindi nag-author ng bespoke language. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + hindi bababa sa isang Singapore/Japan signatory + hindi bababa sa isang Five Eyes ally) na tinatrato ang sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop bilang paired clauses; sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang nag-aadopt dahil ang AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter ay siya nang operative threshold. Ang bear case ay na ang AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus ang Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ay nag-ship ng hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent una; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q1 2027 sa Workflows-shaped tenancy clause sa buong cohort.

summary.fil: Sa Q1 2027 ang May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — ang pagpili ng France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) sa Workflows para sa tax-return anomaly-detection routing sa buong central tax-administration estate na may Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na hayagang pinangalanan bilang procurement deciders laban sa LangGraph self-hosted plus ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, ang paid Workflows tenancy na umaakyat sa 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) na may daily-execution count na tumatawid sa 4.4M, at ang parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note na nagpapakita na ang per-step token-budget bookkeeping ay nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — kasama ng May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort na nag-angat ng tenancy lampas sa 290, ang Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter na ngayon ay pinalawak sa South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB sa loob ng May 9 weekend extension, at ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist na nagngangalan sa LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 bilang disallowed pre-patch versions — ay pumipilit sa susunod na alon ng EU central-government at allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs na pangalanan ang Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation sa pagitan ng tenant data at orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na may named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping na nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI export format) bilang baseline procurement-eligibility requirement imbis na discretionary scoring criterion. Ang forcing function ay na sa sandaling isang flagship central-tax-administration estate ang bumanggit sa architecture by name bilang decider laban sa dalawang nangungunang US alternatives, ang EU member-state procurement frameworks at Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories ay mayroong defensible reference template na pwede nilang i-require nang hindi nag-author ng bespoke language. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + hindi bababa sa isang Singapore/Japan signatory + hindi bababa sa isang Five Eyes ally) na tinatrato ang sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop bilang paired clauses; sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang nag-aadopt dahil ang AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter ay siya nang operative threshold. Ang bear case ay na ang AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus ang Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ay nag-ship ng hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent una; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q1 2027 sa Workflows-shaped tenancy clause sa buong cohort.

bridges.text: The procedural path cleared decisively: Friday's S-407 briefing returned a no-objection finding on the AISI cyber-eval reciprocity 120-day placement window, which a Saturday analysis reads as removing the principal cited signing-window blocker. In parallel the reciprocity ladder hardened, reaching fifteen named jurisdictions with Qatar's formal entry and the OECD GENAI attestation schema on schedule for June plenary adoption.

text_locales.en: The procedural path cleared decisively: Friday's S-407 briefing returned a no-objection finding on the AISI cyber-eval reciprocity 120-day placement window, which a Saturday analysis reads as removing the principal cited signing-window blocker. In parallel the reciprocity ladder hardened, reaching fifteen named jurisdictions with Qatar's formal entry and the OECD GENAI attestation schema on schedule for June plenary adoption.
text_locales.ja: 手続き的な経路は決定的に開けた。金曜日のS-407説明会は、AISIのサイバー評価相互承認の120日配置窓に関する異議なしの所見を返し、土曜日の分析はこれを署名期間の主要な障害として挙げられたものを取り除くものと読み解く。並行して相互承認のはしごは固まり、カタールの正式参加で名指しされた15管轄区域に達し、OECD GENAIのアテステーション・スキーマは6月総会での採択に向けて予定どおりである。
text_locales.es: La vía procedimental se despejó de forma decisiva: la sesión informativa S-407 del viernes devolvió una conclusión de ausencia de objeción sobre la ventana de colocación de 120 días de la reciprocidad de evaluación cibernética del AISI, que un análisis del sábado lee como la eliminación del principal bloqueo citado de la ventana de firma. En paralelo la escalera de reciprocidad se endureció, alcanzando quince jurisdicciones nombradas con la incorporación formal de Catar y el esquema de atestación GENAI de la OCDE según lo previsto para la adopción en el plenario de junio.
text_locales.fil: Nalinis nang malinaw ang procedural path: nagbalik ang Friday's S-407 briefing ng isang no-objection finding sa AISI cyber-eval reciprocity 120-day placement window, na binabasa ng isang Saturday analysis bilang pag-aalis sa pangunahing binanggit na signing-window blocker. Kahanay nito ay tumigas ang reciprocity ladder, na umabot sa labinlimang pinangalanang hurisdiksiyon na may pormal na pagpasok ng Qatar at ang OECD GENAI attestation schema ayon sa iskedyul para sa June plenary adoption.

The sovereign-cloud tenancy and interop primitives are lived precedent, awaiting RFP codification.

text_locales.ja: 予測されるRFP条項が体系化するであろう調達テンプレートはしっかり維持された。Mistral Workflowsは週末を通じて7つのEU加盟国の中央政府の税務当局の参照コホートを維持し、5ベンダーのオーケストレーター横断相互運用マトリクスは15管轄区域のテナントポリシー・スキーマのサポートを伴い6月初旬のGA目標を維持した。ソブリンクラウドのテナンシーおよび相互運用のプリミティブは、RFPの体系化を待つ実地の先例である。
text_locales.es: La plantilla de contratación que la cláusula de RFP predicha codificaría se mantuvo firme: Mistral Workflows conservó su grupo de referencias de gobierno central de administraciones tributarias de siete Estados miembros de la UE a lo largo del fin de semana, y la matriz de interoperabilidad entre orquestadores de cinco proveedores mantuvo su objetivo de GA de principios de junio con soporte de esquema de política de inquilinos de quince jurisdicciones. Las primitivas de tenencia de nube soberana e interoperabilidad son precedente real, a la espera de codificación en RFP.
text_locales.fil: Nanatiling matatag ang procurement template na i-codify ng inihulang RFP clause: pinanatili ng Mistral Workflows ang seven-EU-member-state central-government tax-administration reference cohort nito sa buong weekend, at hinawakan ng five-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix ang early-June GA target nito na may fifteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schema support. Ang sovereign-cloud tenancy at interop primitives ay nabubuhay na precedent, naghihintay ng RFP codification.

text_locales.ja: Mistral Workflowsのday-12アップデートでは、フランスDGFiP、ドイツ連邦雇用庁、英国HMRCに続き、96時間以内にイタリア歳入庁(Agenzia delle Entrate)が4番目の中央政府ソブリンクラウド事例として加わり、同じコントロールプレーン分離とソブリンクラウド実行ワーカーアーキテクチャを引用している。有償テナンシーは法人顧客332社、日次実行550万件を突破し、4ベンダー横断オーケストレーター相互運用マトリクスはGoogle Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Centerのプライベートプレビュー追加でpre-GA形態に到達。インド太平洋12法域に加え、チリとメキシコが探索的オブザーバーとして参加した。

text_locales.fil: Nag-land ang Mistral Workflows day-twelve sa Agenzia delle Entrate ng Italy bilang ikaapat na central-government sovereign-cloud reference sa loob ng 96 oras matapos ang France DGFiP, Germany Bundesagentur, at UK HMRC, na bumabanggit sa parehong control-plane separation plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker architecture; tumatawid ang paid tenancy sa 332 enterprise customers sa 5.5M daily executions; nag-co-complete ang four-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix sa pre-GA form kasama ang Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center private-preview addition; labindalawang-jurisdiction Indo-Pacific perimeter plus Chile at Mexico exploratory observers.

motivation_locales.en: Blocklist already disallows the leading self-hosted orchestrator alternatives in NHS England production, so extending it to allied procurement offices forces RFPs to treat sovereign-cloud control-plane separation as the residual eligible architecture and supplies the Five Eyes leg of the four-jurisdiction cohort.

motivation_locales.es: La lista de bloqueo ya no permite las principales alternativas de orquestador autoalojado en producción de NHS England, así que extenderla a oficinas de adquisición aliadas fuerza a los RFPs a tratar la separación del plano-de-control sovereign-cloud como la arquitectura residual elegible y suministra el tramo Five Eyes de la cohorte de cuatro-jurisdicciones.
motivation_locales.fil: Ipinagbawal na ng blocklist ang mga nangungunang self-hosted orchestrator alternatives sa NHS England production, kaya ang pagpapalawak nito sa allied procurement offices ay pumipilit sa RFPs na tratuhin ang sovereign-cloud control-plane separation bilang residual eligible architecture at nagbibigay ng Five Eyes leg ng four-jurisdiction cohort.

detail.description: By Q1 2027 the May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) selecting Workflows for tax-return anomaly-detection routing across the central tax-administration estate with the Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model explicitly named as procurement deciders over LangGraph self-hosted plus the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, paid Workflows tenancy lifting to 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) with daily-execution count crossing 4.4M, and the parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note showing per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperates with the OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — combined with the May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort that lifted tenancy past 290, the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter now extended to South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB inside the May 9 weekend extension, and the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist naming LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 as disallowed pre-patch versions — force the next wave of EU central-government and allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs to name a Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation between tenant data and orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model with named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping interoperable with the OpenAI Codex CLI export format) as a baseline procurement-eligibility requirement rather than a discretionary scoring criterion. The forcing function is that once a flagship central-tax-administration estate cites the architecture by name as the decider against the two leading US alternatives, EU member-state procurement frameworks and Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories have a defensible reference template they can require without authoring bespoke language. The most likely shape is a four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + at least one Singapore/Japan signatory + at least one Five Eyes ally) treating sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop as the paired clauses; sovereign-cloud and FedRAMP-Moderate tenants adopt first because the AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter is already the operative threshold. Bear case is that AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus the Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ships a hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent first; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the Workflows-shaped tenancy clause across the cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Q1 2027までに、5月9日のMistral AI Workflows 9日目ソブリン・クラウド着地 — フランスのDirection Générale des Finances Publiques(DGFiP)が中央税務行政資産全体での税還付異常検知ルーティングにWorkflowsを選定し、Workflowsのコントロール・プレーン分離アーキテクチャとソブリン・クラウド実行ワーカー・モデルを、LangGraphセルフホストおよびAnthropic Claude Code 3.0レジストリに対する調達決定要因として明示的に指名;有償Workflowsテナンシーが296エンタープライズ顧客(金曜の290社から)に上昇し、日次実行カウントが4.4Mを超え、並行するWorkflows-Codestral統合ノートが、ステップごとのトークン予算記録がOpenAI Codex CLIの/agent Plan-Applyモード・エクスポート形式と相互運用可能であることを示す — に、5月8日のBNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital本番稼働コホート(テナンシーを290超に押し上げた)、5月9日の週末拡張内でSingapore IMDA / Japan AISIサイバー評価レシプロシティ境界が韓国PIPC + ニュージーランドGCSBへ拡張されたこと、NHS Englandエージェンティック AIワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEブロックリストがLangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391を非許可プリパッチ・バージョンとして指名したことが組み合わさり、次のEU中央政府および同盟国管轄AIオーケストレータRFPに、Workflowsの形をしたソブリン・クラウド・テナンシー条項(テナント・データとオーケストレータ・ランタイムの間のコントロール・プレーン分離、名指し管轄実行境界を備えるソブリン・クラウド実行ワーカー・モデル、OpenAI Codex CLIエクスポート形式と相互運用可能なステップごとのトークン予算記録)を、裁量的スコアリング基準ではなくベースラインの調達適格性要件として指名することを強制する。強制機能は、フラッグシップ中央税務行政資産がアーキテクチャを名指しで2つの主要米国代替に対する決定要因として引用するや否や、EU加盟国の調達フレームワークおよびインド太平洋レシプロシティ・シグナトリは、ビスポーク言語を起草せずに要求できる擁護可能な参照テンプレートを持つことである。最も可能性の高い形状は4管轄区域コホート(France DGFiP同等 + Germany BSI同等 + 少なくとも1つのSingapore/Japanシグナトリ + 少なくとも1つのFive Eyes同盟国)で、ソブリン・クラウド・コントロール・プレーン分離 + 実行ワーカー管轄 + トークン予算相互運用をペアの条項として扱う;ソブリン・クラウドおよびFedRAMP-Moderateテナントが最初に採用するのは、AISI管理サイバー評価レシプロシティ境界が既に運用閾値となっているためである。ベア・ケースはAWS Bedrock Agent RegistryのFedRAMP-Moderate継承およびGoogle Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Centerのレシプロシティ・アテステーション・フィールド追加が、ハイパースケーラー管理のソブリン・クラウド同等品を先に出荷する;それ以外の場合、Q1 2027はコホート全体にWorkflowsの形をしたテナンシー条項を着地させる。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q1 2027 el aterrizaje sovereign-cloud del día-nueve de Mistral AI Workflows del 9 de mayo — la Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) de Francia seleccionando Workflows para enrutamiento de detección de anomalías de declaraciones fiscales a través de la propiedad central de administración tributaria con la arquitectura de separación del plano-de-control de Workflows más el modelo de execution-worker sovereign-cloud explícitamente nombrados como factores decisivos de adquisición sobre LangGraph autoalojado más el registro de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0, la tenancia paga de Workflows elevándose a 296 clientes empresariales (vs 290 el viernes) con el conteo de ejecuciones diarias cruzando 4.4M, y la nota paralela de integración Workflows-Codestral mostrando que la contabilidad de presupuesto-de-tokens por paso interopera con el formato de exportación del modo Plan-Apply del /agent del Codex CLI de OpenAI — combinado con la cohorte de go-live del 8 de mayo de BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital que elevó la tenancia más allá de 290, el perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI ahora extendido a South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB dentro de la extensión de fin de semana del 9 de mayo, y la lista de bloqueo de CVE de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI de NHS England nombrando LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 como versiones pre-parche no permitidas — fuerzan a la próxima ola de RFPs de orquestador AI de gobierno central de la UE y de jurisdicciones aliadas a nombrar una cláusula de tenancy sovereign-cloud forma-Workflows (separación del plano-de-control entre datos del tenant y runtime del orquestador, modelo de execution-worker sovereign-cloud con frontera-de-ejecución de jurisdicción-nombrada, contabilidad de presupuesto-de-tokens por paso interoperable con el formato de exportación del Codex CLI de OpenAI) como un requisito de elegibilidad-de-adquisición de línea-base en lugar de un criterio de scoring discrecional. La función forzante es que una vez que una propiedad insignia de central-tax-administration cita la arquitectura por nombre como el factor decisivo contra las dos principales alternativas estadounidenses, los marcos de adquisición de estados-miembro EU y los signatarios de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífico tienen una plantilla de referencia defensible que pueden requerir sin redactar lenguaje a medida. La forma más probable es una cohorte de cuatro jurisdicciones (Francia DGFiP-equivalente + Germany BSI-equivalente + al menos un signatario Singapur/Japón + al menos un aliado Five Eyes) tratando la separación del plano-de-control sovereign-cloud más la jurisdicción del execution-worker más la interop de presupuesto-de-tokens como las cláusulas emparejadas; los tenants sovereign-cloud y FedRAMP-Moderate adoptan primero porque el perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber administrado por AISI ya es el umbral operativo. El caso bajista es que la herencia FedRAMP-Moderate del AWS Bedrock Agent Registry más el campo add de atestación-de-reciprocidad del Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center envíen un equivalente sovereign-cloud gestionado por hyperscaler primero; en ausencia de eso, Q1 2027 aterriza la cláusula de tenancy forma-Workflows a través de la cohorte.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Sa Q1 2027 ang May 9 Mistral AI Workflows day-nine sovereign-cloud landing — ang pagpili ng France's Direction Generale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) sa Workflows para sa tax-return anomaly-detection routing sa buong central tax-administration estate na may Workflows control-plane separation architecture plus sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na hayagang pinangalanan bilang procurement deciders laban sa LangGraph self-hosted plus ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry, ang paid Workflows tenancy na umaakyat sa 296 enterprise customers (vs 290 Friday) na may daily-execution count na tumatawid sa 4.4M, at ang parallel Workflows-Codestral integration note na nagpapakita na ang per-step token-budget bookkeeping ay nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI /agent Plan-Apply mode export format — kasama ng May 8 BNP Paribas Securities Services + Siemens Healthineers + Saudi Aramco Digital go-live cohort na nag-angat ng tenancy lampas sa 290, ang Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter na ngayon ay pinalawak sa South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB sa loob ng May 9 weekend extension, at ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist na nagngangalan sa LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 + CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 + Haystack CVE-2026-44391 bilang disallowed pre-patch versions — ay pumipilit sa susunod na alon ng EU central-government at allied-jurisdiction AI-orchestrator RFPs na pangalanan ang Workflows-shaped sovereign-cloud tenancy clause (control-plane separation sa pagitan ng tenant data at orchestrator runtime, sovereign-cloud execution-worker model na may named-jurisdiction execution boundary, per-step token-budget bookkeeping na nag-i-interoperate sa OpenAI Codex CLI export format) bilang baseline procurement-eligibility requirement imbis na discretionary scoring criterion. Ang forcing function ay na sa sandaling isang flagship central-tax-administration estate ang bumanggit sa architecture by name bilang decider laban sa dalawang nangungunang US alternatives, ang EU member-state procurement frameworks at Indo-Pacific reciprocity signatories ay mayroong defensible reference template na pwede nilang i-require nang hindi nag-author ng bespoke language. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang four-jurisdiction cohort (France DGFiP-equivalent + Germany BSI-equivalent + hindi bababa sa isang Singapore/Japan signatory + hindi bababa sa isang Five Eyes ally) na tinatrato ang sovereign-cloud control-plane separation plus execution-worker jurisdiction plus token-budget interop bilang paired clauses; sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang nag-aadopt dahil ang AISI-administered cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter ay siya nang operative threshold. Ang bear case ay na ang AWS Bedrock Agent Registry's FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance plus ang Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center reciprocity-attestation field add ay nag-ship ng hyperscaler-managed sovereign-cloud equivalent una; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q1 2027 sa Workflows-shaped tenancy clause sa buong cohort.

nodes.title: Agentic-AI frameworks ship four-surface signed-load default by mid-June 2026
nodes.description: By mid-June 2026 the Thursday fourth-tier-surface adoption wave forces the agentic-AI framework cohort — LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack, and LiteLLM — to ship the paired four-surface mitigation (load-time signed-checkpoint plus runtime manifest-allowlist-validation plus workflow-state path-canonicalization plus intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization) as the documented default in the next minor-version release rather than as opt-in or sub-tier-only features. The Thursday catalysts are concrete, mutually reinforcing, and land within a single business day across all four surfaces simultaneously: LangChain CVE-2026-44967 (CVSS 8.8) drops as a path-traversal in the workflow-state checkpoint loader's intermediate hand-off serializer with v0.3.7 shipping same-day plus paired v0.2.x and v0.1.x backports the NHS England blocklist references; Trail of Bits publishes a Thursday addendum extending the Wednesday nine-CVE taxonomy to ten with intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization as a fresh sub-pattern, reaffirming the four-tier-and-sub-tier common-mitigation shape; the DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft Thursday v3 joint preprint addendum (arxiv 2605.06712v3) extends the runtime-verifier integration pattern to the intermediate-state-serializer with reference implementations in Python and Rust covering all ten CVE-pattern instances; Verifiable Intermediate-State-Serializer Canonicalization for Agentic AI Workflow-State Migration (arxiv 2605.06892) ships Thursday with formal compositional safety theorems for the four-tier-and-sub-tier load-runtime-workflow-state-intermediate-state loader pattern, with MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, INRIA France, and Tokyo Institute of Technology added to the institutional reviewer cohort; vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 plus SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8 plus Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1 each ship the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation on the same Thursday with vLLM additionally defaulting the signed-checkpoint loader and closing the parity gap to SGLang at 4.3 percent, the tightest gap since the benchmark cycle began; Unsloth ships the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation Thursday as the first local-LLM fine-tuning stack to cover the now-four-tier-and-sub-tier surface ahead of the framework cohort target; OpenAI Codex CLI v3.1.2 ships the matching client-side mitigation; and Microsoft, LangChain, the CrewAI maintainer team, the Pydantic AI maintainer team, plus the AutoGen maintainer team publish parallel Thursday commitments to ship the paired four-surface delivery as a default in the next minor-version release, extending the previously-coordinated mid-June default-shipment window to cover all four surfaces as one bundle. The structural force is that when ten CVE instances, one production-tier serving stack defaulting the signed-checkpoint loader, three serving stacks shipping the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation, one local-LLM fine-tuning stack shipping the same primitive, one client-side CLI shipping the matching mitigation, and the v3 runtime-verifier preprint with reference implementations in Python and Rust covering all ten CVE patterns all land on the same Thursday, the agentic-AI framework cohort cannot ship a partial three-surface mitigation in their next minor release while the CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft now incorporating the ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy clears interagency review into the OMB publication queue and treats four-surface signed-load posture as paired procurement-eligibility evidence. The most likely shape is the four-surface mitigation becoming the documented default in the next minor release of LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack, and LiteLLM — with paired backport advisories for the older branches the NHS England blocklist references and explicit unsigned-load opt-out flags for sandboxed test fixtures — within the mid-June 2026 window the maintainer cohort has now publicly committed to. Bear case is that one framework defers the intermediate-state-serializer sub-tier as a sub-minor patch release and ships only the three-surface bundle in its mid-June minor; absent that, mid-June 2026 lands the paired four-surface signed-load mitigation as the documented default across the agentic-AI framework cohort.

description.ja: 2026年6月中旬までに、木曜日の第4ティア面採用波がエージェンティックAIフレームワーク群——LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、Pydantic AI、Semantic Kernel、Haystack、LiteLLM——に対し、ペアとなる四面緩和策(ロード時の署名済みチェックポイント、ランタイムのマニフェスト許可リスト検証、ワークフロー状態のパス正規化、中間状態シリアライザの正規化)を、オプトインまたはサブティア限定機能ではなく次回マイナー・バージョン・リリースの文書化されたデフォルトとして出荷することを促す。木曜日のきっかけは具体的かつ相互に強化し合い、四つの面すべてに対して単一営業日内で同時に着地する。LangChain CVE-2026-44967(CVSS 8.8)が、ワークフロー状態チェックポイント・ローダーの中間ハンドオフ・シリアライザにおけるパス・トラバーサルとして公開され、即日v0.3.7と、NHS England遮断リストが参照するペアv0.2.x・v0.1.xバックポートが出荷される。Trail of Bitsは木曜日の追補を公開し、水曜日の9件CVE分類を10件に拡張、中間状態シリアライザ正規化を新たなサブパターンとして加え、四ティアおよびサブティアの共通緩和策の形を再確認する。DeepMind、Meta AI、Anthropic、Microsoftの木曜版v3合同プレプリント追補(arxiv 2605.06712v3)は、ランタイム検証器統合パターンを中間状態シリアライザへと拡張し、10件のCVEパターン全てを網羅するPythonとRustのリファレンス実装を提供する。Verifiable Intermediate-State-Serializer Canonicalization for Agentic AI Workflow-State Migration(arxiv 2605.06892)は木曜日に出荷され、4ティアおよびサブティアのロード・ランタイム・ワークフロー状態・中間状態ローダー・パターン向けの形式的合成安全定理を提供し、MIT CSAIL、ETH Zurich、INRIA France、東京工業大学が機関レビュアー群に追加される。vLLM v0.11.4-rc1、SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8、Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1がそれぞれ同じ木曜日に中間状態シリアライザ緩和策を出荷し、vLLMは追加で署名済みチェックポイント・ローダーをデフォルト化、SGLangとのパリティ・ギャップをベンチマーク・サイクル開始以来最小の4.3%まで縮める。Unslothは木曜日に中間状態シリアライザ緩和策を出荷し、フレームワーク群の目標に先行して四ティアおよびサブティア面をカバーする初のローカルLLMファインチューニング・スタックとなる。OpenAI Codex CLI v3.1.2は対応するクライアントサイド緩和策を出荷する。Microsoft、LangChain、CrewAI保守チーム、Pydantic AI保守チーム、AutoGen保守チームは、ペア四面配信を次回マイナー・バージョン・リリースのデフォルトとして出荷する並行木曜コミットメントを公表し、これまでに調整された6月中旬デフォルト出荷ウィンドウを四つの面を一つのバンドルとして網羅するよう拡張する。構造的な力は、10件のCVEインスタンス、本番ティアの1サービング・スタックが署名済みチェックポイント・ローダーをデフォルト化、3つのサービング・スタックが中間状態シリアライザ緩和策を出荷、1つのローカルLLMファインチューニング・スタックが同プリミティブを出荷、1つのクライアントサイドCLIが対応緩和策を出荷、Pythonと Rust リファレンス実装で10件のCVEパターン全てを網羅するv3ランタイム検証器プレプリントが同じ木曜日に着地する中、エージェンティックAIフレームワーク群は、CISA連邦民間オペレーション指令ワーキング草案が10件CVE Trail of Bits分類を組み込み省庁間レビューを通過してOMB公表キューに入り、四面署名ロード姿勢をペア調達適格性証拠として扱う一方、次回マイナー・リリースで部分的な三面緩和を出荷することができない、というものである。最も蓋然性が高い形は、LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、Pydantic AI、Semantic Kernel、Haystack、LiteLLMの次回マイナー・リリースで四面緩和策が文書化されたデフォルトとなり、NHS England遮断リストが参照する旧ブランチ向けペア・バックポート・アドバイザリーとサンドボックステストフィクスチャ向けの明示的な署名なしロード・オプトアウトフラグを備える形で、保守者群が現在公表コミットした2026年6月中旬ウィンドウ内に着地するというものである。下方シナリオはあるフレームワークが中間状態シリアライザのサブティアをサブマイナー・パッチ・リリースとして先送りし、6月中旬マイナーで三面バンドルのみを出荷する展開で、それがなければ2026年6月中旬はエージェンティックAIフレームワーク群全体でペア四面署名ロード緩和策が文書化されたデフォルトとして着地する。
description.es: Para mediados de junio de 2026, la ola de adopcion de la superficie de cuarto nivel del jueves obligara al cohorte de frameworks de IA agentica — LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack y LiteLLM — a enviar la mitigacion combinada de cuatro superficies (checkpoint firmado en el momento de carga mas validacion de lista de permisos del manifiesto en tiempo de ejecucion mas canonizacion de rutas del estado del flujo de trabajo mas canonizacion del serializador del estado intermedio) como la ruta de carga documentada por defecto en el proximo lanzamiento de version menor, en lugar de como funciones de adhesion opcional o limitadas al sub-nivel. Los catalizadores del jueves son concretos, se refuerzan mutuamente y aterrizan dentro de un solo dia habil en las cuatro superficies simultaneamente: LangChain CVE-2026-44967 (CVSS 8.8) aparece como una vulnerabilidad de path traversal en el serializador intermedio de handoff del cargador de checkpoints del estado del flujo de trabajo, con la version v0.3.7 entregada el mismo dia mas los backports emparejados v0.2.x y v0.1.x que referencia la lista de bloqueo de NHS England; Trail of Bits publica un addendum del jueves extendiendo la taxonomia de nueve CVE del miercoles a diez con la canonizacion del serializador del estado intermedio como un nuevo sub-patron, reafirmando la forma comun de mitigacion de cuatro niveles y sub-nivel; el addendum conjunto v3 del jueves de DeepMind mas Meta AI mas Anthropic mas Microsoft (arxiv 2605.06712v3) extiende el patron de integracion del verificador en tiempo de ejecucion al serializador del estado intermedio con implementaciones de referencia en Python y Rust que cubren las diez instancias del patron de CVE; Verifiable Intermediate-State-Serializer Canonicalization for Agentic AI Workflow-State Migration (arxiv 2605.06892) se publica el jueves con teoremas formales de seguridad composicional para el patron de cargador de cuatro niveles y sub-nivel carga-tiempo-de-ejecucion-estado-del-flujo-de-trabajo-estado-intermedio, con MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, INRIA Francia y el Instituto de Tecnologia de Tokio agregados al cohorte de revisores institucionales; vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 mas SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8 mas Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1 envian cada uno la mitigacion del serializador del estado intermedio el mismo jueves, con vLLM ademas estableciendo por defecto el cargador de checkpoint firmado y cerrando la brecha de paridad con SGLang al 4.3 por ciento, la brecha mas estrecha desde que comenzo el ciclo del benchmark; Unsloth envia la mitigacion del serializador del estado intermedio el jueves como la primera pila de ajuste fino de LLM locales en cubrir la ahora superficie de cuatro niveles y sub-nivel por delante del objetivo del cohorte de frameworks; description.fil: Pagsapit ng hatinggitna ng Hunyo 2026, pipilitin ng adoption wave ng fourth-tier-surface sa Huwebes ang cohort ng mga agentic-AI framework — LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack, at LiteLLM — na ipadala ang paired four-surface mitigation (load-time signed-checkpoint plus runtime manifest-allowlist-validation plus workflow-state path-canonicalization plus intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization) bilang documented default sa susunod na minor-version release sa halip na opt-in o sub-tier-only features. Ang mga catalyst nitong Huwebes ay konkreto, magkakaugnay, at lahat ay lumapag sa loob ng iisang business day sa lahat ng apat na surface nang sabay-sabay: bumaba ang LangChain CVE-2026-44967 (CVSS 8.8) bilang path-traversal sa intermediate hand-off serializer ng workflow-state checkpoint loader na may v0.3.7 na ipinadala same-day plus paired v0.2.x at v0.1.x backports na tinutukoy ng NHS England blocklist; naglathala ang Trail of Bits ng Thursday addendum na nag-extend sa Wednesday nine-CVE taxonomy patungong sampu na may intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization bilang fresh sub-pattern, na muling pinatibay ang four-tier-and-sub-tier common-mitigation shape; ang DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft Thursday v3 joint preprint addendum (arxiv 2605.06712v3) ay nag-extend sa runtime-verifier integration pattern patungong intermediate-state-serializer na may reference implementations sa Python at Rust na sumasaklaw sa lahat ng sampung CVE-pattern instances; ang Verifiable Intermediate-State-Serializer Canonicalization for Agentic AI Workflow-State Migration (arxiv 2605.06892) ay nagpadala Huwebes na may formal compositional safety theorems para sa four-tier-and-sub-tier load-runtime-workflow-state-intermediate-state loader pattern, kasama ang MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, INRIA France, at Tokyo Institute of Technology na idinagdag sa institutional reviewer cohort; ang vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 plus SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8 plus Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1 ay bawat isang nagpadala ng intermediate-state-serializer mitigation sa iisang Huwebes habang ang vLLM ay karagdagang nag-default sa signed-checkpoint loader at isinara ang parity gap sa SGLang sa 4.3 porsiyento, ang pinakamasikip na agwat mula nang magsimula ang benchmark cycle; nagpadala ang Unsloth ng intermediate-state-serializer mitigation Huwebes bilang unang local-LLM fine-tuning stack na sumakop sa now-four-tier-and-sub-tier surface ahead ng framework cohort target; nagpadala ang OpenAI Codex CLI v3.1.2 ng matching client-side mitigation; at naglathala ang Microsoft, LangChain, ang CrewAI maintainer team, ang Pydantic AI maintainer team, plus ang AutoGen maintainer team ng parallel Thursday commitments na ipadala ang paired four-surface delivery bilang default sa susunod na minor-version release, na ina-extend ang previously-coordinated mid-June default-shipment window upang masakop ang lahat ng apat na surface bilang isang bundle. Ang structural force ay kapag lumapag sa parehong Huwebes ang sampung CVE instances, isang production-tier serving stack na nag-default sa signed-checkpoint loader, tatlong serving stacks na nagpapadala ng intermediate-state-serializer mitigation, isang local-LLM fine-tuning stack na nagpapadala ng parehong primitive, isang client-side CLI na nagpapadala ng matching mitigation, at ang v3 runtime-verifier preprint na may reference implementations sa Python at Rust na sumasaklaw sa lahat ng sampung CVE patterns, hindi makakapagpadala ang cohort ng agentic-AI framework ng partial three-surface mitigation sa kanilang susunod na minor release habang ang CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft na ngayon ay nagsasama ng ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy ay tumatawid sa interagency review patungo sa OMB publication queue at tinatrato ang four-surface signed-load posture bilang paired procurement-eligibility evidence. Ang pinakamalamang na hugis ay ang four-surface mitigation ay magiging documented default sa susunod na minor release ng LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, Semantic Kernel, Haystack, at LiteLLM — na may paired backport advisories para sa mga lumang branch na tinutukoy ng NHS England blocklist at explicit unsigned-load opt-out flags para sa sandboxed test fixtures — sa loob ng hatinggitna ng Hunyo 2026 window na pampublikong ipinangako ng maintainer cohort. Ang bear case ay kung mag-defer ang isang framework sa intermediate-state-serializer sub-tier bilang sub-minor patch release at magpadala lamang ng three-surface bundle sa kanyang mid-June minor; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang mid-June 2026 ng paired four-surface signed-load mitigation bilang documented default sa buong cohort ng agentic-AI framework.

The Thursday catalysts are concrete, mutually reinforcing, and land within a single business day across all four surfaces simultaneously: LangChain CVE-2026-44967 (CVSS 8.8) drops as a path-traversal in the workflow-state checkpoint loader's intermediate hand-off serializer with v0.3.7 shipping same-day plus paired v0.2.x and v0.1.x backports the NHS England blocklist references; Trail of Bits publishes a Thursday addendum extending the Wednesday nine-CVE taxonomy to ten with intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization as a fresh sub-pattern, reaffirming the four-tier-and-sub-tier common-mitigation shape; the DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft Thursday v3 joint preprint addendum (arxiv 2605.06712v3) extends the runtime-verifier integration pattern to the intermediate-state-serializer with reference implementations in Python and Rust covering all ten CVE-pattern instances; Verifiable Intermediate-State-Serializer Canonicalization for Agentic AI Workflow-State Migration (arxiv 2605.06892) ships Thursday with formal compositional safety theorems for the four-tier-and-sub-tier load-runtime-workflow-state-intermediate-state loader pattern, with MIT CSAIL, ETH Zurich, INRIA France, and Tokyo Institute of Technology added to the institutional reviewer cohort; vLLM v0.11.4-rc1 plus SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8 plus Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1 each ship the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation on the same Thursday with vLLM additionally defaulting the signed-checkpoint loader and closing the parity gap to SGLang at 4.3 percent, the tightest gap since the benchmark cycle began; Unsloth ships the intermediate-state-serializer mitigation Thursday as the first local-LLM fine-tuning stack to cover the now-four-tier-and-sub-tier surface ahead of the framework cohort target; OpenAI Codex CLI v3.1.2 ships the matching client-side mitigation; and Microsoft, LangChain, the CrewAI maintainer team, the Pydantic AI maintainer team, plus the AutoGen maintainer team publish parallel Thursday commitments to ship the paired four-surface delivery as a default in the next minor-version release, extending the previously-coordinated mid-June default-shipment window to cover all four surfaces as one bundle. Kernel、Haystack、LiteLLM——に対し、ペアとなる四面緩和策(ロード時の署名済みチェックポイント、ランタイムのマニフェスト許可リスト検証、ワークフロー状態のパス正規化、中間状態シリアライザの正規化)を、オプトインまたはサブティア限定機能ではなく次回マイナー・バージョン・リリースの文書化されたデフォルトとして出荷することを促す。木曜日のきっかけは具体的かつ相互に強化し合い、四つの面すべてに対して単一営業日内で同時に着地する。LangChain CVE-2026-44967(CVSS 8.8)が、ワークフロー状態チェックポイント・ローダーの中間ハンドオフ・シリアライザにおけるパス・トラバーサルとして公開され、即日v0.3.7と、NHS England遮断リストが参照するペアv0.2.x・v0.1.xバックポートが出荷される。Trail of Bitsは木曜日の追補を公開し、水曜日の9件CVE分類を10件に拡張、中間状態シリアライザ正規化を新たなサブパターンとして加え、四ティアおよびサブティアの共通緩和策の形を再確認する。DeepMind、Meta AI、Anthropic、Microsoftの木曜版v3合同プレプリント追補(arxiv 2605.06712v3)は、ランタイム検証器統合パターンを中間状態シリアライザへと拡張し、10件のCVEパターン全てを網羅するPythonとRustのリファレンス実装を提供する。Verifiable Intermediate-State-Serializer Canonicalization for Agentic AI Workflow-State Migration(arxiv 2605.06892)は木曜日に出荷され、4ティアおよびサブティアのロード・ランタイム・ワークフロー状態・中間状態ローダー・パターン向けの形式的合成安全定理を提供し、MIT CSAIL、ETH Zurich、INRIA France、東京工業大学が機関レビュアー群に追加される。vLLM v0.11.4-rc1、SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8、Hugging Face TGI v3.2.1がそれぞれ同じ木曜日に中間状態シリアライザ緩和策を出荷し、vLLMは追加で署名済みチェックポイント・ローダーをデフォルト化、SGLangとのパリティ・ギャップをベンチマーク・サイクル開始以来最小の4.3%まで縮める。Unslothは木曜日に中間状態シリアライザ緩和策を出荷し、フレームワーク群の目標に先行して四ティアおよびサブティア面をカバーする初のローカルLLMファインチューニング・スタックとなる。OpenAI Codex CLI v3.1.2は対応するクライアントサイド緩和策を出荷する。Microsoft、LangChain、CrewAI保守チーム、Pydantic AI保守チーム、AutoGen保守チームは、ペア四面配信を次回マイナー・バージョン・リリースのデフォルトとして出荷する並行木曜コミットメントを公表し、これまでに調整された6月中旬デフォルト出荷ウィンドウを四つの面を一つのバンドルとして網羅するよう拡張する。構造的な力は、10件のCVEインスタンス、本番ティアの1サービング・スタックが署名済みチェックポイント・ローダーをデフォルト化、3つのサービング・スタックが中間状態シリアライザ緩和策を出荷、1つのローカルLLMファインチューニング・スタックが同プリミティブを出荷、1つのクライアントサイドCLIが対応緩和策を出荷、Pythonと Rust リファレンス実装で10件のCVEパターン全てを網羅するv3ランタイム検証器プレプリントが同じ木曜日に着地する中、エージェンティックAIフレームワーク群は、CISA連邦民間オペレーション指令ワーキング草案が10件CVE Trail of Bits分類を組み込み省庁間レビューを通過してOMB公表キューに入り、四面署名ロード姿勢をペア調達適格性証拠として扱う一方、次回マイナー・リリースで部分的な三面緩和を出荷することができない、というものである。最も蓋然性が高い形は、LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、Pydantic AI、Semantic Kernel、Haystack、LiteLLMの次回マイナー・リリースで四面緩和策が文書化されたデフォルトとなり、NHS England遮断リストが参照する旧ブランチ向けペア・バックポート・アドバイザリーとサンドボックステストフィクスチャ向けの明示的な署名なしロード・オプトアウトフラグを備える形で、保守者群が現在公表コミットした2026年6月中旬ウィンドウ内に着地するというものである。下方シナリオはあるフレームワークが中間状態シリアライザのサブティアをサブマイナー・パッチ・リリースとして先送りし、6月中旬マイナーで三面バンドルのみを出荷する展開で、それがなければ2026年6月中旬はエージェンティックAIフレームワーク群全体でペア四面署名ロード緩和策が文書化されたデフォルトとして着地する。

text_locales.en: Thursday carries the four-surface bundle inside the now-six-surface coordinated commitment: the LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort holds the mid-June default-shipment commitment with covered surfaces unchanged plus the tenant-policy-attestation manifest as the optional sixth verification surface and now treats the mid-June ship as a downhill release, the CISA federal-civilian directive cleanly clears its 12:00 ET deadline mark, and the consolidated reference-implementation index now ships a single end-to-end conformance run covering all six surfaces.
text_locales.ja: 木曜日は、いまや6サーフェスとなった協調されたコミットメントの内側に4サーフェスのバンドルを担う:LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、Haystack、Pydantic AIのメンテナー集団は、対象サーフェスを変えずに、加えてテナントポリシー証明マニフェストをオプションの6番目の検証サーフェスとして、6月中旬のデフォルト出荷コミットメントを維持し、いまや6月中旬の出荷を下り坂のリリースとして扱い、CISA連邦民間指令が12:00 ET期限マークを無傷でクリアし、統合されたリファレンス実装インデックスが、いまや6サーフェスすべてをカバーする単一のエンドツーエンドの適合性ランを出荷する。
text_locales.es: El jueves lleva el paquete de cuatro superficies dentro del compromiso coordinado ahora de seis superficies: el grupo de mantenedores de LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack y Pydantic AI mantiene el compromiso de entrega por defecto de mediados de junio con las superficies cubiertas sin cambios más el manifiesto de atestación de políticas de inquilino como la sexta superficie de verificación opcional y trata ahora la entrega de mediados de junio como un lanzamiento cuesta abajo, la directiva del ámbito civil federal de CISA despeja limpiamente su marca de plazo de las 12:00 ET, y el índice consolidado de implementación de referencia entrega ahora una única ejecución de conformidad de extremo a extremo que cubre las seis superficies.
text_locales.fil: Dinadala ng Huwebes ang four-surface bundle sa loob ng ngayon-ay-six-surface coordinated commitment: hawak ng LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, at Pydantic AI maintainer cohort ang mid-June default-shipment commitment kasama ang mga covered surface na hindi nagbago plus ang tenant-policy-attestation manifest bilang ang opsyonal na ikaanim na verification surface at ngayon ay itinuturing ang mid-June ship bilang isang downhill release, malinis na natapos ng CISA federal-civilian directive ang 12:00 ET deadline mark nito, at ang consolidated reference-implementation index ay ngayon ay naghahatid ng isang single end-to-end conformance run na sumasaklaw sa lahat ng anim na surface.

bridges.text: Tuesday's Hugging Face Blog post confirms the LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort carrying Monday's no-schedule-revision status into the second business-week day, the coordinated mid-June default-shipment commitment covering all five mitigation surfaces — load-time signed-checkpoint, manifest-allowlist with the nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization extension, workflow-state path-canonicalization, and intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization — unchanged, and Simon Willison's Tuesday note observes the CISA federal-civilian directive's first operating day now gives any framework releasing the default ahead of mid-June a fully-pinned alignment story.

text_locales.en: Tuesday's Hugging Face Blog post confirms the LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort carrying Monday's no-schedule-revision status into the second business-week day, the coordinated mid-June default-shipment commitment covering all five mitigation surfaces — load-time signed-checkpoint, manifest-allowlist with the nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization extension, workflow-state path-canonicalization, and intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization — unchanged, and Simon Willison's Tuesday note observes the CISA federal-civilian directive's first operating day now gives any framework releasing the default ahead of mid-June a fully-pinned alignment story.
text_locales.ja: 火曜日のHugging Face Blog投稿は、LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、Haystack、Pydantic AIのメンテナー集団が、月曜日のスケジュール改定なしのステータスを業務週2日目へと持ち越し、5つの緩和サーフェスすべて——ロード時の署名済みチェックポイント、ネストされた依存解決の正規化拡張を伴うマニフェスト許可リスト、ワークフロー状態のパス正規化、中間状態シリアライザの正規化——をカバーする協調的な6月中旬のデフォルト出荷コミットメントを変更なしで担っていることを確認し、Simon Willisonの火曜日のノートは、CISA連邦民間指令の最初の運用日が、6月中旬以前にデフォルトをリリースするフレームワークに、完全にピン留めされた整合性のストーリーを与えていることを観察している。
text_locales.es: La publicación del martes del blog de Hugging Face confirma que el grupo de mantenedores de LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack y Pydantic AI lleva al segundo día hábil de la semana el estatus sin revisión del calendario del lunes, el compromiso coordinado de entrega por defecto de mediados de junio que cubre las cinco superficies de mitigación —checkpoint firmado en tiempo de carga, lista de permitidos de manifiesto con la extensión de canonicalización de resolución de dependencias anidadas, canonicalización de rutas del estado del flujo de trabajo y canonicalización del serializador de estado intermedio— sin cambios, y la nota del martes de Simon Willison observa que el primer día operativo de la directiva del ámbito civil federal de CISA da ahora a cualquier marco que lance el valor por defecto antes de mediados de junio una historia de alineación plenamente fijada.
text_locales.fil: Kinukumpirma ng Tuesday Hugging Face Blog post ang LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, at Pydantic AI maintainer cohort na dala ang no-schedule-revision status ng Lunes patungo sa ikalawang business-week day, ang coordinated mid-June default-shipment commitment na sumasaklaw sa lahat ng limang mitigation surface — load-time signed-checkpoint, manifest-allowlist kasama ang nested-dependency-resolution canonicalization extension, workflow-state path-canonicalization, at intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization — ay hindi nagbabago, at sinusunod ng Tuesday Simon Willison note na ang unang operating day ng CISA federal-civilian directive ay nagbibigay ngayon sa anumang framework na maglalabas ng default bago ang mid-June ng isang fully-pinned alignment story.

text_locales.es: El grupo de mantenimiento de LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack y Pydantic AI reafirmó el sábado que su compromiso coordinado de envío por defecto de mediados de junio cubre ahora las cinco superficies de mitigación, con la taxonomía consolidada de Trail of Bits y el arxiv 2605.07241 aportando la línea base de verificación — el valor por defecto de carga firmada predicho va por buen camino.

text_locales.es: El jueves, LangChain CVE-2026-44967 más la taxonomía de diez CVE de Trail of Bits, el preprint v3 del runtime-verifier con implementaciones de referencia en Python y Rust, y los envíos del mismo día de la mitigación del intermediate-state-serializer por parte de vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Unsloth y Codex CLI observan la precondición: el sustrato ya está enviando la cuarta superficie. Los equipos de mantenedores de Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI y AutoGen publican compromisos paralelos el jueves para activar por defecto la entrega emparejada de cuatro superficies en el próximo lanzamiento menor.
text_locales.fil: Ang Huwebes LangChain CVE-2026-44967 plus ang Trail of Bits ten-CVE taxonomy plus ang v3 runtime-verifier preprint na may Python at Rust reference implementations plus ang same-day shipments ng vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Unsloth, at Codex CLI ng intermediate-state-serializer mitigation ay nag-o-observe sa precondition: ini-ship na ng substrate ang ikaapat na surface. Naglalathala ang Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, at AutoGen maintainer teams ng parallel Huwebes commitments na i-default ang paired four-surface delivery sa susunod na minor release.

motivation_locales.en: The joint-author cohort cannot leave the v2 runtime-verifier pattern uncovered at the intermediate-state-serializer sub-tier once the LangChain CVE-2026-44967 fourth-surface instance lands and the Trail of Bits taxonomy extends from nine to ten CVEs; without same-Thursday v3 reference implementations the framework cohort's mid-June commitment cannot extend coherently from three-surface to four-surface, and the formal compositional safety theorems in arxiv 2605.06892 are the structural floor that makes the four-surface mitigation auditable as a single bundle.
motivation_locales.ja: 共同執筆者群は、LangChain CVE-2026-44967の4つ目の面インスタンスが着地しTrail of Bits分類が9件から10件に拡張された後、v2ランタイム検証器パターンを中間状態シリアライザ・サブティアで未対応のまま残すことはできない。同じ木曜のv3リファレンス実装がなければ、フレームワーク群の6月中旬コミットメントが3面から4面へと整合的に拡張できない。arxiv 2605.06892の形式的合成安全定理は、4面緩和策を単一バンドルとして監査可能にする構造的な床である。
