text_locales.es: La persistencia de 10-dias-sin-parchear de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 con PoC publico, los KEV adds del 28 de abril de CISA con deadline federal del 12 de mayo, y el cluster Milesight + Totolink 9.8 extienden directamente la precondicion de que los codepaths inference-runtime + agentic-CI estan alcanzando severidad de Patch-Tuesday-grade a una cadencia sostenida. La categoria de clase-CVE continua cristalizando en el terreno.
text_locales.fil: Ang 10-araw-unpatched persistence ng SGLang CVE-2026-5760 kasama ang public PoC, ang Apr 28 CISA KEV adds na may May-12 federal deadline, at ang Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster ay direktang nag-mamaterialize ng precondition na ang inference-runtime + agentic-CI codepaths ay umaabot sa Patch-Tuesday-grade severity sa sustained cadence. Ang CVE-class category ay patuloy na nag-cri-crystallize sa lupa.

detail.description: **Inference servers become the new "primitive supply chain" — Q3 2026 sees the first AI Infra-specific CVE class (LLM-INFRA-CWE) with mandatory NVD tagging.** The Apr 19-26 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m exploited)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + the Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot — composes a clear "inference-runtime + agentic-CI" attack-surface category. By Q3 2026, NIST/NVD adds a dedicated **"AI-Infra"** tag to its CVE schema, OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes **"Inference Server Template / Loader RCE"** to a top-3 entry, and supply-chain SBOM tooling (Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera) ships **per-engine signature feeds for vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollama** as standard SKUs. description.en: **The "AI-Infra CVE class" graduates into a regulatory primitive — Q4 2026 sees CISA / NIST publish a sub-catalog for inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, separate from KEV.** The Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — is no longer a "category emerging." NIST's Apr ops update (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) plus Google's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise in the wild** force CISA/NVD to ship a **dedicated inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging by Q4 2026. OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「AI インフラ CVE クラス」が規制プリミティブへ昇格する — Q4 2026 までに CISA / NIST が KEV とは別の、推論サーバ + エージェンティック CI ランタイム向けサブカタログを公表する。** 4/19-27 のシーケンス — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12 時間 31 分)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (依然として未パッチ)** + **Pillar による Antigravity の `find_by_name -X` 経由サンドボックス エスケープ** + **基盤的な CI/CD 依存性における simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE** + **4/21 の Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot をまたぐ Comment-and-Control プロンプトインジェクション連鎖** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 サンドボックス回避** — はもはや「カテゴリーが立ち現れている」段階ではない。NIST の 4 月運用アップデート (CVE 公表数の記録的増加、AI 駆動の評価サポート) と Google の **野生の間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 前年比増** が CISA / NVD に対し、Q4 2026 までに **SBOM タグ付け必須化を伴う、推論サーバ + エージェンティックツール専用の CVE サブカタログ**を出荷するよう迫る。OWASP の LLM Top 10 v2026 は「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」をトップ 3 へ格上げする。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La "clase CVE de AI-Infra" se gradúa como primitiva regulatoria — el Q4 2026 ve a CISA / NIST publicar un sub-catálogo para runtimes de inference-server + agentic-CI, separado de KEV.** La secuencia del 19-27 de abril — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (todavía sin parchear)** + **escape de sandbox de Pillar Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en una dependencia fundacional de CI/CD** + **cadena de prompt-injection Comment-and-Control del 21 de abril a través de Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **bypass de sandbox OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329** — ya no es una "categoría emergente". La actualización ops de NIST de abril (crecimiento récord de publicación de CVE, soporte de evaluación impulsado por IA) más el **aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecto en la naturaleza** de Google fuerzan a CISA/NVD a entregar un **sub-catálogo CVE dedicado a inference-server + agentic-tool** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio para el Q4 2026. El OWASP LLM Top 10 v2026 promueve "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" al top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "AI-Infra CVE class" ay magiging regulatory primitive — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ilalathala ng CISA / NIST ang sub-catalog para sa inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, hiwalay sa KEV.** Ang Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (hindi pa rin na-patch)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape sa pamamagitan ng `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE sa foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain sa Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — ay hindi na isang "category emerging." Ang Apr ops update ng NIST (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) kasama ang **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise sa wild ng Google** ay pumipilit sa CISA/NVD na magpadala ng **dedikadong inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** na may mandatory SBOM tagging pagsapit ng Q4 2026. Ang LLM Top 10 v2026 ng OWASP ay mag-aangat sa "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" sa top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.en: CISA formally tracked an inference-proxy and agentic-tool CVE - the LiteLLM MCP-endpoint flaw - on a KEV remediation timeline, advancing the federal-governance side of this thesis that the agent tool-wiring layer is an internet-reachable surface needing patch deadlines. It nudges toward the expected publication, but is a one-off CISA listing with no NIST-side classification and no named inference-server-plus-agentic-tool sub-catalog.
text_locales.ja: CISAは推論プロキシおよびエージェント型ツールのCVE——LiteLLMのMCPエンドポイントの欠陥——をKEVの修正タイムラインで正式に追跡し、エージェントのツール配線層はインターネットから到達可能であり修正期限を要するという、この見立ての連邦ガバナンス側を前進させた。想定される公表に向けて後押しするものの、NIST側の分類も、推論サーバーとエージェント型ツールという名前付きサブカタログも伴わない、CISAの単発の掲載にとどまる。
text_locales.es: CISA siguió formalmente un CVE de proxy de inferencia y herramienta agéntica -el fallo en el endpoint MCP de LiteLLM- en un calendario de remediación KEV, lo que hace avanzar el lado de la gobernanza federal de esta tesis: que la capa que conecta los agentes con las herramientas es una superficie accesible desde internet que necesita plazos de parcheo. Empuja hacia la publicación esperada, pero es una inclusión puntual de CISA sin clasificación por parte de NIST y sin un subcatálogo nombrado de servidor de inferencia más herramienta agéntica.
text_locales.fil: Pormal na sinubaybayan ng CISA ang isang inference-proxy at agentic-tool CVE - ang MCP-endpoint flaw ng LiteLLM - sa isang KEV remediation timeline, na nagpapasulong sa federal-governance na bahagi ng tesis na ito na ang agent tool-wiring layer ay isang internet-reachable surface na nangangailangan ng mga patch deadline. Itinutulak nito ang inaasahang publikasyon, ngunit isa itong one-off na CISA listing na walang klasipikasyon mula sa NIST at walang pinangalanang inference-server-plus-agentic-tool sub-catalog.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **The "AI-Infra CVE class" graduates into a regulatory primitive — Q4 2026 sees CISA / NIST publish a sub-catalog for inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, separate from KEV.** The Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — is no longer a "category emerging." NIST's Apr ops update (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) plus Google's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise in the wild** force CISA/NVD to ship a **dedicated inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging by Q4 2026. OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.es: **La "clase CVE de AI-Infra" se gradúa como primitiva regulatoria — el Q4 2026 ve a CISA / NIST publicar un sub-catálogo para runtimes de inference-server + agentic-CI, separado de KEV.** La secuencia del 19-27 de abril — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (todavía sin parchear)** + **escape de sandbox de Pillar Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en una dependencia fundacional de CI/CD** + **cadena de prompt-injection Comment-and-Control del 21 de abril a través de Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **bypass de sandbox OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329** — ya no es una "categoría emergente". La actualización ops de NIST de abril (crecimiento récord de publicación de CVE, soporte de evaluación impulsado por IA) más el **aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecto en la naturaleza** de Google fuerzan a CISA/NVD a entregar un **sub-catálogo CVE dedicado a inference-server + agentic-tool** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio para el Q4 2026. El OWASP LLM Top 10 v2026 promueve "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" al top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang "AI-Infra CVE class" ay magiging regulatory primitive — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ilalathala ng CISA / NIST ang sub-catalog para sa inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, hiwalay sa KEV.** Ang Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (hindi pa rin na-patch)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape sa pamamagitan ng `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE sa foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain sa Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — ay hindi na isang "category emerging." Ang Apr ops update ng NIST (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) kasama ang **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise sa wild ng Google** ay pumipilit sa CISA/NVD na magpadala ng **dedikadong inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** na may mandatory SBOM tagging pagsapit ng Q4 2026. Ang LLM Top 10 v2026 ng OWASP ay mag-aangat sa "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" sa top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **Public-opinion blowback against AI converts into binding agent-governance rules — by Q3 2026 at least one US state ships a "Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents" Act mirroring Okta's Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway pattern.** Apr 16 attacks on Altman's home + the Apr 15 CNBC datacenter-blowback piece + Apr 26 Salt Security data ("48.9% of orgs cannot monitor AI-agent traffic") + Okta for AI Agents GA on **Apr 30** (with Agent Discovery, Agent Gateway, virtual-MCP-server registry, credential vaulting + auto-rotation, universal logout) compose a regulatory pull-forward. A US state (CA, NY, or TX likely) ships a statute by Q3 2026 mandating **agent-as-first-class-identity registration, MCP-call-chain logging, and per-action consent**, mirroring Cross App Access protocol semantics. EU AI Act Article 26 enforcement triggers in parallel. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **AI への世論の反発が拘束力のあるエージェント・ガバナンス・ルールへ転化する — Q3 2026 までに、米国少なくとも 1 州が Okta の Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway パターンを反映した「自律エージェントの法定アイデンティティ」法を出荷する。** 4/16 の Altman 自宅への襲撃 + 4/15 の CNBC データセンター反発記事 + 4/26 の Salt Security データ (「組織の 48.9% が AI エージェントトラフィックを監視できない」) + **4/30** の Okta for AI Agents GA (Agent Discovery、Agent Gateway、仮想 MCP サーバレジストリ、認証情報の保管庫化 + 自動ローテーション、ユニバーサルログアウトを搭載) が、規制の前倒しを構成する。米国の 1 州 (CA、NY もしくは TX が有力) が Q3 2026 までに **エージェントをファーストクラスのアイデンティティとして登録すること、MCP コールチェーンのロギング、アクション単位の同意**を義務付ける法令を、Cross App Access プロトコルのセマンティクスを反映する形で出荷する。EU AI 法第 26 条の執行が並行して始動する。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La reacción de la opinión pública contra la IA se convierte en reglas vinculantes de gobernanza de agentes — para el Q3 2026 al menos un estado de EE.UU. entrega una Ley de "Identidad Estatutaria para Agentes Autónomos" reflejando el patrón Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway de Okta.** Los ataques del 16 de abril a la casa de Altman + la pieza del 15 de abril de CNBC sobre la reacción contra los datacenters + los datos de Salt Security del 26 de abril ("48.9% de las organizaciones no pueden monitorear el tráfico de AI-agent") + Okta for AI Agents GA el **30 de abril** (con Agent Discovery, Agent Gateway, registro virtual-MCP-server, vaulting de credenciales + auto-rotación, logout universal) componen un adelanto regulatorio. Un estado de EE.UU. (CA, NY o TX probable) entrega un estatuto para el Q3 2026 que obliga **el registro de agente como identidad de primera clase, el logging de la cadena de llamadas MCP y el consentimiento por acción**, reflejando la semántica del protocolo Cross App Access. La aplicación del Artículo 26 del EU AI Act se activa en paralelo. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang public-opinion blowback laban sa AI ay magiging binding agent-governance rules — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isang US state ay magpapadala ng "Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents" Act na sumasalamin sa Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway pattern ng Okta.** Ang Apr 16 attacks sa bahay ni Altman + ang Apr 15 CNBC datacenter-blowback piece + Apr 26 Salt Security data ("48.9% ng orgs ay hindi makakapag-monitor ng AI-agent traffic") + Okta for AI Agents GA noong **Apr 30** (kasama ang Agent Discovery, Agent Gateway, virtual-MCP-server registry, credential vaulting + auto-rotation, universal logout) ay bumubuo ng regulatory pull-forward. Isang US state (CA, NY, o TX malamang) ay magpapadala ng statute pagsapit ng Q3 2026 na nag-uutos ng **agent-as-first-class-identity registration, MCP-call-chain logging, at per-action consent**, na sumasalamin sa Cross App Access protocol semantics. Ang EU AI Act Article 26 enforcement ay magti-trigger nang parallel. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

detail.summary_short: Apr 15 CNBC public-opinion data, Apr 16 attacks on Altman's home, Apr 26 Salt Security finding 48.9% of orgs cannot monitor AI-agent traffic, and Apr 30 Okta for AI Agents GA together push at least one US state (CA, NY, or TX) to ship a Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents Act by Q3 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: Apr 15 CNBC public-opinion data, Apr 16 attacks on Altman's home, Apr 26 Salt Security finding 48.9% of orgs cannot monitor AI-agent traffic, and Apr 30 Okta for AI Agents GA together push at least one US state (CA, NY, or TX) to ship a Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents Act by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: 4/15 の CNBC 世論データ、4/16 の Altman 自宅への襲撃、4/26 の Salt Security による「組織の 48.9% が AI エージェントトラフィックを監視できない」との所見、そして 4/30 の Okta for AI Agents GA が一体となり、米国少なくとも 1 州 (CA、NY もしくは TX) を Q3 2026 までに「自律エージェントの法定アイデンティティ」法を出荷する方向へ押し出す。
summary_short_locales.es: Los datos de opinión pública del 15 de abril de CNBC, los ataques del 16 de abril a la casa de Altman, el hallazgo del 26 de abril de Salt Security de que el 48.9% de las organizaciones no pueden monitorear el tráfico de AI-agent, y el GA de Okta for AI Agents del 30 de abril empujan juntos a al menos un estado de EE.UU. (CA, NY o TX) a entregar una Ley de Identidad Estatutaria para Agentes Autónomos para el Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Apr 15 CNBC public-opinion data, Apr 16 attacks sa bahay ni Altman, Apr 26 Salt Security finding na 48.9% ng orgs ay hindi makakapag-monitor ng AI-agent traffic, at Apr 30 Okta for AI Agents GA ay magkakasamang magtutulak sa kahit isang US state (CA, NY, o TX) na magpadala ng Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents Act pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: On the US state agent-as-first-class-identity statute prediction (April 27, revived), Natoma's MCP gateway (under Snowflake acquisition) enforcing identity, policy, and audit at the individual MCP tool-call level establishes the architectural precondition by making the agent a first-class principal in the IAM substrate. State legislators drafting statutes can cite this M&A reference as the named industry baseline.

text_locales.en: On the US state agent-as-first-class-identity statute prediction (April 27, revived), Natoma's MCP gateway (under Snowflake acquisition) enforcing identity, policy, and audit at the individual MCP tool-call level establishes the architectural precondition by making the agent a first-class principal in the IAM substrate. State legislators drafting statutes can cite this M&A reference as the named industry baseline.
text_locales.ja: 米国州レベルのエージェントを第一級アイデンティティとする州法予想(4月27日、再活性化)に対し、Snowflake買収下のNatoma MCPゲートウェイは、個別のMCPツール呼び出しレベルでアイデンティティ、ポリシー、監査を強制し、エージェントをIAM基層の第一級プリンシパルとすることで建築上の前提条件を確立する。州議会議員はこのM&Aの参照点を、指名された業界基準として引用しうる。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción del estatuto estatal de EE. UU. que reconoce al agente como identidad de primera clase (27 de abril, revivida), la pasarela MCP de Natoma (en adquisición por Snowflake) que aplica identidad, política y auditoría al nivel de cada tool-call individual de MCP establece la precondición arquitectónica al convertir al agente en un principal de primera clase dentro del sustrato IAM. Los legisladores estatales que redactan estatutos pueden citar esta referencia de M&A como base nominada de la industria.
text_locales.fil: Sa hula ng US state agent-as-first-class-identity statute (Abril 27, revived), nagtatatag ang MCP gateway ng Natoma (sa ilalim ng Snowflake acquisition) na nagpapatupad ng identity, policy, at audit sa individual MCP tool-call level ng architectural precondition sa pamamagitan ng paggawa sa agent bilang first-class principal sa IAM substrate. Maaaring ipakita ng mga state legislator na nagdadrowing ng statutes ang M&A reference na ito bilang pinangalanang industry baseline.

bridges.text: The RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity strengthens the structural force a state-level statute would codify, but no California, New York, or Texas legislative draft surfaces in the window.

text_locales.en: The RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity strengthens the structural force a state-level statute would codify, but no California, New York, or Texas legislative draft surfaces in the window.
text_locales.ja: RSACウィークのMicrosoft + Cisco + CSAのエージェントをファーストクラス・アイデンティティとして扱うことへの収斂は、州レベル法案が成文化するであろう構造的な強制力を強化するが、California、New York、Texasの立法草案はウィンドウ内で浮上しない。
text_locales.es: La convergencia de Microsoft + Cisco + CSA durante la semana de RSAC sobre agente-como-identidad-de-primera-clase fortalece la fuerza estructural que un estatuto a nivel estatal codificaría, pero ningún borrador legislativo de California, Nueva York o Texas aparece en la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence sa agent-as-first-class-identity ay nagpapatibay sa structural force na ko-codify-pin ng state-level statute, ngunit walang California, New York, o Texas legislative draft na lumilitaw sa window.

bridges.text: Microsoft's Agent 365 GA and the CSA Identity-in-AI piece show the agent-as-first-class-identity primitive landing on the commercial side at $15/user/mo, which is the operational schema a state statute would point to. The structural force of the prediction holds, but the legislative-pull remains industry-led rather than state-codified for now.

text_locales.en: Microsoft's Agent 365 GA and the CSA Identity-in-AI piece show the agent-as-first-class-identity primitive landing on the commercial side at $15/user/mo, which is the operational schema a state statute would point to. The structural force of the prediction holds, but the legislative-pull remains industry-led rather than state-codified for now.
text_locales.ja: MicrosoftのAgent 365 GAとCSAのIdentity-in-AI記事は、エージェント・ファーストクラス・アイデンティティ・プリミティブが商業側で$15/user/moで着地したことを示す。これは州法令が指し示す運用上のスキーマだ。予測の構造的力は保持されているが、立法プルは現時点では州が成文化するのではなく業界主導のままだ。
text_locales.es: La GA de Agent 365 de Microsoft y la pieza CSA Identity-in-AI muestran la primitiva de agente-como-identidad-de-primera-clase aterrizando del lado comercial a $15/usuario/mes, que es el esquema operacional al que apuntaría un estatuto estatal. La fuerza estructural de la predicción se sostiene, pero la presión legislativa permanece liderada por la industria en lugar de codificada por el estado por ahora.
text_locales.fil: Ipinapakita ng Agent 365 GA ng Microsoft at ng CSA Identity-in-AI piece na ang agent-as-first-class-identity primitive ay dumarating sa commercial side sa $15/user/mo, na siyang operational schema na tutukuyin ng isang state statute. Ang structural force ng prediction ay nananatili, ngunit ang legislative-pull ay nananatiling industry-led sa halip na state-codified sa kasalukuyan.

bridges.text: CSA's identity reframing plus Agent 365's tenant-level policy primitives give a future state statute the implementation surface the prediction assumes, even though no California, New York, or Texas bill has yet been introduced.

text_locales.en: CSA's identity reframing plus Agent 365's tenant-level policy primitives give a future state statute the implementation surface the prediction assumes, even though no California, New York, or Texas bill has yet been introduced.
text_locales.ja: CSAのアイデンティティ再構成と、Agent 365のテナントレベルポリシープリミティブは、California、New York、またはTexasの法案がまだ提出されていないものの、予測が想定する将来の州法令の実装サーフェスを与える。
text_locales.es: El replanteo de identidad de CSA más las primitivas de política a nivel de inquilino de Agent 365 dan a un futuro estatuto estatal la superficie de implementación que la predicción asume, aunque ningún proyecto de ley de California, Nueva York o Texas haya sido presentado todavía.
text_locales.fil: Ang identity reframing ng CSA kasama ang tenant-level policy primitives ng Agent 365 ay nagbibigay sa future state statute ng implementation surface na ipinapalagay ng prediction, kahit walang California, New York, o Texas bill ang naipakilala pa.

bridges.text: CSAI's STAR-for-AI Catastrophic Risk Annex, AARM, and ATF specifications plus Microsoft's Zero Trust for AI guidance compose the technical substrate the statutory thesis depends on — agent-as-first-class-identity registration, MCP-call-chain logging, and per-action consent are converging through industry self-regulation. The legislative side has not yet shipped but the substrate is in place for a CA / NY / TX move.

text_locales.en: CSAI's STAR-for-AI Catastrophic Risk Annex, AARM, and ATF specifications plus Microsoft's Zero Trust for AI guidance compose the technical substrate the statutory thesis depends on — agent-as-first-class-identity registration, MCP-call-chain logging, and per-action consent are converging through industry self-regulation. The legislative side has not yet shipped but the substrate is in place for a CA / NY / TX move.
text_locales.ja: CSAIのSTAR-for-AI Catastrophic Risk Annex、AARM、ATF仕様に加え、MicrosoftのZero Trust for AIガイダンスは、法定テーゼが依拠する技術基盤を構成する ― エージェント・アズ・ファーストクラス・アイデンティティ登録、MCPコールチェーンログ記録、アクションごとの同意は業界の自己規制を通じて収束している。立法側はまだ出荷していないが、CA / NY / TXの動きのための基盤は整っている。
text_locales.es: El STAR-for-AI Catastrophic Risk Annex de CSAI, las especificaciones AARM y ATF más la guía de Zero Trust for AI de Microsoft componen el sustrato técnico sobre el cual depende la tesis estatutaria — registro de agente-como-identidad-de-primera-clase, logging de cadena de llamadas MCP, y consentimiento por-acción están convergiendo a través de auto-regulación industrial. El lado legislativo aún no ha enviado pero el sustrato está en su lugar para un movimiento de CA / NY / TX.
text_locales.fil: Ang STAR-for-AI Catastrophic Risk Annex, AARM, at ATF specifications ng CSAI plus ang Zero Trust for AI guidance ng Microsoft ay bumubuo sa technical substrate na pinanindigan ng statutory thesis — agent-as-first-class-identity registration, MCP-call-chain logging, at per-action consent ay nagko-converge sa pamamagitan ng industry self-regulation. Ang legislative side ay hindi pa nag-ship ngunit ang substrate ay nasa lugar para sa CA / NY / TX move.

El sustrato está en su sitio para un movimiento de CA / NY / TX, no el movimiento en sí.

Ang substrate ay nakalagay para sa CA / NY / TX move, hindi ang move mismo.

bridges.text: Cloud Security Alliance's zero-trust-for-AI-agents framing and Okta for AI Agents Apr 30 GA with Agent Discovery + virtual MCP server registry + credential vaulting + universal logout extend the structural force the prediction names: agent-as-first-class-identity is becoming the assumed baseline. The legislative branch has not moved in the window.

text_locales.en: Cloud Security Alliance's zero-trust-for-AI-agents framing and Okta for AI Agents Apr 30 GA with Agent Discovery + virtual MCP server registry + credential vaulting + universal logout extend the structural force the prediction names: agent-as-first-class-identity is becoming the assumed baseline. The legislative branch has not moved in the window.
text_locales.ja: Cloud Security AllianceのAIエージェント向けゼロトラスト・フレーミングと、Okta for AI Agents 4月30日GA(Agent Discovery + 仮想MCPサーバー・レジストリ + 認証情報保管 + ユニバーサル・ログアウト)が、予測が指摘する構造的な力を拡大する: ファーストクラスID としてのエージェントが想定ベースラインになりつつある。立法府はウィンドウ内で動いていない。
text_locales.es: El framing zero-trust-para-AI-agents de Cloud Security Alliance y el Okta for AI Agents GA del 30 de abril con Agent Discovery + virtual MCP server registry + credential vaulting + universal logout extienden la fuerza estructural que la prediccion nombra: agent-as-first-class-identity se esta convirtiendo en el baseline asumido. La rama legislativa no se ha movido en la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang zero-trust-for-AI-agents framing ng Cloud Security Alliance at ang Okta for AI Agents Apr 30 GA na may Agent Discovery + virtual MCP server registry + credential vaulting + universal logout ay nagpapalawak ng structural force na pinapangalanan ng hula: ang agent-as-first-class-identity ay nagiging assumed baseline. Ang legislative branch ay hindi gumalaw sa window.

bridges.text: Okta's imminent GA stabilizes the reference implementation the prediction expects a state statute to cite, while the broader zero-trust-for-agents consensus keeps the underlying-cause pressure on legislators visible — the cause side is loading even though the legislative artefact is still ahead.

text_locales.en: Okta's imminent GA stabilizes the reference implementation the prediction expects a state statute to cite, while the broader zero-trust-for-agents consensus keeps the underlying-cause pressure on legislators visible — the cause side is loading even though the legislative artefact is still ahead.
text_locales.ja: Okta の差し迫った GA は、予測が州法令が引用すると見込むリファレンス実装を安定化させ、より広いゼロトラスト for エージェントの合意が立法者への根底原因の圧力を可視に保つ — 原因側はロードしているが、立法アーティファクトはまだ先だ。
text_locales.es: El inminente GA de Okta estabiliza la implementación de referencia que la predicción espera que un estatuto estatal cite, mientras el consenso más amplio zero-trust-for-agents mantiene visible la presión de causa subyacente sobre los legisladores — el lado de causa se está cargando aunque el artefacto legislativo aún esté por delante.
text_locales.fil: Ang papalapit na GA ng Okta ay pinapatatag ang reference implementation na inaasahan ng prediction na ici-cite ng state statute, habang ang mas malawak na zero-trust-for-agents consensus ay pinapanatili ang underlying-cause pressure sa mga legislators na visible — naglo-load ang cause side kahit pa nasa unahan pa rin ang legislative artefact.

description.en: **Inference-server SSTI graduates from one-off CVE to OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry; CISA ships an "AI-Infra KEV" sub-catalog by Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **remains unpatched into Apr 28** (10+ days post-disclosure), with a public PoC and the same Jinja2-without-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` shape now flagged as a copy-paste class spanning vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent inference servers. Combined with the **Apr 27-28 Totolink CVE quad (7153/7154/7156/7202, all 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in CI/CD**, **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`**, and Google/Forcepoint's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise** with 10 in-the-wild payloads — pressure on NIST/CISA crystallizes. **By Q3 2026 CISA ships a dedicated "AI-Infra" KEV sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging on inference servers (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) and agentic-CI runtimes (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **推論サーバ SSTI が単発の CVE から OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 のエントリへ昇格する。CISA は Q3 2026 までに「AI インフラ KEV」サブカタログを出荷する。** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) は **4/28 時点で依然として未パッチ** (公表後 10 日以上)、公開 PoC が出回っており、`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` を伴わない同じ Jinja2 形状は今や vLLM、LMDeploy、隣接する推論サーバを横断するコピペ的クラスとしてフラグされている。**4/27-28 の Totolink CVE 4 連発 (7153 / 7154 / 7156 / 7202、いずれも 9.8)**、**Cisco ISE の認証なし RCE**、**CI/CD における simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE**、**Pillar による Antigravity の `find_by_name -X` 経由のサンドボックス エスケープ**、そして Google / Forcepoint の **野生における間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 前年比増** と 10 件の野生のペイロードが組み合わさり — NIST / CISA への圧力が結晶化する。**Q3 2026 までに CISA は専用の「AI インフラ」KEV サブカタログを出荷する**。推論サーバ (vLLM / SGLang / Ollama / llama.cpp / LMDeploy) とエージェンティック CI ランタイム (Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / OpenClaw) に対する SBOM タグ付けが必須化される。OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 は「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」をトップ 3 へ格上げする。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El SSTI de inference-server pasa de CVE puntual a entrada del OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026; CISA publica un sub-catálogo "AI-Infra KEV" para Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **permanece sin parchear hasta el 28 de abril** (más de 10 días después de la divulgación), con un PoC público y la misma forma de Jinja2-sin-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` ahora marcada como una clase de copy-paste que abarca vLLM, LMDeploy, y servidores de inferencia adyacentes. Combinado con el **cuádruple Totolink CVE del 27-28 de abril (7153/7154/7156/7202, todos 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en CI/CD**, **escape de sandbox de Pillar's Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`**, y el aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecta de Google/Forcepoint con 10 payloads in-the-wild — la presión sobre NIST/CISA cristaliza. **Para Q3 2026 CISA publica un sub-catálogo "AI-Infra" KEV dedicado** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio en servidores de inferencia (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) y runtimes agentic-CI (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 promueve "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" al top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang inference-server SSTI ay magta-graduate mula one-off CVE patungo sa OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry; magpapadala ang CISA ng "AI-Infra KEV" sub-catalog pagsapit ng Q3 2026.** Ang SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) ay **nananatiling unpatched hanggang Apr 28** (10+ araw post-disclosure), na may pampublikong PoC at ang parehong Jinja2-without-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` shape na ngayon ay nakaflag bilang copy-paste class na sumasaklaw sa vLLM, LMDeploy, at mga karatig na inference servers. Pinagsama sa **Apr 27-28 Totolink CVE quad (7153/7154/7156/7202, lahat 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE sa CI/CD**, **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape sa pamamagitan ng `find_by_name -X`**, at ang **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise** ng Google/Forcepoint na may 10 in-the-wild payloads — ang pressure sa NIST/CISA ay nagkri-crystallize. **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, magpapadala ang CISA ng dedikadong "AI-Infra" KEV sub-catalog** na may mandatory SBOM tagging sa inference servers (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) at agentic-CI runtimes (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). Ina-promote ng OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 ang "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" sa top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

bridges.text: CISA adding CVE-2026-42271 in LiteLLM's MCP endpoints to its KEV catalog with a federal remediation deadline puts the AI-inference-broker tier squarely inside federal cyber governance, the substrate this sub-catalog anticipates. It moves toward the expected outcome, but remains a single per-CVE listing rather than a carved-out, named AI-Infra catalog carrying a mandatory inference-server SBOM requirement.

text_locales.en: CISA adding CVE-2026-42271 in LiteLLM's MCP endpoints to its KEV catalog with a federal remediation deadline puts the AI-inference-broker tier squarely inside federal cyber governance, the substrate this sub-catalog anticipates. It moves toward the expected outcome, but remains a single per-CVE listing rather than a carved-out, named AI-Infra catalog carrying a mandatory inference-server SBOM requirement.
text_locales.ja: CISAがLiteLLMのMCPエンドポイントにあるCVE-2026-42271を連邦の修正期限付きでKEVカタログに追加したことで、AI推論ブローカー層が連邦のサイバーガバナンスの内側に明確に組み込まれた。これはこのサブカタログが想定する土台である。想定される帰結に向けて前進しているものの、推論サーバーのSBOMを必須とする独立した名前付きのAI-Infraカタログではなく、なおCVE単位の個別掲載にとどまっている。
text_locales.es: Que CISA añada CVE-2026-42271, en los endpoints MCP de LiteLLM, a su catálogo KEV con un plazo federal de remediación sitúa de lleno el nivel del intermediario de inferencia de IA dentro de la gobernanza cibernética federal, el sustrato que este subcatálogo anticipa. Avanza hacia el resultado esperado, pero sigue siendo una única inclusión por CVE en lugar de un catálogo de AI-Infra delimitado y nombrado que imponga un requisito obligatorio de SBOM para servidores de inferencia.
text_locales.fil: Sa pagdaragdag ng CISA ng CVE-2026-42271 sa MCP endpoints ng LiteLLM sa KEV catalog nito na may federal remediation deadline, direktang inilalagay nito ang AI-inference-broker tier sa loob ng federal cyber governance, ang batayang inaasahan ng sub-catalog na ito. Lumalapit ito sa inaasahang resulta, ngunit nananatiling isang per-CVE listing sa halip na isang hiwalay at pinangalanang AI-Infra catalog na may sapilitang inference-server SBOM requirement.

bridges.text: The May 5 NVD-confirmed SGLang CVE-2026-5760 fix closes the longest-running 2026 LLM-tooling RCE, but the supply-chain GGUF vector and ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (roughly half unauthenticated) plus a 31-69% YoY AI-CVE forecast keep the inference-server / template-loader threat-class warm enough to merit a dedicated KEV sub-catalog with SBOM coverage.

text_locales.en: The May 5 NVD-confirmed SGLang CVE-2026-5760 fix closes the longest-running 2026 LLM-tooling RCE, but the supply-chain GGUF vector and ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (roughly half unauthenticated) plus a 31-69% YoY AI-CVE forecast keep the inference-server / template-loader threat-class warm enough to merit a dedicated KEV sub-catalog with SBOM coverage.
text_locales.ja: 5月5日のNVD確認のSGLang CVE-2026-5760修正は、最長稼働の2026年LLMツーリングRCEを閉じるが、サプライチェーンGGUFベクトル、約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバー(およそ半数が未認証)、+31〜69% YoYのAI-CVE予測が、推論サーバー / テンプレートローダー脅威クラスをSBOMカバレッジを伴う専用KEVサブカタログに値するほど温存している。
text_locales.es: El fix de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 confirmado por NVD del 5 de mayo cierra el RCE LLM-tooling más largo corriendo de 2026, pero el vector GGUF de cadena de suministro y los ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (aproximadamente la mitad sin autenticación) más un pronóstico AI-CVE de 31-69% YoY mantienen la clase de amenaza servidor-de-inferencia / cargador-de-plantillas suficientemente caliente como para merecer un sub-catálogo KEV dedicado con cobertura SBOM.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 5 NVD-confirmed SGLang CVE-2026-5760 fix ay nagsasara sa pinakamatagal na 2026 LLM-tooling RCE, ngunit ang supply-chain GGUF vector at ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (humigit-kumulang kalahati ay walang authentication) plus ang 31-69% YoY AI-CVE forecast ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang inference-server / template-loader threat-class na sapat upang maging karapat-dapat sa dedicated KEV sub-catalog na may SBOM coverage.

bridges.text: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 staying unpatched at the 15-day mark plus the operative reference treatment in the Stellar Cyber survey reinforces the precondition that inference-server template / loader RCEs deserve a top-3 OWASP slot; the prediction's force holds even without a fresh OWASP or CISA announcement.

text_locales.en: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 staying unpatched at the 15-day mark plus the operative reference treatment in the Stellar Cyber survey reinforces the precondition that inference-server template / loader RCEs deserve a top-3 OWASP slot; the prediction's force holds even without a fresh OWASP or CISA announcement.
text_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760が15日マークで未パッチのまま留まること + Stellar Cyber調査での運用上の参照扱いが、推論サーバー・テンプレート / ローダーRCEがOWASPトップ3スロットに値するという前提条件を強化している; 予測の力は、新たなOWASPまたはCISA発表がなくても保たれる。
text_locales.es: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 permaneciendo sin parchar a la marca de 15 días más el tratamiento de referencia operativo en la encuesta de Stellar Cyber refuerza la precondición de que las RCEs de plantilla / cargador de servidor de inferencia merecen un puesto top-3 en OWASP; la fuerza de la predicción se mantiene incluso sin un anuncio fresco de OWASP o CISA.
text_locales.fil: Ang SGLang CVE-2026-5760 na nananatiling unpatched sa 15-day mark plus ang operative reference treatment sa Stellar Cyber survey ay nagpapatibay sa precondition na ang inference-server template / loader RCEs ay karapat-dapat sa top-3 OWASP slot; ang force ng prediction ay nananatiling buo kahit walang sariwang OWASP o CISA announcement.

bridges.text: SGLang's 14-day unpatched runway, the May 1 Copy Fail KEV add, and CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority compose the same SSTI-plus-kernel chain the prediction described. The Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape now reads as a copy-paste class across vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent servers, which is the OWASP-promotion driver.

text_locales.en: SGLang's 14-day unpatched runway, the May 1 Copy Fail KEV add, and CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority compose the same SSTI-plus-kernel chain the prediction described. The Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape now reads as a copy-paste class across vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent servers, which is the OWASP-promotion driver.
text_locales.ja: SGLangの14日間未パッチランウェイ、5月1日のCopy Fail KEV追加、CSAIのMITRE-CNA権限が、予測が記述したのと同じSSTIプラスカーネルチェーンを構成する。Jinja2をImmutableSandboxedEnvironmentなしで使う形は、vLLM、LMDeploy、隣接サーバーをまたいだコピペクラスとして読まれ、これがOWASP昇格ドライバーだ。
text_locales.es: El runway de 14 días sin parchar de SGLang, el agregado al KEV de Copy Fail del 1 de mayo, y la autoridad MITRE-CNA de CSAI componen la misma cadena SSTI-más-kernel que la predicción describió. La forma Jinja2-sin-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment ahora se lee como una clase copy-paste a través de vLLM, LMDeploy, y servidores adyacentes, que es el driver de promoción OWASP.
text_locales.fil: Ang 14-day unpatched runway ng SGLang, ang May 1 Copy Fail KEV add, at ang MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI ay bumubuo ng parehong SSTI-plus-kernel chain na inilarawan ng prediction. Ang Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape ay nababasa na ngayon bilang copy-paste class sa kabuuan ng vLLM, LMDeploy, at adjacent servers, na siyang OWASP-promotion driver.

bridges.text: SGLang's unpatched-CVSS-9.8 status across 13 days plus the CSAI MITRE-CNA lane keep building the case for an inference-server-class catalogue without yet producing a separate CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalog.

text_locales.en: SGLang's unpatched-CVSS-9.8 status across 13 days plus the CSAI MITRE-CNA lane keep building the case for an inference-server-class catalogue without yet producing a separate CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalog.
text_locales.ja: SGLangの未パッチCVSS 9.8ステータスが13日間にわたり、加えてCSAI MITRE-CNAレーンが、別個のCISA AIインフラKEVサブカタログをまだ生み出していないものの、推論サーバークラスのカタログ事例を構築し続けている。
text_locales.es: El estado sin parchear con CVSS 9.8 de SGLang durante 13 días más el carril MITRE-CNA de CSAI siguen construyendo el caso para un catálogo de clase de servidor de inferencia sin producir todavía un sub-catálogo separado de AI-Infra KEV de CISA.
text_locales.fil: Ang unpatched-CVSS-9.8 status ng SGLang sa loob ng 13 araw kasama ang CSAI MITRE-CNA lane ay patuloy na nagpapatibay sa kaso para sa inference-server-class catalogue nang hindi pa nakapagpoproduce ng separate CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalog.

bridges.text: LiteLLM's pre-auth SQLi is the cleanest extension yet of the Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI shape SGLang exposed, applied at the gateway tier with multi-vendor key blast radius. The CVE telemetry is converging exactly where the prediction said, but the OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry and CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalogue are still upstream of the Q3 2026 deadline.

text_locales.en: LiteLLM's pre-auth SQLi is the cleanest extension yet of the Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI shape SGLang exposed, applied at the gateway tier with multi-vendor key blast radius. The CVE telemetry is converging exactly where the prediction said, but the OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry and CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalogue are still upstream of the Q3 2026 deadline.
text_locales.ja: LiteLLMの事前認証SQLiは、SGLangが露呈したJinja2 without ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI形状の最もクリーンな拡張であり、マルチベンダーキーブラスト半径でゲートウェイ層に適用されている。CVEテレメトリは予測が述べた通りに収束しているが、OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026エントリーとCISA AI-Infra KEVサブカタログは依然として2026年Q3期限の上流にある。
text_locales.es: El SQLi pre-auth de LiteLLM es la extensión más limpia hasta ahora de la forma SSTI Jinja2-sin-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment que SGLang expuso, aplicada al tier gateway con blast radius de claves multi-vendor. La telemetría de CVE está convergiendo exactamente donde la predicción dijo, pero la entrada OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 y el sub-catálogo CISA AI-Infra KEV todavía están upstream del deadline Q3 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang pre-auth SQLi ng LiteLLM ay ang pinaka-malinis na extension hanggang ngayon ng Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI shape na inilantad ng SGLang, na inilapat sa gateway tier na may multi-vendor key blast radius. Ang CVE telemetry ay nagko-converge eksaktong kung saan sinabi ng prediction, ngunit ang OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry at CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalogue ay nasa upstream pa rin ng Q3 2026 deadline.

bridges.text: The Spring AI CVE is the cleanest extension yet of the same Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI shape SGLang exposed, but the OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry and CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalogue have not yet shipped. The CVE telemetry is converging exactly where the prediction said; the regulatory codification is one step out.

text_locales.en: The Spring AI CVE is the cleanest extension yet of the same Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI shape SGLang exposed, but the OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry and CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalogue have not yet shipped. The CVE telemetry is converging exactly where the prediction said; the regulatory codification is one step out.
text_locales.ja: Spring AI CVEはSGLangが露呈した同じJinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI形のこれまで最も明確な拡張だが、OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026エントリとCISA AI-Infra KEVサブカタログはまだ出荷されていない。CVEテレメトリは予測どおりの場所で収束しているが、規制的法典化は1ステップ先である。
text_locales.es: El CVE de Spring AI es la extensión más limpia hasta ahora de la misma forma SSTI Jinja2-sin-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment que expuso SGLang, pero la entrada de OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 y el sub-catálogo CISA AI-Infra KEV aún no se han enviado. La telemetría de CVE está convergiendo exactamente donde dijo la predicción; la codificación regulatoria está un paso fuera.
text_locales.fil: Ang Spring AI CVE ay ang pinakamalinaw na extension hanggang ngayon ng parehong Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI shape na inilantad ng SGLang, ngunit ang OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry at CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalogue ay hindi pa nagpapadala. Ang CVE telemetry ay nagsasama-sama eksakto kung saan sinabi ng prediction; ang regulatory codification ay isang hakbang pa.

bridges.text: SGLang's 10+ day unpatched window with shipping-exploitable v0.5.10, the cross-server SSTI copy-paste class spanning vLLM and LMDeploy, and Apr 28's CISA KEV adds plus the Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster directly extend the precondition the prediction names. The pressure on NIST / CISA is building exactly along the inference-server SSTI axis the prediction projects.

text_locales.en: SGLang's 10+ day unpatched window with shipping-exploitable v0.5.10, the cross-server SSTI copy-paste class spanning vLLM and LMDeploy, and Apr 28's CISA KEV adds plus the Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster directly extend the precondition the prediction names. The pressure on NIST / CISA is building exactly along the inference-server SSTI axis the prediction projects.
text_locales.ja: SGLangの10日以上の未パッチ・ウィンドウ(悪用可能v0.5.10を出荷)、vLLMとLMDeployにまたがるクロスサーバーSSTIコピペ・クラス、4月28日のCISA KEV追加、Milesight + Totolink 9.8クラスタが、予測が指摘する前提条件を直接拡大する。NIST / CISAへの圧力は、予測が投影する推論サーバーSSTI軸に沿ってまさに構築されている。
text_locales.es: La ventana de 10+ dias sin parchear de SGLang con v0.5.10 explotable enviada, la clase SSTI cross-server copy-paste spanning vLLM y LMDeploy, y los KEV adds del 28 de abril de CISA mas el cluster Milesight + Totolink 9.8 extienden directamente la precondicion que la prediccion nombra. La presion sobre NIST / CISA esta construyendose exactamente a lo largo del eje SSTI de inference-server que la prediccion proyecta.
text_locales.fil: Ang 10+ araw unpatched window ng SGLang kasama ang shipping-exploitable v0.5.10, ang cross-server SSTI copy-paste class na sumasaklaw sa vLLM at LMDeploy, at ang Apr 28 CISA KEV adds kasama ang Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster ay direktang nagpapalawak sa precondition na pinapangalanan ng hula. Ang pressure sa NIST / CISA ay nabubuo nang eksakto sa inference-server SSTI axis na ipino-project ng hula.

detail.description: **Inference-server SSTI graduates from one-off CVE to OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry; CISA ships an "AI-Infra KEV" sub-catalog by Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **remains unpatched into Apr 28** (10+ days post-disclosure), with a public PoC and the same Jinja2-without-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` shape now flagged as a copy-paste class spanning vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent inference servers. Combined with the **Apr 27-28 Totolink CVE quad (7153/7154/7156/7202, all 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in CI/CD**, **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`**, and Google/Forcepoint's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise** with 10 in-the-wild payloads — pressure on NIST/CISA crystallizes. **By Q3 2026 CISA ships a dedicated "AI-Infra" KEV sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging on inference servers (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) and agentic-CI runtimes (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.es: **El SSTI de inference-server pasa de CVE puntual a entrada del OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026; CISA publica un sub-catálogo "AI-Infra KEV" para Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **permanece sin parchear hasta el 28 de abril** (más de 10 días después de la divulgación), con un PoC público y la misma forma de Jinja2-sin-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` ahora marcada como una clase de copy-paste que abarca vLLM, LMDeploy, y servidores de inferencia adyacentes. Combinado con el **cuádruple Totolink CVE del 27-28 de abril (7153/7154/7156/7202, todos 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en CI/CD**, **escape de sandbox de Pillar's Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`**, y el aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecta de Google/Forcepoint con 10 payloads in-the-wild — la presión sobre NIST/CISA cristaliza. **Para Q3 2026 CISA publica un sub-catálogo "AI-Infra" KEV dedicado** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio en servidores de inferencia (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) y runtimes agentic-CI (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). With Corpus2Skill making **"skills as a navigable artifact"** mainstream and the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) calling skills/harness/protocol the dominant 2026 design layer, the attack surface is now **first-class infrastructure**, not a side-channel. By H2 2026 we see (a) a published agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style or NIST-led) covering skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, and (b) at least one major marketplace mandating signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish — with Anthropic's 17-skill repo, ClawHub, Multica's marketplace, and Hugging Face's agent-trace surface as the first candidates. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年H2までに、エージェント・スキルの攻撃面が独自のMITRE-ATT&CK様式のサブマトリクスを獲得し、少なくとも1つの主要スキル・マーケットプレイス(Anthropicの公式スキル、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Faceスキル/エージェント・トレース)が強制署名+来歴ゲートを出荷する。** ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるClawHubスキル + Ciscoの**OpenClawスキル・マーケットプレイス全体での36%のプロンプト・インジェクション率**は、もはや単発ではない — 4月28日のNovita Sandboxは、OpenClaw + Hermes + 自律エージェント・ランタイム向けに構築された最初の商用緩和製品だ。Corpus2Skillが**「ナビゲート可能な成果物としてのスキル」**を主流化し、Externalization-in-LLM-Agentsサーベイ(arxiv 2604.08224)がスキル/ハーネス/プロトコルを2026年の支配的な設計レイヤーと呼ぶことで、攻撃面は今や**サイドチャネルではなくファーストクラスのインフラ**となった。2026年H2までに、(a) スキル・ポイズニング + スキル経由の間接プロンプト・インジェクション + クロススキル特権チェーンをカバーする公開エージェント・スキル脅威マトリクス(MITRE様式またはNIST主導)、および (b) 公開前に署名済みかつ来歴認証済みのスキルを義務付ける少なくとも1つの主要マーケットプレイス — Anthropicの17スキル・リポジトリ、ClawHub、Multicaのマーケットプレイス、Hugging Faceのエージェント・トレース面が最初の候補となる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el H2 2026 la superficie de ataque de agent-skills aterriza su propia sub-matriz estilo MITRE-ATT&CK y al menos un mercado de skills importante (skills oficiales de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face / trazas de agente) envia una puerta de firma + procedencia obligatoria.** Las 1,184 skills maliciosas de ClawHub de ClawHavoc + el **36% de tasa de prompt-injection a traves del mercado de skills de OpenClaw** de Cisco ya no es algo aislado — el Novita Sandbox del 28 de abril es el primer producto comercial de mitigacion construido a proposito para runtimes OpenClaw + Hermes + agente-autonomo. Con Corpus2Skill haciendo mainstream **"skills como artefacto navegable"** y el survey Externalization-in-LLM-Agents (arxiv 2604.08224) llamando skills/harness/protocol la capa de diseno dominante de 2026, la superficie de ataque ahora es **infraestructura de primera clase**, no un canal lateral. Para el H2 2026 vemos (a) una matriz de amenazas de agent-skills publicada (estilo MITRE o liderada por NIST) cubriendo envenenamiento de skills + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cadenas de privilegio entre-skills, y (b) al menos un mercado importante mandando skills firmadas-y-con-procedencia-atestada antes de publicar — con el repo de 17-skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, el mercado de Multica, y la superficie de trazas de agente de Hugging Face como los primeros candidatos. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang agent-skills attack surface ay magkakaroon ng sariling MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix at kahit isang major skill marketplace (opisyal na skills ng Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ay maglalabas ng enforced signing + provenance gate.** Ang 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills ng ClawHavoc + ang **36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco sa kabuuan ng OpenClaw skill marketplace** ay hindi na one-off — ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox ang unang commercial mitigation product na purpose-built para sa OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. Sa Corpus2Skill na ginagawang **"skills bilang navigable artifact"** mainstream at ang Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) na tumatawag sa skills/harness/protocol bilang dominant 2026 design layer, ang attack surface ay ngayon **first-class infrastructure**, hindi side-channel. Pagsapit ng H2 2026, makikita natin ang (a) inilathalang agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style o NIST-led) na sumasaklaw sa skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, at (b) kahit isang major marketplace na nag-mamandato ng signed-and-provenance-attested skills bago mag-publish — kasama ang 17-skill repo ng Anthropic, ClawHub, marketplace ng Multica, at agent-trace surface ng Hugging Face bilang unang mga kandidato. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.es: El cluster del 4-6 de mayo de CVEs de n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy a través de abuso de webhook, RCE impulsada por prompt-injection y SSRF en motor de inferencia tensa la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción agent-skills threat sub-matrix (29 abr): el abuso de tool-calls de IA agéntica es ahora empíricamente distinguible entre vendors y plataformas. El trabajo de taxonomía sigue siendo el artefacto faltante.

Ang taxonomy work mismo ang natitirang missing artifact.

detail.description: **By H2 2026 the agent-skills attack surface lands its own MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ships an enforced signing + provenance gate.** ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills + Cisco's **36% prompt-injection rate across the OpenClaw skill marketplace** is no longer a one-off — Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. With Corpus2Skill making **"skills as a navigable artifact"** mainstream and the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) calling skills/harness/protocol the dominant 2026 design layer, the attack surface is now **first-class infrastructure**, not a side-channel. By H2 2026 we see (a) a published agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style or NIST-led) covering skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, and (b) at least one major marketplace mandating signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish — with Anthropic's 17-skill repo, ClawHub, Multica's marketplace, and Hugging Face's agent-trace surface as the first candidates. prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el H2 2026 la superficie de ataque de agent-skills aterriza su propia sub-matriz estilo MITRE-ATT&CK y al menos un mercado de skills importante (skills oficiales de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face / trazas de agente) envia una puerta de firma + procedencia obligatoria.** Las 1,184 skills maliciosas de ClawHub de ClawHavoc + el **36% de tasa de prompt-injection a traves del mercado de skills de OpenClaw** de Cisco ya no es algo aislado — el Novita Sandbox del 28 de abril es el primer producto comercial de mitigacion construido a proposito para runtimes OpenClaw + Hermes + agente-autonomo. Con Corpus2Skill haciendo mainstream **"skills como artefacto navegable"** y el survey Externalization-in-LLM-Agents (arxiv 2604.08224) llamando skills/harness/protocol la capa de diseno dominante de 2026, la superficie de ataque ahora es **infraestructura de primera clase**, no un canal lateral. Para el H2 2026 vemos (a) una matriz de amenazas de agent-skills publicada (estilo MITRE o liderada por NIST) cubriendo envenenamiento de skills + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cadenas de privilegio entre-skills, y (b) al menos un mercado importante mandando skills firmadas-y-con-procedencia-atestada antes de publicar — con el repo de 17-skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, el mercado de Multica, y la superficie de trazas de agente de Hugging Face como los primeros candidatos. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang agent-skills attack surface ay magkakaroon ng sariling MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix at kahit isang major skill marketplace (opisyal na skills ng Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ay maglalabas ng enforced signing + provenance gate.** Ang 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills ng ClawHavoc + ang **36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco sa kabuuan ng OpenClaw skill marketplace** ay hindi na one-off — ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox ang unang commercial mitigation product na purpose-built para sa OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. Sa Corpus2Skill na ginagawang **"skills bilang navigable artifact"** mainstream at ang Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) na tumatawag sa skills/harness/protocol bilang dominant 2026 design layer, ang attack surface ay ngayon **first-class infrastructure**, hindi side-channel. Pagsapit ng H2 2026, makikita natin ang (a) inilathalang agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style o NIST-led) na sumasaklaw sa skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, at (b) kahit isang major marketplace na nag-mamandato ng signed-and-provenance-attested skills bago mag-publish — kasama ang 17-skill repo ng Anthropic, ClawHub, marketplace ng Multica, at agent-trace surface ng Hugging Face bilang unang mga kandidato. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. **By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 + v5.4 framework already names AI-agent context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, and malicious agent deployment as techniques; Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes runtimes; Apr 28 SuiteCloud Agent Skills (Oracle NetSuite, SuiteConnect SF) is the first major non-foundation-lab vendor shipping skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the security frame; Apr 28 arxiv 2604.24026 (SSL representation for skills) + Apr 24 arxiv 2604.23374 NeuroTaint provide the academic scaffolding. description.en: By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. **By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 + v5.4 framework already names AI-agent context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, and malicious agent deployment as techniques; Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes runtimes; Apr 28 SuiteCloud Agent Skills (Oracle NetSuite, SuiteConnect SF) is the first major non-foundation-lab vendor shipping skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the security frame; Apr 28 arxiv 2604.24026 (SSL representation for skills) + Apr 24 arxiv 2604.23374 NeuroTaint provide the academic scaffolding. The forcing function is the Cisco RSAC 2026 36%-prompt-injection-rate finding + ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills + Apr 23-29 Google +32% IPI uptick; combined this is the same governance-gap arc that produced MITRE ATT&CK Mobile in 2017 and MITRE ATLAS in 2021. The first of these mandates likely originates from CISA / NIST or directly from the marketplace operators under enterprise-customer pressure rather than from a foundation lab.
description.ja: 2026年Q3までに、公開されたエージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクスがMITRE ATT&CKの第一級拡張またはNIST AI-RMFの付録として登場し、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic公式スキルリポジトリ、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Faceスキル)が公開前の署名+来歴認証ゲートを強制的に出荷する。2026年Q3までに、公開されたエージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクスがMITRE ATT&CKの第一級拡張またはNIST AI-RMFの付録として登場し、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic公式スキルリポジトリ、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Faceスキル)が公開前の署名+来歴認証ゲートを強制的に出荷する。2026年Q3までに、公開されたエージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクスがMITRE ATT&CKの第一級拡張またはNIST AI-RMFの付録として登場し、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic公式スキルリポジトリ、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Faceスキル)が公開前の署名+来歴認証ゲートを強制的に出荷する。**2026年Q3までに、公開されたエージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクスがMITRE ATT&CKの第一級拡張またはNIST AI-RMFの付録として登場し、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic公式スキルリポジトリ、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Faceスキル)が公開前の署名+来歴認証ゲートを強制的に出荷する。** 4月28日のATT&CK v19 + v5.4フレームワークは、AIエージェントのコンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出しの濫用、MCPサーバ侵害、悪意あるエージェントのデプロイをすでに技法として命名している。4月28日のNovita SandboxはOpenClaw + Hermesランタイム向けに設計された初の商用緩和製品である。4月28日のSuiteCloud Agent Skills(Oracle NetSuite、SuiteConnect SF)は、署名配布をセキュリティ枠組みとしてスキル・アズ・ア・プロダクトを出荷する初の主要な非基盤研究所ベンダーである。4月28日のarxiv 2604.24026(スキル向けSSL表現) + 4月24日のarxiv 2604.23374 NeuroTaintが学術的な土台を提供している。強制要因はCisco RSAC 2026の36%プロンプトインジェクション率の発見 + ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるスキル + 4月23-29日のGoogle +32%のIPI急増である。これらを組み合わせると、2017年のMITRE ATT&CK Mobileと2021年のMITRE ATLASを生み出したのと同じガバナンスギャップ弧となる。これらの義務化の最初のものは、基盤研究所からではなく、CISA / NIST、または企業顧客の圧力下にあるマーケットプレイス事業者から直接生まれる可能性が高い。

La función forzante es el hallazgo de Cisco RSAC 2026 de 36% de tasa de prompt-injection + los 1.184 skills maliciosos de ClawHavoc + el alza del +32% en IPI de Google del 23-29 abr; combinado, este es el mismo arco de brecha-de-gobernanza que produjo MITRE ATT&CK Mobile en 2017 y MITRE ATLAS en 2021. Es probable que el primero de estos mandatos se origine en CISA / NIST o directamente en los operadores de marketplace bajo presión de clientes empresariales en lugar de en un laboratorio de fundación. title_locales.fil: Agent-skills threat sub-matrix lalabas bilang MITRE/NIST extension pagsapit ng Q3 2026

detail.summary_short: ATT&CK v19's named techniques (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) plus ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills, Cisco's 36% prompt-injection rate, and a +32% IPI uptick force a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix and an enforced signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate by Q3 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named techniques (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) plus ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills, Cisco's 36% prompt-injection rate, and a +32% IPI uptick force a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix and an enforced signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名された技法(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出しの濫用、MCP侵害、悪意あるエージェントのデプロイ)に加え、ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるスキル、Ciscoの36%プロンプトインジェクション率、+32%のIPI急増が、2026年Q3までに公開されたエージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクスと強制的な署名+来歴認証マーケットプレイスゲートを強制する。
summary_short_locales.es: Las técnicas nombradas en ATT&CK v19 (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos) más los 1.184 skills maliciosos de ClawHavoc, la tasa del 36% de prompt-injection de Cisco y un alza del +32% en IPI fuerzan una sub-matriz publicada de amenazas de agent-skills y un gate obligatorio de firma + provenance en marketplaces para Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang mga pinangalanang technique ng ATT&CK v19 (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) kasama ang 1,184 malicious skills ng ClawHavoc, 36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco, at +32% IPI uptick ay pumipilit ng nailathalang agent-skills threat sub-matrix at ipinatutupad na signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: The May 7 wave — n8n KEV plus LangGraph SSRF (control-plane to cloud-metadata pivot) plus LiteLLM identity-impersonation plus MCP-server exposure telemetry plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — delivers ~5x the empirical corpus the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) baseline assumed, spanning webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, and identity-impersonation in 24 hours.

text_locales.en: The May 7 wave — n8n KEV plus LangGraph SSRF (control-plane to cloud-metadata pivot) plus LiteLLM identity-impersonation plus MCP-server exposure telemetry plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — delivers ~5x the empirical corpus the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) baseline assumed, spanning webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, and identity-impersonation in 24 hours.
text_locales.ja: 5月7日の波──n8n KEV、LangGraph SSRF(コントロールプレーンからクラウドメタデータへのピボット)、LiteLLMアイデンティティ偽装、MCPサーバー露出テレメトリ、Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP検出GA──は、エージェントスキルMITRE/NIST拡張予測(4月30日)のベースライン想定の約5倍の経験的コーパスを24時間以内に提供し、Webhook濫用、コントロールプレーンSSRF、アイデンティティ偽装に及んでいる。
text_locales.es: La oleada del 7 de mayo — n8n KEV más SSRF de LangGraph (pivote de plano de control a metadatos en la nube) más suplantación de identidad de LiteLLM más telemetría de exposición de servidor MCP más GA de detección MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud — entrega ~5x el corpus empírico que la base de la predicción de extensión MITRE/NIST de habilidades de agente (30 de abril) asumió, abarcando abuso de webhook, SSRF de plano de control y suplantación de identidad en 24 horas.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 7 wave — n8n KEV kasama ang LangGraph SSRF (control-plane sa cloud-metadata pivot) kasama ang LiteLLM identity-impersonation kasama ang MCP-server exposure telemetry kasama ang Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — ay nagdedeliver ng ~5x ng empirical corpus na inakala ng agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Abr 30) baseline, sumasaklaw sa webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, at identity-impersonation sa loob ng 24 oras.

bridges.text: The n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus the standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline tighten the structural force the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) names: the LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus is now ~5x richer than the prediction baseline assumed, hardening the empirical case for a curated standards-body extension.

text_locales.en: The n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus the standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline tighten the structural force the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) names: the LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus is now ~5x richer than the prediction baseline assumed, hardening the empirical case for a curated standards-body extension.
text_locales.ja: n8n + Flowise + LMDeployのCVEウェーブと、標準のSGLang jinja2 SSTIベースラインは、エージェントスキルMITRE/NIST拡張予測(4月30日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する: LLMプラットフォーム固有の攻撃パターン・コーパスは、予測のベースラインが想定したよりも約5倍リッチであり、キュレートされた標準化団体拡張への経験的ケースを硬化させている。
text_locales.es: La ola de CVEs n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy más la línea base estándar SGLang jinja2 SSTI tensan la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción de extensión agent-skills MITRE/NIST (30 abr): el corpus de patrones de ataque específicos de plataforma LLM es ~5x más rico de lo que asumió la línea base, endureciendo el caso empírico para una extensión curada de cuerpo de estándares.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus ang standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Abr 30): ang LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus ay ~5x richer kaysa sa inakala ng prediction baseline, na nagpapatibay ng empirical case para sa curated standards-body extension.

bridges.text: The RSAC-week enterprise-platform convergence keeps the doctrine side warm but does not advance the specific MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix the prediction names; the marketplace-signing-gate side stays quiet today.

text_locales.en: The RSAC-week enterprise-platform convergence keeps the doctrine side warm but does not advance the specific MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix the prediction names; the marketplace-signing-gate side stays quiet today.
text_locales.ja: RSACウィークのエンタープライズ・プラットフォーム収斂はドクトリン側を温存するが、予測が指摘する具体的なMITRE ATT&CK拡張やNIST AI-RMF付録を前進させない; マーケットプレイス署名ゲート側は本日も静かなままである。
text_locales.es: La convergencia de plataforma empresarial durante la semana RSAC mantiene caliente el lado doctrina pero no avanza la extensión MITRE ATT&CK específica o el apéndice NIST AI-RMF que la predicción nombra; el lado de puerta de firma de marketplace permanece silencioso hoy.
text_locales.fil: Ang RSAC-week enterprise-platform convergence ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang doctrine side ngunit hindi sumusulong sa specific MITRE ATT&CK extension o NIST AI-RMF appendix na pinangalanan ng prediction; ang marketplace-signing-gate side ay nananatiling tahimik ngayon.

bridges.text: ATT&CK v19's named techniques, CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority, and Microsoft Agent 365's tools-management allow/block primitive supply the regulatory and marketplace levers the prediction's structural force assumes. SAGE and LiveClawBench add the eval substrate that a published sub-matrix can reference.

text_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named techniques, CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority, and Microsoft Agent 365's tools-management allow/block primitive supply the regulatory and marketplace levers the prediction's structural force assumes. SAGE and LiveClawBench add the eval substrate that a published sub-matrix can reference.
text_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名済み手法、CSAIのMITRE-CNA権限、Microsoft Agent 365のツール管理許可/ブロックプリミティブが、予測の構造的力が想定する規制とマーケットプレイスのレバーを供給する。SAGEとLiveClawBenchが、公開サブマトリクスが参照できる評価基盤を加える。
text_locales.es: Las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19, la autoridad MITRE-CNA de CSAI, y la primitiva allow/block de gestión de herramientas de Microsoft Agent 365 suministran las palancas regulatorias y de marketplace que asume la fuerza estructural de la predicción. SAGE y LiveClawBench añaden el sustrato de evaluación al que una sub-matriz publicada puede referirse.
text_locales.fil: Ang named techniques ng ATT&CK v19, ang MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI, at ang tools-management allow/block primitive ng Microsoft Agent 365 ay nagbibigay ng regulatory at marketplace levers na ipinapalagay ng structural force ng prediction. Ang SAGE at LiveClawBench ay nagdaragdag ng eval substrate na maaaring sangguniin ng inilathalang sub-matrix.

bridges.text: ATT&CK v19's published technique names, the CSAI MITRE-CNA lane, and Agent 365's tenant-level enforcement primitive line up with the precondition arc that should make a sub-matrix appendix and a publish-time signing gate inevitable inside Q3.

text_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's published technique names, the CSAI MITRE-CNA lane, and Agent 365's tenant-level enforcement primitive line up with the precondition arc that should make a sub-matrix appendix and a publish-time signing gate inevitable inside Q3.
text_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の公開されたテクニック名、CSAI MITRE-CNAレーン、Agent 365のテナントレベル強制プリミティブが、Q3内でサブマトリックス付録と公開時署名ゲートを必然にする前提条件アークと整合する。
text_locales.es: Los nombres de técnicas publicados de ATT&CK v19, el carril MITRE-CNA de CSAI, y la primitiva de aplicación a nivel de inquilino de Agent 365 se alinean con el arco de precondiciones que debería hacer inevitable un apéndice de sub-matriz y una puerta de firma en tiempo de publicación dentro del Q3.
text_locales.fil: Ang nailathalang technique names ng ATT&CK v19, ang CSAI MITRE-CNA lane, at ang tenant-level enforcement primitive ng Agent 365 ay nakahanay sa precondition arc na dapat gawing inevitable sa loob ng Q3 ang sub-matrix appendix at publish-time signing gate.

bridges.text: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization is the cleanest possible institutional precursor to the prediction's ATT&CK-extension / AI-RMF-appendix thesis, with ATT&CK v19's named-techniques wave already populating the technique slots. The forecast and yesterday's evidence are functionally one-day apart and converging. The marketplace-signing-gate half remains the open leg.

text_locales.en: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization is the cleanest possible institutional precursor to the prediction's ATT&CK-extension / AI-RMF-appendix thesis, with ATT&CK v19's named-techniques wave already populating the technique slots. The forecast and yesterday's evidence are functionally one-day apart and converging. The marketplace-signing-gate half remains the open leg.
text_locales.ja: CSAIのMITRE-CNA認定は、予測のATT&CK拡張 / AI-RMF付録テーゼに対する最もクリーンな制度的前駆体であり、ATT&CK v19の命名技法の波はすでに技法スロットを埋めている。予測と昨日の証拠は機能的に1日離れて収束している。マーケットプレイス署名ゲートの後半は依然として開いた脚である。
text_locales.es: La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI es el precursor institucional más limpio posible a la tesis de extensión-de-ATT&CK / apéndice-de-AI-RMF de la predicción, con la ola de técnicas-nombradas de ATT&CK v19 ya poblando los slots de técnicas. El forecast y la evidencia de ayer están funcionalmente a un día de distancia y convergiendo. La mitad del marketplace-signing-gate permanece como el leg abierto.
text_locales.fil: Ang MITRE-CNA authorization ng CSAI ay ang pinaka-malinis na posibleng institutional precursor sa ATT&CK-extension / AI-RMF-appendix thesis ng prediction, na may named-techniques wave ng ATT&CK v19 na nagpu-populate na ng technique slots. Ang forecast at evidence ng kahapon ay functionally one-day apart at nagko-converge. Ang marketplace-signing-gate kalahati ay nananatiling bukas na leg.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish. **By Q3 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix lands as a first-class MITRE ATT&CK extension or NIST AI-RMF appendix, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills repo, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships an enforced signed + provenance-attested gate before publish.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 + v5.4 framework already names AI-agent context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, and malicious agent deployment as techniques; Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes runtimes; Apr 28 SuiteCloud Agent Skills (Oracle NetSuite, SuiteConnect SF) is the first major non-foundation-lab vendor shipping skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the security frame; Apr 28 arxiv 2604.24026 (SSL representation for skills) + Apr 24 arxiv 2604.23374 NeuroTaint provide the academic scaffolding. The forcing function is the Cisco RSAC 2026 36%-prompt-injection-rate finding + ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills + Apr 23-29 Google +32% IPI uptick; combined this is the same governance-gap arc that produced MITRE ATT&CK Mobile in 2017 and MITRE ATLAS in 2021. The first of these mandates likely originates from CISA / NIST or directly from the marketplace operators under enterprise-customer pressure rather than from a foundation lab.

nodes.description: Cisco's May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition makes non-human-identity (NHI) governance an explicit M&A-tier primitive on the same week as Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU with per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) and the May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting that names identity as Zero Trust's first pillar in the agentic-AI era. The structural backdrop is severe: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers as of early 2026 with roughly half operating with no authorization controls, AI agents and other non-human identities now outnumber human users ~100:1 in major enterprises (per Cisco's customer survey), and MCP itself ships with no built-in identity, no least-privilege enforcement, and no audit trail. Cisco's planned integration of Astrix into Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converges with Microsoft's per-agent identity model into a de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — but the procurement tier above (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) requires a published-standard reference, not a vendor-specific architecture diagram. By Q4 2026 NIST is expected to publish a dedicated NHI control profile (most likely as a SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement or an SP 800-53 control-family overlay) treating machine identities, agent identities, and service-account identities as a distinct compliance category with discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, and audit-trail control families. CISA agentic-AI guidance and SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary follow within one quarter via the same forcing function — the $400M Astrix M&A price tag is itself a regulator-readable signal that the category has crossed into balance-sheet materiality.

By Q4 2026 NIST is expected to publish a dedicated NHI control profile (most likely as a SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement or an SP 800-53 control-family overlay) treating machine identities, agent identities, and service-account identities as a distinct compliance category with discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, and audit-trail control families.
