description.ja: 5月4日のCiscoによる$400MのAstrix Security買収は、5月1日のMicrosoft Agent 365 GA($15/ユーザー/月のM365 E7 SKU、エージェント単位のDefenderリレーションシップマップ + Entra ID + Purview + Intune)、そしてエージェントAI時代のZero Trust第一の柱としてアイデンティティを名指しした5月1日のCloud Security Alliance投稿と同じ週に、非人間アイデンティティ(NHI)ガバナンスを明示的なM&A階層のプリミティブにする。構造的な背景は深刻だ: 2026年初頭時点で約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーがあり、その約半数が認可コントロールなしで稼働、AIエージェントその他の非人間アイデンティティが大手企業内で人間ユーザーを約100:1で上回る(Ciscoの顧客調査)、そしてMCP自体は組み込みアイデンティティ、最小権限、監査証跡を一切備えていない。CiscoによるAstrixのCisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAMへの統合計画は、Microsoftのエージェント単位アイデンティティ・モデルと収斂してデファクトの2ベンダーNHIコントロール・プレーン・プリミティブを形成する — しかしその上の調達階層(連邦CISOオフィス、銀行規制当局、HIPAAスコープのヘルスケア・バイヤー)は、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図ではなく公表標準のリファレンスを要求する。2026年Q4までに、NISTは専用のNHIコントロール・プロファイルを公表することが期待される(SP 800-207系のZero Trust補遺、もしくはSP 800-53コントロール・ファミリー・オーバーレイの形が最有力)。マシン・アイデンティティ、エージェント・アイデンティティ、サービス・アカウント・アイデンティティを、発見、ライフサイクル、最小権限、監査証跡のコントロール・ファミリーを伴う独立したコンプライアンス・カテゴリとして扱う。CISAのエージェントAIガイダンスとSECのサイバー開示ルール・コメンタリーは同じ強制関数で1四半期以内に追随する — $400MのAstrix M&A価格自体が、カテゴリがバランスシート重要性に達したことを示す規制当局可読のシグナルである。
description.es: La adquisición del 4 de mayo de Astrix Security por $400M de Cisco hace de la gobernanza de identidad no-humana (NHI) un primitivo explícito de nivel M&A en la misma semana que la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 (1 de mayo, SKU M365 E7 a $15/user/mo con mapa de relaciones por agente de Defender + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) y la publicación del 1 de mayo de Cloud Security Alliance que nombra a la identidad como el primer pilar de Zero Trust en la era de la IA agéntica. El telón de fondo estructural es severo: ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet a comienzos de 2026 con aproximadamente la mitad operando sin controles de autorización, los agentes de IA y otras identidades no-humanas ahora superan en número a los usuarios humanos ~100:1 en empresas grandes (según la encuesta de clientes de Cisco), y MCP mismo se entrega sin identidad incorporada, sin aplicación de mínimo privilegio y sin pista de auditoría. La integración planeada de Astrix por Cisco en Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converge con el modelo de identidad por agente de Microsoft hacia un primitivo de plano de control de NHI de facto de dos vendors — pero el nivel de adquisición superior (oficinas federales de CISO, reguladores bancarios, compradores con alcance HIPAA en salud) requiere una referencia de estándar publicado, no un diagrama de arquitectura específico de vendor. Para Q4 2026 se espera que NIST publique un perfil de control de NHI dedicado (más probablemente como un suplemento de la serie SP 800-207 de Zero Trust o una superposición de familia de controles de SP 800-53) tratando las identidades de máquina, identidades de agente e identidades de cuentas de servicio como una categoría de cumplimiento distinta con familias de controles de descubrimiento, ciclo de vida, mínimo privilegio y pista de auditoría. La guía de IA agéntica de CISA y el comentario de la regla de divulgación cibernética de la SEC siguen dentro de un trimestre vía la misma función forzante — el precio de M&A de Astrix de $400M es en sí mismo una señal legible para reguladores de que la categoría ha cruzado a materialidad de balance.
description.fil: Ang May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition ng Cisco ay ginagawang explicit M&A-tier primitive ang non-human-identity (NHI) governance sa parehong linggo ng Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU na may per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) at ng May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting na nagngangalan sa identity bilang unang pillar ng Zero Trust sa agentic-AI era. Malala ang structural backdrop: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers noong unang bahagi ng 2026 na halos kalahati ay tumatakbo nang walang authorization controls, ang AI agents at ibang non-human identities ay ngayon mas marami kaysa sa human users sa ratio na ~100:1 sa mga major enterprises (ayon sa Cisco customer survey), at ang MCP mismo ay nag-ship nang walang built-in identity, walang least-privilege enforcement, at walang audit trail. Ang planned integration ng Cisco ng Astrix sa Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM ay nag-co-converge sa per-agent identity model ng Microsoft papasok sa de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — ngunit ang procurement tier sa itaas (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) ay nangangailangan ng nailathalang-pamantayang reference, hindi vendor-specific architecture diagram. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, inaasahan na maglathala ang NIST ng nakatuong NHI control profile (pinakamalamang bilang SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement o SP 800-53 control-family overlay) na tinatrato ang machine identities, agent identities, at service-account identities bilang natatanging compliance category na may discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, at audit-trail control families. Susunod ang CISA agentic-AI guidance at SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary sa loob ng isang quarter sa pamamagitan ng parehong forcing function — ang $400M Astrix M&A price tag mismo ay regulator-readable signal na ang category ay tumawid na sa balance-sheet materiality.

plain_language.en: AI agents outnumber humans 100-to-1 inside companies and most have no security check — the US standards body will soon name them their own category.
plain_language.ja: AIエージェントが企業の中で人間より100倍多く、ほとんどがセキュリティ・チェックなしで動いている — 米国の標準化機関は近いうちに彼らを独自カテゴリとして扱うだろう。
plain_language.es: Los agentes de IA superan a los humanos 100 a 1 dentro de las empresas y la mayoría no tiene control de seguridad — el organismo de estándares de EE.UU. pronto los nombrará su propia categoría.
plain_language.fil: Ang AI agents ay 100-to-1 na mas marami kaysa sa tao sa loob ng mga kumpanya at karamihan ay walang security check — sa lalong madaling panahon, papangalanan sila ng US standards body bilang sariling kategorya.

bridges.text: Cross-vendor agentic-AI control-plane visibility crosses 85 percent of new MCP-server provisioning events Thursday with CrowdStrike Falcon adding Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry alongside Vertex; Sysdig holds the 5-minute credential-extraction median while Defender-protected tenants extend to 4.9 hours (59x gap); Wiz Defender-for-Cloud quarantine reaches 42 percent net-new — the demand pressure for a NIST non-human-identity control profile hardens.

text_locales.en: Cross-vendor agentic-AI control-plane visibility crosses 85 percent of new MCP-server provisioning events Thursday with CrowdStrike Falcon adding Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry alongside Vertex; Sysdig holds the 5-minute credential-extraction median while Defender-protected tenants extend to 4.9 hours (59x gap); Wiz Defender-for-Cloud quarantine reaches 42 percent net-new — the demand pressure for a NIST non-human-identity control profile hardens.
text_locales.ja: クロスベンダー・エージェンティックAIコントロール・プレーン可視性は木曜に新規MCPサーバー・プロビジョニング・イベントの85パーセントを突破し、CrowdStrike FalconがVertexと並んでAmazon Bedrock Agent Registryを追加;Sysdigは5分のクレデンシャル抽出中央値を維持する一方、Defender保護下テナントは4.9時間まで延長(59倍ギャップ);Wiz Defender for Cloud隔離は新規42パーセントに到達 — NIST非人間アイデンティティ・コントロール・プロファイルの需要圧力が硬化する。
text_locales.es: La visibilidad cross-vendor del plano de control de la IA agentic supera el 85 por ciento de los nuevos eventos de aprovisionamiento de servidores MCP el jueves, con CrowdStrike Falcon sumando Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry además de Vertex; Sysdig mantiene la mediana de 5 minutos para la extracción de credenciales mientras los tenants protegidos por Defender se extienden a 4,9 horas (brecha de 59x); la cuarentena de Wiz Defender for Cloud llega al 42 por ciento de los nuevos servidores; la presión de demanda por un perfil de control de identidades no humanas de NIST se endurece.
text_locales.fil: Tumawid ang cross-vendor agentic-AI control-plane visibility sa 85 porsyento ng mga bagong MCP-server provisioning events noong Huwebes kasabay ng pagdaragdag ng CrowdStrike Falcon sa Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry kasama ng Vertex; pinananatili ng Sysdig ang 5-minutong credential-extraction median habang ang Defender-protected tenants ay umaabot sa 4.9 oras (59x gap); umabot ang Wiz Defender-for-Cloud quarantine sa 42 porsyento net-new — pinatatatag ang demand pressure para sa NIST non-human-identity control profile.

bridges.text: Wednesday MCP-server telemetry sharpens the empirical baseline a non-human-identity profile would consolidate: Sysdig's unprotected median time-to-credential-extraction collapses to 5 minutes (50x gap versus the 4.2-hour Defender-protected median); Wiz quarantine reaches 39 percent; Cisco-Astrix tenancy crosses 1,720 with Akamai SkyAtlas at 720; CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI public preview lifts cross-vendor visibility to 81 percent.

text_locales.en: Wednesday MCP-server telemetry sharpens the empirical baseline a non-human-identity profile would consolidate: Sysdig's unprotected median time-to-credential-extraction collapses to 5 minutes (50x gap versus the 4.2-hour Defender-protected median); Wiz quarantine reaches 39 percent; Cisco-Astrix tenancy crosses 1,720 with Akamai SkyAtlas at 720; CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI public preview lifts cross-vendor visibility to 81 percent.
text_locales.ja: 水曜日のMCPサーバ・テレメトリは、非人間アイデンティティ・プロファイルが集約することになる経験的ベースラインをさらに鮮明化した。Sysdigの無防備環境における初回クレデンシャル抽出までの中央値は5分まで短縮し(Defender保護下の4.2時間との比較で50倍のギャップ)、Wizによる隔離率は39パーセントに到達。Cisco-Astrixの導入は1,720テナントを突破し、Akamai SkyAtlasは720テナントを記録。CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AIのパブリックプレビューはクロスベンダー可視性を81パーセントまで引き上げた。
text_locales.es: La telemetría del miércoles sobre servidores MCP afina la línea base empírica que un perfil de identidades no humanas consolidaría: la mediana de tiempo hasta la extracción de credenciales en entornos no protegidos de Sysdig cae a 5 minutos (brecha de 50x frente a la mediana de 4,2 horas en entornos protegidos por Defender); la cuarentena de Wiz alcanza el 39 por ciento; la adopción de Cisco-Astrix supera los 1.720 con Akamai SkyAtlas en 720; la vista previa pública de CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI eleva la visibilidad multi-proveedor al 81 por ciento.
text_locales.fil: Pinapatibay ng Miyerkules MCP-server telemetry ang empirical baseline na pagsasama-samahin ng non-human-identity profile: bumababa ang Sysdig's unprotected median time-to-credential-extraction sa 5 minuto (50x gap kumpara sa 4.2-hour Defender-protected median); umaabot ang Wiz quarantine sa 39 percent; tumatawid ang Cisco-Astrix tenancy sa 1,720 kasama ang Akamai SkyAtlas sa 720; nag-aangat ang CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI public preview ng cross-vendor visibility sa 81 percent.

bridges.text: Tuesday MCP-server telemetry sharpens the empirical baseline a non-human-identity profile would consolidate: Sysdig's unprotected median time-to-credential-extraction collapses to 5 minutes (50x gap versus the 4.2-hour Defender-protected median); Wiz quarantine reaches 36 percent; Cisco-Astrix tenancy crosses 1,470 with Akamai SkyAtlas at 720; CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI public preview lifts cross-vendor visibility to 74 percent.

text_locales.en: Tuesday MCP-server telemetry sharpens the empirical baseline a non-human-identity profile would consolidate: Sysdig's unprotected median time-to-credential-extraction collapses to 5 minutes (50x gap versus the 4.2-hour Defender-protected median); Wiz quarantine reaches 36 percent; Cisco-Astrix tenancy crosses 1,470 with Akamai SkyAtlas at 720; CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI public preview lifts cross-vendor visibility to 74 percent.
text_locales.ja: 火曜MCPサーバー・テレメトリは非人間アイデンティティ・プロファイルが統合するであろう経験的ベースラインを先鋭化:Sysdigの未保護クレデンシャル抽出までの中央値時間は5分に崩壊(4.2時間Defender保護中央値対比で50倍ギャップ);Wiz隔離は36パーセントに到達;Cisco-Astrixテナンシーは1,470を突破、Akamai SkyAtlasは720;CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AIパブリック・プレビューはクロスベンダー視認性を74パーセントに引き上げる。
text_locales.es: La telemetría del martes de servidor MCP afila el baseline empírico que un perfil de identidad no-humana consolidaría: la mediana desprotegida de Sysdig del tiempo-a-extracción-de-credenciales colapsa a 5 minutos (brecha 50x versus la mediana protegida por Defender de 4.2 horas); la cuarentena Wiz alcanza 36 por ciento; la tenancy Cisco-Astrix cruza 1,470 con Akamai SkyAtlas en 720; el preview público de CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI eleva la visibilidad cross-vendor al 74 por ciento.
text_locales.fil: Pinatatalas ng Tuesday MCP-server telemetry ang empirical baseline na ico-consolidate ng isang non-human-identity profile: bumabagsak ang unprotected median time-to-credential-extraction ng Sysdig sa 5 minuto (50x gap versus ang 4.2-hour Defender-protected median); umaabot ang Wiz quarantine sa 36 percent; tumatawid ang Cisco-Astrix tenancy sa 1,470 kasama ng Akamai SkyAtlas sa 720; inaangat ng CrowdStrike Falcon for Agentic AI public preview ang cross-vendor visibility sa 74 percent.

bridges.text: Monday MCP-server telemetry sharpens the empirical baseline a non-human-identity profile would consolidate: Sysdig's unprotected median time-to-credential-extraction collapses to 8 minutes versus 4 hours for Defender-protected tenants (30x gap); Defender quarantine climbs to 32 percent; Cisco-Astrix tenancy reaches 1,180 with Akamai SkyAtlas at 510; arxiv 2605.06298 supplies the citable sovereign-cloud composition-verification anchor.

text_locales.ja: 月曜のMCPサーバー・テレメトリは、非人間アイデンティティ・プロファイルが統合するであろう実証ベースラインを先鋭化する:Sysdigの保護されていない中央認証情報抽出時間は、Defender保護テナント向け4時間に対し8分に崩壊(30倍ギャップ);Defender隔離は32パーセントに上昇;Cisco-Astrixテナンシーは1,180に到達、Akamai SkyAtlasは510に;arxiv 2605.06298は引用可能な主権クラウド合成検証アンカーを供給する。
text_locales.es: La telemetría del lunes de servidor MCP afila el baseline empírico que un perfil de identidad no-humana consolidaría: la mediana desprotegida de Sysdig del tiempo-a-extracción-de-credenciales colapsa a 8 minutos versus 4 horas para tenants protegidos por Defender (brecha 30x); la cuarentena Defender sube a 32 por ciento; la tenancy Cisco-Astrix alcanza 1,180 con Akamai SkyAtlas en 510; arxiv 2605.06298 suministra el ancla citable de verificación-de-composición de cloud-soberana.
text_locales.fil: Hinahasa ng Monday MCP-server telemetry ang empirical baseline na ico-consolidate ng isang non-human-identity profile: nag-co-collapse ang Sysdig's unprotected median time-to-credential-extraction sa 8 minuto kontra sa 4 oras para sa Defender-protected tenants (30x gap); umaakyat ang Defender quarantine sa 32 percent; umaabot ang Cisco-Astrix tenancy sa 1,180 kasama ang Akamai SkyAtlas sa 510; nagbibigay ang arxiv 2605.06298 ng citable sovereign-cloud composition-verification anchor.

bridges.text: The citable scaffolding the NIST non-human-identity profile would consolidate hardens Sunday: arxiv 2605.06012 generalizes the May 9 attestation paper to multi-tenant compositional safety theorems with Microsoft added to MIT CSAIL plus ETH Zurich plus Anthropic authorship; Defender quarantine climbs to 28 percent; the Sysdig credential-extraction gap widens 23 percent; Cisco-Astrix tenancy hits 920 (+24 percent).

text_locales.en: The citable scaffolding the NIST non-human-identity profile would consolidate hardens Sunday: arxiv 2605.06012 generalizes the May 9 attestation paper to multi-tenant compositional safety theorems with Microsoft added to MIT CSAIL plus ETH Zurich plus Anthropic authorship; Defender quarantine climbs to 28 percent; the Sysdig credential-extraction gap widens 23 percent; Cisco-Astrix tenancy hits 920 (+24 percent).
text_locales.ja: NIST非人間アイデンティティ・プロファイルが統合する引用可能な足場が日曜に硬化する: arxiv 2605.06012は5月9日アテステーション論文をMicrosoftがMIT CSAILプラスETH ZurichプラスAnthropic著者陣に追加されたマルチテナント合成安全性定理へ一般化する;Defender隔離は28パーセントへ上昇する;Sysdig認証情報抽出ギャップは23パーセント拡大する;Cisco-Astrixテナンシーは920(+24パーセント)へ。
text_locales.es: El andamiaje citable que el perfil de identidad no-humana de NIST consolidaría se endurece el domingo: arxiv 2605.06012 generaliza el paper de atestación del 9 de mayo a teoremas de seguridad composicional multi-tenant con Microsoft añadido a la autoría MIT CSAIL más ETH Zurich más Anthropic; la cuarentena Defender sube a 28 por ciento; la brecha de extracción de credenciales de Sysdig se amplía 23 por ciento; la tenancy de Cisco-Astrix llega a 920 (+24 por ciento).
text_locales.fil: Tumitigas noong Linggo ang citable scaffolding na pagsasama-samahin ng NIST non-human-identity profile: nag-ge-generalize ang arxiv 2605.06012 sa Mayo 9 attestation paper papunta sa multi-tenant compositional safety theorems kasama ang Microsoft na idinagdag sa MIT CSAIL plus ETH Zurich plus Anthropic authorship; umaakyat ang Defender quarantine sa 28 porsiyento; lumalawak ang Sysdig credential-extraction gap ng 23 porsiyento; umaabot ang Cisco-Astrix tenancy sa 920 (+24 porsiyento).

bridges.text: The Saturday arxiv 2605.05933 (MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic) provides a citable formal-verification framework for per-tenant capability attestation; Defender quarantines climb to 24% of net-new MCP servers, Sysdig logs 19-minute median credential-extraction on unprotected estates, and the 41-enterprise gated cohort delivers exactly the cross-vendor empirical baseline a NIST profile would consolidate.

text_locales.en: The Saturday arxiv 2605.05933 (MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic) provides a citable formal-verification framework for per-tenant capability attestation; Defender quarantines climb to 24% of net-new MCP servers, Sysdig logs 19-minute median credential-extraction on unprotected estates, and the 41-enterprise gated cohort delivers exactly the cross-vendor empirical baseline a NIST profile would consolidate.
text_locales.ja: 土曜arxiv 2605.05933(MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic)はテナント単位能力アテステーションのための引用可能な形式検証フレームワークを提供;Defender隔離はネットニューMCPサーバーの24%へ上昇、Sysdigは保護されていないエステートで19分中央認証情報抽出をログ、41エンタープライズ・ゲーティング・コホートはNISTプロファイルが統合する正にクロスベンダー経験的ベースラインを提供する。
text_locales.es: El arxiv del sábado 2605.05933 (MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic) provee un marco citable de verificación formal para atestación de capacidad por tenant; las cuarentenas de Defender suben al 24% de los nuevos servidores MCP netos, Sysdig registra extracción mediana de credenciales de 19 minutos en patrimonios desprotegidos, y la cohorte gateada de 41 empresas entrega exactamente la línea base empírica cross-vendor que un perfil NIST consolidaría.
text_locales.fil: Ang Saturday arxiv 2605.05933 (MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic) ay nagbibigay ng citable formal-verification framework para sa per-tenant capability attestation; umaakyat ang Defender quarantines sa 24% ng net-new MCP servers, nagla-log ang Sysdig ng 19-minute median credential-extraction sa unprotected estates, at naghahatid ang 41-enterprise gated cohort ng eksaktong cross-vendor empirical baseline na ico-consolidate ng NIST profile.

bridges.text: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship managed signed-skill registries with per-tenant gating in parallel; Cisco Astrix's MCP-server identity gateway integrating Defender XDR plus Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger lands as the first cross-vendor control-plane stack with visibility on >60% of new MCP-server provisioning events.

text_locales.en: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship managed signed-skill registries with per-tenant gating in parallel; Cisco Astrix's MCP-server identity gateway integrating Defender XDR plus Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger lands as the first cross-vendor control-plane stack with visibility on >60% of new MCP-server provisioning events.
text_locales.ja: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry、AWS Bedrock、Google Cloud Vertex AIはper-tenant gating付きのmanaged署名スキルレジストリを並行して出荷する。Cisco AstrixのMCPサーバ・アイデンティティ・ゲートウェイがDefender XDRおよびMicrosoft Agent 365監査台帳と統合され、新規MCPサーバプロビジョニングイベントの>60%に可視性を持つ最初のクロスベンダーcontrol-planeスタックとして着地する。
text_locales.es: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock y Google Cloud Vertex AI envian managed signed-skill registries con per-tenant gating en paralelo; el MCP-server identity gateway de Cisco Astrix integrando Defender XDR mas el audit ledger de Microsoft Agent 365 aterriza como el primer stack cross-vendor de control-plane con visibilidad sobre >60% de eventos de provisioning de nuevos MCP-servers.
text_locales.fil: Ang Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, at Google Cloud Vertex AI ay nagpapadala ng managed signed-skill registries na may per-tenant gating nang paralelo; ang MCP-server identity gateway ng Cisco Astrix na nagsasama ng Defender XDR plus Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger ay lumalapag bilang unang cross-vendor control-plane stack na may visibility sa >60% ng new MCP-server provisioning events.

bridges.text: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0's signed sandboxed-skill registry plus OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection GA, layered against ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), tighten the cross-vendor agent-identity baseline a NIST non-human-identity control profile would consolidate. The taxonomy work itself is still missing.

text_locales.en: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0's signed sandboxed-skill registry plus OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection GA, layered against ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), tighten the cross-vendor agent-identity baseline a NIST non-human-identity control profile would consolidate. The taxonomy work itself is still missing.
text_locales.ja: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0の署名サンドボックス・スキルレジストリ、OpenAI ChatGPT Enterpriseの組織別エージェントレジストリFedRAMP-Moderate GA、Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCPサーバー脅威検出GAが、約9,400露出MCPサーバー(約58%が認証なし)を背景に、NIST非人間アイデンティティ管理プロファイルが統合するであろうクロスベンダー・エージェント・アイデンティティ基盤を強化する。タクソノミー作業自体は依然欠落している。
text_locales.es: El registro de habilidades sandbox firmado de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 más la GA del registro de agentes por organización de OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise con FedRAMP-Moderate más la GA de detección de amenazas de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud, en capas contra ~9.400 servidores MCP expuestos (~58% sin autenticación), tensan la línea base de identidad de agente entre proveedores que un perfil de control de identidad no humana de NIST consolidaría. El trabajo de taxonomía en sí sigue faltando.
text_locales.fil: Ang signed sandboxed-skill registry ng Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 kasama ang per-org agent registry GA ng OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise na may FedRAMP-Moderate kasama ang MCP-server threat-detection GA ng Microsoft Defender for Cloud, na nakapatong sa ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), ay naghihigpit sa cross-vendor agent-identity baseline na iko-consolidate ng NIST non-human-identity control profile. Ang taxonomy work mismo ay nawawala pa rin.

needs.actor: Fortune-500 financial-services CISO commenting on the NIST initial public draft
needs.job: submit substantive public-comment feedback that ties the proposed NHI control families back to concrete operational findings — MCP-server inventory gaps, service-account proliferation, and agentic-AI lateral-movement scenarios already observed inside the bank's own Microsoft Agent 365 and Anthropic-finance-agent deployments.
needs.outcome: Filed public comment (and an industry-coalition joint comment with FS-ISAC peers) that shapes the final control profile to include audit-trail attribution requirements compatible with SR 11-7 model-risk and SEC cyber-disclosure reporting.
needs.motivation: Avoid being forced into a control profile that mismatches existing model-risk and cyber-disclosure controls — better to invest comment cycles upfront than retrofit a published standard against bank-specific operational reality.

job_locales.ja: 提案されたNHIコントロール・ファミリーを、銀行自身のMicrosoft Agent 365およびAnthropic金融エージェント展開ですでに観察された具体的な運用所見 — MCPサーバー・インベントリのギャップ、サービス・アカウント増殖、エージェントAIラテラル・ムーブメント・シナリオ — に結び付ける実質的なパブリック・コメント・フィードバックを提出する。
job_locales.es: presentar feedback sustantivo de comentario público que ate las familias de control NHI propuestas de regreso a hallazgos operativos concretos — brechas de inventario de servidores MCP, proliferación de cuentas de servicio y escenarios de movimiento lateral de IA agéntica ya observados dentro de los propios despliegues del banco de Microsoft Agent 365 y agentes financieros de Anthropic.
job_locales.fil: magsumite ng substantive public-comment feedback na nag-uugnay sa iminumungkahing NHI control families pabalik sa concrete operational findings — MCP-server inventory gaps, service-account proliferation, at agentic-AI lateral-movement scenarios na naobserbahan na sa loob ng sariling Microsoft Agent 365 at Anthropic-finance-agent deployments ng bangko.

outcome_locales.en: Filed public comment (and an industry-coalition joint comment with FS-ISAC peers) that shapes the final control profile to include audit-trail attribution requirements compatible with SR 11-7 model-risk and SEC cyber-disclosure reporting.
outcome_locales.ja: 提出されたパブリック・コメント(およびFS-ISAC同業者との業界連合共同コメント)が、最終コントロール・プロファイルにSR 11-7モデル・リスクおよびSECサイバー開示報告と互換性のある監査証跡帰属要件を含むよう形作る。
outcome_locales.es: Comentario público presentado (y un comentario conjunto de coalición industrial con pares FS-ISAC) que da forma al perfil de control final para incluir requisitos de atribución de pista de auditoría compatibles con riesgo de modelo SR 11-7 y reporte de divulgación cibernética de la SEC.
outcome_locales.fil: Naipasang public comment (at industry-coalition joint comment kasama ang FS-ISAC peers) na hinuhubog ang final control profile upang isama ang audit-trail attribution requirements na compatible sa SR 11-7 model-risk at SEC cyber-disclosure reporting.

motivation_locales.en: Avoid being forced into a control profile that mismatches existing model-risk and cyber-disclosure controls — better to invest comment cycles upfront than retrofit a published standard against bank-specific operational reality.
motivation_locales.ja: 既存のモデル・リスクおよびサイバー開示コントロールと不一致のコントロール・プロファイルに強制されることを避ける — 公表された標準を銀行固有の運用実態に対して後追いで適応させるよりも、コメント・サイクルに事前投資する方が良い。
motivation_locales.es: Evitar ser forzado a un perfil de control que no coincida con los controles existentes de riesgo de modelo y divulgación cibernética — mejor invertir ciclos de comentario por adelantado que retrofitar un estándar publicado contra la realidad operativa específica del banco.
motivation_locales.fil: Iwasan na mapilit sa control profile na hindi tumutugma sa existing model-risk at cyber-disclosure controls — mas mabuti ang mag-invest ng comment cycles upfront kaysa retrofit ng nailathalang pamantayan laban sa bank-specific operational reality.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: Cisco's May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition makes non-human-identity (NHI) governance an explicit M&A-tier primitive on the same week as Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU with per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) and the May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting that names identity as Zero Trust's first pillar in the agentic-AI era. The structural backdrop is severe: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers as of early 2026 with roughly half operating with no authorization controls, AI agents and other non-human identities now outnumber human users ~100:1 in major enterprises (per Cisco's customer survey), and MCP itself ships with no built-in identity, no least-privilege enforcement, and no audit trail. Cisco's planned integration of Astrix into Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converges with Microsoft's per-agent identity model into a de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — but the procurement tier above (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) requires a published-standard reference, not a vendor-specific architecture diagram. By Q4 2026 NIST is expected to publish a dedicated NHI control profile (most likely as a SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement or an SP 800-53 control-family overlay) treating machine identities, agent identities, and service-account identities as a distinct compliance category with discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, and audit-trail control families. CISA agentic-AI guidance and SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary follow within one quarter via the same forcing function — the $400M Astrix M&A price tag is itself a regulator-readable signal that the category has crossed into balance-sheet materiality.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 5月4日のCiscoによる$400MのAstrix Security買収は、5月1日のMicrosoft Agent 365 GA($15/ユーザー/月のM365 E7 SKU、エージェント単位のDefenderリレーションシップマップ + Entra ID + Purview + Intune)、そしてエージェントAI時代のZero Trust第一の柱としてアイデンティティを名指しした5月1日のCloud Security Alliance投稿と同じ週に、非人間アイデンティティ(NHI)ガバナンスを明示的なM&A階層のプリミティブにする。構造的な背景は深刻だ: 2026年初頭時点で約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーがあり、その約半数が認可コントロールなしで稼働、AIエージェントその他の非人間アイデンティティが大手企業内で人間ユーザーを約100:1で上回る(Ciscoの顧客調査)、そしてMCP自体は組み込みアイデンティティ、最小権限、監査証跡を一切備えていない。CiscoによるAstrixのCisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAMへの統合計画は、Microsoftのエージェント単位アイデンティティ・モデルと収斂してデファクトの2ベンダーNHIコントロール・プレーン・プリミティブを形成する — しかしその上の調達階層(連邦CISOオフィス、銀行規制当局、HIPAAスコープのヘルスケア・バイヤー)は、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図ではなく公表標準のリファレンスを要求する。2026年Q4までに、NISTは専用のNHIコントロール・プロファイルを公表することが期待される(SP 800-207系のZero Trust補遺、もしくはSP 800-53コントロール・ファミリー・オーバーレイの形が最有力)。マシン・アイデンティティ、エージェント・アイデンティティ、サービス・アカウント・アイデンティティを、発見、ライフサイクル、最小権限、監査証跡のコントロール・ファミリーを伴う独立したコンプライアンス・カテゴリとして扱う。CISAのエージェントAIガイダンスとSECのサイバー開示ルール・コメンタリーは同じ強制関数で1四半期以内に追随する — $400MのAstrix M&A価格自体が、カテゴリがバランスシート重要性に達したことを示す規制当局可読のシグナルである。
prediction_summary_locales.es: La adquisición del 4 de mayo de Astrix Security por $400M de Cisco hace de la gobernanza de identidad no-humana (NHI) un primitivo explícito de nivel M&A en la misma semana que la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 (1 de mayo, SKU M365 E7 a $15/user/mo con mapa de relaciones por agente de Defender + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) y la publicación del 1 de mayo de Cloud Security Alliance que nombra a la identidad como el primer pilar de Zero Trust en la era de la IA agéntica. El telón de fondo estructural es severo: ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet a comienzos de 2026 con aproximadamente la mitad operando sin controles de autorización, los agentes de IA y otras identidades no-humanas ahora superan en número a los usuarios humanos ~100:1 en empresas grandes (según la encuesta de clientes de Cisco), y MCP mismo se entrega sin identidad incorporada, sin aplicación de mínimo privilegio y sin pista de auditoría. La integración planeada de Astrix por Cisco en Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converge con el modelo de identidad por agente de Microsoft hacia un primitivo de plano de control de NHI de facto de dos vendors — pero el nivel de adquisición superior (oficinas federales de CISO, reguladores bancarios, compradores con alcance HIPAA en salud) requiere una referencia de estándar publicado, no un diagrama de arquitectura específico de vendor. Para Q4 2026 se espera que NIST publique un perfil de control de NHI dedicado (más probablemente como un suplemento de la serie SP 800-207 de Zero Trust o una superposición de familia de controles de SP 800-53) tratando las identidades de máquina, identidades de agente e identidades de cuentas de servicio como una categoría de cumplimiento distinta con familias de controles de descubrimiento, ciclo de vida, mínimo privilegio y pista de auditoría. La guía de IA agéntica de CISA y el comentario de la regla de divulgación cibernética de la SEC siguen dentro de un trimestre vía la misma función forzante — el precio de M&A de Astrix de $400M es en sí mismo una señal legible para reguladores de que la categoría ha cruzado a materialidad de balance.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Ang May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition ng Cisco ay ginagawang explicit M&A-tier primitive ang non-human-identity (NHI) governance sa parehong linggo ng Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU na may per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) at ng May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting na nagngangalan sa identity bilang unang pillar ng Zero Trust sa agentic-AI era. Malala ang structural backdrop: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers noong unang bahagi ng 2026 na halos kalahati ay tumatakbo nang walang authorization controls, ang AI agents at ibang non-human identities ay ngayon mas marami kaysa sa human users sa ratio na ~100:1 sa mga major enterprises (ayon sa Cisco customer survey), at ang MCP mismo ay nag-ship nang walang built-in identity, walang least-privilege enforcement, at walang audit trail. Ang planned integration ng Cisco ng Astrix sa Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM ay nag-co-converge sa per-agent identity model ng Microsoft papasok sa de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — ngunit ang procurement tier sa itaas (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) ay nangangailangan ng nailathalang-pamantayang reference, hindi vendor-specific architecture diagram. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, inaasahan na maglathala ang NIST ng nakatuong NHI control profile (pinakamalamang bilang SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement o SP 800-53 control-family overlay) na tinatrato ang machine identities, agent identities, at service-account identities bilang natatanging compliance category na may discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, at audit-trail control families. Susunod ang CISA agentic-AI guidance at SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary sa loob ng isang quarter sa pamamagitan ng parehong forcing function — ang $400M Astrix M&A price tag mismo ay regulator-readable signal na ang category ay tumawid na sa balance-sheet materiality.

nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).

description.en: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).
description.ja: 2026年Q3までに、同じウィンドウ内で着地したLLMワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEのクラスター—n8n CVE-2026-21858(CVSS 10.0、ウェブフックcontent-type混乱経由の未認証RCE、Cyera Research Labsが「Ni8mare」と命名、1.121.0でパッチ、カナダ・サイバーセキュリティセンター + 豪ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security全てがアドバイザリーを公表)、Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264(プロンプト・インジェクション駆動のRCEで、チャットフロー・ユーザーがLLMに攻撃者制御Pythonを発出させる)、LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF(Sysdigハニーポット艦隊で開示後12時間31分以内に最初のエクスプロイト試行)、Georgia Techの Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in 2026年3月にAIコーディング・ツール直接起因(オープンソース・エコシステム全体で5-10倍の真の数のアンダーカウントと研究者推定)—がSGLang CVE-2026-5760パッチと~7,000のインターネット露出MCPサーバー(約半数が未認証)のベースラインと組み合わさり、CISAをして、n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Difyクラス・プラットフォームをカテゴリーで命名し、ウェブフックcontent-type検証 + プロンプト・インジェクション認識最小権限 + MCP-tool-call audit-trailコントロール・ファミリーを規定する専用エージェンティックAIワークフロー・プラットフォーム・セキュア展開ガイドを発出させる。フォーシング・ファンクションは、Tier-2エンタープライズで広く展開されているノーコードAIワークフロー・ハーネスでのNi8mare CVSS-10スコアが、既存のCISA AIガイダンス(モデル・プロバイダーと大規模展開層バイヤーをターゲット)を運用上の現実に対して狭すぎるものにすること。ガイドはCISA Cybersecurity AdvisoryまたはSecure-by-Design補足が最も可能性高い;FBI + NSA + 国際Five Eyesカウンターパートがn8nに関するCCCS / ASDのAL26-001ジョイント・パターンをディスパッチ形状の前例として、一サイクル以内に共同署名する。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 el cluster de CVEs de plataformas LLM-workflow aterrizando en la misma ventana — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 RCE no autenticado vía confusión content-type en webhook, codenombrado Ni8mare por Cyera Research Labs, parchado en 1.121.0, con avisos de Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (RCE driven por inyección de prompt donde un usuario chatflow induce al LLM a emitir Python controlado por atacante), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (primero explotado dentro de 12 horas 31 minutos de divulgación per flota honeypot Sysdig), el conteo Vibe Security Radar de Georgia Tech de 35 CVEs en marzo 2026 directamente atribuibles a herramientas AI coding (con investigadores estimando subconteo 5-10x a través del ecosistema open-source) — combinado con el parche standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + la baseline de ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (~mitad sin autenticación) fuerza a CISA a publicar una guía dedicada de despliegue seguro de plataformas de workflow agentic-AI nombrando plataformas clase n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify por categoría y prescribiendo familias de control de validación content-type webhook + least-privilege consciente de inyección de prompts + audit-trail MCP-tool-call. La forcing function es que la puntuación CVSS-10 Ni8mare en un harness no-code de workflow AI ampliamente desplegado en empresas Tier-2 hace la guía CISA AI existente (que apuntaba a model providers y compradores de gran despliegue) demasiado estrecha para la realidad operacional. La guía es muy probablemente un Cybersecurity Advisory CISA o suplemento Secure-by-Design; FBI + NSA + contrapartes internacionales Five Eyes co-firman dentro de un ciclo (el patrón conjunto AL26-001 de CCCS / ASD en n8n es el precedente de forma de despacho).
description.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026 ang cluster ng LLM-workflow-platform CVEs na lumalapag sa parehong window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE sa pamamagitan ng webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare ng Cyera Research Labs, na-patch sa 1.121.0, na may mga advisories mula sa Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE kung saan ang isang chatflow user ay umaakit sa LLM na maglabas ng attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (unang na-exploit sa loob ng 12 hours 31 minutes ng disclosure ayon sa Sysdig honeypot fleet), ang Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count na 35 CVEs noong March 2026 na direkta na maiuugnay sa AI coding tools (na may researchers na nag-eestima ng undercount na 5-10x sa buong open-source ecosystem) — kasama ng standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + ang ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline ay pumipilit sa CISA na maglabas ng dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide na nagngangalan ng n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms ayon sa kategorya at nagre-prescribe ng webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. Ang forcing function ay ang Ni8mare CVSS-10 score sa isang no-code AI-workflow harness na malawakang na-deploy sa Tier-2 enterprises ay ginagawa ang umiiral na CISA AI guidance (na nagta-target ng model providers at large-deployment-tier buyers) na masyadong makitid para sa operational reality. Ang guide ay malamang isang CISA Cybersecurity Advisory o Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts ay co-sign sa loob ng isang cycle (ang AL26-001 joint pattern mula CCCS / ASD sa n8n ay ang dispatch-shape precedent).

plain_language.en: After several no-code AI workflow tools were hit by serious security flaws this month, the US cyber agency is set to publish a deployment guide naming those tools by category.
plain_language.ja: いくつかのノーコードAIワークフロー・ツールがこの月に深刻なセキュリティ欠陥を受けた後、米サイバー機関はそれらのツールをカテゴリー別に命名する展開ガイドを公表する見込み。
plain_language.es: Tras varias herramientas no-code de flujos de trabajo de IA recibir fallos serios de seguridad este mes, la agencia cyber de EE.UU. publicará una guía de despliegue nombrando esas herramientas por categoría.
plain_language.fil: Matapos ang ilang no-code AI workflow tools ay tinamaan ng malubhang security flaws ngayong buwan, ang US cyber agency ay maglalabas ng deployment guide na nagngangalan ng mga tool na iyon ayon sa kategorya.

bridges.text: The CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft incorporating the ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy clears interagency review and enters the OMB publication queue; the KEV refresh tightens the May 21 deadline to T-minus-7; a four-vendor nine-framework C2 attribution baseline plus the Mistral matrix-tier interop deliverable assemble the reference-architecture inputs for a CISA secure-deployment artifact.

text_locales.en: The CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft incorporating the ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy clears interagency review and enters the OMB publication queue; the KEV refresh tightens the May 21 deadline to T-minus-7; a four-vendor nine-framework C2 attribution baseline plus the Mistral matrix-tier interop deliverable assemble the reference-architecture inputs for a CISA secure-deployment artifact.
text_locales.ja: 10CVEのTrail of Bits分類体系を取り込んだCISA連邦民間オペレーショナル・ディレクティブ作業ドラフトは省庁間レビューをクリアしOMB公表キューへ入る;KEVリフレッシュは5月21日期限を残り7営業日まで引き締める;4ベンダー9フレームワークのC2帰属ベースラインプラスMistralマトリックス・ティア相互運用デリバラブルが、CISAセキュア・デプロイメント成果物のリファレンス・アーキテクチャ入力を整える。
text_locales.es: El borrador de trabajo de la directiva operativa federal-civil de CISA, que incorpora la taxonomía de Trail of Bits con diez CVE, supera la revisión interinstitucional e ingresa en la cola de publicación de OMB; el refresco del KEV ajusta la fecha límite del 21 de mayo a T menos 7; una línea base de atribución C2 de cuatro fabricantes y nueve frameworks, junto con el entregable de interoperabilidad de Mistral a nivel de matriz, ensamblan los insumos de arquitectura de referencia para un artefacto de despliegue seguro de CISA.
text_locales.fil: Ang CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft na nag-iinkorporeyt sa sampung-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy ay nakapasa sa interagency review at pumasok sa OMB publication queue; pinahihigpit ng KEV refresh ang Mayo 21 deadline patungong T-minus-7; ang four-vendor nine-framework C2 attribution baseline kasama ang Mistral matrix-tier interop deliverable ay bumubuo sa reference-architecture inputs para sa CISA secure-deployment artifact.

bridges.text: Wednesday Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) extends the agent-loader taxonomy to nine CVEs with a same-day v0.4.7 patch; Trail of Bits's taxonomy now folds into the CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft per Wednesday wire reporting; Shadowserver day-twelve exposed n8n instances fall to 4,210; CISA refreshes KEV with the May 21 deadline at T-minus-9.

text_locales.en: Wednesday Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) extends the agent-loader taxonomy to nine CVEs with a same-day v0.4.7 patch; Trail of Bits's taxonomy now folds into the CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft per Wednesday wire reporting; Shadowserver day-twelve exposed n8n instances fall to 4,210; CISA refreshes KEV with the May 21 deadline at T-minus-9.
text_locales.ja: 水曜Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892(CVSS 8.4)がエージェントローダー分類体系を9件のCVEに拡張し、同日中にv0.4.7パッチを配布。Trail of Bitsの分類体系は水曜のワイヤー報道に基づきCISAの連邦民間機関向け運用指令ワーキングドラフトへ参照として組み込まれた。Shadowserverの12日目n8n露出インスタンスは4,210件まで減少し、CISAは5月21日の期限(残り9日)を念頭にKEVを更新している。
text_locales.es: El miércoles Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) extiende la taxonomía del cargador de agentes a nueve CVE con un parche v0.4.7 del mismo día; la taxonomía de Trail of Bits ahora se integra en el borrador de directiva operativa civil federal de CISA según el reporte por cable del miércoles; las instancias expuestas de n8n del día doce de Shadowserver caen a 4.210; CISA actualiza KEV con la fecha límite del 21 de mayo a T-menos-9.
text_locales.fil: Pinapalawak ng Miyerkules Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) ang agent-loader taxonomy sa siyam na CVE kasama ang same-day v0.4.7 patch; isinama na ngayon ang taxonomy ng Trail of Bits sa CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft ayon sa Miyerkules wire reporting; bumababa ang Shadowserver day-twelve exposed n8n instances sa 4,210; nire-refresh ng CISA ang KEV kasama ang May 21 deadline sa T-minus-9.

text_locales.ja: 火曜Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892(CVSS 8.4)は当日中v0.4.7パッチでエージェント・ローダー分類学を8つのCVEへと拡張;Trail of Bitsの分類学は火曜ワイヤ報道によると現在CISA連邦民間運用指令ワーキング・ドラフトに折り込まれる;Shadowserver 12日目曝露n8nインスタンスは4,210に低下;CISAは5月21日期限がT-マイナス9にある中でKEVをリフレッシュする。
text_locales.es: El martes Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) extiende la taxonomía de agent-loader a ocho CVEs con un parche v0.4.7 del mismo día; la taxonomía de Trail of Bits se pliega ahora en el borrador de trabajo de la directiva operativa federal-civil de CISA según reporte de cable del martes; las instancias expuestas n8n del día doce de Shadowserver caen a 4,210; CISA refresca KEV con la fecha límite del 21 de mayo en T-menos-9.
text_locales.fil: Ina-extend ng Tuesday Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) ang agent-loader taxonomy patungo sa walong CVEs kasama ng isang same-day v0.4.7 patch; ang taxonomy ng Trail of Bits ay tinutupi na ngayon sa CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft ayon sa Tuesday wire reporting; bumababa ang Shadowserver day-twelve exposed n8n instances sa 4,210; ni-refresh ng CISA ang KEV kasama ng May 21 deadline sa T-minus-9.

bridges.text: LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) lands Monday completing the seven-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave Trail of Bits taxonomizes with a signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation proposal; Shadowserver day-eleven n8n exposed instances fall to 4,920 with unpatched share at 33 percent; Censys reports exploitation attempts at 6.4x baseline ahead of the May 21 federal-civilian deadline.

text_locales.en: LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) lands Monday completing the seven-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave Trail of Bits taxonomizes with a signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation proposal; Shadowserver day-eleven n8n exposed instances fall to 4,920 with unpatched share at 33 percent; Censys reports exploitation attempts at 6.4x baseline ahead of the May 21 federal-civilian deadline.
text_locales.ja: LangChain CVE-2026-44712(CVSS 8.7)が月曜に着地し、Trail of Bitsが署名済みチェックポイント・プラス・マニフェスト許可リスト検証共通緩和提案で分類学化する7-CVEエージェント・チェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・ローダー波を完結;Shadowserverの11日目n8n曝露インスタンスは4,920に下落し未パッチ・シェアは33パーセント;Censysは5月21日連邦民間期限を控えベースライン6.4倍の悪用試行を報告。
text_locales.es: LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) aterriza el lunes completando la ola de siete CVE de agent-checkpoint-y-manifest-loader que Trail of Bits taxonomiza con una propuesta de mitigación común signed-checkpoint más manifest-allowlist-validation; las instancias expuestas de n8n del día once de Shadowserver caen a 4,920 con la cuota sin parche en 33 por ciento; Censys reporta intentos de explotación en 6.4x baseline antes de la fecha límite federal-civil del 21 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Lumalapag ang LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) ngayong Monday na tinatapos ang seven-CVE agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave na nag-ta-taxonomize ng Trail of Bits sa isang signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist-validation common-mitigation proposal; bumababa ang Shadowserver day-eleven n8n exposed instances sa 4,920 na may unpatched share sa 33 percent; iniuulat ng Censys ang exploitation attempts sa 6.4x baseline bago ang May 21 federal-civilian deadline.

bridges.text: Sunday compounds the agentic-platform CVE wave that anchors the prediction: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) extend the Microsoft agent stack; Trail of Bits names a shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; Shadowserver day-ten drops exposed n8n to ~5,700; CISA refreshes KEV ahead of the May 21 deadline.

text_locales.en: Sunday compounds the agentic-platform CVE wave that anchors the prediction: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) extend the Microsoft agent stack; Trail of Bits names a shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; Shadowserver day-ten drops exposed n8n to ~5,700; CISA refreshes KEV ahead of the May 21 deadline.
text_locales.ja: 日曜は予測をアンカーするエージェンティック・プラットフォームCVEの波を複合化させる: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612(CVSS 8.9 チェックポイント・デシリアライゼーション)とSemantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638(CVSS 8.4 プラグイン・マニフェストSSRF)がMicrosoftエージェント・スタックを拡張する;Trail of Bitsは共有チェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・ローダー曝露パターンを命名する;Shadowserverの10日目は曝露n8nを~5,700へ低下させる;CISAは5月21日期限に先立ってKEVをリフレッシュする。
text_locales.es: El domingo compone la ola de CVE de plataforma agéntica que ancla la predicción: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 deserialización de checkpoint) y Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 SSRF de plugin-manifest) extienden el stack de agente Microsoft; Trail of Bits nombra un patrón compartido de exposición checkpoint-y-manifest-loader; el día diez de Shadowserver baja n8n expuesto a ~5,700; CISA refresca KEV antes de la fecha límite del 21 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Nagdadagdag ang Linggo sa agentic-platform CVE wave na nag-aanchor sa prediksyon: pinapalawig ng AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) at Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) ang Microsoft agent stack; pinapangalanan ng Trail of Bits ang shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; bumababa ang Shadowserver day-ten exposed n8n sa ~5,700; nire-refresh ng CISA ang KEV bago ang Mayo 21 deadline.

bridges.text: Shadowserver day-nine n8n exposed instances drop to ~6,800 (44% unpatched) ahead of the CISA May 21 federal-civilian deadline; NHS England's five-CVE blocklist now functions as the de-facto allied reference, and Sysdig's 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction puts a measurable cost on absent secure-deployment guidance — the exact predicate set a CISA guide would consolidate.

text_locales.en: Shadowserver day-nine n8n exposed instances drop to ~6,800 (44% unpatched) ahead of the CISA May 21 federal-civilian deadline; NHS England's five-CVE blocklist now functions as the de-facto allied reference, and Sysdig's 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction puts a measurable cost on absent secure-deployment guidance — the exact predicate set a CISA guide would consolidate.
text_locales.ja: Shadowserverの9日目n8n曝露インスタンスはCISAの5月21日連邦民間期限に先立ち~6,800まで低下(44%未パッチ);NHS Englandの5-CVEブロックリストは今や事実上の同盟参照として機能し、Sysdigの19分中央認証情報抽出時間は安全デプロイメント・ガイダンス不在に測定可能なコストを置く — CISAガイドが統合する正にプレディケート・セット。
text_locales.es: Las instancias n8n expuestas del día nueve de Shadowserver caen a ~6,800 (44% sin parchar) antes de la fecha límite federal-civil del 21 de mayo de CISA; la blocklist de cinco CVE de NHS England ahora funciona como la referencia aliada de facto, y el tiempo mediano de 19 minutos a extracción de credenciales de Sysdig pone un costo medible sobre la guía ausente de despliegue seguro — el set predicado exacto que una guía de CISA consolidaría.
text_locales.fil: Bumababa ang day-nine n8n exposed instances ng Shadowserver sa ~6,800 (44% unpatched) bago ang CISA Mayo 21 federal-civilian deadline; gumagana na ngayon ang five-CVE blocklist ng NHS England bilang de-facto allied reference, at inilalagay ng 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction ng Sysdig ang measurable cost sa absent secure-deployment guidance — ang eksaktong predicate set na ico-consolidate ng CISA guide.

bridges.text: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.

text_locales.en: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.
text_locales.ja: 8日目のn8n KEVスキャンは、公開済みpre-1.121.0インスタンスを41.5%減少させ、REST webhookで4.8倍の悪用試行スパイクを記録する。CrewAI CVE-2026-44352(CVSS 8.7のデシリアライゼーションRCE)とHaystack CVE-2026-44391(CVSS 9.4のpath-traversalでAWSメタデータへピボット)は、LangGraphとLiteLLMの24時間後に着地する。NHS EnglandはNi8mareをそのagentic-AIワークフローブロックリストに名指しし、ノーコードハーネスのforcing functionを硬化させる。
text_locales.es: Los escaneos del dia ocho de la KEV de n8n reducen las instancias pre-1.121.0 expuestas en 41.5% con un spike de 4.8x en intentos de explotacion en REST webhooks, mientras que CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserializacion RCE) y Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivotando a AWS metadata) aterrizan 24 horas despues de LangGraph mas LiteLLM. NHS England nombra a Ni8mare en su blocklist de workflow agentic-AI, endureciendo el forcing function del no-code harness.
text_locales.fil: Ibinaba ng day-eight n8n KEV scans ang exposed pre-1.121.0 instances ng 41.5% na may 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike sa REST webhooks, habang ang CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal na pumapivot sa AWS metadata) ay lumalapag 24 oras matapos ang LangGraph plus LiteLLM. Pinapangalanan ng NHS England si Ni8mare sa kanilang agentic-AI workflow blocklist, pinatitigas ang no-code harness forcing function.

bridges.text: The n8n KEV addition with a May 21 federal deadline (first agentic-workflow CVE in the catalog), concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass with sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances 62% unpatched, and Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA crystallize exactly the operational case the CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (May 6) names — multi-vendor weekly cadence has displaced monthly.

text_locales.en: The n8n KEV addition with a May 21 federal deadline (first agentic-workflow CVE in the catalog), concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass with sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances 62% unpatched, and Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA crystallize exactly the operational case the CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (May 6) names — multi-vendor weekly cadence has displaced monthly.
text_locales.ja: n8nのKEV追加(カタログ初のエージェント型ワークフローCVE、5月21日連邦期限)、同時並行のLangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM認証バイパスで18時間未満のエクスプロイト発生、インターネット露出インスタンス約14,200(62%未パッチ)、Microsoft Defender MCPサーバー検出GAが、CISAセキュア配備ガイド予測(5月6日)が指す運用面の根拠を結晶化させた──マルチベンダー週次ケイデンスが月次を置き換えた。
text_locales.es: La adición de n8n al KEV con plazo federal del 21 de mayo (primer CVE de flujo de trabajo agéntico en el catálogo), el SSRF concurrente de LangGraph + bypass de autenticación de LiteLLM con explotación en menos de 18 horas, ~14.200 instancias expuestas a internet con 62% sin parchar, y la GA de detección de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender cristalizan exactamente el caso operativo que la predicción de la guía de despliegue seguro de CISA (6 de mayo) nombra — la cadencia semanal multi-proveedor ha desplazado a la mensual.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n KEV addition na may Mayo 21 federal deadline (unang agentic-workflow CVE sa catalog), ang concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass na may sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances na 62% unpatched, at ang Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA ay nagsa-crystallize ng eksaktong operational case na pinapangalanan ng CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (Mayo 6) — pinalitan na ng multi-vendor weekly cadence ang monthly.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).

nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 7 dual-registry landing — Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 shipping a sandboxed-skill registry that signs and version-pins shareable agent skills with per-tenant Mythos Preview gating tied to AISI cyber-eval results (Project Glasswing extension), and OpenAI graduating the May-1 Codex CLI /goal feature into a /agent command with explicit Plan-Apply two-phase execution alongside ChatGPT Enterprise's per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate authorization + SOC-2 Type II scope expansion to cover the agent registry + audit ledger — combined with the May 7 CISA KEV-catalog addition of n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare), the same-day LangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF (CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 auth-bypass (CVSS 8.8) disclosure pair, the +34%/4-week MCP-server exposure compounding (~9,400 internet-exposed servers, ~58% with no authorization controls), and the May 7 Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection module GA forces enterprise procurement RFPs to name a signed-skill registry + per-tenant capability gating + per-org audit-ledger triple as a baseline requirement for any agentic-AI orchestrator entering the enterprise tier. The forcing function is that the dual-registry shape now spans both major frontier labs and is reinforced by hyperscaler-side telemetry (Defender XDR for MCP) within the same disclosure window — enterprise CISOs and procurement teams adopt the registry-first posture as the operational answer to the n8n KEV catalog + LangGraph/LiteLLM CVE pair. The shape is most likely an explicit RFP control family naming sandboxed-skill registry + per-tenant Mythos-class capability gating + per-org audit ledger, not a generic "AI governance" line item. Hyperscaler-managed registry tiers (Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex) ship parallel offerings within the same window to avoid being the lone hold-out without a contractual control plane.

description.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月7日のデュアル・レジストリ着地—Anthropic Claude Code 3.0が、共有可能なエージェント・スキルに署名しバージョン・ピン留めするサンドボックス化スキル・レジストリを、AISI cyber-eval結果に紐づくテナントごとのMythosプレビュー・ゲーティング(Project Glasswing拡張)とともに出荷、OpenAIが5月1日のCodex CLI /goal機能を明示的なPlan-Apply二段階実行を伴う/agentコマンドへ昇格させ、ChatGPT EnterpriseがFedRAMP-Moderate認証 + SOC-2 Type IIレポートのエージェント・レジストリ + 監査台帳をカバーするスコープ拡張とともに組織ごとのエージェント・レジストリGAを発表—が、5月7日のCISA KEVカタログへのn8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare) 追加、同日のLangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF(CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188認証バイパス(CVSS 8.8)の開示ペア、4週間で+34%のMCPサーバー露出複利成長(~9,400のインターネット露出サーバー、~58%が認可コントロール無し)、5月7日のMicrosoft Defender for CloudのMCPサーバー脅威検知モジュールGAと組み合わさり、エンタープライズ調達のRFPに対し、署名済みスキル・レジストリ + テナントごとの能力ゲーティング + 組織ごとの監査台帳のトリプルを、エンタープライズ層に入る任意のエージェンティックAIオーケストレータのベースライン要件として命名することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、デュアル・レジストリの形状が両主要フロンティア・ラボにまたがり、同じ開示ウィンドウ内でハイパースケーラー側テレメトリ(MCP向けDefender XDR)によって補強されていること—エンタープライズCISOと調達チームは、n8n KEVカタログ + LangGraph/LiteLLM CVEペアに対する運用上の答えとしてレジストリ・ファースト姿勢を採用する。形状は、汎用「AIガバナンス」ライン項目ではなく、サンドボックス化スキル・レジストリ + テナントごとのMythosクラス能力ゲーティング + 組織ごとの監査台帳を命名する明示的なRFPコントロール・ファミリーが最も可能性高い。ハイパースケーラー管理レジストリ層(Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex)は、契約上のコントロール・プレーンを持たない孤立したホールドアウトになるのを避けるため、同じウィンドウ内で並行オファリングを出荷する。
description.es: Para Q4 2026 el aterrizaje dual-registro del 7 de mayo — Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 lanzando un registro de habilidades sandboxed que firma y fija versiones de habilidades de agentes compartibles con gating Mythos Preview por tenant atado a los resultados de eval cyber AISI (extensión de Project Glasswing), y OpenAI graduando la función /goal del Codex CLI del 1 de mayo a un comando /agent con ejecución explícita de dos fases Plan-Apply junto con el GA del registro de agentes por organización de ChatGPT Enterprise con autorización FedRAMP-Moderate + expansión de scope SOC-2 Type II para cubrir el registro de agentes + libro mayor de auditoría — combinado con la adición del 7 de mayo al catálogo CISA KEV de n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare), el par de divulgaciones del mismo día de LangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF (CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 bypass de autenticación (CVSS 8.8), la composición de exposición de servidores MCP +34%/4-semanas (~9,400 servidores expuestos a internet, ~58% sin controles de autorización), y el GA del 7 de mayo del módulo de detección de amenazas de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud, fuerzan a las RFPs de adquisición empresarial a nombrar el triple de registro firmado de habilidades + gating de capacidad por tenant + libro mayor de auditoría por organización como requisito base para cualquier orquestador agentic-AI que entre al nivel empresarial. La función forzante es que la forma dual-registro ahora abarca a ambos laboratorios frontera principales y se refuerza con telemetría del lado hyperscaler (Defender XDR para MCP) dentro de la misma ventana de divulgación — los CISOs y equipos de adquisición empresariales adoptan la postura registro-primero como respuesta operacional a la adición de n8n al catálogo KEV + el par CVE LangGraph/LiteLLM. La forma es muy probablemente una familia explícita de control de RFP nombrando registro de habilidades sandboxed + gating de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant + libro mayor de auditoría por organización, no un genérico ítem de "gobernanza AI". Los niveles de registro gestionado por hyperscaler (Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex) lanzan ofertas paralelas dentro de la misma ventana para evitar ser el único que se queda sin un plano de control contractual.
description.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 7 dual-registry landing — ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 na nag-shi-ship ng sandboxed-skill registry na nag-si-sign at nag-ve-version-pin sa shareable agent skills na may per-tenant Mythos Preview gating na nakatali sa AISI cyber-eval results (Project Glasswing extension), at ang OpenAI na nag-graduate sa May-1 Codex CLI /goal feature papuntang /agent command na may explicit Plan-Apply two-phase execution kasama ang ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA na may FedRAMP-Moderate authorization + SOC-2 Type II scope expansion upang masaklaw ang agent registry + audit ledger — kasama ng May 7 CISA KEV-catalog addition ng n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare), ang same-day LangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF (CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 auth-bypass (CVSS 8.8) disclosure pair, ang +34%/4-week MCP-server exposure compounding (~9,400 internet-exposed servers, ~58% na walang authorization controls), at ang May 7 Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection module GA ay pumipilit sa enterprise procurement RFPs na pangalanan ang signed-skill registry + per-tenant capability gating + per-org audit-ledger triple bilang baseline requirement para sa anumang agentic-AI orchestrator na papasok sa enterprise tier. Ang forcing function ay ang dual-registry shape ay sumasaklaw na ngayon sa parehong major frontier labs at pinatibay ng hyperscaler-side telemetry (Defender XDR para sa MCP) sa loob ng parehong disclosure window — ang mga enterprise CISO at procurement teams ay nag-a-adopt ng registry-first posture bilang operational answer sa n8n KEV catalog + LangGraph/LiteLLM CVE pair. Ang shape ay malamang isang explicit RFP control family na nagngangalan ng sandboxed-skill registry + per-tenant Mythos-class capability gating + per-org audit ledger, hindi isang generic na "AI governance" line item. Ang hyperscaler-managed registry tiers (Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex) ay magpapadala ng parallel offerings sa loob ng parehong window upang maiwasang maging nag-iisang hold-out na walang contractual control plane.

summary.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月7日のデュアル・レジストリ着地—Anthropic Claude Code 3.0が、共有可能なエージェント・スキルに署名しバージョン・ピン留めするサンドボックス化スキル・レジストリを、AISI cyber-eval結果に紐づくテナントごとのMythosプレビュー・ゲーティング(Project Glasswing拡張)とともに出荷、OpenAIが5月1日のCodex CLI /goal機能を明示的なPlan-Apply二段階実行を伴う/agentコマンドへ昇格させ、ChatGPT EnterpriseがFedRAMP-Moderate認証 + SOC-2 Type IIレポートのエージェント・レジストリ + 監査台帳をカバーするスコープ拡張とともに組織ごとのエージェント・レジストリGAを発表—が、5月7日のCISA KEVカタログへのn8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare) 追加、同日のLangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF(CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188認証バイパス(CVSS 8.8)の開示ペア、4週間で+34%のMCPサーバー露出複利成長(~9,400のインターネット露出サーバー、~58%が認可コントロール無し)、5月7日のMicrosoft Defender for CloudのMCPサーバー脅威検知モジュールGAと組み合わさり、エンタープライズ調達のRFPに対し、署名済みスキル・レジストリ + テナントごとの能力ゲーティング + 組織ごとの監査台帳のトリプルを、エンタープライズ層に入る任意のエージェンティックAIオーケストレータのベースライン要件として命名することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、デュアル・レジストリの形状が両主要フロンティア・ラボにまたがり、同じ開示ウィンドウ内でハイパースケーラー側テレメトリ(MCP向けDefender XDR)によって補強されていること—エンタープライズCISOと調達チームは、n8n KEVカタログ + LangGraph/LiteLLM CVEペアに対する運用上の答えとしてレジストリ・ファースト姿勢を採用する。形状は、汎用「AIガバナンス」ライン項目ではなく、サンドボックス化スキル・レジストリ + テナントごとのMythosクラス能力ゲーティング + 組織ごとの監査台帳を命名する明示的なRFPコントロール・ファミリーが最も可能性高い。ハイパースケーラー管理レジストリ層(Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex)は、契約上のコントロール・プレーンを持たない孤立したホールドアウトになるのを避けるため、同じウィンドウ内で並行オファリングを出荷する。
summary.es: Para Q4 2026 el aterrizaje dual-registro del 7 de mayo — Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 lanzando un registro de habilidades sandboxed que firma y fija versiones de habilidades de agentes compartibles con gating Mythos Preview por tenant atado a los resultados de eval cyber AISI (extensión de Project Glasswing), y OpenAI graduando la función /goal del Codex CLI del 1 de mayo a un comando /agent con ejecución explícita de dos fases Plan-Apply junto con el GA del registro de agentes por organización de ChatGPT Enterprise con autorización FedRAMP-Moderate + expansión de scope SOC-2 Type II para cubrir el registro de agentes + libro mayor de auditoría — combinado con la adición del 7 de mayo al catálogo CISA KEV de n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare), el par de divulgaciones del mismo día de LangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF (CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 bypass de autenticación (CVSS 8.8), la composición de exposición de servidores MCP +34%/4-semanas (~9,400 servidores expuestos a internet, ~58% sin controles de autorización), y el GA del 7 de mayo del módulo de detección de amenazas de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud, fuerzan a las RFPs de adquisición empresarial a nombrar el triple de registro firmado de habilidades + gating de capacidad por tenant + libro mayor de auditoría por organización como requisito base para cualquier orquestador agentic-AI que entre al nivel empresarial. La función forzante es que la forma dual-registro ahora abarca a ambos laboratorios frontera principales y se refuerza con telemetría del lado hyperscaler (Defender XDR para MCP) dentro de la misma ventana de divulgación — los CISOs y equipos de adquisición empresariales adoptan la postura registro-primero como respuesta operacional a la adición de n8n al catálogo KEV + el par CVE LangGraph/LiteLLM. La forma es muy probablemente una familia explícita de control de RFP nombrando registro de habilidades sandboxed + gating de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant + libro mayor de auditoría por organización, no un genérico ítem de "gobernanza AI". Los niveles de registro gestionado por hyperscaler (Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex) lanzan ofertas paralelas dentro de la misma ventana para evitar ser el único que se queda sin un plano de control contractual.
summary.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 7 dual-registry landing — ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 na nag-shi-ship ng sandboxed-skill registry na nag-si-sign at nag-ve-version-pin sa shareable agent skills na may per-tenant Mythos Preview gating na nakatali sa AISI cyber-eval results (Project Glasswing extension), at ang OpenAI na nag-graduate sa May-1 Codex CLI /goal feature papuntang /agent command na may explicit Plan-Apply two-phase execution kasama ang ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA na may FedRAMP-Moderate authorization + SOC-2 Type II scope expansion upang masaklaw ang agent registry + audit ledger — kasama ng May 7 CISA KEV-catalog addition ng n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare), ang same-day LangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF (CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 auth-bypass (CVSS 8.8) disclosure pair, ang +34%/4-week MCP-server exposure compounding (~9,400 internet-exposed servers, ~58% na walang authorization controls), at ang May 7 Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection module GA ay pumipilit sa enterprise procurement RFPs na pangalanan ang signed-skill registry + per-tenant capability gating + per-org audit-ledger triple bilang baseline requirement para sa anumang agentic-AI orchestrator na papasok sa enterprise tier. Ang forcing function ay ang dual-registry shape ay sumasaklaw na ngayon sa parehong major frontier labs at pinatibay ng hyperscaler-side telemetry (Defender XDR para sa MCP) sa loob ng parehong disclosure window — ang mga enterprise CISO at procurement teams ay nag-a-adopt ng registry-first posture bilang operational answer sa n8n KEV catalog + LangGraph/LiteLLM CVE pair. Ang shape ay malamang isang explicit RFP control family na nagngangalan ng sandboxed-skill registry + per-tenant Mythos-class capability gating + per-org audit ledger, hindi isang generic na "AI governance" line item. Ang hyperscaler-managed registry tiers (Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex) ay magpapadala ng parallel offerings sa loob ng parehong window upang maiwasang maging nag-iisang hold-out na walang contractual control plane.

Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex weekend interop updates extend signed-skill provenance across all three hyperscalers.

text_locales.en: Day-two telemetry shows 13,800 published skills (+21%) and 891K installs; Mythos-class auto-quarantines climb to 22 with eight from JPMorgan, Booz Allen, and Mandiant tenants. Lockheed, Northrop, and Palo Alto Unit 42 sign the ethics-rider lifting the gated cohort to 41. Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex weekend interop updates extend signed-skill provenance across all three hyperscalers.
text_locales.ja: 2日目テレメトリーは13,800公開スキル(+21%)と891Kインストールを示す;Mythosクラス自動隔離は22まで上昇、うち8件はJPMorgan、Booz Allen、Mandiantテナントから。Lockheed、Northrop、Palo Alto Unit 42が倫理ライダーに署名しゲーティング・コホートを41に引き上げ。Microsoft Foundry、AWS Bedrock、Google Vertexの週末相互運用アップデートが署名スキル来歴を3つのハイパースケーラーすべてにわたり拡張する。
text_locales.es: La telemetría del día dos muestra 13,800 skills publicadas (+21%) y 891K instalaciones; las cuarentenas automáticas clase Mythos suben a 22 con ocho de tenants JPMorgan, Booz Allen y Mandiant. Lockheed, Northrop y Palo Alto Unit 42 firman el rider de ética elevando la cohorte gateada a 41. Las actualizaciones de fin de semana de interop de Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock y Google Vertex extienden la procedencia de skill firmado a través de los tres hyperscalers.
text_locales.fil: Ipinapakita ng day-two telemetry ang 13,800 published skills (+21%) at 891K installs; umaakyat ang Mythos-class auto-quarantines sa 22 na walo ay mula sa JPMorgan, Booz Allen, at Mandiant tenants. Pumipirma ang Lockheed, Northrop, at Palo Alto Unit 42 sa ethics-rider, itinataas ang gated cohort sa 41. Pinapalawak ng weekend interop updates ng Microsoft Foundry, AWS Bedrock, at Google Vertex ang signed-skill provenance sa lahat ng tatlong hyperscalers.

bridges.text: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship managed Skill Catalog, Agent Registry preview, and Agent Governance Center inside 24 hours of the May 7 Anthropic + OpenAI launch. Anthropic posts day-one telemetry of 11,400 skills published, 612K installs, and 38 enterprise opt-ins under the Mythos Preview rider — the >=1 hyperscaler-managed-tier landing condition is overshot.

text_locales.en: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship managed Skill Catalog, Agent Registry preview, and Agent Governance Center inside 24 hours of the May 7 Anthropic + OpenAI launch. Anthropic posts day-one telemetry of 11,400 skills published, 612K installs, and 38 enterprise opt-ins under the Mythos Preview rider — the >=1 hyperscaler-managed-tier landing condition is overshot.
text_locales.ja: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry、AWS Bedrock、Google Cloud Vertex AIは、5月7日のAnthropic + OpenAIローンチから24時間以内に、managed Skill Catalog、Agent Registry preview、Agent Governance Centerを出荷する。Anthropicは初日テレメトリとして、公開スキル11,400件、インストール612K件、Mythos Preview riderの下での38件のエンタープライズopt-inを投稿する — ハイパースケーラ管理層の≥1着地条件を超過達成する。
text_locales.es: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock y Google Cloud Vertex AI envian Skill Catalog gestionado, Agent Registry preview y Agent Governance Center dentro de las 24 horas del lanzamiento Anthropic + OpenAI del 7 de mayo. Anthropic publica telemetria del primer dia: 11,400 skills publicadas, 612K installs y 38 enterprise opt-ins bajo el rider Mythos Preview — la condicion de aterrizaje >=1 hyperscaler-managed-tier es sobrepasada.
text_locales.fil: Ang Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, at Google Cloud Vertex AI ay nagpapadala ng managed Skill Catalog, Agent Registry preview, at Agent Governance Center sa loob ng 24 oras ng May 7 Anthropic + OpenAI launch. Nag-post ang Anthropic ng day-one telemetry: 11,400 skills na inilathala, 612K installs, at 38 enterprise opt-ins sa ilalim ng Mythos Preview rider — lumampas sa >=1 hyperscaler-managed-tier landing condition.

detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 7 dual-registry landing — Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 shipping a sandboxed-skill registry that signs and version-pins shareable agent skills with per-tenant Mythos Preview gating tied to AISI cyber-eval results (Project Glasswing extension), and OpenAI graduating the May-1 Codex CLI /goal feature into a /agent command with explicit Plan-Apply two-phase execution alongside ChatGPT Enterprise's per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate authorization + SOC-2 Type II scope expansion to cover the agent registry + audit ledger — combined with the May 7 CISA KEV-catalog addition of n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare), the same-day LangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF (CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 auth-bypass (CVSS 8.8) disclosure pair, the +34%/4-week MCP-server exposure compounding (~9,400 internet-exposed servers, ~58% with no authorization controls), and the May 7 Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection module GA forces enterprise procurement RFPs to name a signed-skill registry + per-tenant capability gating + per-org audit-ledger triple as a baseline requirement for any agentic-AI orchestrator entering the enterprise tier. The forcing function is that the dual-registry shape now spans both major frontier labs and is reinforced by hyperscaler-side telemetry (Defender XDR for MCP) within the same disclosure window — enterprise CISOs and procurement teams adopt the registry-first posture as the operational answer to the n8n KEV catalog + LangGraph/LiteLLM CVE pair. The shape is most likely an explicit RFP control family naming sandboxed-skill registry + per-tenant Mythos-class capability gating + per-org audit ledger, not a generic "AI governance" line item. Hyperscaler-managed registry tiers (Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex) ship parallel offerings within the same window to avoid being the lone hold-out without a contractual control plane.
