detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **By H2 2026 the Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training with 20% less VRAM and 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — combined with the SGLang 29% throughput advantage on H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared with vLLM at ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support for MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + the Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) makes consumer-GPU training operationally equivalent to enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; expect ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI) to ship a managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier with managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool to close the consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap before AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Forcing function is the procurement-friction asymmetry: enterprises with internal Unsloth pilots already see 70%-VRAM-reduction economics on consumer GPUs, but enterprise security + governance demands a managed control plane that the open-source CLI doesn't provide; whichever hyperscaler ships first absorbs the migration. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI all have the runtime substrate; the missing piece is the fine-tuning-as-a-service surface that unifies the open-source kernel performance with managed-IAM enterprise governance. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年下半期までに、Unsloth 2026アップデートの波 — 12倍高速MoE学習 + 超ロングコンテキスト強化学習 + 1.8〜3.3倍高速 embedding / BERT / 分類器学習でVRAM 20%削減 + コンテキスト2倍長(Hugging Face共同エンジニアリング) + Unsloth Studio 3月17日 100%オフラインGGUF + Safetensorsランタイム + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garageファインチューニング・ガイド(RTXラップトップ性能2.5倍向上) — がSGLangのH100上での29%スループット優位(RadixAttentionプレフィックスキャッシュをvLLMと共有、約16,200 vs 約12,500 tok/s) + SGLangのMiMo-V2-Flash、Nemotron 3 Nano、Mistral Large 3、LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion、MiniMax M2へのday-0サポート + 4月28日〜5月3日のKVキャッシュarxiv波(SideQuest、DepthKV、KVFundaBench)と組み合わさり、コンシューマーGPU学習をエンタープライズGPU 2024ベースラインと運用上同等にする。1社以上のハイパースケーラー(AWS Bedrock fine-tuning、Azure AI Foundry、またはGoogle Vertex AI)が、コンシューマーGPU → エンタープライズ・ファインチューニング間のギャップを埋めるため、AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Igniteのサイクルまでに、マネージド・ランタイム + IAM + 監査 + コスト最適化GPUプールを伴うマネージドUnsloth-as-a-serviceティアを出荷することが期待される。** 強制関数は調達摩擦の非対称性: 内部Unslothパイロットを持つ企業はコンシューマーGPUで既にVRAM 70%削減の経済性を得ているが、エンタープライズのセキュリティ + ガバナンス要件には、オープンソースCLIでは提供できないマネージド・コントロールプレーンが必要となる。最初に出荷したハイパースケーラーが移行需要を吸収する。Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AIはいずれもランタイム基盤を持っており、欠けているピースは、オープンソースカーネル性能とマネージドIAMエンタープライズ・ガバナンスを統合するファインチューニング・アズ・ア・サービスのサーフェスである。In plain language: ローカルLLM学習は今や2倍高速でVRAMも70%少なくて済む — 近いうちに大手クラウドがそれをマネージドサービスとして貸し出すだろう。In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para H2 2026, la ola de actualización Unsloth 2026 — entrenamiento MoE 12x más rápido + Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo + entrenamiento de embedding / BERT / clasificador 1.8-3.3x más rápido con 20% menos VRAM y contexto 2x más largo (ingeniería conjunta con Hugging Face) + Unsloth Studio del 17 de marzo con runtime GGUF + Safetensors 100% offline + guía de fine-tuning RTX-AI Garage de NVIDIA DGX Spark (rendimiento de portátil RTX hasta 2.5x) — combinado con la ventaja de rendimiento del 29% de SGLang en H100 (caché de prefijo RadixAttention compartido con vLLM en ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + soporte day-0 de SGLang para MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + la ola arxiv KV-cache del 28 de abril al 3 de mayo (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) hace que el entrenamiento en GPU de consumo sea operativamente equivalente a la línea base de GPU empresarial de 2024; se espera que ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) entregue un nivel gestionado de Unsloth-as-a-service con runtime gestionado + IAM + auditoría + pool de GPU optimizado en costo para cerrar la brecha entre fine-tuning en GPU de consumo → empresarial antes de los ciclos de AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite.** La función forzante es la asimetría de fricción de adquisición: las empresas con pilotos internos de Unsloth ya ven la economía de reducción del 70% de VRAM en GPUs de consumo, pero la seguridad + gobernanza empresarial demanda un plano de control gestionado que el CLI open-source no proporciona; el hyperscaler que entregue primero absorbe la migración. Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI tienen todos el sustrato de runtime; la pieza que falta es la superficie de fine-tuning-as-a-service que unifica el rendimiento del kernel open-source con la gobernanza empresarial de IAM gestionada. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang Unsloth 2026 update wave — 12x faster MoE training + ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning + 1.8-3.3x faster embedding / BERT / classifier training na may 20% less VRAM at 2x longer context (joint Hugging Face engineering) + Unsloth Studio Mar 17 100%-offline GGUF + Safetensors runtime + NVIDIA DGX Spark RTX-AI Garage fine-tuning guide (RTX-laptop performance up 2.5x) — pinagsama sa SGLang 29% throughput advantage sa H100 (RadixAttention prefix-cache shared sa vLLM sa ~16,200 vs ~12,500 tok/s) + day-0 SGLang support para sa MiMo-V2-Flash, Nemotron 3 Nano, Mistral Large 3, LLaDA 2.0 Diffusion, MiniMax M2 + ang Apr 28-May 3 KV-cache arxiv wave (SideQuest, DepthKV, KVFundaBench) ay ginagawang operationally equivalent ang consumer-GPU training sa enterprise-GPU 2024-baseline; inaasahan na ≥1 hyperscaler (AWS Bedrock fine-tuning, Azure AI Foundry, o Google Vertex AI) ang magpapadala ng managed Unsloth-as-a-service tier na may managed-runtime + IAM + audit + cost-optimized GPU pool upang isara ang consumer-GPU → enterprise-fine-tuning gap bago ang AWS re:Invent / Microsoft Ignite cycles.** Ang forcing function ay ang procurement-friction asymmetry: ang mga enterprises na may panloob na Unsloth pilots ay nakakita na ng 70%-VRAM-reduction economics sa consumer GPUs, ngunit ang enterprise security + governance ay humihingi ng managed control plane na hindi maibibigay ng open-source CLI; sinumang hyperscaler ang unang magpapadala ay sumusubsob sa migration. Ang Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Google Vertex AI ay lahat may runtime substrate; ang nawawalang piraso ay ang fine-tuning-as-a-service surface na nagbubuklod sa open-source kernel performance sa managed-IAM enterprise governance. In plain language: Local-LLM training is now twice as fast and uses 70% less VRAM — soon big clouds will rent that out as a managed service. In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — the Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint reporting 71-78% recovery of full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy at 8-13% of training-step time and 11-16% of peak VRAM across a four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), Unsloth's same-day production recipes for Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 on a 96GB workstation, and Mixtral 8x22B for sovereign-cloud customers, the parallel DeepMind preprint on router-aware advantage decomposition closing the long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap that previously kept router-only mode out of ultra-long-context training, and Cerebras's CS-4 engineering-sample announcement explicitly naming Mixture-of-Experts router-only training plus ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning as the target workload — together force the router-only adaptation mode out of the Unsloth-specific category and into the default fine-tuning recipe shipped by every major training stack inside the same calendar window. The structural force is that the four-model ablation gives downstream framework maintainers a published parity baseline they can target without re-running the search, and the DeepMind stability proof removes the last operational reason to keep training all expert weights for a router-shaped objective. The most likely shape is a router-only adapter type added as a first-class option in Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Meta's torchtune, with default recipe templates targeting at least the Llama, Qwen, and Mixtral families; sovereign-cloud customers and on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers adopt it first because the VRAM reduction is the only path to single-node tuning of Behemoth-class MoE models. Bear case is a competing scaling-law preprint showing the accuracy gap widens past 200B parameters and forcing a hybrid mode; absent that, Q4 2026 lands router-only as the documented default across the cohort.

The structural force is that the four-model ablation gives downstream framework maintainers a published parity baseline they can target without re-running the search, and the DeepMind stability proof removes the last operational reason to keep training all expert weights for a router-shaped objective. The most likely shape is a router-only adapter type added as a first-class option in Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Meta's torchtune, with default recipe templates targeting at least the Llama, Qwen, and Mixtral families; sovereign-cloud customers and on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers adopt it first because the VRAM reduction is the only path to single-node tuning of Behemoth-class MoE models. description.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月8日のルーター・オンリーLoRA収束—UnslothとHugging Faceの共著arxivプレプリントが4モデル(Qwen3.6-Max、Mixtral 8x22B、DBRX、Kimi K2.6)アブレーションでフルLoRA-on-experts精度の71-78%を学習ステップ時間8-13%・ピークVRAM 11-16%で回復したと報告、Unsloth同日のLlama 4 Behemothシングルノード・チューニング、96GBワークステーションでのKimi K2.6、ソブリン・クラウド顧客向けMixtral 8x22Bの本番レシピ、ルーター認識アドバンテージ分解に関する並行DeepMindプレプリントが、これまでルーター・オンリー・モードを超長コンテキスト学習から締め出していた長コンテキストReinforcement Learning安定性ギャップを解消、CerebrasのCS-4エンジニアリング・サンプル発表がMixture-of-Expertsルーター・オンリー学習と超長コンテキストReinforcement Learningをターゲット・ワークロードとして明示的に命名—が、ルーター・オンリー適応モードをUnsloth固有のカテゴリーから押し出し、同一カレンダー・ウィンドウ内であらゆる主要学習スタックが出荷するデフォルト・ファインチューニング・レシピへと変える。構造的な力学は、4モデル・アブレーションがダウンストリームのフレームワーク・メンテナにサーチを再実行せずにターゲットできる公開済みパリティ・ベースラインを与え、DeepMindの安定性証明がルーター形状の目的関数のためにすべてのエキスパート重みを学習し続ける最後の運用上の理由を取り除くことにある。最も可能性の高い形状は、Hugging Face PEFT、NVIDIA NeMo、Microsoft DeepSpeed、Metaのtorchtuneにファーストクラスのオプションとして追加されるルーター・オンリー・アダプタ・タイプであり、少なくともLlama、Qwen、Mixtralファミリーをターゲットとするデフォルト・レシピ・テンプレートを伴う;ソブリン・クラウド顧客とオンプレRTX 6000 Adaワークステーション層のバイヤーが、VRAM削減がBehemothクラスMoEモデルのシングルノード・チューニングへの唯一の道であるため最初に採用する。ベアケースは、200Bパラメータ超で精度ギャップが拡大しハイブリッド・モードを強制する競合スケーリング則プレプリントが登場すること;それがなければ、2026年Q4にはコホート全体でドキュメント化されたデフォルトとしてルーター・オンリーが着地する。
description.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia LoRA solo-router del 8 de mayo — el preprint conjunto en arxiv de Unsloth + Hugging Face reportando 71-78% de recuperación de la precisión de full-LoRA-en-expertos al 8-13% del tiempo de paso de entrenamiento y al 11-16% del VRAM pico a través de una ablación de cuatro modelos (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), las recetas de producción del mismo día de Unsloth para tuning de Llama 4 Behemoth en nodo único, Kimi K2.6 en una workstation de 96GB, y Mixtral 8x22B para clientes sovereign-cloud, el preprint paralelo de DeepMind sobre descomposición de ventaja consciente del router cerrando la brecha de estabilidad de Reinforcement Learning de contexto largo que previamente mantenía el modo solo-router fuera del entrenamiento de contexto ultra-largo, y el anuncio de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras nombrando explícitamente el entrenamiento solo-router de Mixture-of-Experts más Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo como la carga de trabajo objetivo — juntos fuerzan al modo de adaptación solo-router fuera de la categoría específica de Unsloth y hacia la receta por defecto de fine-tuning enviada por cada stack importante de entrenamiento dentro de la misma ventana calendario. La fuerza estructural es que la ablación de cuatro modelos da a los mantenedores de frameworks downstream una línea base de paridad publicada que pueden apuntar sin re-ejecutar la búsqueda, y la prueba de estabilidad de DeepMind elimina la última razón operacional para mantener el entrenamiento de todos los pesos de expertos para un objetivo con forma de router. La forma más probable es un tipo de adaptador solo-router agregado como opción de primera clase en Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, y torchtune de Meta, con plantillas de receta por defecto apuntando al menos a las familias Llama, Qwen y Mixtral; los clientes sovereign-cloud y los compradores del nivel workstation on-prem RTX 6000 Ada lo adoptan primero porque la reducción de VRAM es la única ruta hacia tuning de nodo único de modelos MoE clase Behemoth. El caso bajista es un preprint de scaling-law competidor mostrando que la brecha de precisión se ensancha más allá de 200B parámetros y forzando un modo híbrido; sin eso, Q4 2026 aterriza solo-router como el por defecto documentado en toda la cohorte.
description.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — ang Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint na nag-uulat ng 71-78% recovery ng full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy sa 8-13% ng training-step time at 11-16% ng peak VRAM sa isang four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), ang same-day production recipes ng Unsloth para sa Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 sa isang 96GB workstation, at Mixtral 8x22B para sa sovereign-cloud customers, ang parallel DeepMind preprint sa router-aware advantage decomposition na nagsasara sa long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap na dating naglalayo sa router-only mode mula sa ultra-long-context training, at ang CS-4 engineering-sample announcement ng Cerebras na hayagang pinapangalanan ang Mixture-of-Experts router-only training kasama ang ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning bilang target workload — ay magkasamang pumipilit sa router-only adaptation mode na lumabas sa Unsloth-specific category at pumasok bilang default fine-tuning recipe na ina-ship ng bawat major training stack sa loob ng parehong calendar window. Ang structural force ay ang four-model ablation ay nagbibigay sa downstream framework maintainers ng published parity baseline na pwedeng targetin nang hindi muling ina-i-rerun ang search, at ang DeepMind stability proof ay nag-aalis sa huling operational reason para i-train ang lahat ng expert weights para sa isang router-shaped objective. Ang most likely shape ay isang router-only adapter type na idinaragdag bilang first-class option sa Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, at Meta torchtune, na may default recipe templates na nakatutok man lamang sa Llama, Qwen, at Mixtral families; mauuna ang sovereign-cloud customers at on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers sa pag-adopt dahil ang VRAM reduction ay ang tanging path sa single-node tuning ng Behemoth-class MoE models. Ang bear case ay isang competing scaling-law preprint na nagpapakitang lumalawak ang accuracy gap lampas sa 200B parameters at pinipilit ang isang hybrid mode; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa router-only bilang documented default sa kabuuan ng cohort.

plain_language.en: Researchers showed you can fine-tune giant Mixture-of-Experts models by training just the router, and major training tools will copy that shortcut.
plain_language.ja: 研究者はルーターだけを学習させて巨大なMixture-of-Expertsモデルをファインチューニングできることを示し、主要な学習ツールはこのショートカットを真似ることになる。
plain_language.es: Investigadores mostraron que se pueden afinar modelos gigantes Mixture-of-Experts entrenando solo el router, y las herramientas principales de entrenamiento copiarán ese atajo.
plain_language.fil: Ipinakita ng mga researcher na pwede mong i-fine-tune ang malalaking Mixture-of-Experts models sa pamamagitan lamang ng pag-train sa router, at kokopyahin ng major training tools ang shortcut na ito.

title_locales.en: Router-only LoRA lands as default MoE fine-tuning recipe by Q4 2026
title_locales.ja: ルーター・オンリーLoRAが2026年Q4までにMoEファインチューニングのデフォルト・レシピとして着地
title_locales.es: LoRA solo-router aterriza como receta por defecto de fine-tuning de MoE para Q4 2026
title_locales.fil: Lalapag ang router-only LoRA bilang default na MoE fine-tuning recipe bago ang Q4 2026

detail.summary_short: A May 8 Unsloth + Hugging Face arxiv preprint shows router-only LoRA recovers 71-78% accuracy at 11-16% VRAM across four MoE models. DeepMind ships a long-context stability proof; Cerebras CS-4 targets the workload. By Q4 2026 router-only adapters ship as default MoE fine-tuning recipe.

summary_short_locales.en: A May 8 Unsloth + Hugging Face arxiv preprint shows router-only LoRA recovers 71-78% accuracy at 11-16% VRAM across four MoE models. DeepMind ships a long-context stability proof; Cerebras CS-4 targets the workload. By Q4 2026 router-only adapters ship as default MoE fine-tuning recipe.
summary_short_locales.ja: 5月8日のUnsloth + Hugging Face共著arxivプレプリントが、4 MoEモデル全体でルーター・オンリーLoRAが精度71-78%をVRAM 11-16%で回復することを示す。DeepMindが長コンテキスト安定性証明を出荷、Cerebras CS-4が当該ワークロードをターゲット。2026年Q4までにルーター・オンリー・アダプタがデフォルトMoEファインチューニング・レシピとして出荷される。
summary_short_locales.es: Un preprint en arxiv de Unsloth + Hugging Face del 8 de mayo muestra que LoRA solo-router recupera 71-78% de precisión al 11-16% de VRAM en cuatro modelos MoE. DeepMind lanza una prueba de estabilidad de contexto largo; el CS-4 de Cerebras apunta a la carga de trabajo. Para Q4 2026 los adaptadores solo-router se envían como receta por defecto de fine-tuning de MoE.
summary_short_locales.fil: Isang May 8 Unsloth + Hugging Face arxiv preprint ang nagpapakitang ang router-only LoRA ay nakaka-recover ng 71-78% accuracy sa 11-16% VRAM sa apat na MoE models. Naglathala ang DeepMind ng long-context stability proof; tinatarget ng Cerebras CS-4 ang workload. Bago ang Q4 2026, ina-ship ang router-only adapters bilang default na MoE fine-tuning recipe.

bridges.text: Unsloth's seventh refinement track lands an octa-Hopper kernel-fused tensor-parallel router-attention pass with a further 9 percent step-time reduction, INT4 ONNX paths into AMD MI350/MI450 plus Apple M5 Ultra, and a DeepSeek R3 Pro 38B MoE recipe at 5 percent VRAM on dual-RTX 6000 Ada; the fifth Hacker News Mac Studio reproduction plus arxiv 2605.05844v7 densify commodity-tier accessibility.

text_locales.en: Unsloth's seventh refinement track lands an octa-Hopper kernel-fused tensor-parallel router-attention pass with a further 9 percent step-time reduction, INT4 ONNX paths into AMD MI350/MI450 plus Apple M5 Ultra, and a DeepSeek R3 Pro 38B MoE recipe at 5 percent VRAM on dual-RTX 6000 Ada; the fifth Hacker News Mac Studio reproduction plus arxiv 2605.05844v7 densify commodity-tier accessibility.
text_locales.ja: Unsloth社の第7改良トラックは、8基Hopper構成上でカーネルフュージョン型テンソル並列ルータアテンションを実現してステップ時間をさらに9%短縮し、AMD MI350/MI450とApple M5 Ultraへ向けたINT4 ONNX経路、そしてデュアルRTX 6000 AdaでVRAM 5%を達成するDeepSeek R3 Pro 38B MoEレシピを着地させた。Hacker News第5の再現報告であるMac Studio事例と、arxiv 2605.05844v7の登場が、コモディティ層でのアクセシビリティをさらに濃密にしている。
text_locales.es: La séptima vía de refinamiento de Unsloth aterriza una pasada de atención del router con paralelismo tensorial fusionado en kernel octa-Hopper con una reducción adicional del 9 por ciento en el tiempo por paso, rutas INT4 ONNX hacia AMD MI350/MI450 más Apple M5 Ultra, y una receta DeepSeek R3 Pro 38B MoE al 5 por ciento de VRAM en dual-RTX 6000 Ada; la quinta reproducción en Hacker News con Mac Studio más arxiv 2605.05844v7 densifican la accesibilidad de nivel commodity.
text_locales.fil: Inihahatid ng pampitong refinement track ng Unsloth ang isang octa-Hopper kernel-fused tensor-parallel router-attention pass na may karagdagang 9 porsyentong pagbawas sa step-time, mga INT4 ONNX path patungo sa AMD MI350/MI450 kasama ang Apple M5 Ultra, at isang DeepSeek R3 Pro 38B MoE recipe sa 5 porsyentong VRAM sa dual-RTX 6000 Ada; ang ikalimang Hacker News Mac Studio reproduction kasama ang arxiv 2605.05844v7 ay nagpapatibay sa commodity-tier accessibility.

bridges.text: On the router-only LoRA default Mixture-of-Experts recipe prediction (May 8): Sunday's Hacker News write-up documents a successful Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA run on a dual RTX 5090 workstation at 64GB combined VRAM via NCCL, reporting 12 percent peak combined VRAM and 74 percent accuracy recovery on in-domain finance-news classification. Unsloth's Sunday changelog adds a multi-GPU NCCL backend for consumer dual-GPU workstation tiers, an ONNX inference export path, and a Triton kernel cutting router-attention latency by 22 percent on Llama 4 Behemoth and Kimi K2.6. DeepMind's v3 addendum (arxiv 2605.05844v3) closes the long-context RL stability gap on the same dual-5090 reference setup up to 96K tokens.

text_locales.en: On the router-only LoRA default Mixture-of-Experts recipe prediction (May 8): Sunday's Hacker News write-up documents a successful Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA run on a dual RTX 5090 workstation at 64GB combined VRAM via NCCL, reporting 12 percent peak combined VRAM and 74 percent accuracy recovery on in-domain finance-news classification. Unsloth's Sunday changelog adds a multi-GPU NCCL backend for consumer dual-GPU workstation tiers, an ONNX inference export path, and a Triton kernel cutting router-attention latency by 22 percent on Llama 4 Behemoth and Kimi K2.6. DeepMind's v3 addendum (arxiv 2605.05844v3) closes the long-context RL stability gap on the same dual-5090 reference setup up to 96K tokens.
text_locales.ja: ルーター・オンリーLoRAデフォルトMixture-of-Expertsレシピ予測(5月8日)について: 日曜のHacker NewsライトアップはNCCL経由64GB合算VRAMでのデュアル RTX 5090ワークステーション上のMixtral 8x22Bルーター・オンリーLoRA実行成功を文書化し、12パーセントピーク合算VRAMとドメイン内ファイナンス・ニュース分類上の74パーセント精度回復を報告。Unslothの日曜チェンジログはコンシューマー・デュアルGPUワークステーション・ティア向けマルチGPU NCCLバックエンド、ONNXインファレンス・エクスポート・パス、Llama 4 BehemothとKimi K2.6上でルーター・アテンション・レイテンシを22パーセント削減するTritonカーネルを追加。DeepMindのv3追補(arxiv 2605.05844v3)は同じデュアル-5090リファレンス・セットアップ上で96Kトークンまでロング・コンテキストRL安定性ギャップを閉じる。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de router-only LoRA como receta default de Mixture-of-Experts (8 de mayo): el writeup dominical de Hacker News documenta una corrida exitosa de Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA en una workstation dual RTX 5090 a 64GB combinada de VRAM vía NCCL, reportando 12 por ciento de pico de VRAM combinada y 74 por ciento de recuperación de precisión en clasificación in-domain de noticias financieras. El changelog dominical de Unsloth añade un backend multi-GPU NCCL para tiers de workstation dual-GPU de consumidor, una ruta de exportación de inferencia ONNX, y un kernel Triton recortando la latencia router-attention en 22 por ciento en Llama 4 Behemoth y Kimi K2.6. El addendum v3 de DeepMind (arxiv 2605.05844v3) cierra la brecha de estabilidad RL de contexto largo en la misma configuración de referencia dual-5090 hasta 96K tokens.
text_locales.fil: Sa router-only LoRA default Mixture-of-Experts recipe prediction (Mayo 8): idinodokumento ng Sunday Hacker News write-up ang matagumpay na Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA run sa isang dual RTX 5090 workstation sa 64GB combined VRAM sa pamamagitan ng NCCL, na nag-uulat ng 12 porsiyento peak combined VRAM at 74 porsiyento accuracy recovery sa in-domain finance-news classification. Idinaragdag ng Sunday changelog ng Unsloth ang multi-GPU NCCL backend para sa consumer dual-GPU workstation tiers, isang ONNX inference export path, at isang Triton kernel na pinuputol ang router-attention latency ng 22 porsiyento sa Llama 4 Behemoth at Kimi K2.6. Isinasara ng DeepMind's v3 addendum (arxiv 2605.05844v3) ang long-context RL stability gap sa parehong dual-5090 reference setup hanggang 96K tokens.

detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — the Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint reporting 71-78% recovery of full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy at 8-13% of training-step time and 11-16% of peak VRAM across a four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), Unsloth's same-day production recipes for Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 on a 96GB workstation, and Mixtral 8x22B for sovereign-cloud customers, the parallel DeepMind preprint on router-aware advantage decomposition closing the long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap that previously kept router-only mode out of ultra-long-context training, and Cerebras's CS-4 engineering-sample announcement explicitly naming Mixture-of-Experts router-only training plus ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning as the target workload — together force the router-only adaptation mode out of the Unsloth-specific category and into the default fine-tuning recipe shipped by every major training stack inside the same calendar window. The structural force is that the four-model ablation gives downstream framework maintainers a published parity baseline they can target without re-running the search, and the DeepMind stability proof removes the last operational reason to keep training all expert weights for a router-shaped objective. The most likely shape is a router-only adapter type added as a first-class option in Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Meta's torchtune, with default recipe templates targeting at least the Llama, Qwen, and Mixtral families; sovereign-cloud customers and on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers adopt it first because the VRAM reduction is the only path to single-node tuning of Behemoth-class MoE models. Bear case is a competing scaling-law preprint showing the accuracy gap widens past 200B parameters and forcing a hybrid mode; absent that, Q4 2026 lands router-only as the documented default across the cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月8日のルーター・オンリーLoRA収束—UnslothとHugging Faceの共著arxivプレプリントが4モデル(Qwen3.6-Max、Mixtral 8x22B、DBRX、Kimi K2.6)アブレーションでフルLoRA-on-experts精度の71-78%を学習ステップ時間8-13%・ピークVRAM 11-16%で回復したと報告、Unsloth同日のLlama 4 Behemothシングルノード・チューニング、96GBワークステーションでのKimi K2.6、ソブリン・クラウド顧客向けMixtral 8x22Bの本番レシピ、ルーター認識アドバンテージ分解に関する並行DeepMindプレプリントが、これまでルーター・オンリー・モードを超長コンテキスト学習から締め出していた長コンテキストReinforcement Learning安定性ギャップを解消、CerebrasのCS-4エンジニアリング・サンプル発表がMixture-of-Expertsルーター・オンリー学習と超長コンテキストReinforcement Learningをターゲット・ワークロードとして明示的に命名—が、ルーター・オンリー適応モードをUnsloth固有のカテゴリーから押し出し、同一カレンダー・ウィンドウ内であらゆる主要学習スタックが出荷するデフォルト・ファインチューニング・レシピへと変える。構造的な力学は、4モデル・アブレーションがダウンストリームのフレームワーク・メンテナにサーチを再実行せずにターゲットできる公開済みパリティ・ベースラインを与え、DeepMindの安定性証明がルーター形状の目的関数のためにすべてのエキスパート重みを学習し続ける最後の運用上の理由を取り除くことにある。最も可能性の高い形状は、Hugging Face PEFT、NVIDIA NeMo、Microsoft DeepSpeed、Metaのtorchtuneにファーストクラスのオプションとして追加されるルーター・オンリー・アダプタ・タイプであり、少なくともLlama、Qwen、Mixtralファミリーをターゲットとするデフォルト・レシピ・テンプレートを伴う;ソブリン・クラウド顧客とオンプレRTX 6000 Adaワークステーション層のバイヤーが、VRAM削減がBehemothクラスMoEモデルのシングルノード・チューニングへの唯一の道であるため最初に採用する。ベアケースは、200Bパラメータ超で精度ギャップが拡大しハイブリッド・モードを強制する競合スケーリング則プレプリントが登場すること;それがなければ、2026年Q4にはコホート全体でドキュメント化されたデフォルトとしてルーター・オンリーが着地する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia LoRA solo-router del 8 de mayo — el preprint conjunto en arxiv de Unsloth + Hugging Face reportando 71-78% de recuperación de la precisión de full-LoRA-en-expertos al 8-13% del tiempo de paso de entrenamiento y al 11-16% del VRAM pico a través de una ablación de cuatro modelos (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), las recetas de producción del mismo día de Unsloth para tuning de Llama 4 Behemoth en nodo único, Kimi K2.6 en una workstation de 96GB, y Mixtral 8x22B para clientes sovereign-cloud, el preprint paralelo de DeepMind sobre descomposición de ventaja consciente del router cerrando la brecha de estabilidad de Reinforcement Learning de contexto largo que previamente mantenía el modo solo-router fuera del entrenamiento de contexto ultra-largo, y el anuncio de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras nombrando explícitamente el entrenamiento solo-router de Mixture-of-Experts más Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo como la carga de trabajo objetivo — juntos fuerzan al modo de adaptación solo-router fuera de la categoría específica de Unsloth y hacia la receta por defecto de fine-tuning enviada por cada stack importante de entrenamiento dentro de la misma ventana calendario. La fuerza estructural es que la ablación de cuatro modelos da a los mantenedores de frameworks downstream una línea base de paridad publicada que pueden apuntar sin re-ejecutar la búsqueda, y la prueba de estabilidad de DeepMind elimina la última razón operacional para mantener el entrenamiento de todos los pesos de expertos para un objetivo con forma de router. La forma más probable es un tipo de adaptador solo-router agregado como opción de primera clase en Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, y torchtune de Meta, con plantillas de receta por defecto apuntando al menos a las familias Llama, Qwen y Mixtral; los clientes sovereign-cloud y los compradores del nivel workstation on-prem RTX 6000 Ada lo adoptan primero porque la reducción de VRAM es la única ruta hacia tuning de nodo único de modelos MoE clase Behemoth. El caso bajista es un preprint de scaling-law competidor mostrando que la brecha de precisión se ensancha más allá de 200B parámetros y forzando un modo híbrido; sin eso, Q4 2026 aterriza solo-router como el por defecto documentado en toda la cohorte.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — ang Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint na nag-uulat ng 71-78% recovery ng full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy sa 8-13% ng training-step time at 11-16% ng peak VRAM sa isang four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), ang same-day production recipes ng Unsloth para sa Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 sa isang 96GB workstation, at Mixtral 8x22B para sa sovereign-cloud customers, ang parallel DeepMind preprint sa router-aware advantage decomposition na nagsasara sa long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap na dating naglalayo sa router-only mode mula sa ultra-long-context training, at ang CS-4 engineering-sample announcement ng Cerebras na hayagang pinapangalanan ang Mixture-of-Experts router-only training kasama ang ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning bilang target workload — ay magkasamang pumipilit sa router-only adaptation mode na lumabas sa Unsloth-specific category at pumasok bilang default fine-tuning recipe na ina-ship ng bawat major training stack sa loob ng parehong calendar window. Ang structural force ay ang four-model ablation ay nagbibigay sa downstream framework maintainers ng published parity baseline na pwedeng targetin nang hindi muling ina-i-rerun ang search, at ang DeepMind stability proof ay nag-aalis sa huling operational reason para i-train ang lahat ng expert weights para sa isang router-shaped objective. Ang most likely shape ay isang router-only adapter type na idinaragdag bilang first-class option sa Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, at Meta torchtune, na may default recipe templates na nakatutok man lamang sa Llama, Qwen, at Mixtral families; mauuna ang sovereign-cloud customers at on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers sa pag-adopt dahil ang VRAM reduction ay ang tanging path sa single-node tuning ng Behemoth-class MoE models. Ang bear case ay isang competing scaling-law preprint na nagpapakitang lumalawak ang accuracy gap lampas sa 200B parameters at pinipilit ang isang hybrid mode; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa router-only bilang documented default sa kabuuan ng cohort.

nodes.title: Disaggregated prefill ships as vLLM and SGLang serving default by Q4 2026
nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence forces prefill/decode disaggregation out of the Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture and into the documented default serving mode shipped by vLLM and SGLang at the H100 and L40S tiers. The catalysts landing across a single weekend cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: vLLM v0.11.1 ships a disaggregated-prefill mode that, per Cloudflare Infire engineering's Saturday benchmark note, reaches parity with the production Infire edge architecture on prefill throughput at the H100 tier, with Infire retaining only a 1.4x advantage at the L40S edge tier on decode-side latency rather than the order-of-magnitude gap that previously kept disaggregation out of the open-source serving stack; the Yotta Labs benchmark refresh holds the canonical shared-prefix workload at approximately 14,650 tok/s on vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk, narrowing the throughput gap to a level where the architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) dominates the remaining delta; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ships a parallel architectural primitive in the form of RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse delivering a 2.1x speedup on tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, demonstrating that the radix-tree cache substrate generalizes from prefix sharing to tool-call result sharing; and Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up on SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus the v0.11.1 patch for the prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 disclosed Friday convert the security narrative from a blocker to a documented disclosure-timeline pattern. The structural force is that once Cloudflare Infire engineering publishes a benchmark showing parity at the H100 tier between its production edge architecture and an open-source serving stack's disaggregated mode, downstream framework maintainers can cite the production-comparable benchmark rather than ship monolithic-mode defaults, and the SGLang radix-tree cache substrate gives a parallel architectural lineage that converges on the same shape. The most likely shape is a disaggregated-prefill/decode mode added as the documented default in the vLLM v0.12 and SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, with per-tier deployment templates targeting H100 single-node and L40S edge-tier topology, plus a Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness gating the production-readiness claim. Sovereign-cloud and on-prem agentic-AI workloads adopt it first because the tool-result-cache reuse substrate compounds the latency win for long tool-call chains. Bear case is a competing serving-stack architecture refusing the disaggregation split and forking the benchmark methodology; absent that, Q4 2026 lands disaggregated prefill as the documented default across the open-source serving cohort.

description.ja: Q4 2026までに、5月9日のディスアグリゲート・プリフィル収束は、プリフィル/デコード・ディスアグリゲーションをCloudflare-Infire特有のエッジ・アーキテクチャから押し出し、vLLMとSGLangがH100およびL40S層で出荷する文書化されたデフォルト・サービング・モードへと移行させる。単一の週末サイクルで着地する触媒は具体的かつ相互強化的である: vLLM v0.11.1はディスアグリゲート・プリフィル・モードを出荷し、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングの土曜ベンチマーク・ノートによれば、H100層でのプリフィル・スループットにおいて本番Infireエッジ・アーキテクチャと同等水準に達し、Infireはデコード側レイテンシでL40Sエッジ層に1.4倍の優位を残すのみで、これまでディスアグリゲーションをオープンソース・サービング・スタックから遠ざけていた桁違いのギャップは解消された;Yotta Labsのベンチマーク・リフレッシュは、正準共有プレフィックス・ワークロードをvLLMで約14,650 tok/s、SGLang RadixArkで17,300 tok/sに維持し、スループット・ギャップを、残るデルタをアーキテクチャ選択(モノリシック対ディスアグリゲート)が支配する水準まで狭める;SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4は並行的なアーキテクチャ・プリミティブを、RadixAttention対応のツール結果キャッシュ再利用としてエージェンティック・ワークロードに対し2.1倍の高速化として出荷し、ラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤がプレフィックス共有からツールコール結果共有へと一般化することを実証する;そしてTrail of BitsのSGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567(CVSS 8.1の認証済みサーバーサイド・テンプレート・インジェクション)に対する完全レッドチーム・ライトアップに加え、金曜開示のプレフィックス・キャッシュ汚染CVE-2026-44512に対するv0.11.1パッチが、セキュリティ・ナラティブをブロッカーから文書化された開示タイムライン・パターンへと変える。構造的な力は、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングが本番エッジ・アーキテクチャとオープンソース・サービング・スタックのディスアグリゲート・モードの間でH100層でのパリティを示すベンチマークを公表するや否や、下流のフレームワーク・メンテナーは本番比較可能ベンチマークを引用でき、モノリシック・モードのデフォルトを出荷する必要はなくなり、SGLangのラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤が同じ形に収束する並行的なアーキテクチャ系譜を提供することである。最も可能性の高い形状は、vLLM v0.12およびSGLang RadixArk v0.6リリースラインに文書化されたデフォルトとして追加されるディスアグリゲート・プリフィル/デコード・モードで、H100単一ノードとL40Sエッジ層トポロジをターゲットとする層別デプロイ・テンプレートに加え、本番運用準備性の主張をゲートするYottaスタイルの正準ベンチマーク・ハーネスを伴う。ソブリン・クラウドおよびオンプレのエージェンティックAIワークロードが最初に採用するのは、ツール結果キャッシュ再利用基盤が長いツールコール・チェーンに対するレイテンシ改善を複利化するためである。ベア・ケースは競合するサービング・スタック・アーキテクチャがディスアグリゲーション分割を拒否してベンチマーク手法をフォークする;それ以外の場合、Q4 2026はディスアグリゲート・プリフィルをオープンソース・サービング・コホート全体の文書化されたデフォルトとして着地させる。
description.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia de prefill desagregado del 9 de mayo fuerza la desagregación de prefill/decode fuera de la arquitectura edge específica de Cloudflare Infire y hacia el modo de servicio predeterminado documentado enviado por vLLM y SGLang en los niveles H100 y L40S. Los catalizadores que aterrizan en un solo ciclo de fin de semana son concretos y mutuamente reforzantes: vLLM v0.11.1 envía un modo de prefill desagregado que, según la nota de benchmark del sábado de la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire, alcanza paridad con la arquitectura edge de producción de Infire en throughput de prefill en el nivel H100, con Infire reteniendo solo una ventaja de 1.4x en el nivel edge L40S en latencia del lado-decode en lugar de la brecha de orden-de-magnitud que previamente mantuvo la desagregación fuera del stack de servicio open-source; la actualización de benchmark de Yotta Labs mantiene la carga canónica de prefijo compartido en aproximadamente 14,650 tok/s en vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s en SGLang RadixArk, estrechando la brecha de throughput a un nivel donde la elección arquitectónica (monolítica vs desagregada) domina el delta restante; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 envía una primitiva arquitectónica paralela en forma de reutilización de cache de resultados de tool-call consciente de RadixAttention entregando una aceleración de 2.1x en cargas agentic intensivas en tool-calls, demostrando que el sustrato de cache radix-tree se generaliza desde compartir prefijos hasta compartir resultados de tool-call; y el write-up red-team completo de Trail of Bits sobre SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 inyección de plantilla server-side autenticada) más el parche v0.11.1 para el CVE-2026-44512 de envenenamiento de prefix-cache divulgado el viernes convierten la narrativa de seguridad de un bloqueador a un patrón documentado de cronograma de divulgación. La fuerza estructural es que una vez que la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire publica un benchmark mostrando paridad en el nivel H100 entre su arquitectura edge de producción y el modo desagregado de un stack de servicio open-source, los mantenedores de marcos descendentes pueden citar el benchmark comparable a producción en lugar de enviar predeterminados de modo monolítico, y el sustrato de cache radix-tree de SGLang da un linaje arquitectónico paralelo que converge en la misma forma. La forma más probable es un modo prefill/decode desagregado agregado como el predeterminado documentado en las líneas de release vLLM v0.12 y SGLang RadixArk v0.6, con plantillas de despliegue por-nivel apuntando a topología H100 single-node y edge L40S, más un harness canónico de benchmark estilo Yotta que sirva de gate para la afirmación de production-readiness. Las cargas sovereign-cloud y agentic-AI on-prem lo adoptan primero porque el sustrato de reutilización de cache de tool-result compone la victoria de latencia para cadenas largas de tool-call. El caso bajista es una arquitectura competidora de stack de servicio rechazando la división de desagregación y bifurcando la metodología de benchmark; en ausencia de eso, Q4 2026 aterriza el prefill desagregado como el predeterminado documentado a través de la cohorte de servicio open-source.
description.fil: Sa Q4 2026 ang May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence ay pumipilit sa prefill/decode disaggregation na lumabas mula sa Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture at pumasok sa documented default serving mode na nag-ship ng vLLM at SGLang sa H100 at L40S tiers. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang weekend cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang vLLM v0.11.1 ay nag-ship ng disaggregated-prefill mode na, ayon sa Saturday benchmark note ng Cloudflare Infire engineering, ay umaabot sa parity sa production Infire edge architecture sa prefill throughput sa H100 tier, na ang Infire ay nag-iingat lamang ng 1.4x advantage sa L40S edge tier sa decode-side latency imbis na order-of-magnitude gap na dati ay nagpapanatili sa disaggregation sa labas ng open-source serving stack; ang Yotta Labs benchmark refresh ay hinahawakan ang canonical shared-prefix workload sa humigit-kumulang 14,650 tok/s sa vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s sa SGLang RadixArk, na nagpapakitid sa throughput gap sa antas kung saan ang architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) ay nangingibabaw sa natitirang delta; ang SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ay nag-ship ng parallel architectural primitive sa anyo ng RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse na naghahatid ng 2.1x speedup sa tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, na nagpapakita na ang radix-tree cache substrate ay nag-ge-generalize mula sa prefix sharing papasok sa tool-call result sharing; at ang Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up sa SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus ang v0.11.1 patch para sa prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 na inilathala nitong Friday ay nagko-convert sa security narrative mula sa blocker papasok sa documented disclosure-timeline pattern. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang Cloudflare Infire engineering ay maglathala ng benchmark na nagpapakita ng parity sa H100 tier sa pagitan ng production edge architecture nito at disaggregated mode ng open-source serving stack, ang downstream framework maintainers ay pwedeng banggitin ang production-comparable benchmark imbis na mag-ship ng monolithic-mode defaults, at ang SGLang radix-tree cache substrate ay nagbibigay ng parallel architectural lineage na nagko-converge sa parehong shape. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang disaggregated-prefill/decode mode na idinaragdag bilang documented default sa vLLM v0.12 at SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, na may per-tier deployment templates na nakatutok sa H100 single-node at L40S edge-tier topology, plus isang Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness na nagga-gate sa production-readiness claim. Ang sovereign-cloud at on-prem agentic-AI workloads ang unang nag-aadopt nito dahil ang tool-result-cache reuse substrate ay nagko-compound sa latency win para sa mahahabang tool-call chains. Ang bear case ay isang competing serving-stack architecture na tumatangging tanggapin ang disaggregation split at nag-fo-fork ng benchmark methodology; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa disaggregated prefill bilang documented default sa buong open-source serving cohort.

summary.en: By Q4 2026 the May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence forces prefill/decode disaggregation out of the Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture and into the documented default serving mode shipped by vLLM and SGLang at the H100 and L40S tiers. The catalysts landing across a single weekend cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: vLLM v0.11.1 ships a disaggregated-prefill mode that, per Cloudflare Infire engineering's Saturday benchmark note, reaches parity with the production Infire edge architecture on prefill throughput at the H100 tier, with Infire retaining only a 1.4x advantage at the L40S edge tier on decode-side latency rather than the order-of-magnitude gap that previously kept disaggregation out of the open-source serving stack; the Yotta Labs benchmark refresh holds the canonical shared-prefix workload at approximately 14,650 tok/s on vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk, narrowing the throughput gap to a level where the architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) dominates the remaining delta; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ships a parallel architectural primitive in the form of RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse delivering a 2.1x speedup on tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, demonstrating that the radix-tree cache substrate generalizes from prefix sharing to tool-call result sharing; and Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up on SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus the v0.11.1 patch for the prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 disclosed Friday convert the security narrative from a blocker to a documented disclosure-timeline pattern. The structural force is that once Cloudflare Infire engineering publishes a benchmark showing parity at the H100 tier between its production edge architecture and an open-source serving stack's disaggregated mode, downstream framework maintainers can cite the production-comparable benchmark rather than ship monolithic-mode defaults, and the SGLang radix-tree cache substrate gives a parallel architectural lineage that converges on the same shape. The most likely shape is a disaggregated-prefill/decode mode added as the documented default in the vLLM v0.12 and SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, with per-tier deployment templates targeting H100 single-node and L40S edge-tier topology, plus a Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness gating the production-readiness claim. Sovereign-cloud and on-prem agentic-AI workloads adopt it first because the tool-result-cache reuse substrate compounds the latency win for long tool-call chains. Bear case is a competing serving-stack architecture refusing the disaggregation split and forking the benchmark methodology; absent that, Q4 2026 lands disaggregated prefill as the documented default across the open-source serving cohort.

plain_language.en: Cloudflare proved vLLM matches its production speed when split into a prefill and decode stage, so other serving tools will copy the split.
plain_language.ja: Cloudflareがプリフィル段階とデコード段階に分割するとvLLMが本番速度に並ぶことを示したため、他のサービング・ツールもこの分割を真似る。
plain_language.es: Cloudflare demostró que vLLM iguala su velocidad de producción cuando se divide en una etapa de prefill y decode, así que otras herramientas de servicio copiarán la división.
plain_language.fil: Pinatunayan ng Cloudflare na tumutugma ang vLLM sa production speed nito kapag hinati sa prefill at decode stage, kaya kokopyahin ng iba pang serving tools ang split.

SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 adds tool-result-cache reuse. By Q4 2026 disaggregated prefill ships as documented default in vLLM and SGLang.

bridges.text: The serving stacks held a hold-steady weekend benchmark cycle ahead of the Monday vLLM v0.11.4 stable cut, with the vLLM-versus-SGLang throughput gap flat near 2.7 percent and Cloudflare Infire holding L40S edge parity at 1.00x. The canonical Yotta-style benchmark cadence persists, but the day's coverage centered on agent-loader mitigation rather than the prefill/decode disaggregation split itself.

text_locales.en: The serving stacks held a hold-steady weekend benchmark cycle ahead of the Monday vLLM v0.11.4 stable cut, with the vLLM-versus-SGLang throughput gap flat near 2.7 percent and Cloudflare Infire holding L40S edge parity at 1.00x. The canonical Yotta-style benchmark cadence persists, but the day's coverage centered on agent-loader mitigation rather than the prefill/decode disaggregation split itself.
text_locales.ja: サービングスタックは、5月18日(月)のvLLM v0.11.4安定版カットに先立ち維持的な週末のベンチマークサイクルを保ち、vLLM対SGLangのスループットの差は2.7パーセント近くで横ばい、Cloudflare InfireはL40Sエッジのパリティを1.00倍で維持した。標準的なYottaスタイルのベンチマークのリズムは続いているが、この日のカバレッジは、プリフィル／デコードの分離の分割ではなく、エージェントローダーの緩和を中心としていた。
text_locales.es: Las pilas de servicio mantuvieron un ciclo de benchmarks de estabilidad de fin de semana de cara al corte estable de vLLM v0.11.4 del lunes, con la brecha de rendimiento de vLLM frente a SGLang plana cerca del 2,7 por ciento y Cloudflare Infire manteniendo la paridad edge L40S en 1,00x. La cadencia de benchmarks canónica al estilo de Yotta persiste, pero la cobertura del día se centró en la mitigación de cargadores de agentes más que en la propia división prefill/decode.
text_locales.fil: Hinawakan ng serving stacks ang isang hold-steady weekend benchmark cycle bago ang Monday vLLM v0.11.4 stable cut, na ang vLLM-versus-SGLang throughput gap ay pantay malapit sa 2.7 porsiyento at hinahawakan ng Cloudflare Infire ang L40S edge parity sa 1.00x. Nagpapatuloy ang canonical Yotta-style benchmark cadence, ngunit nakasentro ang coverage ng araw sa agent-loader mitigation sa halip na ang prefill/decode disaggregation split mismo.

bridges.text: Friday's serving-stack activity covered the v0.11.4-rc2, RadixArk v0.5.9, and TGI v3.2.2 point releases, a throughput gap narrowing to 2.7 percent, and Cloudflare Infire holding L40S latency parity. None of this documents a disaggregated prefill/decode default mode entering the vLLM or SGLang release lines, so today's evidence does not touch the prediction's specific claim.

text_locales.en: Friday's serving-stack activity covered the v0.11.4-rc2, RadixArk v0.5.9, and TGI v3.2.2 point releases, a throughput gap narrowing to 2.7 percent, and Cloudflare Infire holding L40S latency parity. None of this documents a disaggregated prefill/decode default mode entering the vLLM or SGLang release lines, so today's evidence does not touch the prediction's specific claim.
text_locales.ja: 金曜の推論スタックの動きは、v0.11.4-rc2、RadixArk v0.5.9、TGI v3.2.2のポイントリリース、2.7パーセントへと縮まったスループット差、ならびにCloudflare InfireがL40Sのレイテンシの同等性を維持したことを網羅した。これらのいずれも、vLLMやSGLangのリリースラインに入る分散プリフィル/デコードの既定モードを文書化しておらず、本日の証拠は予測の固有の主張には触れていない。
text_locales.es: La actividad de las pilas de servicio del viernes cubrió las versiones puntuales v0.11.4-rc2, RadixArk v0.5.9 y TGI v3.2.2, una brecha de rendimiento estrechándose al 2,7 por ciento, y Cloudflare Infire manteniendo la paridad de latencia L40S. Nada de esto documenta un modo por defecto de prefill/decode desagregado entrando en las líneas de versiones de vLLM o SGLang, por lo que la evidencia de hoy no toca la afirmación específica de la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Sinaklaw ng Biyernes serving-stack activity ang v0.11.4-rc2, RadixArk v0.5.9, at TGI v3.2.2 point releases, isang throughput gap na pumipikli tungo sa 2.7 porsyento, at ang Cloudflare Infire na nananatili sa L40S latency parity. Wala sa mga ito ang nagdodokumento ng isang disaggregated prefill/decode default mode na pumapasok sa vLLM o SGLang release lines, kaya ang ebidensya ngayon ay hindi humahawak sa partikular na pag-aangkin ng prediction.

bridges.text: vLLM v0.11.4-rc1, SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8, and TGI v3.2.1 ship Thursday point releases consolidating the signed-checkpoint loader default across all three open-source serving stacks while adding the intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization mitigation, with the throughput gap narrowing to 4.3 percent and Cloudflare Infire reaching 1.00x parity; the substrate continues to mature toward the disaggregated-prefill primitive even though Thursday's headline lands on the signed-load surface rather than disaggregated prefill directly.

text_locales.en: vLLM v0.11.4-rc1, SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8, and TGI v3.2.1 ship Thursday point releases consolidating the signed-checkpoint loader default across all three open-source serving stacks while adding the intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization mitigation, with the throughput gap narrowing to 4.3 percent and Cloudflare Infire reaching 1.00x parity; the substrate continues to mature toward the disaggregated-prefill primitive even though Thursday's headline lands on the signed-load surface rather than disaggregated prefill directly.
text_locales.ja: vLLM v0.11.4-rc1、SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8、TGI v3.2.1は木曜日のポイントリリースとして、3つのオープンソース推論スタック全体で署名済みチェックポイントローダの既定化を統合しつつ、中間状態シリアライザの正規化緩和策を追加した。スループット差は4.3パーセントへ縮小し、Cloudflare Infireは1.00倍の同等性に到達した。基盤は分離プリフィルのプリミティブへ向けた成熟を続けているものの、木曜日の見出しは分離プリフィルそのものではなく、署名済みロードのサーフェスに着地した。
text_locales.es: El borrador de trabajo de la directiva operativa federal-civil de CISA, que incorpora la taxonomía de Trail of Bits ahora ampliada a diez CVEs, supera la revisión formal entre agencias y entra en la cola de publicación de la OMB según los reportes en cable del jueves, con la fecha límite de remediación KEV del 21 de mayo a T-menos-siete días hábiles; Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne y, recién incorporado, Palo Alto Cortex XDR publican la primera línea base de atribución C2 de cuatro proveedores y nueve frameworks, añadiendo Winnti y PlugX, mientras que Trail of Bits extiende la taxonomía de nueve a diez CVEs.
text_locales.fil: Nag-ship ang vLLM v0.11.4-rc1, SGLang RadixArk v0.5.8, at TGI v3.2.1 ng Thursday point releases na nagko-consolidate ng signed-checkpoint loader default sa kabuuan ng lahat ng tatlong open-source serving stacks habang nagdaragdag ng intermediate-state-serializer canonicalization mitigation, kasama ang throughput gap na lumiliit sa 4.3 percent at ang Cloudflare Infire na inaabot ang 1.00x parity; patuloy na umuusbong ang substrate patungo sa disaggregated-prefill primitive kahit lumalapag ang Thursday headline sa signed-load surface sa halip na disaggregated prefill direkta.

bridges.text: vLLM v0.11.3 Wednesday point release pairs the tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill mode with the first open-source serving-tier signed-checkpoint loader; Yotta Labs's canonical benchmark refresh narrows the vLLM-SGLang RadixArk throughput gap to 9.1 percent (from 9.4 percent Tuesday); Cloudflare Infire's Wednesday note closes the L40S edge-tier latency gap to a 1.12x Infire advantage (from 1.18x Tuesday) with parity projected at v0.11.4 late-May; arxiv 2605.05844 v5 confirms long-context RL stability against v0.11.3.

text_locales.en: vLLM v0.11.3 Wednesday point release pairs the tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill mode with the first open-source serving-tier signed-checkpoint loader; Yotta Labs's canonical benchmark refresh narrows the vLLM-SGLang RadixArk throughput gap to 9.1 percent (from 9.4 percent Tuesday); Cloudflare Infire's Wednesday note closes the L40S edge-tier latency gap to a 1.12x Infire advantage (from 1.18x Tuesday) with parity projected at v0.11.4 late-May; arxiv 2605.05844 v5 confirms long-context RL stability against v0.11.3.
text_locales.ja: vLLM v0.11.3の水曜版ポイントリリースは、テンソル並列ディスアグリゲーテッド・プリフィルモードと、オープンソース・サービングティアとして初の署名付きチェックポイントローダーを併載した。Yotta Labsの公式ベンチマーク更新ではvLLM対SGLang RadixArkのスループット差が9.1%(火曜の9.4%から)まで縮小し、Cloudflare Infireの水曜版メモはL40Sエッジティアのレイテンシ差をInfire側1.12倍優位(火曜の1.18倍から)まで縮め、5月下旬のv0.11.4で同等まで到達する見通しを示した。arxiv 2605.05844 v5はv0.11.3との長文脈強化学習の安定性を確認している。
text_locales.es: El point release del miercoles de vLLM v0.11.3 empareja el modo de prefill desagregado con paralelismo tensorial con el primer cargador de checkpoint firmado de la capa de servicio de codigo abierto; la actualizacion del benchmark canonico de Yotta Labs estrecha la brecha de rendimiento vLLM-SGLang RadixArk al 9,1 por ciento (desde el 9,4 por ciento del martes); la nota del miercoles de Cloudflare Infire cierra la brecha de latencia de la capa edge L40S a una ventaja de 1,12x de Infire (desde 1,18x del martes) con paridad proyectada en v0.11.4 a finales de mayo; arxiv 2605.05844 v5 confirma la estabilidad del RL de contexto largo contra v0.11.3.
text_locales.fil: Ipinares ng vLLM v0.11.3 Miyerkules point release ang tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill mode sa unang open-source serving-tier signed-checkpoint loader; pinaiikli ng Yotta Labs canonical benchmark refresh ang vLLM-SGLang RadixArk throughput gap sa 9.1 percent (mula 9.4 percent Martes); pinaiikli ng Miyerkules note ng Cloudflare Infire ang L40S edge-tier latency gap sa 1.12x Infire advantage (mula 1.18x Martes) kasama ang parity na inaasahan sa v0.11.4 late-May; kinukumpirma ng arxiv 2605.05844 v5 ang long-context RL stability laban sa v0.11.3.

text_locales.es: La versión puntual del martes de vLLM v0.11.3 empareja el modo tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill con el primer loader signed-checkpoint de tier-serving open-source; el refresh del benchmark canónico de Yotta Labs estrecha la brecha de throughput vLLM-SGLang RadixArk al 9.4 por ciento (desde 11.3 por ciento el lunes); la nota del martes de Cloudflare Infire cierra la brecha de latencia del tier L40S edge a una ventaja Infire de 1.18x (desde 1.25x el lunes) con paridad proyectada en v0.11.4 a finales-de-mayo; arxiv 2605.05844 v5 confirma estabilidad RL de contexto-largo contra v0.11.3.

bridges.text: On the disaggregated-prefill vLLM-and-SGLang default prediction (May 10): vLLM v0.11.2 ships a Monday point release adding a tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill mode on dual-H100 SXM5 plus PCIe workstation tiers, Cloudflare Infire's Monday addendum reports the L40S edge-tier Infire advantage narrows to 1.25x (down from 1.40x Sunday), the Yotta canonical refresh narrows the vLLM-SGLang RadixArk gap to 11.3 percent (from 16.7 percent Sunday), and arxiv 2605.05844 v4 confirms long-context RL stability on the new tensor-parallel setup with pre-tested integration against v0.11.2.

text_locales.en: On the disaggregated-prefill vLLM-and-SGLang default prediction (May 10): vLLM v0.11.2 ships a Monday point release adding a tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill mode on dual-H100 SXM5 plus PCIe workstation tiers, Cloudflare Infire's Monday addendum reports the L40S edge-tier Infire advantage narrows to 1.25x (down from 1.40x Sunday), the Yotta canonical refresh narrows the vLLM-SGLang RadixArk gap to 11.3 percent (from 16.7 percent Sunday), and arxiv 2605.05844 v4 confirms long-context RL stability on the new tensor-parallel setup with pre-tested integration against v0.11.2.
text_locales.ja: ディスアグリゲート・プリフィルvLLMとSGLangデフォルト予測(5月10日)について: vLLM v0.11.2はデュアルH100 SXM5プラスPCIeワークステーション層上のテンソル並列ディスアグリゲート・プリフィル・モードを追加する月曜ポイント・リリースを出荷し、Cloudflare Infireの月曜追補はL40Sエッジ層Infire優位が1.25倍(日曜の1.40倍から低下)に縮小すると報告し、Yotta正準リフレッシュはvLLM-SGLang RadixArkギャップを11.3パーセント(日曜の16.7パーセントから)に縮小し、arxiv 2605.05844 v4はv0.11.2に対する事前テスト済み統合を伴う新しいテンソル並列セットアップ上のロング・コンテキストRL安定性を確認する。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de disaggregated-prefill como default vLLM-y-SGLang (10 de mayo): vLLM v0.11.2 envía una versión puntual del lunes añadiendo un modo tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill sobre tiers de workstation dual-H100 SXM5 más PCIe, el addendum del lunes de Cloudflare Infire reporta que la ventaja Infire del tier L40S edge se estrecha a 1.25x (bajando de 1.40x el domingo), el refresh canónico de Yotta estrecha la brecha vLLM-SGLang RadixArk a 11.3 por ciento (desde 16.7 por ciento el domingo), y arxiv 2605.05844 v4 confirma estabilidad RL de contexto largo en el nuevo setup tensor-parallel con integración pre-probada contra v0.11.2.
text_locales.fil: Sa disaggregated-prefill vLLM-and-SGLang default prediction (Mayo 10): nag-ship ang vLLM v0.11.2 ng Monday point release na nagdaragdag ng tensor-parallel disaggregated-prefill mode sa dual-H100 SXM5 plus PCIe workstation tiers, iniuulat ng Monday addendum ng Cloudflare Infire na ang L40S edge-tier Infire advantage ay pinapaliit sa 1.25x (mula sa 1.40x Sunday), pinapaliit ng Yotta canonical refresh ang vLLM-SGLang RadixArk gap sa 11.3 percent (mula sa 16.7 percent Sunday), at kinukumpirma ng arxiv 2605.05844 v4 ang long-context RL stability sa bagong tensor-parallel setup na may pre-tested integration kontra sa v0.11.2.

bridges.text: On the disaggregated-prefill default prediction (May 10): the day's evidence is the catalyst stack itself landing in a single weekend. Cloudflare Infire's Sunday addendum holds vLLM v0.11.1 disaggregated mode at H100 parity with only a 1.6x decode advantage retained at the L40S tier; the Yotta Pareto refresh narrows the vLLM-versus-SGLang RadixArk gap to architecture-dominant territory; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 generalizes the radix-tree substrate to tool-result-cache reuse; and Trail of Bits's coordinated-disclosure supplementary on CVE-2026-44567 across LMDeploy, TGI, and TensorRT-LLM converts the security overhang into a documented disclosure pattern.

text_locales.en: On the disaggregated-prefill default prediction (May 10): the day's evidence is the catalyst stack itself landing in a single weekend. Cloudflare Infire's Sunday addendum holds vLLM v0.11.1 disaggregated mode at H100 parity with only a 1.6x decode advantage retained at the L40S tier; the Yotta Pareto refresh narrows the vLLM-versus-SGLang RadixArk gap to architecture-dominant territory; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 generalizes the radix-tree substrate to tool-result-cache reuse; and Trail of Bits's coordinated-disclosure supplementary on CVE-2026-44567 across LMDeploy, TGI, and TensorRT-LLM converts the security overhang into a documented disclosure pattern.
text_locales.ja: ディスアグリゲート・プリフィル・デフォルト予測(5月10日)について: 本日のエビデンスは触媒スタック自体が単一週末内に着地している。Cloudflare Infireの日曜追補がvLLM v0.11.1ディスアグリゲート・モードをH100パリティで維持し、L40Sティアで1.6倍のデコード優位のみを残す;Yotta Paretoリフレッシュはアーキテクチャ支配的領域へvLLM対SGLang RadixArkギャップを縮める;SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4はラディックス・ツリー基板をツール結果キャッシュ再利用へ一般化する;Trail of BitsのLMDeploy、TGI、TensorRT-LLMにわたるCVE-2026-44567協調開示補足は、セキュリティ・オーバーハングを文書化された開示パターンへ転換する。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de disaggregated-prefill como default (10 de mayo): la evidencia del día es la propia pila de catalizadores aterrizando en un solo fin de semana. El addendum del domingo de Cloudflare Infire mantiene vLLM v0.11.1 en modo disaggregated a paridad H100 con solo una ventaja de decode 1.6x retenida en el tier L40S; el refresh de Pareto de Yotta estrecha la brecha vLLM-vs-SGLang RadixArk a territorio dominado por arquitectura; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 generaliza el sustrato radix-tree a reutilización de tool-result-cache; y el suplementario de divulgación coordinada de Trail of Bits sobre CVE-2026-44567 a través de LMDeploy, TGI y TensorRT-LLM convierte el overhang de seguridad en un patrón documentado de divulgación.
text_locales.fil: Sa disaggregated-prefill default prediction (Mayo 10): ang ebidensya ng araw ay ang catalyst stack mismo na lumalapag sa isang weekend. Hawak ng Sunday addendum ng Cloudflare Infire ang vLLM v0.11.1 disaggregated mode sa H100 parity na may 1.6x decode advantage na lamang na nananatili sa L40S tier; pinapaliit ng Yotta Pareto refresh ang vLLM-versus-SGLang RadixArk gap papunta sa architecture-dominant territory; nag-ge-generalize ang SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ng radix-tree substrate patungo sa tool-result-cache reuse; at kino-convert ng coordinated-disclosure supplementary ng Trail of Bits sa CVE-2026-44567 sa LMDeploy, TGI, at TensorRT-LLM ang security overhang papunta sa documented disclosure pattern.

outcome_locales.en: SGLang RadixArk v0.6 ships disaggregated prefill/decode as documented default, with the radix-tree cache substrate generalized across prefix sharing and tool-call result sharing, the CVE-2026-44567 SSTI fix bundled, and per-tier H100/L40S templates aligned to the Yotta canonical workload.
outcome_locales.ja: SGLang RadixArk v0.6がディスアグリゲート・プリフィル/デコードを文書化されたデフォルトとして、ラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤がプレフィックス共有とツールコール結果共有全体に一般化され、CVE-2026-44567 SSTI修正がバンドルされ、層別H100/L40SテンプレートがYotta正準ワークロードに整合する形で出荷する。
outcome_locales.es: SGLang RadixArk v0.6 envía prefill/decode desagregado como predeterminado documentado, con el sustrato de cache radix-tree generalizado a través de compartir prefijos y compartir resultados de tool-call, el fix del SSTI CVE-2026-44567 incluido, y plantillas H100/L40S por-nivel alineadas a la carga canónica de Yotta.
outcome_locales.fil: Nag-ship ang SGLang RadixArk v0.6 ng disaggregated prefill/decode bilang documented default, kasama ang radix-tree cache substrate na na-generalize sa prefix sharing at tool-call result sharing, ang CVE-2026-44567 SSTI fix na nabundle, at per-tier H100/L40S templates na naka-align sa Yotta canonical workload.

motivation_locales.en: The 14.65k vs 17.3k tok/s gap is already inside the architectural-choice band; if vLLM's v0.12 disaggregated default ships first without SGLang's parallel radix lineage as a peer, the sovereign-cloud and agentic-AI cohort defaults to vLLM and the radix-tree substrate loses its narrative.
motivation_locales.ja: 14.65k対17.3k tok/sのギャップは既にアーキテクチャ選択バンド内である;vLLMのv0.12ディスアグリゲート・デフォルトがSGLangの並行ラディックス系譜なしに先に出荷される場合、ソブリン・クラウドとエージェンティックAIコホートはvLLMへデフォルト化し、ラディックス・ツリー基盤はナラティブを失う。
motivation_locales.es: La brecha de 14.65k vs 17.3k tok/s ya está dentro de la banda de elección-arquitectónica; si el predeterminado desagregado v0.12 de vLLM se envía primero sin el linaje radix paralelo de SGLang como par, la cohorte sovereign-cloud y agentic-AI predetermina a vLLM y el sustrato radix-tree pierde su narrativa.
motivation_locales.fil: Ang 14.65k vs 17.3k tok/s gap ay nasa loob na ng architectural-choice band; kung mag-ship muna ang v0.12 disaggregated default ng vLLM nang walang parallel radix lineage ng SGLang bilang peer, ang sovereign-cloud at agentic-AI cohort ay nag-de-default sa vLLM at ang radix-tree substrate ay mawawalan ng narrative nito.

detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence forces prefill/decode disaggregation out of the Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture and into the documented default serving mode shipped by vLLM and SGLang at the H100 and L40S tiers. The catalysts landing across a single weekend cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: vLLM v0.11.1 ships a disaggregated-prefill mode that, per Cloudflare Infire engineering's Saturday benchmark note, reaches parity with the production Infire edge architecture on prefill throughput at the H100 tier, with Infire retaining only a 1.4x advantage at the L40S edge tier on decode-side latency rather than the order-of-magnitude gap that previously kept disaggregation out of the open-source serving stack; the Yotta Labs benchmark refresh holds the canonical shared-prefix workload at approximately 14,650 tok/s on vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk, narrowing the throughput gap to a level where the architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) dominates the remaining delta; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ships a parallel architectural primitive in the form of RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse delivering a 2.1x speedup on tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, demonstrating that the radix-tree cache substrate generalizes from prefix sharing to tool-call result sharing; and Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up on SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus the v0.11.1 patch for the prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 disclosed Friday convert the security narrative from a blocker to a documented disclosure-timeline pattern. The structural force is that once Cloudflare Infire engineering publishes a benchmark showing parity at the H100 tier between its production edge architecture and an open-source serving stack's disaggregated mode, downstream framework maintainers can cite the production-comparable benchmark rather than ship monolithic-mode defaults, and the SGLang radix-tree cache substrate gives a parallel architectural lineage that converges on the same shape. The most likely shape is a disaggregated-prefill/decode mode added as the documented default in the vLLM v0.12 and SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, with per-tier deployment templates targeting H100 single-node and L40S edge-tier topology, plus a Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness gating the production-readiness claim. Sovereign-cloud and on-prem agentic-AI workloads adopt it first because the tool-result-cache reuse substrate compounds the latency win for long tool-call chains. Bear case is a competing serving-stack architecture refusing the disaggregation split and forking the benchmark methodology; absent that, Q4 2026 lands disaggregated prefill as the documented default across the open-source serving cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Q4 2026までに、5月9日のディスアグリゲート・プリフィル収束は、プリフィル/デコード・ディスアグリゲーションをCloudflare-Infire特有のエッジ・アーキテクチャから押し出し、vLLMとSGLangがH100およびL40S層で出荷する文書化されたデフォルト・サービング・モードへと移行させる。単一の週末サイクルで着地する触媒は具体的かつ相互強化的である: vLLM v0.11.1はディスアグリゲート・プリフィル・モードを出荷し、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングの土曜ベンチマーク・ノートによれば、H100層でのプリフィル・スループットにおいて本番Infireエッジ・アーキテクチャと同等水準に達し、Infireはデコード側レイテンシでL40Sエッジ層に1.4倍の優位を残すのみで、これまでディスアグリゲーションをオープンソース・サービング・スタックから遠ざけていた桁違いのギャップは解消された;Yotta Labsのベンチマーク・リフレッシュは、正準共有プレフィックス・ワークロードをvLLMで約14,650 tok/s、SGLang RadixArkで17,300 tok/sに維持し、スループット・ギャップを、残るデルタをアーキテクチャ選択(モノリシック対ディスアグリゲート)が支配する水準まで狭める;SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4は並行的なアーキテクチャ・プリミティブを、RadixAttention対応のツール結果キャッシュ再利用としてエージェンティック・ワークロードに対し2.1倍の高速化として出荷し、ラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤がプレフィックス共有からツールコール結果共有へと一般化することを実証する;そしてTrail of BitsのSGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567(CVSS 8.1の認証済みサーバーサイド・テンプレート・インジェクション)に対する完全レッドチーム・ライトアップに加え、金曜開示のプレフィックス・キャッシュ汚染CVE-2026-44512に対するv0.11.1パッチが、セキュリティ・ナラティブをブロッカーから文書化された開示タイムライン・パターンへと変える。構造的な力は、Cloudflare Infireエンジニアリングが本番エッジ・アーキテクチャとオープンソース・サービング・スタックのディスアグリゲート・モードの間でH100層でのパリティを示すベンチマークを公表するや否や、下流のフレームワーク・メンテナーは本番比較可能ベンチマークを引用でき、モノリシック・モードのデフォルトを出荷する必要はなくなり、SGLangのラディックス・ツリー・キャッシュ基盤が同じ形に収束する並行的なアーキテクチャ系譜を提供することである。最も可能性の高い形状は、vLLM v0.12およびSGLang RadixArk v0.6リリースラインに文書化されたデフォルトとして追加されるディスアグリゲート・プリフィル/デコード・モードで、H100単一ノードとL40Sエッジ層トポロジをターゲットとする層別デプロイ・テンプレートに加え、本番運用準備性の主張をゲートするYottaスタイルの正準ベンチマーク・ハーネスを伴う。ソブリン・クラウドおよびオンプレのエージェンティックAIワークロードが最初に採用するのは、ツール結果キャッシュ再利用基盤が長いツールコール・チェーンに対するレイテンシ改善を複利化するためである。ベア・ケースは競合するサービング・スタック・アーキテクチャがディスアグリゲーション分割を拒否してベンチマーク手法をフォークする;それ以外の場合、Q4 2026はディスアグリゲート・プリフィルをオープンソース・サービング・コホート全体の文書化されたデフォルトとして着地させる。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia de prefill desagregado del 9 de mayo fuerza la desagregación de prefill/decode fuera de la arquitectura edge específica de Cloudflare Infire y hacia el modo de servicio predeterminado documentado enviado por vLLM y SGLang en los niveles H100 y L40S. Los catalizadores que aterrizan en un solo ciclo de fin de semana son concretos y mutuamente reforzantes: vLLM v0.11.1 envía un modo de prefill desagregado que, según la nota de benchmark del sábado de la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire, alcanza paridad con la arquitectura edge de producción de Infire en throughput de prefill en el nivel H100, con Infire reteniendo solo una ventaja de 1.4x en el nivel edge L40S en latencia del lado-decode en lugar de la brecha de orden-de-magnitud que previamente mantuvo la desagregación fuera del stack de servicio open-source; la actualización de benchmark de Yotta Labs mantiene la carga canónica de prefijo compartido en aproximadamente 14,650 tok/s en vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s en SGLang RadixArk, estrechando la brecha de throughput a un nivel donde la elección arquitectónica (monolítica vs desagregada) domina el delta restante; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 envía una primitiva arquitectónica paralela en forma de reutilización de cache de resultados de tool-call consciente de RadixAttention entregando una aceleración de 2.1x en cargas agentic intensivas en tool-calls, demostrando que el sustrato de cache radix-tree se generaliza desde compartir prefijos hasta compartir resultados de tool-call; y el write-up red-team completo de Trail of Bits sobre SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 inyección de plantilla server-side autenticada) más el parche v0.11.1 para el CVE-2026-44512 de envenenamiento de prefix-cache divulgado el viernes convierten la narrativa de seguridad de un bloqueador a un patrón documentado de cronograma de divulgación. La fuerza estructural es que una vez que la ingeniería de Cloudflare Infire publica un benchmark mostrando paridad en el nivel H100 entre su arquitectura edge de producción y el modo desagregado de un stack de servicio open-source, los mantenedores de marcos descendentes pueden citar el benchmark comparable a producción en lugar de enviar predeterminados de modo monolítico, y el sustrato de cache radix-tree de SGLang da un linaje arquitectónico paralelo que converge en la misma forma. La forma más probable es un modo prefill/decode desagregado agregado como el predeterminado documentado en las líneas de release vLLM v0.12 y SGLang RadixArk v0.6, con plantillas de despliegue por-nivel apuntando a topología H100 single-node y edge L40S, más un harness canónico de benchmark estilo Yotta que sirva de gate para la afirmación de production-readiness. Las cargas sovereign-cloud y agentic-AI on-prem lo adoptan primero porque el sustrato de reutilización de cache de tool-result compone la victoria de latencia para cadenas largas de tool-call. El caso bajista es una arquitectura competidora de stack de servicio rechazando la división de desagregación y bifurcando la metodología de benchmark; en ausencia de eso, Q4 2026 aterriza el prefill desagregado como el predeterminado documentado a través de la cohorte de servicio open-source.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Sa Q4 2026 ang May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence ay pumipilit sa prefill/decode disaggregation na lumabas mula sa Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture at pumasok sa documented default serving mode na nag-ship ng vLLM at SGLang sa H100 at L40S tiers. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang weekend cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang vLLM v0.11.1 ay nag-ship ng disaggregated-prefill mode na, ayon sa Saturday benchmark note ng Cloudflare Infire engineering, ay umaabot sa parity sa production Infire edge architecture sa prefill throughput sa H100 tier, na ang Infire ay nag-iingat lamang ng 1.4x advantage sa L40S edge tier sa decode-side latency imbis na order-of-magnitude gap na dati ay nagpapanatili sa disaggregation sa labas ng open-source serving stack; ang Yotta Labs benchmark refresh ay hinahawakan ang canonical shared-prefix workload sa humigit-kumulang 14,650 tok/s sa vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s sa SGLang RadixArk, na nagpapakitid sa throughput gap sa antas kung saan ang architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) ay nangingibabaw sa natitirang delta; ang SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ay nag-ship ng parallel architectural primitive sa anyo ng RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse na naghahatid ng 2.1x speedup sa tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, na nagpapakita na ang radix-tree cache substrate ay nag-ge-generalize mula sa prefix sharing papasok sa tool-call result sharing; at ang Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up sa SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus ang v0.11.1 patch para sa prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 na inilathala nitong Friday ay nagko-convert sa security narrative mula sa blocker papasok sa documented disclosure-timeline pattern. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang Cloudflare Infire engineering ay maglathala ng benchmark na nagpapakita ng parity sa H100 tier sa pagitan ng production edge architecture nito at disaggregated mode ng open-source serving stack, ang downstream framework maintainers ay pwedeng banggitin ang production-comparable benchmark imbis na mag-ship ng monolithic-mode defaults, at ang SGLang radix-tree cache substrate ay nagbibigay ng parallel architectural lineage na nagko-converge sa parehong shape. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang disaggregated-prefill/decode mode na idinaragdag bilang documented default sa vLLM v0.12 at SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, na may per-tier deployment templates na nakatutok sa H100 single-node at L40S edge-tier topology, plus isang Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness na nagga-gate sa production-readiness claim. Ang sovereign-cloud at on-prem agentic-AI workloads ang unang nag-aadopt nito dahil ang tool-result-cache reuse substrate ay nagko-compound sa latency win para sa mahahabang tool-call chains. Ang bear case ay isang competing serving-stack architecture na tumatangging tanggapin ang disaggregation split at nag-fo-fork ng benchmark methodology; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa disaggregated prefill bilang documented default sa buong open-source serving cohort.

nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the Chinese frontier-open Mixture-of-Experts checkpoint cohort — Alibaba's Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B that landed on OpenRouter Thursday morning Pacific time plus the rolling-cadence successors lining up behind it (the Tsinghua KEG Lab MiniMax M2.7 235B port that already shipped through Unsloth v2026.5.26, DeepSeek-V4-Pro on the same OpenRouter board at the $1.10 input-token tier, and the Moonshot Kimi K3 plus Zhipu GLM-5 checkpoints publicly committed to a June rolling-cadence OpenRouter integration) crosses a 15 percent floor on OpenRouter's daily completion-volume share — the first time the Chinese frontier-open MoE cohort treats OpenRouter as a structurally-anchored distribution surface rather than a permissioned showcase. Thursday's first-six-hour routing telemetry on Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B already lifted the model to 4.7 percent of total OpenRouter completion volume across all listed models — the third-highest first-day share for any new model on the gateway behind only GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 — with median first-token latency holding at 0.16 seconds across the five-provider hosted pool (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, Together AI, Fireworks AI, Hyperbolic, DeepInfra) and the default lowest-price-first routing policy landing roughly 73 percent of requests on Together AI plus Fireworks AI on the back of their FP8 quantization tier. Hugging Face's Thursday hosted-endpoint dashboard separately recorded the model crossing 1.04 million completion requests in the first eight hours of OpenRouter availability, and Simon Willison flagged the integration as the first Chinese frontier-open MoE checkpoint to land on OpenRouter inside its scheduled vendor-announced calendar window without slippage — the precondition that breaks the prior pattern of Chinese open checkpoints arriving on the gateway with weeks of slippage and price-floor-uncertainty that kept the routing-policy default skewed against them. The structural force is that once a Chinese frontier-open MoE checkpoint lands on on launch day across five hosted providers at a $0.45 per million input-token floor that undercuts DeepSeek-V4-Pro at $1.10 and Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 at $7.50, the lowest-price-first routing policy pulls structural traffic onto the cohort automatically, the vLLM v0.11.5-rc1 expert-fused-router pass already serves the same checkpoint at 22,140 tokens per second on the Yotta Labs benchmark with 79.4 percent prefill cache hit-rate, and the Mistral Workflows five-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix that hit GA two weeks ahead of schedule normalizes calling these checkpoints from inside enterprise agent harnesses without per-vendor adapter friction. The most likely landing is that by Q3 2026 OpenRouter's daily completion-volume share for the Chinese frontier-open MoE cohort crosses 15 percent on the rolling seven-day median — driven by Qwen3.6-Max-Preview-235B holding the high single digits plus at least two of the three June-cohort integrations (DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu) clearing 2 percent each — with at least one US-headquartered hyperscaler-managed inference tier publishing a public BYO-checkpoint configuration page citing the OpenRouter price-floor cohort as the reference comparand. Bear case is a US Commerce Department BIS export-control adjustment that bars one of the five hosted providers from continuing to serve the cohort inside the Q3 window, capping share at 9 to 11 percent; absent that intervention, Q3 2026 lands the Chinese frontier-open MoE cohort at a structural 15 percent OpenRouter share floor.
